papers.title: Quantum ring all-reduce: communication and privacy advantages for distributed learning
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models have scaled to unprecedented sizes, making training across distributed devices the de facto standard in the field. In this work, we explore how quantum communications can make distributed training both more communication-efficient and information-theoretically private, for both classical and quantum learning models. Ring all-reduce is the foundational communication primitive for large-scale distributed training. We present a quantum version that reduces per-link online communication by a provably optimal factor of two using pre-shared entanglement and superdense coding, without requiring the learning model or gradient computation to change. Beyond bandwidth, the primitive enables privacy guarantees that are information-theoretically impossible for any classical protocol, achieving composable ε-secure aggregation, via verified entanglement, at a 2x overhead in GHZ copies. Our hybrid quantum-classical communication architecture yields simultaneous communication and security advantages for large scale distributed training, regardless of whether the learning itself is quantum or classical. Finally, we characterise quantum advantages in gradient conflict detection for server-to-client communication under bandwidth constraints, a setting that arises after ring all-reduce is completed, when full gradient broadcast to external clients is infeasible. Two variants of the problem admit different separations. For margin-based alignment testing (\textsc{GapIP}_τ), the quantum advantage is quadratic in the margin parameter: \widetilde{O}(τ^{-1}\log P) qubits versus \widetilde{O}(\min(\τ^{-2},P)) bits. For sign-consistency auditing against a private parameter matching (\textsc{TieAudit}_ε), the advantage represents an exponential separation in communication complexity: Ω(\sqrt{P}) bits whereas O(ε^{-2}\log P) qubits suffice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子环归约（Quantum ring all-reduce）协议，利用预共享纠缠和超密编码将分布式训练中每链路的通信量降低至最优的1/2，同时通过验证纠缠实现信息论安全的可组合ε-安全聚合，在GHZ副本上仅有2倍开销。该混合量子-经典架构在不改变学习模型或梯度计算的前提下，同时获得通信和隐私优势，适用于经典和量子学习模型。此外，在带宽受限下，针对梯度冲突检测的两个变体（GapIP_τ和TieAudit_ε）展现了量子优势：前者在边际参数上有二次改进，后者在通信复杂度上呈指数分离。
Motivation: 大型机器学习模型的分布式训练依赖于环归约通信原语，但经典协议在通信效率和隐私保护方面存在固有瓶颈，且无法同时实现信息论安全的聚合。
Method: 提出基于预共享纠缠和超密编码的量子环归约协议，以及利用验证纠缠实现可组合ε-安全聚合的方案；并分析两种梯度冲突检测问题的量子通信复杂度优势。
Result: 每链路在线通信量减少一半；可组合ε-安全聚合的量子协议以2倍GHZ副本开销实现信息论安全；GapIP_τ问题的量子比特复杂度为Õ(τ⁻¹log P)，优于经典比特的Õ(min(τ⁻²,P))；TieAudit_ε问题的量子复杂度为O(ε⁻²log P)，而经典下界为Ω(√P)比特。
Conclusion: 量子通信能在分布式训练中同时带来通信效率和隐私保护的优势，且不依赖学习模型是经典还是量子；梯度冲突检测中的量子优势可为未来通信受限场景提供理论依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SoftSkill: Behavioral Compression for Contextual Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills are commonly deployed as natural-language Markdown files that encode answer policies, evidence-use habits, and task procedures. These files are readable and portable, but they are consumed indirectly: for each task instance, a frozen language model must translate a long textual artifact into generation-time behavior. This paper asks whether a natural-language skill can instead initialize a compact continuous context object, refined by a trainable soft delta while the base model remains frozen. We propose SoftSkill, a frozen-backbone method that tunes such soft skills with next-token prediction and deploys them as latent behavioral priors at inference time. In our main single-round setting, a length-32 SoftSkill prefix on Qwen3.5-4B improves over no-skill prompting by 8.3 points on SearchQA, 42.1 points on LiveMath, and 1.3 points on DocVQA. Relative to SkillOpt, SoftSkill improves accuracy by 5.2 points on SearchQA and 12.5 points on LiveMath, while replacing hundreds to thousands of Markdown skill tokens with a few virtual tokens. We further study agentic execution as a harder boundary case, where sparse trajectory imitation provides useful signal but does not yet robustly compress long-horizon procedural behavior. More broadly, the results suggest that some task skills are better treated not as additional Markdown to be reinterpreted at inference time, but as compact latent controls over how a frozen model enters the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SoftSkill方法，将自然语言技能文件压缩为紧凑的连续上下文对象（soft skill），通过可训练软增量调整，基模型冻结。在单轮设置中，长度32的SoftSkill前缀在SearchQA、LiveMath、DocVQA上分别提升8.3、42.1、1.3个点，并优于SkillOpt。还研究了代理执行作为硬边界情况。结果表明任务技能更适合作为潜在控制而非重新解释的Markdown。
Motivation: 现有agent技能以自然语言Markdown文件部署，但推理时需冻结语言模型重新解释长文本，效率低。本文探索能否用紧凑连续上下文对象初始化技能。
Method: 提出SoftSkill，一种冻结骨干方法，通过下一个token预测调整软技能，推理时作为潜在行为先验部署。
Result: 在单轮设置中，长度32的SoftSkill前缀在SearchQA上提升8.3点，LiveMath上42.1点，DocVQA上1.3点。相对SkillOpt，SearchQA提升5.2，LiveMath提升12.5，且用少量虚拟token替代数百至数千Markdown技能token。
Conclusion: 结果表明任务技能更适合作为紧凑潜在控制，而非推理时重新解释的Markdown。

papers.title: Constrained hybrid modelling to predict microbial dynamics and organic matter turnover in soil systems
papers.abstract_en: Soil microorganisms control organic matter cycling and largely determine how soil systems can cope with and mitigate climate change and environmental threats. Representing microbial dynamics in process-based soil models is therefore critical to predict carbon cycling in soils, albeit highly challenging to inform from data. One promising approach to improve their parametrisation is the integration of genomic data, yet modelling the complex and unknown relationship between genomes and the processes the microbes are driving is an unsolved problem. In this work, we present the first hybrid modeling framework for deriving biokinetic parameter values of a process-based soil organic matter turnover model from metagenome-inferred functional traits based on DNA sequencing data. Our model predicts biokinetic parameters of the process-based model from genomic trait data with a neural network and integrates constraints from ecological theory and literature to ensure realistic behavior, even of non-observed state variables. We evaluate our method on synthetic genomic trait datasets of varying complexity and on real data, showing that our approach improves performance over multiple baselines and learns the dynamics of unmeasurable components of the process-based model effectively, even for small training datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个约束混合建模框架，用于从宏基因组推断的功能特征数据中推导基于过程的土壤有机质周转模型的生物动力学参数。该框架使用神经网络从基因组特征数据预测生物动力学参数，并整合生态理论和文献约束以确保模型行为合理。在合成和真实数据集上的评估表明，该方法优于多个基线，并能有效学习过程模型中不可观测分量的动力学。
Motivation: 土壤微生物在有机质循环中起关键作用，但目前基于过程的土壤模型参数化难度大，尤其是整合基因组数据时，基因组与微生物驱动过程之间的复杂关系尚不明确。
Method: 提出混合建模框架，包含神经网络从宏基因组推断的功能特征预测生物动力学参数，并引入来自生态理论和文献的先验约束，确保未观测状态变量的行为合理。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，该方法优于多个基线，即使在训练数据较小的情况下也能有效学习过程模型中不可观测分量的动力学。
Conclusion: 该混合方法为利用基因组数据改进土壤有机质模型参数化提供了新途径，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Quantum-classical physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks for PDEs
papers.abstract_en: We develop QCPIKAN, the first quantum-classical physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold network designed to solve partial differential equations (PDEs). Built upon Chebyshev-polynomial KAN layers and parameterized quantum circuits, this hybrid framework embeds physical constraints into the training loss to enforce physical consistency. Our theoretical investigations grounded in approximation theory prove that this design accelerates high-frequency error convergence to an exponential rate and effectively mitigates numerical dispersion. We validate the framework across three typical seepage scenarios in porous media, including single-phase flow, component transport and two-phase flow. Compared with existing quantum-classical physics-informed neural networks, QCPIKAN achieves superior performance in global prediction accuracy, local error control, dynamic evolution tracking and displacement front localization. This work provides a robust and efficient alternative for solving complex PDEs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QCPIKAN，首个量子-经典物理信息Kolmogorov-Arnold网络，用于求解偏微分方程。该混合框架基于Chebyshev多项式KAN层和参数化量子电路，将物理约束嵌入训练损失。理论证明其能加速高频误差收敛至指数速率并有效抑制数值色散。在多孔介质渗流场景（单相流、组分传输、两相流）中，相比现有量子-经典物理信息神经网络，QCPIKAN在全局预测精度、局部误差控制、动态演化跟踪和位移前沿定位上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有量子-经典物理信息神经网络在求解复杂PDE时存在精度不足、误差收敛慢等问题，亟需更高效且物理一致的替代方案。
Method: 构建Chebyshev多项式KAN层与参数化量子电路混合架构，通过将物理约束（如PDE残差）加入损失函数进行训练。
Result: 理论证明高频误差指数收敛；实验在多孔介质渗流三个场景中取得优于对比方法的精度、误差控制和动态跟踪效果。
Conclusion: QCPIKAN为求解复杂PDE提供了鲁棒高效的混合方法，但当前仅验证于渗流问题，推广至其他PDE类型仍需进一步研究。

papers.title: Recurrent neural networks approximate continuous functions
papers.abstract_en: Classical approximation theorems ask for a new neural network whenever the target accuracy is improved. This paper studies the opposite possibility: can the network be chosen once and for all, and can accuracy be bought only by letting it run longer? We prove that this is possible for every continuous function on [-1,1]. More precisely, each such function is uniformly approximated by the time evolution of a single ReLU recurrent neural network with fixed weights and fixed hidden dimension. The mechanism behind the construction is a new intermediate model, the Turing machine with neural units (TMNU). This model retains the algorithmic freedom needed to implement polynomial approximation schemes, while remaining rigid enough to be simulated by RNNs with explicit bounds on hidden dimension and weight magnitude. The resulting convergence rates reflect the underlying polynomial approximation rates. We complement the construction with minimax lower bounds showing that runtime is not merely a proof artifact, but an unavoidable resource in this fixed-network approximation paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明固定权重的单隐层ReLU RNN可以通过时间演化以任意精度一致逼近[-1,1]上的连续函数，无需改变网络结构，只需延长运行时间。提出的中间模型“带神经单元的图灵机”(TMNU)将多项式逼近方案编码为RNN动力学，并给出了收敛率及极小极大下界，表明运行时间是不可回避的计算资源。
Motivation: 经典逼近定理要求每次提高精度时重新选择网络，本文探究是否可以在不改变网络结构的情况下仅通过延长运行时间提高精度。
Method: 引入带神经单元的图灵机(TMNU)作为中间模型，该模型保留算法自由度以执行多项式逼近方案，同时足够刚性以便由固定隐层维度和权重的RNN模拟。基于ReLU激活的RNN实现。
Result: 证明了对于[-1,1]上的任意连续函数，存在一个固定权重和固定隐层维度的ReLU RNN，其时间演化能以任意精度一致逼近函数；收敛率取决于底层多项式逼近率；极小极大下界表明运行时间是必要资源。
Conclusion: 该结果揭示了在固定网络近似范式下，运行时延是不可避免的计算资源；为RNN的逼近能力提供了新的理论视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Model-Driven Approach for Developing Families of Reinforcement Learning Environments
papers.abstract_en: Virtual training environments are software-intensive systems in which reinforcement learning (RL) agents learn, adapt, and demonstrate meaningful behavior. Virtual training environments offer a safe and cost-efficient alternative to training agents in real-world settings. However, to converge, most realistic RL problems require training in multiple, mostly similar but slightly different environments - i.e., families of environment variants. The typical development process of environment families is a labor-intensive and error-prone manual endeavor that does not scale well. To alleviate these issues, in this paper, we propose a model-driven approach for developing families of RL training environments. To obtain the family of environments, we develop an approach and prototype tool. In our approach, a hybrid genetic algorithm - a combination of population-based global search and heuristic local search - generates environment families. Mutations and constraints are expressed as model transformations and are operationalized into a search process by a state-of-the-art model transformation engine. We demonstrate the soundness of our approach in a wildfire mitigation scenario and curriculum learning - a particular learning paradigm that relies on environment families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模型驱动方法，用于开发强化学习训练环境家族。通过混合遗传算法（结合全局搜索和局部启发式搜索）生成环境变体，并使用模型变换表达变异和约束。在野火缓解场景和课程学习中验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 传统开发环境家族是劳动密集且容易出错的手动过程，难以扩展。
Method: 基于模型驱动的方法，采用混合遗传算法（全局搜索与局部启发式搜索结合），通过模型变换实现变异和约束的自动化。
Result: 在野火缓解场景和课程学习中的实验表明该方法能有效生成环境家族。
Conclusion: 该模型驱动方法有望缓解强化学习环境家族开发中的可扩展性问题。

papers.title: Leveraging systems' non-linearity to tackle the scarcity of data in the design of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deep Transfer Learning (DTL) allows for the efficient building of Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Systems (IFDS). On the other hand, DTL methods still heavily rely on large amounts of labelled data. Obtaining such an amount of data can be challenging when dealing with machines or structures faults. This document proposes a novel approach to the design of vibration-based IFDS using DTL in condition of strong data scarcity. A periodic multi-excitation level procedure leveraging intrinsic non-linearities of real-world systems is used to produce images that can be conveniently analysed by pre-trained Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to diagnose faults. A new data visualization method and its augmentation technique are proposed in this paper to tackle the typical lack of data encountered during the design of IFDS. Experimental validation on a railway pantograph structure provides effective support for the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对智能故障诊断系统中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出利用系统固有非线性的方法，通过周期性多激励水平程序生成适合预训练CNN分析的图像，并引入新的数据可视化与增强技术。实验在铁路受电弓结构上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 深度迁移学习在故障诊断中仍依赖大量标注数据，而获取机器或结构故障的大规模标注数据困难，导致数据稀缺成为瓶颈。
Method: 提出一种利用真实系统固有非线性的周期性多激励水平程序，将振动信号转换为图像，再由预训练CNN进行分析；同时提出新的数据可视化方法及其增强技术。
Result: 在铁路受电弓结构上的实验验证提供了有效支持。
Conclusion: 所提方法能在数据稀缺条件下有效设计基于振动的智能故障诊断系统。

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Prototype Calibration for Frozen Pose-Flow Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Pose-flow video anomaly detectors are attractive for one-class surveillance because they provide likelihood-based rankings for tracked skeleton windows. However, a single likelihood score may hide multimodal normal behavior and be sensitive to pose-observation noise. We study a frozen-detector setting in which the pose-flow backbone, cached skeleton tracks, and evaluation pipeline are fixed. Reliability-Aware Prototype Calibration (RPC) is a post-hoc score calibration method for this setting. It adds a standardized nearest-prototype deviation in the frozen latent space to the standardized flow score, and uses keypoint confidence only to gate this added geometric evidence. Thus, RPC preserves the original density signal while correcting the ranking with empirical normal-mode structure under pose reliability. Across two frozen pose-flow backbones and four datasets, RPC improves frame-level AUROC in all eight backbone-dataset pairs, with gains ranging from 0.34 to 4.49 percentage points and averaging 2.03 points. Ablation and reliability analyses show that prototype deviation is the main corrective signal, while reliability gating is most useful when pose observations are less trustworthy. These results suggest that lightweight post-hoc calibration can strengthen cached pose-flow systems when retraining or reproducing the full pose pipeline is impractical.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/iNing10/RPC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可靠性感知的原型校准方法（RPC），用于增强冻结的骨架流异常检测器。RPC在冻结的潜在空间中添加标准化的最近原型偏差来校准评分，并使用关键点置信度门控几何证据。在四个数据集上的实验表明，RPC在所有八种骨干-数据集组合中均提升了帧级AUROC，平均提升2.03个百分点。
Motivation: 骨架流异常检测器依赖单一似然分数，可能隐藏多模态正常行为并对姿态观测噪声敏感。在冻结检测器设置下，无法重新训练或复现完整姿态流水线，因此需要轻量级后处理校准方法。
Method: RPC是一种后置评分校准方法，它计算冻结潜在空间中标准化最近原型偏差，并将其与标准化流分数相加，同时利用关键点置信度门控该几何证据，从而在保留原始密度信号的同时，利用姿态可靠性下的经验正常模式校正排名。
Result: 在两种冻结骨架流骨干和四个数据集上，RPC在所有八种骨干-数据集组合中均提升了帧级AUROC，增益范围为0.34至4.49个百分点，平均提升2.03个百分点。消融和可靠性分析表明，原型偏差是主要校正信号，而可靠性门控在姿态观测不可靠时最有用。
Conclusion: 轻量级后置校准可以增强缓存的骨架流系统，在无法重新训练或复现完整姿态流水线的情况下具有实际价值。

papers.title: Through the PRISM: Preference Representation in Intermediate States of Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating video generation with clean, pixel-based reward models disconnects evaluation from the noisy diffusion process and incurs massive VAE decoding costs. In this paper, we challenge this paradigm by asking a fundamental question: Can a powerful video generator inherently discriminate preferences directly from noisy latents? To answer this, we introduce \textbf{PRISM} (\textbf{P}reference \textbf{R}epresentation in \textbf{I}ntermediate \textbf{S}tates of Diffusion \textbf{M}odels). PRISM employs a lightweight Query-based Aggregation head with a frozen video diffusion backbone to decode preference signals from noisy latents. Surprisingly, PRISM not only achieves SOTA preference accuracy but also unlocks strong noise-robustness, which enables early-stage Best-of-$N$ sampling. This allows for filtering suboptimal candidates at the very beginning of denoising, drastically reducing computation while boosting video quality. We also reveal a strong positive correlation between a backbone's generative performance and its inherent evaluative power, enabling self-improving video backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM，一种从视频扩散模型中间噪声潜在状态直接解码偏好信号的方法。PRISM采用轻量级查询聚合头（Query-based Aggregation head）配合冻结的扩散骨干网络，实现高偏好准确性和噪声鲁棒性，并支持早期最佳N采样（Best-of-N sampling）以降低计算开销同时提升视频质量。
Motivation: 现有基于像素的奖励模型与去噪过程脱节，且需要昂贵的VAE解码。本文探究能否直接从噪声潜在状态中判别偏好，以简化评估流程。
Method: PRISM使用一个轻量级查询聚合头（Query-based Aggregation head），从视频扩散模型的各种噪声时间步的潜在状态中提取偏好信号，扩散骨干网络保持冻结。
Result: PRISM在偏好预测准确性上达到SOTA，并且展现出强噪声鲁棒性。早期最佳N采样（Best-of-N sampling）可在去噪初期滤除次优候选，显著减少计算量并提升最终视频质量。
Conclusion: 研究发现扩散模型的生成能力与其内在评估能力呈强正相关，表明模型可通过自身评估实现自我改进。

papers.title: GEN-Guard: Correcting Generalization Failures for Deployable Federated Surgical AI
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) in surgical video AI enables collaborative model training without sharing sensitive data. However, standard evaluation practices - selecting the "best" global model based only on validation data from participating hospitals - can lead to suboptimal deployment choices. We identify this critical failure mode as performance leakage, where the selected model overfits internal federation data and fails to generalize to unseen institutions. We propose GEN-Guard, a practical post-hoc framework to detect and correct generalization failures in federated surgical AI. It integrates Generalization Detection via Client-Blocked Evaluation (CBE), which validates performance on isolated client distributions to prevent performance leakage, and Generalization Correction through Disagreement-Aware Distillation (DAD), which learns adaptive feature-level corrections for cross-institutional robustness. Both components operate after standard FL convergence while providing robust support for zero-shot adaptation to unseen environments. We first quantify the severity of performance leakage, observing Model Selection Failures (MSFs) exceeding 80% under standard evaluation. GEN-Guard is evaluated on two multi-center clinical challenges: surgical phase recognition in laparoscopic cholecystectomy and polyp segmentation in colonoscopy. Across both datasets, GEN-Guard consistently corrects these failures, improving in-federation F1 scores by up to 2 points, unseen-institution performance by up to 3 points, and worst-case institutional performance by 3-9 points. Performance leakage represents a systematic and previously under-recognized risk in federated surgical AI. GEN-Guard provides a practical solution for detecting and correcting such failures. By improving cross-institutional robustness and zero-shot generalization, it strengthens the reliability of FL for real-world surgical deployment.
papers.journal_ref: Int J Comput Assist Radiol Surg. 2026 Jun 14
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GEN-Guard，一个用于检测和纠正联邦手术AI中泛化失败的后处理框架。它通过客户端阻塞评估（CBE）检测性能泄露，并通过分歧感知蒸馏（DAD）进行特征级校正，以提高跨机构鲁棒性和零样本泛化。在腹腔镜胆囊切除术阶段识别和结肠镜息肉分割两个多中心临床挑战上，GEN-Guard将联邦内F1分数提升最多2点，未见机构性能提升最多3点，最差机构性能提升3-9点。
Motivation: 联邦学习（FL）在手术视频AI中允许协作训练而不共享敏感数据，但标准评估方法（仅基于参与医院验证数据选择最佳全局模型）可能导致部署选择次优。作者将这种失败模式称为性能泄露，即所选模型过拟合联邦内部数据，无法泛化到未见机构。
Method: GEN-Guard是一个后处理框架，包含两个组件：1）通用性检测：通过客户端阻塞评估（CBE）在隔离客户端分布上验证性能，防止性能泄露；2）通用性校正：通过分歧感知蒸馏（DAD）学习自适应特征级校正，以实现跨机构鲁棒性。两个组件在标准FL收敛后运行，并支持零样本适应未见环境。
Result: 论文首先量化了性能泄露的严重性，观察到标准评估下的模型选择失败（MSF）超过80%。在腹腔镜胆囊切除术阶段识别和结肠镜息肉分割两个数据集上，GEN-Guard一致地纠正了这些失败，将联邦内F1分数提升最多2点，未见机构性能提升最多3点，最差机构性能提升3-9点。
Conclusion: 性能泄露是联邦手术AI中一个系统性且此前未被充分认识的风险。GEN-Guard提供了一种实用的后处理解决方案来检测和纠正此类失败，通过提高跨机构鲁棒性和零样本泛化，增强了FL在真实手术部署中的可靠性。

papers.title: CUPID: Reconstructing UV Texture Maps for Interpretable Person-of-Interest Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfakes targeting a high-profile individual, known as Person-of-Interest (POI), are a threat to modern democracies and societies. Current POI deepfake detection methods still struggle to combine robustness to post-processing, efficiency and interpretability, focal aspects of modern deepfake detectors. In this paper we propose CUPID, a POI video deepfake detector that combines UV texture maps, a facial appearance representation derived from 3D face reconstructions, with the representation learning capabilities of the Masked Autoencoder (MAE). Our method does not require any deepfake videos in its training phase. Moreover, it does not even require to include a specific POI in the training set: the combination of UV texture maps extracted from real video frames and the MAE context-guided reconstruction yields a latent space that captures rich and discriminative facial features also for identities unseen during training. In the testing phase, the embeddings extracted from a query video depicting the POI can be matched against pristine reference videos to assess the video authenticity. Furthermore, operating in the UV space naturally provides an additional layer of interpretability. Specifically, we can extract decoded residual maps that highlight which facial regions of a test video deviate most from the identity representation of the corresponding POI. Experiments on four deepfake datasets show that CUPID outperforms current state of the art on most datasets and achieves the best overall robustness against strong downscaling and compression, providing also substantially faster inference. Our experimental code will be released at https://github.com/polimi-ispl/CUPID.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CUPID 是一个针对特定人物（Person-of-Interest, POI）的深度伪造视频检测器，利用 UV 纹理图（从 3D 人脸重建得到）和掩码自编码器（MAE）进行表示学习。该方法无需任何深度伪造视频训练，也不要求训练集中包含目标 POI；测试时通过将查询视频的嵌入与纯净参考视频匹配来判定真实性，并通过解码残差图提供可解释性。在四个数据集上的实验表明，CUPID 在多数数据集上达到当前最优，对强降采样和压缩具有最佳鲁棒性，且推理速度显著更快。
Motivation: 现有 POI 深度伪造检测方法难以同时满足鲁棒性（对后处理）、效率和可解释性，而这三点是现代深度伪造检测器的关键需求。
Method: 提出 CUPID，结合 UV 纹理图（从 3D 人脸重建提取的面部外观表示）与 MAE 的上下文引导重建，形成富含判别性面部特征的潜在空间。训练仅需真实视频帧，无需深度伪造样本或目标 POI；测试时通过比较查询视频与参考视频的嵌入来检测伪造，并利用 UV 空间的残差图定位异常区域。
Result: 在四个深度伪造数据集上，CUPID 在多数数据集上超越现有方法，在强降采样和压缩场景下取得最佳鲁棒性，同时推理速度快于同类方法。
Conclusion: CUPID 无需深度伪造训练样本且无需目标身份先验即可实现 POI 深度伪造检测，并通过 UV 空间提供可解释的残差图作为额外分析层。

papers.title: CMDS-AD: Cross-Modal Dual-Stream Decoupling for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot anomaly detection remains challenging due to limited training data. Multi-modal anomaly detection (MAD) offers a viable solution, leveraging 3D geometric cues to enrich 2D RGB representations and compensate for this scarcity. However, existing MAD methods apply spatially uniform feature processing, conflating stable macroscopic structures with high-frequency localized defect signals, exacerbating cross-modal misalignment and inflating false-positive rates. To overcome this, we present CMDS-AD, a Cross-Modal Dual-Stream Anomaly Detection framework. A LoRA-guided diffusion model generates diverse RGB samples to mitigate extreme data scarcity. For 3D normal augmentation, we employ a pre-trained diffusion model as a normal estimator. Crucially, this estimator inherently acts as a non-linear low-pass filter, directly extracting low-frequency normal representations from RGB inputs. This establishes an auxiliary estimated stream of purely low-frequency information, anchoring robust structural templates and assisting the uncompressed real stream, containing coupled high- and low-frequency components, to precisely isolate micro-defects. A Coordinate-Aware Hierarchical Feature Mapper adaptively aligns cross-modal semantics, while a multiplicative scoring mechanism filters modality-specific noise. Under the extreme 1-shot setting, CMDS-AD achieves absolute performance gains of 5.7% (I-AUROC) and 2.0% (AUPRO) on MVTec 3D-AD, alongside 7.7% and 5.6% improvements on EyeCandies, establishing a new state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨模态双流解耦小样本异常检测框架CMDS-AD，利用LoRA引导的扩散模型增强RGB样本，并通过预训练扩散模型作为正态估计器提取低频信息，辅助高频缺陷定位。在MVTec 3D-AD和EyeCandies数据集上，1-shot设置下分别提升I-AUROC 5.7%和7.7%，达到新最优。
Motivation: 现有多模态异常检测方法对空间特征进行统一处理，混淆了宏观结构与局部缺陷信号，导致跨模态对齐错误和假阳性率高。小样本场景下数据稀缺加剧了这一问题。
Method: LoRA引导的扩散模型生成多样RGB样本；预训练扩散模型作为正态估计器，充当非线性低通滤波器提取低频正态表示，建立辅助估计流；配合坐标感知层次特征映射器进行跨模态语义对齐，以及乘性评分机制过滤模态特异性噪声。
Result: 1-shot设置下，MVTec 3D-AD上I-AUROC提升5.7%、AUPRO提升2.0%；EyeCandies上分别提升7.7%和5.6%，建立新最优。
Conclusion: 通过解耦低频结构和高频缺陷信号，CMDS-AD有效缓解了跨模态对齐问题，在小样本异常检测中取得显著性能提升。

papers.title: Statistical Properties of Training & Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has managed to evade numerous intuitions from classical statistics to achieve unprecedented performance on a number of real-world tasks. In this article, we investigate the key features and surprises of deep learning from a physics-informed perspective, taking care to point out and justify where possible the many choices inherent in constructing a deep learning model. In particular, we review the phenomenon of neural scaling laws and discuss their interplay with the constraints and inductive biases which may be present when applying machine learning to problems in physics.
papers.comment: 32 pages, 3 figures. Part of the VERaiPHY initiative
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从物理学视角审视深度学习与传统统计学的差异，讨论神经缩放定律（neural scaling laws）及其与物理问题中约束和归纳偏置（inductive biases）的相互作用。
Motivation: 深度学习在许多实际任务上超越了经典统计学的直觉，但其关键特征和惊喜尚未被充分理解，尤其是从物理角度。
Conclusion: 强调在物理问题中应用机器学习时，需注意缩放定律与约束、归纳偏置的相互影响。

papers.title: Shifting-based Optimizable Linear Relaxations for General Activation Functions
papers.abstract_en: The use of neural networks (NNs) is rapidly increasing, including in safety- and security-critical domains. To provide formal guarantees about NN behavior, many verification methods rely on optimizable linear relaxations of activation functions. However, existing techniques depend on hand-crafted relaxations for each activation function. Extension to state-of-the-art activation functions therefore requires substantial manual effort. In contrast, our approach SLiR (Shifting-based Linear Relaxations) is broadly applicable, requiring only a Lipschitz constant or a set of critical points. SLiR parameterizes relaxations by their slope and computes the corresponding offset via a shifting procedure that ensures sound upper and lower bounds over the input domain, enabling efficient optimization while maintaining correctness. Our experiments show that SLiR produces tight relaxations across a wide range of practical activation functions and enables verification of up to 7.8x more properties compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SLiR（基于平移的线性松弛）方法，用于神经网络的激活函数可优化线性松弛，仅需 Lipschitz 常数或临界点即可通用地处理各类激活函数，并通过平移程序确保输入域上的紧上下界。实验表明，SLiR 在多种实用激活函数上产生紧致松弛，比现有方法多验证最多 7.8 倍的性质。
Motivation: 现有神经网络验证方法依赖为每个激活函数手工设计线性松弛，扩展到新激活函数需大量人力。
Method: SLiR 通过斜率参数化松弛，并利用平移程序计算偏移量，在输入域上生成可靠的上下界，同时保持可优化性。
Result: 实验显示 SLiR 在多种激活函数上产生紧致松弛，并比当前最佳方法多验证 7.8 倍的性质。
Conclusion: SLiR 是一种通用且高效的激活函数线性松弛方法，可显著提升神经网络验证的可扩展性。

papers.title: Integrating national forest inventory, airborne lidar, and satellite imagery for wall-to-wall mapping of forest structure with computer vision
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing is increasingly relied upon to deliver actionable science for forest and wildfire risk management across large landscapes. Wall-to-wall, annually updated maps are a persistent need for effective forest management. Many planning systems and data collections combine disparate data sources with different purposes, vintages, and prediction quality, which leads to confounding behavior in operational planning systems. We introduce the VibrantForests framework, developed and applied to map forest attributes and provide a coherent foundation for effective forest and wildfire planning. VibrantForests includes a satellite-based forest structure model trained on lidar-derived samples and applied across the contiguous United States to concurrently generate estimates of canopy cover, canopy height, aboveground live tree biomass, basal area, and quadratic mean diameter at 10-meter resolution. We demonstrate predictive capability spanning the full spectrum of forest conditions ranging from sparse-canopy/low-biomass to dense-canopy/high-biomass. Results show that our model extends the range at which saturation is commonly encountered in comparable passive-sensor models, and reduces regression-to-mean behavior that commonly produces overestimation of forest attributes in small/sparse conditions and underestimation in large/dense conditions. The VibrantForests framework addresses a key limitation in large-area forest and wildfire planning by delivering coherent wall-to-wall estimates of management-relevant attributes at annual cadence and 10m resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VibrantForests框架，结合国家森林清查、机载激光雷达和卫星影像，利用计算机视觉方法生成美国本土10米分辨率的森林结构图，包括树冠覆盖、树高、地上生物量、胸高断面积和平均直径。模型在稀疏到密集的森林条件下均表现良好，减少了常见被动传感器模型中的饱和和回归均值问题。
Motivation: 现有的森林和野火规划系统常整合不同来源、不同年份和数据质量的数据，导致预测不一致。需要一种每年更新的、全覆盖的、管理相关的森林属性地图。
Method: VibrantForests框架：基于卫星的森林结构模型，使用激光雷达导出的样本训练，应用于整个美国本土。模型同时估计树冠覆盖、树高、地上活树生物量、胸高断面积和二次平均直径，分辨率为10米。
Result: 模型在从稀疏/低生物量到密集/高生物量的全部森林条件下均展现出预测能力。相比同类被动传感器模型，扩展了常见的饱和范围，并减少了回归均值行为，后者通常导致小/稀疏条件下高估、大/密集条件下低估。
Conclusion: VibrantForests框架通过提供每年更新的、10米分辨率的管理相关属性的一致性全覆盖估计，解决了大区域森林和野火规划中的关键限制。

papers.title: Boundary Embedding Shaping with Adaptive Contrastive Learning for Graph Structural Disentanglement
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) excel at aggregating neighbor information for classification, yet their performance is hindered by graph structural entanglement, where spurious correlations from semantically irrelevant neighbors contaminate node embeddings. This challenge is most acute for nodes near class boundaries in the embedding space, where amplified structural noise blurs decision boundaries and destabilizes predictions. Existing robust GNN methods largely treat all nodes uniformly, ignoring boundary vulnerabilities. In this paper, to improve classification performance, we tackle graph structural disentanglement by identifying boundary-region entanglement as the primary bottleneck and propose Boundary Embedding Shaping (BES), an adaptive contrastive learning GNN plug-in module that selectively suppresses spurious structural noise at decision boundaries with minimal model parameter perturbation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BES consistently improves boundary discrimination and outperforms existing leading methods. Notably, BES boosts GCN performance by an average of 3.3% in node classification (up to 5.0% on WikiCS) and achieves superior accuracy in link prediction.

papers.title: U$^2$Mamba: A Two-level Nested U-structure Mamba for Salient Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Mamba-based models have emerged as a promising alternative for salient object detection (SOD), offering significant advantages in modeling long sequences. However, existing models often fail to explore contextual information and the depth of the entire architecture. This paper introduces U$^2$Mamba, a powerful and innovative U-structured network for salient object detection. We propose multiscale Mamba U-blocks (MMUBs) that enhance the model depth to improve local feature extraction capabilities. Our newly developed nested U-structure, incorporating MMUBs, enables the network to integrate various receptive fields from shallow and deep layers, thereby collecting richer contextual information and longer-range data without being constrained by resolution. Instead of using the traditional deep supervision scheme and top-level supervised training, we propose a hierarchical training supervision method where the loss is computed at each level during the training process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that U$^2$Mamba achieves highly competitive performance against state-of-the-art methods. The source code is available at \url{https://github.com/JL021/U2Mamba}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出U$^2$Mamba，一种基于Mamba的两级嵌套U结构网络用于显著目标检测。通过多尺度Mamba U块（MMUBs）增强模型深度和局部特征提取能力，并采用层次化训练监督方法替代传统深度监督。实验表明该方法在显著目标检测基准上达到与最新方法竞争的性能。
Motivation: 现有Mamba-based模型在显著目标检测中未能充分探索上下文信息和网络深度，限制了性能提升。
Method: 提出U$^2$Mamba，包括由多尺度Mamba U块（MMUBs）构成的嵌套U结构，以及层次化训练监督方法，在每一层次计算损失以整合不同感受野的上下文信息。
Result: 在多个显著目标检测基准上，U$^2$Mamba取得了与当前最先进方法竞争的性能。
Conclusion: 通过嵌套U结构和层次监督，U$^2$Mamba能够有效整合浅层和深层的多尺度感受野，收集更丰富的上下文信息，且不受分辨率限制。

papers.title: ELVA: Exploring Ranking-Driven Universal Multimodal Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) via contrastive learning has become a mainstream paradigm for improving the performance of Universal Multimodal Retrieval (UMR). However, previous works have ignored the grain blindness when adapting the contrastive paradigm into retrieval tasks. Grain blindness refers to the tendency of the model to overlook grain-level information contained in the query, which is crucial for effectively handling complex queries. This stems from contrastive learning treating samples as a binary classification (positive/negative), while ignoring the different information carried by each negative sample. To address this, we argue that negatives should be treated differently according to their similarity to the positive sample, enabling the model to learn distinct grain information from each negative. In this paper, we introduce a simple but effective framework, called ELVA, a novel rule-based RL framework that mitigates grain blindness through ranking-driven MLLMs. 1) Instead of relying on reward models, we extend Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to retrieval tasks, allowing the model to explore new ranking behaviors without explicit ranking labels. 2) By utilizing rule-based rewards, our approach jointly optimizes the ranking of negative samples while enlarging the similarity gap between positive and negative. To more precisely measure grain blindness, we further introduce MRBench, a new benchmark specifically designed for multi-grain query scenarios. ELVA achieves state-of-the-art results across standard retrieval benchmarks, and its notable 13.1% improvement on MRBench further demonstrates its effectiveness in alleviating grain blindness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对通用多模态检索（UMR）中对比学习忽视查询中粒度级信息的问题（grain blindness），提出基于规则强化学习（RLVR）的框架ELVA，通过排序驱动MLLM来区分负样本的相似度，从而缓解粒度盲。引入新基准MRBench，在标准检索基准上取得SOTA，MRBench上提升13.1%。
Motivation: 现有对比学习范式在UMR中将样本视为二分类，忽略了负样本携带的不同粒度信息，导致模型难以处理复杂查询。
Method: 将规则可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）扩展到检索任务，无需显式排序标签；利用规则基奖励联合优化负样本排序并增大正负样本相似度差距。
Result: 在标准检索基准上达到SOTA，并在MRBench上取得13.1%的提升，证明方法在缓解粒度盲方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 通过排序驱动的强化学习可有效缓解多模态检索中的粒度盲，提高复杂查询处理能力。

papers.title: Lagrange: An Open-Vocabulary, Energy-Based Sparse Framework for Generalized End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: Scaling end-to-end autonomous driving to complex, open-world environments requires perceptual models that generalize to anomalous scenarios and planners that produce kinematically valid trajectories. Existing paradigms face a distinct dichotomy between representational efficiency and generalization capacity. Dense models (e.g., occupancy networks), while geometrically robust, incur critical computational bottlenecks and struggle with high-level semantic reasoning. Conversely, sparse, query-based planners are efficient but reliant on closed-set definitions, rendering them vulnerable to out-of-distribution (OOD) events. Although recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer open-vocabulary reasoning, their autoregressive, discrete token generation fundamentally conflicts with the continuous, high-frequency control requirements of vehicle dynamics. To address this, we propose Lagrange, an open-vocabulary, computationally sparse driving framework based on Masked Latent Fields (MLF). Rather than relying on dense volumetric reconstructions or closed-set query mechanisms, Lagrange exploits Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to encode class-agnostic object proposals into continuous semantic visual tokens. We introduce an intent-driven masked cross-attention module that temporally filters irrelevant entities, decoding the attended tokens into an implicit continuous energy field defined over spatial coordinates. By framing decision-making as a Lagrangian action minimization problem spanning this energy field, we enforce strict compliance with vehicle kinematics while executing collision avoidance. Extensive offline evaluations on both standard (nuScenes) and long-tail (CODA) benchmarks demonstrate that Lagrange establishes a promising framework for robust, interpretable, and kinematically feasible open-world autonomy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lagrange，一个基于掩码潜在场 (Masked Latent Fields) 的开放词汇、稀疏计算驾驶框架，利用视觉-语言模型编码类无关目标提议为连续语义标记，通过意图驱动的掩码交叉注意力模块过滤无关实体，将决策建模为能量场上的拉格朗日作用量最小化问题，从而保证车辆运动学约束。在 nuScenes 和 CODA 基准上的离线评估表明该框架在鲁棒性、可解释性和运动学可行性方面有前景。
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶范式在表示效率与泛化能力之间存在矛盾：密集模型计算瓶颈高，稀疏查询依赖闭集定义难以处理分布外事件，VLA模型的离散自回归生成与连续高频控制冲突。
Method: 提出 Masked Latent Fields (MLF)，使用 VLM 编码目标提议为连续语义视觉标记；设计意图驱动的掩码交叉注意力模块随时间过滤无关实体；将解码的注意力区域转化为空间坐标上的隐式连续能量场，并将决策形式化为该能量场上的拉格朗日作用量最小化问题。
Result: 在 nuScenes 和 CODA (长尾) 基准上的离线评估表明 Lagrange 提供了鲁棒、可解释且运动学可行的开放世界自主驾驶框架。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Lagrange 通过将稀疏视觉表示与能量基规划结合，为开放世界自动驾驶建立了有前景的框架。

papers.title: Efficiently Linking Real Scenes with Synthetic Data Generation for AI-based Cognitive Robotics and Computer Vision Applications
papers.abstract_en: AI vision models are a driving factor for the potential use case scenarios of cognitive robotics within in the industry and household applications. A large array of methods from semantic environment analysis towards 6D and grasping pose estimation have been proposed based on the latest AI achievements. However, such advancements require further strong and efficient methods w.r.t. training data and AI-architectures, which are capable in synergy to tackle current challenges, precision limits, and scalability beyond domain gaps. In this paper, we discuss these current limits and trends in the related state-of-the-art which are challenging those. Further we discuss our current work in progress on bridging the domain gap between simulations and real world applications by linking those in the training data generation.
papers.comment: Accepted and best paper award at MHI-Kolloquium 2024

papers.title: Confidence-Aware Automated Assessment of Student-Drawn Scientific Models
papers.abstract_en: Student-generated drawings are widely used in science education to assess learners' conceptual understanding in modeling-based tasks aligned with the Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS). However, scoring such drawings requires expert human judgment to interpret complex visual representations, making large-scale assessment costly to implement and sustain in classroom settings. In this work, we study automated scoring of student-generated scientific drawings using a vision-based model. We evaluate a Vision Transformer (ViT) with parameter-efficient adaptation and propose a confidence-aware scoring framework that derives response-level confidence from test-time predictive distributions. This confidence signal enables selective automation by scoring high-confidence responses automatically while deferring uncertain cases for human review. Experiments on six NGSS-aligned middle school assessment items show that the proposed approach improves scoring reliability while supporting a practical trade-off between automated coverage and scoring risk, highlighting the value of confidence-aware methods for trustworthy educational assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究学生手绘科学模型的自动评分，使用 Vision Transformer 和参数高效适应，提出置信度感知评分框架，从测试时预测分布导出回答级置信度，对高置信度回答自动评分，不确定的转人工审查。在六个 NGSS 初中评估题项上实验，该方法提高了评分可靠性，并实现了自动化覆盖率与评分风险之间的实用平衡。
Motivation: 学生手绘科学模型需要专家人工评分，大规模评估成本高，难以在课堂中持续实施。
Method: 采用 Vision Transformer 进行参数高效适应，并提出置信度感知评分框架，从测试时预测分布中提取回答级置信度，高置信度回答自动评分，低置信度转人工审查。
Result: 在六个 NGSS 对齐的初中评估题项上，该方法提高了评分可靠性，并实现了自动化覆盖率与评分风险之间的实用平衡。
Conclusion: 置信度感知方法对于可信的教育评估具有价值，能支持选择性自动化以降低人工成本。

papers.title: Editorial Alignment: A Participatory Approach to Engaging Editorial Expertise in LLM-mediated Knowledge Dissemination
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of LLM-driven information services is reshaping the conditions under which public knowledge institutions operate, threatening to absorb the editorial function these institutions exist to exercise. While LLMs offer powerful new affordances for knowledge dissemination, editorial authority is challenged by pretrained LLMs that arrive already aligned with the values and dissemination strategies of their commercial developers. This paper investigates editor participation in re-aligning LLM interfaces to editorial standards through design workshops, in a case study where we design and implement an LLM-enabled encyclopedia interface with a Nordic public knowledge institution. We introduce editorial alignment as a design practice within Participatory AI, framing AI alignment as a design process and positioning the editorial standard as a design artefact that translates editorial practice and values into alignment objectives for technical implementation. Last, we discuss how editorial alignment can create space for ongoing participation and give editors agency in LLM-mediated knowledge dissemination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“编辑对齐”这一参与式AI设计实践，通过案例研究（与北欧公共知识机构合作设计LLM赋能的百科全书接口）探讨编辑专家如何参与重新对齐LLM接口以符合编辑标准。作者将AI对齐视为设计过程，将编辑标准转化为技术实现的对齐目标，旨在维护公共知识机构的编辑权威。
Motivation: LLM驱动的信息服务挑战了公共知识机构的编辑职能，预训练LLM已与商业开发者的价值观对齐，威胁编辑权威。需要方法让编辑专家参与对齐过程，以确保LLM接口反映机构的编辑标准。
Method: 采用参与式设计工作坊，与北欧公共知识机构合作设计和实现一个LLM赋能的百科全书接口。提出“编辑对齐”实践，将AI对齐视为设计过程，并将编辑标准作为设计制品，以将编辑实践和价值观转化为对齐目标。
Result: 通过案例研究展示了编辑对齐的可行性，并讨论了如何为编辑提供持续参与和能动性的空间。
Conclusion: 编辑对齐作为参与式AI的设计实践，可以为编辑在LLM中介的知识传播中创造参与空间和能动性，但需要进一步探索其长期效果和推广性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Register Gap: A Meaning Intelligence Framework for Nigerian Public Discourse
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Meaning Intelligence Framework (MIF), a nine-dimension annotation and evaluation schema for Nigerian public discourse that separates surface sentiment from true communicative intent. Existing benchmarks for Nigerian languages, including NaijaSenti and AfriSenti, treat sentiment classification as a three-way polarity task (positive, negative, neutral). We argue that the dominant failure mode of AI systems on Nigerian discourse is not translation failure but context failure: the same utterance carries opposite pragmatic force depending on speaker, audience, and situation. The MIF operationalises this insight across nine scored dimensions: register, surface sentiment, true intent, irony, coded subtext, risk tier, annotator confidence, speaker emotion, and recommended communications action. We construct a 30-item calibration dataset spanning Standard English, Nigerian English, Nigerian Pidgin, and code-mixed registers, and evaluate a frontier language model (Gemini 2.5 Flash) under zero-shot and schema-informed prompting conditions. The headline finding is the Register Gap: zero-shot register classification accuracy is 33.3%, rising to 73.3% (+40 points) when the model receives the MIF schema in-context. The composite Meaning Intelligence Score increases by 5.4 points (73.2 to 78.6) under schema-informed prompting, with the largest practical gains in register identification, coded-subtext detection (+10 points), and strategic action recommendation (+10.3 points). We release the framework specification, annotation guidelines, and the 30-item public calibration set to support reproducibility, while retaining a private holdout corpus for contamination-protected evaluation.
papers.comment: Preprint. 12 pages, 2 tables. Supplementary materials: MIF Master Specification v2.0, Annotation Guidelines v1.0, and 30-item public calibration set with gold labels available from the author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出意义智能框架（MIF），一个九维度标注与评估模式，用于区分尼日利亚公共话语的表面情感与真实交际意图。在30项校准数据集上评估Gemini 2.5 Flash，发现零样本语域分类准确率仅33.3%，使用MIF架构提示后提升至73.3%（+40点），复合意义智能得分从73.2升至78.6。该框架旨在解决AI在尼日利亚话语上的上下文失败（context failure）问题，而非翻译失败。
Motivation: 现有尼日利亚语言情感基准（如NaijaSenti、AfriSenti）仅进行三元极性分类，忽略了同一话语因说话者、受众和情境而具有相反的语用力量这一上下文失败问题。
Method: 提出九维度标注架构MIF，涵盖语域、表面情感、真实意图、讽刺、编码潜台词、风险等级、标注者置信度、说话者情绪和推荐沟通行动。构建30项校准数据集，覆盖标准英语、尼日利亚英语、尼日利亚皮钦语及语码混合语域，评估Gemini 2.5 Flash在零样本和架构提示下的表现。
Result: 零样本语域分类准确率33.3%，使用MIF架构提示后升至73.3%（+40点）；意义智能得分提高5.4分（73.2→78.6）；编码潜台词检测提升+10点，战略行动推荐提升+10.3点。
Conclusion: 论文强调上下文失败是AI处理尼日利亚话语的主要失败模式，MIF框架通过九维度架构显著提升语域识别和意图理解。框架规范、标注指南和30项公共校准集已发布，保留私有集用于防污染评估。

papers.title: Single-Stage Hierarchical Rectification for Weakly Supervised Histopathology Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Existing weakly supervised semantic segmentation (WSSS) methods in computational pathology rely on a multi-stage paradigm: class activation map (CAM) generation, offline pseudo-mask refinement, and fully supervised retraining. While established, this decoupled approach presents fundamental limitations. The multi-stage process not only incurs high computational training costs but also suffers from error propagation: local texture biases in shallow CNN layers generate false-positive artifacts that subsequent refinement steps often fail to correct. To address these persistent challenges through a simple yet highly effective approach, we propose the Single-Stage Hierarchical Rectification (SSHR) framework. Rather than passively refining CAMs post-hoc, our method proactively purifies intermediate feature representations during the forward pass. We introduce a Hierarchical Feature Rectification Module (HFRM) that utilizes deep global semantic context to filter out local anomalies in shallow layers. This mechanism generates high-fidelity activation maps directly within a single training loop. Experiments on the LUAD-HistoSeg and BCSS datasets demonstrate that SSHR outperforms state-of-the-art multi-stage methods. Furthermore, SSHR reduces training duration by 2 to 5 times. This efficiency minimizes computational overhead and accelerates clinical translation for large-scale histopathology workflows. The code is available at: https://github.com/trongduc-nguyen/SSHR
papers.comment: Accepted to MICCAI 2026. This is the pre-review submitted version, not the camera-ready version. The final authenticated version will be available in the MICCAI 2026 proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出单阶段分层矫正框架（SSHR），用于弱监督组织病理学图像分割。通过在前向传播中主动净化中间特征表示，利用深层全局语义上下文过滤浅层局部异常，直接在单训练循环内生成高保真激活图。在LUAD-HistoSeg和BCSS数据集上超越现有方法，并将训练时间缩短2-5倍。
Motivation: 现有弱监督语义分割方法采用多阶段范式（CAM生成、离线伪掩码细化、全监督重训练），存在计算成本高和误差传播问题：浅层CNN的局部纹理偏差产生假阳性伪影，后续细化步骤难以纠正。
Method: 提出单阶段分层矫正框架（SSHR），包含分层特征矫正模块（HFRM），利用深层全局语义上下文过滤浅层局部异常，在前向传播中主动净化中间特征，无需事后细化CAM。
Result: 在LUAD-HistoSeg和BCSS数据集上，SSHR优于现有最优多阶段方法，并将训练时间缩短2-5倍。
Conclusion: SSHR通过单阶段设计减少了计算开销，加速了大规模组织病理学工作流的临床转化。

papers.title: Finetuning Vision-Language-Action Models Requires Fewer Layers Than You Think
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models pre-trained on massive video-robot datasets have revolutionized robotic manipulation, yet their multi-billion parameter architectures impose prohibitive computational burdens during downstream fine-tuning and real-time inference. In this work, we reveal a highly non-trivial architectural characteristic of these continuous control foundation policies (e.g., pi_0, GR00T-N1.5): despite being trained on diverse physical trajectories, they exhibit severe layer-wise representational redundancy. To exploit this, we introduce a structural compression pipeline that is entirely training-free, bypassing the need of existing methods to load full-scale models to learn optimized token reductions or dynamic layer selectors. Instead, using only a single forward pass via Centered Kernel Alignment to identify redundant layer features, we remove twin layers to permanently compress the model depth by up to 50% across both the VLM backbone and the continuous control policy head. Downstream fine-tuning of this streamlined architecture yields a dual acceleration benefit: a 40-50% reduction in training time and up to 30% faster real-time inference, while matching or exceeding full-scale base model performance. We comprehensively validate our method across three simulation benchmarks (LIBERO, RoboCasa, SimplerEnv) and 10 diverse real-world manipulation tasks across 4 unique robotic embodiments. These results prove that advanced VLAs require significantly fewer layers than previously assumed, offering a highly compute-efficient paradigm for scalable robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示Vision-Language-Action (VLA)模型（如pi_0, GR00T-N1.5）存在严重的层表示冗余，提出一种完全无需训练的压缩管道。通过单次前向传播和Centered Kernel Alignment识别冗余层并成对移除，将模型深度压缩高达50%。下游微调时训练时间减少40-50%，实时推理加速30%，性能持平或超越全尺寸模型。在LIBERO、RoboCasa、SimplerEnv模拟基准和10个真实世界操作任务上验证。
Motivation: 多十亿参数的VLA模型在下游微调和实时推理中计算开销巨大，亟需降低深度而不牺牲性能。
Method: 提出无需训练的压缩管道：仅用单次前向传播和Centered Kernel Alignment识别冗余特征层，然后成对移除冗余层（twin layers），压缩VLM骨干和连续控制策略头的深度达50%。
Result: 在LIBERO、RoboCasa、SimplerEnv三个模拟基准和10个真实世界操作任务（4种机器人）上，压缩后微调性能匹配或超过全尺寸模型，训练时间减少40-50%，推理延迟降低30%。
Conclusion: 先进VLA模型所需层数远少于以往假设，为可扩展的机器人学习提供了高计算效率的范式。

papers.title: Navigating Unreliable Parametric and Contextual Knowledge: Explicit Knowledge Conflict Resolution for LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across a wide range of language-based tasks by leveraging both extensive parametric knowledge and in-context learning ability, enabling them to incorporate external information provided in the input prompt. However, the integration of external knowledge can introduce conflicts, not only between the model's internal parametric knowledge and the external information, but also among multiple pieces of external contexts. Existing approaches typically assume that either the model or the provided context is reliable, overlooking the possibility that both sources may contain errors, and avoid conflicts by privileging one source over the other, rather than actively resolving inconsistencies. To address these limitations, we propose a novel framework MACR for LLM knowledge conflict resolution that moves beyond the conventional binary choice paradigm and incorporates an explicit conflict-resolution mechanism based on a multi-agent reasoning approach. Specifically, we first propose an adaptive knowledge assessment and retrieval approach that employs a modified semantic entropy measure to quantify an LLM's confidence in its answer to a given query. Based on this confidence estimation, MACR either externalizes the model's internal knowledge as textual representations or retrieves relevant external knowledge when internal knowledge is insufficient, generating basic contexts for subsequent reasoning. Then we introduce an inductive multi-agent reasoning framework with three specialized agents that, respectively, induce explicit rules, analyze potential conflicts, and resolve inconsistencies across all available contexts. Empirical results demonstrate that MACR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across benchmarks, while also providing interpretable resolutions of explicit conflicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MACR框架，用于解决大语言模型（LLM）推理中参数化知识与上下文知识之间的冲突。通过自适应知识评估与检索，结合多智能体推理机制，显式地识别并解决知识不一致问题。实验表明MACR在多个基准上显著优于现有方法，并提供可解释的冲突解决方案。
Motivation: 现有方法常假设模型或上下文之一可靠，通过偏向一方来回避冲突，而非主动解决不一致。实际应用中两者均可能包含错误，需要更鲁棒的冲突解决机制。
Method: 提出MACR框架：首先采用改进的语义熵度量评估模型对查询的置信度，据此决定是外化内部知识还是检索外部知识；然后引入归纳式多智能体推理框架，包含三个专用智能体分别负责规则归纳、潜在冲突分析和跨上下文不一致解决。
Result: 在多个基准上显著超越现有最先进基线，并提供显式冲突的可解释解决方案。
Conclusion: MACR通过显式冲突解决机制超越传统二元选择范式，为处理不可靠的参数量和上下文知识提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPOT-E: Test-Time Entropy Shaping with Visual Spotlights for Frozen VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) often underperform on evidence intensive tasks because decisive visual evidence are small, localized, and easy to overlook, leading to failures in evidence readout even when high-level reasoning is intact. Prior inference-time visual interventions can improve grounding without retraining, but they are largely open-loop and lack a mechanism to verify whether highlighted evidence is actually used. We study answer-span prediction entropy as a model-internal feedback signal and show that naive entropy minimization is ambiguous, since low entropy may arise from evidence-grounded confidence or shortcut collapse. To resolve this ambiguity, we introduce low-entropy anchors and an entropy-shaping objective that reduces answer uncertainty while preserving baseline high-confidence tokens. We instantiate this principle in SPOT-E, a plug-and-play test-time method that produces question-conditioned spotlights, optimized per instance via light-weight tuning based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Across all benchmarks and different VLM families, SPOT-E yields consistent gains and improved robustness under visual corruptions. Code is publicly available at: \url{https://github.com/YinBo0927/SPOT-E}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型在证据密集型任务中因关键视觉证据小而容易忽略的问题，提出SPOT-E，一种测试时熵整形方法，通过低熵锚点和熵整形目标，结合GRPO优化生成问题条件化的聚光灯。实验表明该方法在不同VLM家族和基准上均有一致提升，并增强了对视觉损坏的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有VLM在证据密集型任务中因忽视小且局部的关键视觉证据而表现不佳，且之前的推理时视觉干预缺乏验证高亮证据是否被实际使用的机制。
Method: 提出SPOT-E，一种即插即用的测试时方法，利用答案跨度预测熵作为模型内部反馈信号，引入低熵锚点和熵整形目标来减少答案不确定性同时保持基线高置信度token，并通过GRPO进行每个实例的轻量级优化以生成问题条件化的聚光灯。
Result: 在所有基准和不同VLM家族上，SPOT-E均取得一致的性能提升，并在视觉损坏下展现出改进的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法解决了熵最小化歧义问题，通过熵整形实现更可靠的证据读取。未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: BAFIS: Dataset + Framework to assess occupational Bias and Human Preference in modern Text-to-image Models
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence has the potential to improve productivity and transform the production of creative content. However, existing research indicates that image generation models are significantly influenced by biases. This work investigates the inherent biases and language-induced biases present in text-to-image models within the context of occupation-related image generation, complementing established metrics with human preference feedback. We present a comprehensive evaluation of five current text-to-image models: Midjourney v6.1, Stable Diffusion 3 Medium, DALL-E 3, Playground v2.5, and FLUX.1-dev , focusing on gender and ethnicity bias, image quality, and prompt alignment. To facilitate this evaluation, we developed the "Battle-Arena for Fair Image Synthesis" (BAFIS), a platform designed to collect human feedback on bias in generated images. Furthermore, we created a dataset comprising 21,140 synthetic images generated using multilingual prompts, which serves as a basis for our analysis. We further place our results within a broader social context by comparing them to official statistics from the German Federal Employment Agency. Our findings reveal systematic biases in text-to-image models, with established evaluation metrics in partial correlation with subjective user ratings. Thus, our research emphasizes the need for including human preferences to develop fairer and more inclusive text-to-image models.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision, WACV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像模型在职业图像生成中的偏见问题，提出了BAFIS平台用于收集人类反馈，并构建了一个包含21,140张多语言提示生成图像的数据集。评估了五个现代模型（Midjourney v6.1、Stable Diffusion 3 Medium、DALL-E 3、Playground v2.5、FLUX.1-dev），发现系统性的性别和种族偏见，且客观评估指标与主观用户评分仅部分相关。研究强调需要融合人类偏好以开发更公平的模型。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型存在显著的偏见问题，而现有评估多依赖客观指标，缺乏对人类主观偏好的考量。
Method: 开发了BAFIS（Battle-Arena for Fair Image Synthesis）平台用于收集人类对生成图像偏见的反馈；创建了涵盖多语言提示的21,140张图像数据集；评估了五个主流模型的性别和种族偏见、图像质量及提示对齐度，并与德国联邦就业局的官方统计数据对比。
Result: 发现所有模型均表现出系统性偏见，且客观指标（如偏见度量）与主观用户评分仅部分相关。
Conclusion: 为了开发更公平和包容的文本到图像模型，必须纳入人类偏好反馈。

papers.title: A Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization
papers.abstract_en: Many decision-making problems in computing and networking systems can be naturally formulated as cost-minimization problems under performance constraints. In dynamic environments, reinforcement learning (RL) is often used to solve such problems at runtime by embedding both costs and constraint violations into a single scalar reward through weighted penalty terms, following a Lagrangian-inspired formulation. However, in this context the behavior of the learned policy critically depends on the choice of these weights, which are typically selected manually. This makes it difficult to identify an appropriate trade-off between optimizing the primary objective and effectively avoiding constraint violations, particularly in non-stationary environments where their relative importance may change. This paper presents MAMO (Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization), an approach to tackle this balancing problem through multi-agent RL. MAMO decouples task execution from objective design by formulating the selection of reward weights as a learning problem, providing a !rst step towards more autonomous and robust RL-based solutions for constrained optimization problems in dynamic environments.
papers.comment: Presented at the 17th Workshop on Optimization and Learning in Multiagent Systems (OptLearnMAS, https://optlearnmas.github.io), co-located with the 25th International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAMO (Multi-Agent system for Multi-Objective constrained optimization)，一种利用多智能体强化学习解决动态环境中约束优化问题的方法。MAMO 将任务执行与目标设计解耦，通过将奖励权重选择建模为学习问题，避免手动调参的困难，旨在实现更自主和鲁棒的优化。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法通过加权惩罚项将约束融入奖励，但权重手工设定，难以适应非平稳环境下目标与约束相对重要性的变化。
Method: MAMO 采用多智能体 RL 架构，将奖励权重的选择视为一个独立的学习问题，从而将任务执行与目标设计解耦。
Result: 摘要报告了方法设计，未提供具体实验结果或数值指标。
Conclusion: 该方法是为动态环境中约束优化问题提供更自主和鲁棒 RL 解决方案的第一步。

papers.title: ScholarQuest: A Taxonomy-Guided Benchmark for Agentic Academic Paper Search in Open Literature Environments
papers.abstract_en: Academic paper search is a core step in scientific research, and LLM-based search agents are emerging as a promising paradigm for iterative, intent-driven literature exploration. However, existing benchmarks are insufficient for systematically evaluating agentic academic search under realistic open literature environments. We propose ScholarQuest, a large-scale, taxonomy-guided benchmark for agentic academic paper search. ScholarQuest is constructed from over 1,000 computer science topics and four representative research intents, including method-oriented, setting-anchored, comparison-based, and scope-controlled queries. It further provides scalable answer construction and a shared retrieval backend ScholarBase for reproducible evaluation. Benchmarking results show that agentic methods outperform single-shot retrieval baselines, yet the best-performing agent only achieves 0.314 Recall@100 and 0.355 Recall@All, indicating substantial room for improvement. In addition, analyses of search efficiency, intent-level robustness, and failure cases further highlight the benchmark's ability to provide multi-dimensional evaluation signals for academic paper search agents.

TL;DR: 本文提出 ScholarQuest，一个基于分类法的学术论文搜索智能体基准测试，覆盖 1000 多个计算机科学主题和四种研究意图。实验表明智能体方法优于单次检索基线，但最佳智能体 Recall@100 仅为 0.314，仍有较大提升空间。

Result: 智能体方法优于单次检索，但最佳智能体 Recall@100 为 0.314，Recall@All 为 0.355，表明性能仍有显著提升空间。
Conclusion: ScholarQuest 提供了多维度评估信号，并揭示了现有学术论文搜索智能体的不足。

papers.title: Thermodynamic Measure of Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Can intelligence be measured? We propose that intelligence can be defined as the lawful amplification of rare but valid futures: a system increases the probability of outcomes that would be unlikely under passive dynamics but remain admissible under the constraints of the domain. We start with the premise that an intelligent system must model the world and its own place within it. Because the system is part of the world it models, this leads naturally to recursive self-simulation: the system represents futures in which its own actions are part of the trajectory. Our central results give a necessity statement and a conditional near-sufficiency statement connecting this architecture to a precise thermodynamic measure of lawful amplification of rare-valid futures: high rare-valid lift is impossible unless the internal simulation identifies rare-valid futures with high fidelity; conversely, when rare-valid fidelity is high and the simulation contains an effective policy, the achievable lift approaches the actuation-limited optimum. Thus recursive self-simulation is not merely a plausible feature of intelligence but, under the stated assumptions, is necessary and nearly sufficient for high thermodynamic intelligence. The resulting framework makes intelligence measurable on a universal scale, from passive matter and feedback controllers, large language models, and humans as text generators to Maxwell-demon-like information engines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于热力学的智能度量方法，将智能定义为对罕见但有效未来的合法放大。核心结果证明，递归自模拟（系统在模型中包含自身）对于实现高罕见有效提升是必要且近乎充分的，从而为从被动物质到大型语言模型等各类系统提供统一的智能量化尺度。
Motivation: 现有智能定义缺乏统一、可量化的物理基础，难以跨不同系统（如被动物质、反馈控制器、语言模型）进行比较。
Method: 从递归自模拟架构出发，定义罕见有效提升（rare-valid lift）作为智能的度量，并证明若提升高则模拟保真度必须高，反之若保真度高且存在有效策略则提升可达最优。
Result: 理论结果表明，递归自模拟是高度智能的必要条件，并在一定条件下接近充分条件，从而将智能与热力学放大过程关联。
Conclusion: 智能可通过热力学放大罕见有效未来的能力来度量，该框架适用于从无生命系统到人类智能体的广泛对象。

papers.title: QMFOL: Benchmarking Large Language Model Reasoning via Quantifiable Monadic First-Order Logic Test Case Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant progress in reasoning, particularly in deductive reasoning, which is crucial for high-stakes decision-making. As models improve, evaluation benchmarks should evolve to keep pace. However, existing benchmarks lack fine-grained control over logical complexity and struggle to balance semantic diversity with logical consistency. To address these issues, we propose QMFOL, an automated framework for generating monadic first-order logic reasoning tasks with quantifiable and controllable complexity. It constructs formal logical structures using conjunction and disjunction patterns, enabling precise control over reasoning depth, width, label types, and distractors. These structures are then translated into natural language via LLMs, with logical consistency ensured through round-trip verification using an external prover. Based on our framework, we build QMFOLBench, a benchmark comprising 2880 instances with 960 configurations across diverse logical and semantic dimensions. Evaluations on six large reasoning models (LRMs) and two LLMs show that performance degrades and computational overhead increases with rising logical complexity. Models perform better on True-labeled tasks than on False or Unknown ones, and exhibit sensitivity to semantic variation. Overall, QMFOL offers a scalable and reliable approach for constructing deductive reasoning benchmarks with controllable complexity, enabling more precise evaluation of reasoning capabilities in modern language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QMFOL框架，用于生成具有可量化和可控复杂度的单子一阶逻辑推理任务，并构建了包含2880个实例的基准QMFOLBench。评估表明，随着逻辑复杂度增加，模型性能下降、计算开销上升；模型在True标签任务上表现优于False或Unknown任务，且对语义变化敏感。
Motivation: 现有推理基准缺乏对逻辑复杂度的细粒度控制，且难以平衡语义多样性与逻辑一致性。
Method: QMFOL框架通过合取和析取模式构建形式逻辑结构，精确控制推理深度、宽度、标签类型和干扰项，再通过LLM翻译为自然语言，并使用外部证明器进行往返验证以确保逻辑一致性。
Result: 在6个大型推理模型和2个LLM上的评估显示，性能随逻辑复杂度上升而下降，计算开销增加；模型在True标签任务上优于False或Unknown，并对语义变化敏感。
Conclusion: QMFOL提供了可扩展且可靠的构建可控复杂度演绎推理基准的方法，支持更精确的推理能力评估。

papers.title: DeepForestVisionV2: Ecology-Driven Taxonomy Expansion for Camera-Trap Monitoring in African Tropical Forests
papers.abstract_en: Camera-trap monitoring in African tropical forests increasingly extends beyond closed-canopy interiors to riverbanks, clearings, and park edges. Among available open tools for African forest camera-trap classification, DeepForestVision is the only one providing a matched offline workflow for both photographs and videos, and previous work showed that it outperformed other available baselines on a comparable benchmark. However, it was designed for closed-canopy, ground-level forest interiors and uses a 35-class prediction space that becomes too coarse when deployments encounter arboreal primates, birds, semi-aquatic taxa, or human-associated confounders such as livestock. We present DeepForestVisionV2, an ecology-driven expansion from 35 to 64 prediction classes (61 animal classes plus human, vehicle, and blank) designed to address three recurrent deployment gradients: vertical stratification, scene openness, and anthropogenic interfaces. DeepForestVisionV2 retains the same offline workflow and is trained on 1,535,010 photographs and 243,354 videos from multi-country African tropical-forest projects. Evaluation combines a cross-country cropped-photo validation set, used to assess robustness across sites and camera-trap settings, with three held-out Uganda video benchmarks spanning the targeted gradients. On the validation set, DeepForestVisionV2 reaches 0.86 accuracy, 0.82 macro-F1, and 0.81 balanced accuracy. On the deployment benchmarks, it preserves or improves baseline accuracy despite its harder classification task, while increasing the number of identified taxa from 22 to 29 in forest-interior videos and from 4 to 9 at riverbanks. In the park-edge use case, it raises accuracy from 0.62 to 0.86 and reduces false alarms from 11 to 0. These results show that DeepForestVisionV2 materially improves field utility while preserving robustness across sites, habitats, and camera-trap settings.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICPR 2026 - Computer Vision for Biodiversity Monitoring and Conservation Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了DeepForestVisionV2，将相机陷阱图像分类从35类扩展到64类（61种动物、人类、车辆和空拍），针对垂直分层、开放度、人为界面三方面梯度优化。使用153.5万张照片和24.3万个视频训练，在跨国验证集上达到0.86准确率、0.82宏F1，并在三个部署基准上提升识别物种数，尤其河岸和公园边缘场景效果显著。
Motivation: 现有DeepForestVision仅针对封闭冠层林内地表设计，35类预测空间无法覆盖树栖灵长类、水栖类、人类干扰（如家畜）等场景，限制了实际部署效用。
Method: 提出ecology-driven类别扩展（35→64类），保留离线工作流，利用多国热带森林项目的153.5万照片和243,354视频训练，并通过对跨国验证集和三个涵盖不同梯度的视频基准进行评估。
Result: 验证集上准确率0.86、宏F1 0.82、平衡准确率0.81；在林地内部视频中识别物种从22增至29，河岸从4增至9；公园边缘准确率从0.62提升至0.86，误报从11降至0。
Conclusion: DeepForestVisionV2显著提升了野外实用性，同时保持跨站点、栖息地和相机设置的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Learner-based Concept Drift Detection: Analysis and Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning algorithms deployed for evolving streaming environments must handle the non-stationary data distributions, commonly referred to as concept drift. The presence of concept drift poses a major challenge for many real-world applications because it can severely degrade their predictive performance, hindering their ability to support robust decision-making. Consequently, the timely and efficient detection of drift events is critical for sustaining high accuracy over time. This study examines theoretically the concept drift characteristics and numerous drift detection algorithms across several categories. Furthermore, we evaluate their performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets exhibiting diverse streaming scenarios and drift characteristics, such as abrupt and gradual changes. This study aims to enhance understanding of the complex notion of concept drift characteristics and behavior of drift detectors, along with their applicability to diverse contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上分析概念漂移特征，并对多种漂移检测算法进行分类评估，在合成和真实数据集上测试其性能，涵盖突变和渐变等漂移类型。
Motivation: 流式环境中的概念漂移会严重降低模型预测性能，因此需要及时高效的检测方法。
Method: 理论分析概念漂移特性，并对多类漂移检测算法进行实证评估。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上评估了多种算法在突变和渐变场景下的表现。
Conclusion: 旨在增强对概念漂移特性和检测器行为的理解，以及它们在不同情境下的适用性。

papers.title: Augmenting Game AI with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Immersion in video games depends not only on graphics, audio, and game mechanics, but also on the quality of in-game characters. Producing believable characters, or game AI, remains a significant challenge as behavioral complexity is hard to capture with hand-coded systems. Game AI is a source of immersion and engagement; however, the limitations stemming from the challenges of creating game AI often lead to frustration and the breaking of the illusion of realism within the game. The introduction of machine learning models opens the door to creating more believable, authentic, and relatable characters in games. The promise is that they either learn from interacting with the game, or from player data, to develop true human-like behavior. In this paper, we envision more applications of reinforcement learning for game AI in the future. For this to materialize, current research limitations are prohibitive to broad deployment across game genres. Therefore, we propose a framework for training reinforcement learning models with a set of requirements in mind that are suited towards game AI and game development. We present examples of games with reinforcement learning-augmented game AI and describe the practicalities of deploying player-facing machine learning agents in modern games. Furthermore, we identify bottlenecks and hard problems in these areas, which we believe offer promising research directions to accelerate the adoption of machine learning in game AI for the video game industry.
papers.comment: Vision paper, published in Conference on Games 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是发表在 Conference on Games 2026 上的愿景论文，探讨通过深度强化学习增强游戏人工智能（game AI）以提升玩家沉浸感。论文指出现有手工编码游戏AI的行为复杂性不足，并提出一套面向游戏AI和游戏开发的强化学习模型训练框架，包括针对游戏类型的需求集合。文中展示了强化学习增强的游戏AI示例，并讨论了在实际游戏中部署面向玩家的机器学习代理的实践问题，同时指出当前瓶颈和有前景的研究方向。
Motivation: 游戏AI对于玩家沉浸感至关重要，但手工编码系统难以捕捉复杂行为，导致玩家受挫和真实感破坏。强化学习有望通过与游戏交互或从玩家数据学习来生成更逼真的类人行为，但当前研究限制阻碍了其在多种游戏类型中的广泛部署。
Method: 提出一个强化学习模型训练框架，该框架考虑适用于游戏AI和游戏开发的一组需求。通过示例展示强化学习增强的游戏AI，并描述在实际游戏中部署面向玩家的机器学习代理的实践要点。
Conclusion: 识别了当前瓶颈和难题，并指出这些方向有望加速机器学习在游戏AI中的采用，从而推动视频游戏行业发展。

papers.title: FlowMaps: Modeling Long-Term Multimodal Object Dynamics with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Joint spatial and temporal understanding of 3D scenes is a crucial requirement for robots deployed in everyday household environments. Such agents must not only comprehend and navigate spatial layouts, but also reason about how these spaces evolve over time. In particular, humans interact with objects daily, causing them to change position throughout the environment and making it difficult for robots to reliably associate current observations with previously seen objects. However, these interactions are not random: human habits and routines induce spatio-temporally consistent patterns in object locations, which robotic agents can potentially learn and then exploit for downstream tasks such as navigation. To this end, we introduce FlowMaps, a latent flow matching model for estimating multimodal distributions over the future locations of dynamic objects in a continuous 3D space. By learning the implicit dependencies among objects and their temporal evolution, FlowMaps predicts likely changes in object locations conditioned on past human interactions, while supporting generalization across previously unseen environments that share similar object routines. To demonstrate the utility of this method, we deploy FlowMaps in a downstream dynamic Object Navigation task in both simulated and real-world environments. Across more than 600 episodes, FlowMaps outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, showing that modeling object dynamics through continuous, multimodal spatio-temporal distributions improves robotic search and navigation in changing household environments. Code and additional material is available at https://fra-tsuna.github.io/flowmaps/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FlowMaps，一种基于潜流匹配（latent flow matching）的模型，用于估计连续3D空间中动态物体未来位置的多模态分布。通过学习物体间隐式依赖关系及其时间演变，模型能根据过去的人类交互预测物体位置变化，并在未见场景中泛化。在模拟和真实环境中的动态物体导航任务上，超过600次实验表明该方法优于现有技术。
Motivation: 机器人在家庭环境中需要同时理解空间布局和时间演变，但人类日常交互导致物体位置频繁变化，使机器人难以关联当前观测与历史物体。现有方法未能充分利用人类行为产生的时空一致模式。
Method: FlowMaps采用潜流匹配模型，将物体动态建模为连续空间中的多模态分布，学习物体间的隐式依赖和时序演化，并利用过去的人类交互条件预测未来位置。
Result: 在超过600次模拟和真实环境实验中，FlowMaps在动态物体导航任务上超越现有最优方法，证明连续多模态时空分布建模能提升机器人在变化家庭环境中的搜索与导航能力。
Conclusion: 通过连续多模态分布建模物体动态，可有效利用人类日常行为中的时空模式，为机器人导航提供可靠预测。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Beyond Accuracy: Measuring Logical Compliance of Predictive Models
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning models are predominantly evaluated through predictive performance metrics such as ranking quality, prediction error, or classification accuracy. While these metrics effectively quantify how closely predictions match the ground truth, they do not assess whether model outputs respect predefined logical or domain-specific constraints. In high-stakes applications, including healthcare, finance, and autonomous systems, logical consistency can be as critical as predictive accuracy, yet no standard metric captures this dimension. We introduce the Rule Violation Score (RVS), a complementary evaluation metric that quantifies the extent to which a predictive model respects a given set of logical rules, independently of predictive accuracy. RVS treats hard rules (strict constraints) and soft rules (statistical regularities) differently, can be evaluated on any dataset and on any predictive model expressed over a relational vocabulary, and can be computed using SQL queries that are automatically generated for Horn rules. Beyond evaluating models, RVS can also evaluate the logical consistency of training datasets and help identify poorly defined rules. We evaluate RVS on three benchmarks covering knowledge graph link prediction and relational regression, including rule-based, embedding-based, and neuro-symbolic predictive models. Our results demonstrate that two models achieving comparable predictive accuracy can exhibit substantially different levels of logical compliance, revealing differences in model behavior that standard metrics fail to capture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出规则违反分数（Rule Violation Score, RVS），作为独立于预测精度的补充评估指标，用于量化预测模型对给定逻辑规则的遵守程度。RVS区分硬规则和软规则，可通过自动生成的SQL查询计算，适用于任何关系词汇表上的预测模型。在知识图谱链接预测和关系回归基准上，两个预测精度相似的模型在逻辑合规性上表现出显著差异，表明标准指标遗漏了模型行为的重要方面。
Motivation: 现有评估指标仅关注预测精度，未考虑模型输出是否满足逻辑或领域特定约束。在高风险应用中（如医疗、金融、自主系统），逻辑一致性可能与预测精度同等重要，但缺乏标准度量方法。
Method: 引入规则违反分数（RVS），通过自动为Horn规则生成SQL查询，独立于预测精度评估模型对逻辑规则的遵守程度。RVS对硬规则（严格约束）和软规则（统计规律）采用不同处理方式，可在任意数据集和任意预测模型上计算。
Result: 在知识图谱链接预测和关系回归基准上，两个具有可比预测精度的模型展现出不同的逻辑合规性水平，证明RVS能捕捉标准指标遗漏的模型行为差异。
Conclusion: 逻辑合规性是预测模型评估中独立于精度的关键维度，RVS提供了一种通用且可自动化的度量方法，可用于评估模型、训练数据集和规则定义的质量。

papers.title: Off-Policy Evaluation for Missingness-Aware Policies in MDPs with Rewards Missing Not at Random
papers.abstract_en: In offline Reinforcement Learning, immediate rewards in logged batch data are often unobserved due to sparse or irregular record-keeping, or censored beyond certain reward values. This issue arises in practical settings, including health care and marketing. We investigate off-policy evaluation (OPE) in finite-horizon Markov decision processes when rewards are missing not at random (MNAR), which breaks ignorability and induces selection bias even after conditioning on states and actions. To address this, we formalize a reward-dependent propensity model and use future states as shadow variables to identify the full-data conditional mean reward. We further introduce a bridge function that recovers the conditional mean reward without explicitly modeling the MNAR mechanism, and estimate it via a min-max procedure to avoid double sampling. Building upon these identification results, we propose an Fitted-Q-Evaluation-style estimator that propagates the recovered rewards while allowing target policies to depend on past missingness indicators. Finally, we establish consistency and finite-sample error bounds for our OPE estimator, and show through experiments the strong performance of our method compared to existing methods on simulated and MIMIC-III Sepsis data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了有限马尔可夫决策过程中奖励缺失非随机（MNAR）情况下的离策略评估（OPE）问题。作者形式化了奖励依赖的倾向性模型，利用未来状态作为影子变量识别条件均值奖励，并通过桥函数和最小-最大估计避免显式建模MNAR机制。提出了类似Fitted-Q-Evaluation的估计器，在允许目标策略依赖过去缺失指示符的同时传播恢复的奖励，并给出了一致性和有限样本误差界。
Motivation: 离线强化学习中，奖励常因记录稀疏或不规则而缺失，且缺失机制为非随机（MNAR），导致即使以状态和动作为条件也会产生选择偏差，现有OPE方法无法处理。
Method: 形式化奖励缺失的倾向性模型，利用未来状态作为影子变量恢复条件均值奖励；引入桥函数并通过最小-最大程序估计，避免双重采样；基于此提出Fitted-Q-Evaluation风格的估计器，允许目标策略依赖历史缺失指示符。
Result: 在模拟数据和MIMIC-III脓毒症数据集上，所提方法相比现有方法表现出更强的性能。
Conclusion: 本文为MNAR奖励下的OPE提供了理论与算法框架，具有医疗等实际应用价值。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文为MNAR奖励下的OPE提供了理论与算法框架，具有医疗等实际应用价值。

papers.title: Apparent Psychological Profiles of Large Language Models are Largely a Measurement Artifact
papers.abstract_en: Psychological instruments designed for humans are increasingly used to assign large language models (LLMs) stable psychological profiles that affect their usability, safety assessment, and use as proxies for human participants in research. Using a formal psychometric framework, we show that these profiles are largely a measurement artifact. Administering a battery of personality and risk-preference instruments spanning self-reports and behavioral tasks to 56 instruction-tuned LLMs alongside large human reference samples, we report four findings. First, differences between models are driven not by the traits an instrument targets but by a directional response bias, a tendency to respond toward one end of the scale, or one labeled option, regardless of item content; a variance decomposition attributes 81-90% of between-model variation to this bias, against 9-16% in humans. Second, the bias declines with model capability but is not eliminated by it. Third, because bias rather than trait drives responding, an instrument's apparent reliability is almost entirely predicted by its response orthogonality, a term we coin for the proportion of items for which trait and bias point in opposite directions. Fourth, the profile a model appears to have shifts with the items used and can be manufactured through item selection. These results demonstrate that the apparent psychological profiles of LLMs are artifacts of the instrument used to measure them, not properties of the models themselves. As instruments borrowed from human psychology are rarely fully orthogonal and may inherently lack validity for LLMs, we call for dedicated assessments centered on response orthogonality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过心理测量学框架，对56个指令微调的大型语言模型（LLM）进行了人格和风险偏好测试，发现它们表现出的心理特征主要是测量伪影。模型间的差异主要由方向性响应偏差（directional response bias）驱动，而非目标特质，方差分解显示81-90%的模型间变异来自此偏差。偏差随模型能力提升而下降，但不会被消除。仪器表的表面信度几乎完全由其响应正交性（response orthogonality）预测。模型的心理特征可以通过项目选择人为制造。结论是，LLM看似稳定的心理特征只是测量工具的产物，而非模型自身属性。
Motivation: 心理学工具越来越多地用于给LLM分配稳定心理特征，影响其可用性、安全评估及作为人类被试替代品的有效性。这些测量是否有效尚存疑问，需要严格检验。
Method: 使用正式的心理测量框架，对56个指令微调LLM施测一套自我报告和行为任务形式的人格与风险偏好工具，同时收集大量人类样本作为参照。通过方差分解分析模型间变异来源，并引入“响应正交性”概念解释仪器表的信度。
Result: 1) 模型间差异主要由方向性响应偏差驱动（占比81-90%，人类仅9-16%）；2) 偏差随模型能力下降但未消除；3) 仪器表的信度几乎完全由响应正交性预测；4) 通过选择项目可以人为制造LLM的心理特征。
Conclusion: LLM表现出的心理特征实质是测量伪影，而非模型自身的内在属性。由于从人类心理学借用的工具很少具有完全正交性，可能对LLM天然缺乏效度，因此呼吁开发以响应正交性为中心的专门评估方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation of Image Matching for Art Skills Assessment
papers.abstract_en: While some individuals possess a natural talent for drawing, mastering this skill requires dedicated training and practice. Determining one's skill in the art of drawing requires proper comprehensive assessment. In this paper, we propose a method to measure drawing skill by by matching the hand-drawn image with the original template. Existing techniques often involve complex processes. However, advancements in computer vision allow us to train computers to perform these comparisons at a human-like level, thereby resolving the tedious and overwhelming traditional process. Using computer vision applications, determining image similarity involves identifying the level of similarities in an image with a reference image. We have implemented and analyzed the SIFT feature and Siamese network to measure image similarity. Our results indicate that it is feasible to assess art skill levels. Through feature analysis, we found that SIFT-based key point matching provides a more effective means of detecting drawing skills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图像匹配的绘画技能评估方法，通过将手绘图像与原始模板进行相似度比较来衡量技能水平。作者实现了SIFT特征和Siamese网络两种方法，实验表明SIFT的关键点匹配在检测绘画技能方面更有效。
Motivation: 传统绘画技能评估过程繁琐且耗时，现有计算机视觉方法尚未充分解决该问题。本文旨在利用图像匹配技术自动化评估过程。
Method: 采用SIFT特征匹配和Siamese网络两种计算机视觉方法，计算手绘图像与模板图像的相似度。
Result: 实验结果表明，SIFT特征匹配比Siamese网络更有效地检测绘画技能水平。
Conclusion: 通过图像匹配评估绘画技能是可行的，SIFT方法在特征分析中表现更优。
