papers.title: MetaResearcher: Scaling Deep Research via Self-Reflective Reinforcement Learning in Adversarial Virtual Environments
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in autonomous information gathering and synthesis, yet their training remains constrained by the static nature of simulated environments, the limits of fact-retrieval-only task designs, and the inefficiency of outcome-based reinforcement learning. In this work, we propose MetaResearcher, a novel framework that scales deep research agent training across four synergistic dimensions. First, we introduce an Evolving Virtual World that injects temporal dynamics and adversarial misinformation into the training environment, forcing agents to develop source credibility assessment and temporal conflict resolution skills. Second, we design Discovery-Oriented Tasks -- including hypothesis generation and contradiction resolution -- that transcend simple fact retrieval and push agents toward genuine research behaviors. Third, we propose a Self-Reflective Meta-Reward mechanism within the GRPO framework that jointly optimizes for answer correctness, search path efficiency, reflection depth, and tool call diversity, directly addressing the repetitive action loop problem observed in prior work. Fourth, we introduce a Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Swarm architecture comprising specialized Scout, Filter, and Synthesizer models that learn collaborative research strategies through coordinated reinforcement learning. Built upon the LiteResearcher infrastructure, MetaResearcher requires zero marginal API cost for training while targeting substantial improvements in both benchmark performance (GAIA, Xbench-DS) and epistemic robustness under adversarial conditions. We present the complete framework design, training methodology, and planned experimental validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MetaResearcher，一个扩展深度研究智能体训练的新框架，通过四个维度协同改进：演化虚拟世界引入时间动态和对抗性错误信息；发现导向任务超越简单事实检索；基于GRPO的自反思元奖励机制联合优化答案正确性、搜索路径效率等；异构多智能体群架构使专业模型通过协作强化学习。基于LiteResearcher基础设施，训练零边际API成本，目标在GAIA和Xbench-DS基准及对抗条件下提升性能。
Motivation: 现有深度研究智能体训练受限于静态模拟环境、仅事实检索的任务设计以及基于结果的强化学习效率低下，需要更接近真实研究行为的训练框架。
Method: 提出MetaResearcher框架，包含演化虚拟世界（注入时间动态和对抗性错误信息）、发现导向任务（如假设生成和矛盾解决）、自反思元奖励机制（GRPO框架内联合优化多个目标）以及异构多智能体群架构（Scout、Filter、Synthesizer模型协同强化学习）。
Result: 摘要声称在GAIA和Xbench-DS基准上取得显著改进，并增强对抗条件下的认知鲁棒性，训练零边际API成本。具体数值待实验验证。
Conclusion: MetaResearcher通过多维训练环境设计、任务创新和奖励机制，旨在解决深度研究智能体训练中的关键瓶颈，但实验验证为计划阶段。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体训练受限于静态模拟环境、仅事实检索的任务设计以及基于结果的强化学习效率低下，需要更接近真实研究行为的训练框架。
summary_sections.method: 提出MetaResearcher框架，包含演化虚拟世界（注入时间动态和对抗性错误信息）、发现导向任务（如假设生成和矛盾解决）、自反思元奖励机制（GRPO框架内联合优化多个目标）以及异构多智能体群架构（Scout、Filter、Synthesizer模型协同强化学习）。
summary_sections.result: 摘要声称在GAIA和Xbench-DS基准上取得显著改进，并增强对抗条件下的认知鲁棒性，训练零边际API成本。具体数值待实验验证。
summary_sections.conclusion: MetaResearcher通过多维训练环境设计、任务创新和奖励机制，旨在解决深度研究智能体训练中的关键瓶颈，但实验验证为计划阶段。

papers.title: Adversarial Bandit Optimization with Globally Bounded Perturbations to Convex Losses
papers.abstract_en: We study adversarial bandit optimization in which the loss functions may be non-convex and non-smooth. In each round, the learner selects an action and observes only the loss incurred at that action. The loss consists of an underlying convex and $β$-smooth component and an adversarial perturbation that may be chosen after observing the learner's action. The perturbations are subject to a global budget controlling their cumulative magnitude over time. This framework extends the globally budgeted, post-action perturbation model from underlying linear losses to general convex and $β$-smooth losses. For this broader class, we establish expected regret guarantees that explicitly characterize the effect of the perturbation budget. To establish these guarantees, we modify a standard bandit optimization algorithm and develop an analysis that controls the additional regret caused by the perturbations. In the absence of perturbations, our results reduce to regret guarantees for the standard bandit convex optimization setting with $β$-smooth losses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究对抗性赌博机优化，其中损失函数可能非凸非光滑。每轮学习者选择动作并仅观察该动作的损失，损失由潜在凸且β-光滑成分和对抗性扰动组成，扰动受全局预算约束。该框架将后动作扰动模型从线性损失扩展到一般凸且β-光滑损失，并建立了显式刻画扰动预算影响的期望遗憾上界。通过修改标准赌博机优化算法和分析，控制扰动引起的额外遗憾，无扰动时退化为标准凸光滑赌博机优化的遗憾上界。
Motivation: 现有对抗性扰动下的赌博机优化主要限于线性损失，本文旨在将模型推广到更一般的凸且β-光滑损失，并考虑全局预算的扰动，以更贴近实际场景。
Method: 修改标准赌博机优化算法，并开发新的分析方法以控制扰动带来的额外遗憾，从而建立期望遗憾上界。
Result: 建立了期望遗憾上界，显式刻画了扰动预算的影响；在无扰动时，结果退化为标准凸β-光滑损失赌博机优化的遗憾上界。
Conclusion: 本文为广义凸光滑损失下的对抗性扰动赌博机优化提供了理论保证，拓展了相关模型的应用范围。

papers.title: SurgVista: Long-Horizon Surgical World Modeling with Plausible Instrument-Tissue Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Scaling robot policy learning for autonomous surgery is challenging, as expert demonstrations are expensive and in vivo exploration poses substantial safety risks. Surgical world models address this by generating realistic, action-conditioned future frames from an initial observation, but existing methods exhibit two persistent failure modes: spatial interaction incoherence, where visible instrument contact fails to induce spatially consistent tissue deformation, and temporal fidelity collapse, where prediction errors compound across autoregressive rollouts and progressively corrupt visual quality. We present SurgVista, a surgical world model that mitigates both failures through two training recipes. Deformation Consistency Regularization extracts scene-point trajectories from training videos and enforces cross-frame coherence through latent contrastive learning, strengthening physically consistent instrument-tissue dynamics. Drift Adaptation Training mitigates long-horizon drift by perturbing conditioning frames with online prediction residuals and photometric augmentations calibrated to long-horizon drift statistics, sustaining visual fidelity over extended rollouts. To enable rigorous evaluation, we further introduce SurgWorld-Bench, featuring diverse procedure types, long-range rollouts, and decoupled metrics for instrument-motion accuracy and tissue-response fidelity. Extensive experiments show that SurgVista consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across visual quality, temporal consistency, and interaction fidelity, with gains widening as the prediction horizon grows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对手术世界模型的两类失效模式（空间交互不连贯和时间保真度崩溃），提出 SurgVista 模型。通过形变一致性正则化和漂移自适应训练，在长程预测中保持视觉质量和交互保真度，并引入 SurgWorld-Bench 基准进行多维度评估。实验表明 SurgVista 在视觉质量、时间一致性和交互保真度上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 真实手术演示数据昂贵且体内探索存在安全风险，现有手术世界模型在长程预测中会出现交互不连贯和视觉质量下降的问题。
Method: 提出两种训练策略：形变一致性正则化（从训练视频提取场景点轨迹，通过潜在对比学习强制跨帧一致性）和漂移自适应训练（用在线预测残差和针对长程漂移统计量校准的光度增强扰动条件帧）。
Result: 在 SurgWorld-Bench 上，SurgVista 在视觉质量、时间一致性和交互保真度上持续优于现有方法，且随着预测长度增加优势扩大。
Conclusion: SurgVista 通过针对性的正则化和漂移缓解策略，有效改善了手术世界模型的长程预测能力。

papers.title: SL-S4Wave: Self-Supervised Learning of Physiological Waveforms with Structured State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Modeling long-sequence medical time series data, such as electrocardiograms (ECG), poses significant challenges due to high sampling rates, multichannel signal complexity, inherent noise, and limited labeled data. While recent self-supervised learning (SSL) methods, based on various encoder architectures such as convolutional neural networks, have been proposed to learn representations from unlabeled data, they often fall short in capturing long-range dependencies and noise-invariant features. Structured state space models (S4) excel at long-sequence modeling, but existing S4 architectures fail to capture the unique characteristics of multichannel physiological waveforms. In this work, we propose SL-S4Wave, a self-supervised learning framework that combines contrastive learning with a tailored encoder built on structured state space models. The encoder incorporates multi-layer global convolution using multiscale subkernels, enabling the capture of both fine-grained local patterns and long-range temporal dependencies in noisy, high-resolution multichannel waveforms. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets demonstrate that SL-S4Wave (1) consistently outperforms state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised baselines in a challenging arrhythmia detection task, (2) achieves high performance with significantly fewer labeled examples, showcasing strong label efficiency, and (3) maintains robust performance on long waveform segments, highlighting its capacity to model complex temporal dynamics in long sequences that most existing approaches fail to efficiently model, and (4) transfers effectively to unseen arrhythmia types, underscoring its robust cross-domain generalization. We additionally evaluate SL-S4Wave on multiple EEG tasks, achieving superior performance over strong baselines, demonstrating generalizability of our approach beyond cardiac waveforms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SL-S4Wave，一种结合对比学习与结构化状态空间模型（S4）的自监督学习框架，用于处理高采样率、多通道、含噪声的生理波形（如ECG和EEG）。其编码器通过多尺度子核的多层全局卷积，同时捕捉局部细节和长程依赖。在心律失常检测和多项EEG任务上，SL-S4Wave优于现有监督和自监督基线，且标签效率高、长序列建模能力强、跨领域泛化性好。
Motivation: 现有自监督学习方法在建模长序列生理波形时难以捕捉长程依赖和噪声不变特征，而结构化状态空间模型虽擅长长序列建模，但未针对多通道生理波形的特性进行设计。
Method: 提出SL-S4Wave框架，包含一个基于结构化状态空间模型的编码器，该编码器采用多尺度子核的多层全局卷积，以同时捕获细粒度局部模式和长程时间依赖。训练使用对比学习。
Result: 在心律失常检测任务上持续超越最先进的监督和自监督基线；仅用少量标注样本即达到高性能，展现强标签效率；在长波形片段上保持稳健性能；能有效迁移到未见的心律失常类型；在多个EEG任务上也取得优于强基线的表现。
Conclusion: SL-S4Wave通过结合S4与对比学习，有效建模了长序列、多通道生理波形，并展示了良好的泛化能力和标签效率。

papers.title: FFinRED: An Expert-Guided Benchmark Generation and Evaluation Framework for Financial LLM Red-Teaming
papers.abstract_en: Existing safety benchmarks target general adversarial scenarios but miss finance-specific risks. Financial LLMs face regulatory compliance violations, fraud facilitation, and systemic trust erosion that require targeted evaluation. We introduce FinRED, an expert-guided red-teaming framework for financial LLM safety evaluation developed with financial experts. FinRED uses a novel two-level taxonomy mapping global standards (e.g., FATF and EU DORA) to threats ranging from regulatory evasion to complex fraud, integrated with a scalable pipeline that converts real financial documents into context-rich red-teaming Behavioral Prompts (seeds) through an expert-defined schema. Rigorous expert validation confirms seed plausibility and realism for meaningful LLM safety evaluation. We also provide an expert-validated, finance-specific rubric that goes beyond disclaimer checks, aligns more closely with human experts than static one-size-fits-all rubrics, and reduces critical false negatives from 28 to 12. Aligned with internationally adopted risk-management and information-security standards (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001), FinRED is deployed in South Korea's Financial Security Institute (FSI) regulatory sandbox for generative AI security evaluation in real financial services. To mitigate dual-use risks, the dataset, generation pipeline, prompt template, and evaluation framework are gated for qualified researchers at https://github.com/selectstar-ai/FinRED-paper and https://huggingface.co/datasets/datumo/FinRED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FinRED，一个由金融专家指导的 LLM 红队测试框架，专门用于评估金融领域 LLM 的安全风险。该框架基于双层次分类法，将全球标准（如 FATF 和 EU DORA）映射到金融特定威胁（如监管规避和复杂欺诈），并通过可扩展的流水线将真实金融文档转化为上下文丰富的红队行为提示（种子）。经过专家验证的评估标准比静态通用标准更接近人类专家，将关键假阴性从 28 降至 12。FinRED 已在韩国金融安全研究所（FSI）监管沙盒中部署。
Motivation: 现有安全基准主要针对通用对抗场景，忽略了金融领域特有的监管合规违规、欺诈助力和系统性信任侵蚀等风险，需要专门针对金融 LLM 的评估框架。
Method: FinRED 结合金融专家参与，构建双层次分类法（将全球金融标准映射到威胁），设计专家定义的模式（schema），通过可扩展流水线从真实金融文档生成上下文丰富的红队行为提示（seeds），并提供专家验证的金融专用评估标准（rubric）。
Result: 专家验证表明该框架生成的提示具有合理性，专用评估标准比静态通用标准更接近人类专家，并将关键假阴性从 28 减少到 12。
Conclusion: FinRED 提供了金融领域 LLM 安全评估的专用框架，已部署于监管沙盒，但由于双重用途风险，数据集和生成流水线仅对合格研究人员开放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Matching Markets meet Cumulative Prospect Theory: Towards Optimal and Adversarially Robust Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study a multi-agent multi-armed bandit problem in the competitive setup with two-sided matching markets under a human centric decision making model. To capture human preferences, we use cumulative prospect theory (CPT) that weighs the actions of the agent in a nonlinear fashion using a ($α$-Hölder continuous) weight function. CPT has been widely used in behavioral economics and risk sensitive machine learning to emulate human preferences. We analyze the state-of-the-art learning algorithm with CPT weight distorted rewards and obtain a player optimal regret of $\mathcal{O}(K\log T \left(\frac{1}Δ\right)^{2/α})$, where $K$ denotes the number of arms, $T$ is the learning horizon, and $Δ$ represents (suitably defined) players' minimum preference gap. Noticing the dependence on $Δ$ to be sub-optimal, we further improve this regret by judiciously selecting the active set of arms during exploration, which removes the dependence on $K$ in the dominant term and achieves an improved (optimal) regret guarantees in the setting where the number of arms $K$ is significantly larger than the number of players $N$. In addition, we consider adversarial markets where the observed rewards of the agents may be corrupted. We propose and analyze algorithms for robust markets with CPT as risk sensitive measure in both settings where the total corruption budget is known and where it is unknown, and establish logarithmic player-optimal regret guarantees in both cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究竞争性双边匹配市场中的多智能体多臂老虎机问题，引入累积前景理论（CPT）来模拟人类非线性的决策偏好，提出了CPT扭曲奖励下的学习算法，并证明了玩家最优遗憾界。进一步考虑对抗性市场（奖励可能被篡改），提出了已知和未知总篡改预算下的鲁棒算法，均达到对数级遗憾。
Motivation: 现有匹配市场学习算法通常假设理性行为，未考虑人类决策中的风险偏好和概率扭曲，而这在行为经济学中由累积前景理论刻画。同时，市场可能面临对抗性干扰。
Method: 将CPT中的权重函数（α-Hölder连续）引入奖励观察，修改传统UCB算法。通过精心选择活跃臂集进行探索，移除主导项中对K的依赖，实现最优遗憾。对抗性场景下，利用预算感知的鲁棒估计。
Result: CPT扭曲下得到O(K log T (1/Δ)^{2/α})遗憾；改进算法在K>>N时达到最优遗憾（与K无关）。对抗性场景下，已知与未知预算时均获得对数级玩家最优遗憾。
Conclusion: 本文首次将累积前景理论与匹配市场多臂老虎机结合，并扩展至对抗性设置，为人类中心决策的鲁棒学习提供了理论基础。

papers.title: Multimodal Concept Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) enhance the interpretability of deep learning networks by aligning the features extracted from images with natural concepts. However, existing CBMs are constrained in their ability to generalize beyond a fixed set of predefined classes and the risk of non-concept information leakage, where predictive signals outside the intended concepts are inadvertently exploited. In this paper, we propose Multimodal Concept Bottleneck Model (MM-CBM) to address these issues and extend CBMs into CLIP. MM-CBM utilizes dual Concept Bottleneck Layers (CBLs) to align both the image and text embeddings into interpretable features. This allows us to perform new vision tasks like zero-shot classification or image retrieval in an interpretable way. Compared to existing methods, MM-CBM achieves up to 51.26% accuracy improvement on average across four standard benchmarks. Our method maintains high accuracy, staying within ~5% of black-box performance while offering greater interpretability.
papers.comment: Present at NeurIPS 2025 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop
papers.summary_zh:

Result: 在四个标准基准上平均准确率提升51.26%，性能接近黑盒模型（差距在5%以内）。

papers.title: On the Oracle Complexity of Interpolation-Based Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on first-order optimizers for empirical risk minimization (ERM) has suggested that smoothness of ERM loss functions in the training data, rather than in the optimization parameters, can be leveraged to improve the oracle complexity of gradient descent (GD) methods. In this paper, we propose an inexact gradient method, piecewise polynomial interpolation-based gradient descent (PPI-GD), which approximates the full gradient in each iteration by querying the first-order oracle at equidistant points in the data domain to construct polynomial interpolants of the resulting gradient samples over appropriately sized patches of the data domain. We analyze the oracle complexity of PPI-GD for strongly convex and non-convex loss functions when the data space dimension is bounded by a polylogarithmic function of the number of training samples, and find it to outperform several GD variants in key regimes when the loss function is sufficiently smooth. Furthermore, our analysis extends several techniques from the error analysis of bicubic spline interpolants to the setting of $d$-variate tensor product polynomial interpolants which may be of independent interest in interpolation analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于分段多项式插值的不精确梯度方法 PPI-GD，通过在数据域上查询等距点的一阶预言构造多项式插值来近似梯度。对于强凸和非凸损失函数，当数据空间维度为训练样本数的对数多项式有界时，PPI-GD 的预言复杂度在关键区域优于多种梯度下降变体。论文还扩展了双三次样条插值误差分析到 d 变量张量积多项式插值。
Motivation: 现有工作表明利用 ERM 损失函数在训练数据上的光滑性（而非参数上的光滑性）可改善梯度下降的预言复杂度，本文旨在进一步利用数据域光滑性设计更高效的算法。
Method: 提出 PPI-GD：每次迭代在数据域上的等距点查询一阶预言，通过分段多项式插值（如张量积多项式）近似完整梯度，并动态调整插值片段大小。
Result: 在强凸和非凸损失函数下，当数据空间维数为训练样本数的对数多项式有界时，PPI-GD 的预言复杂度优于多种梯度下降变体。
Conclusion: 利用数据域光滑性可有效提升梯度下降的预言效率，且提出的插值误差分析技术具有独立价值。

papers.title: Global Convergence of Gradient Descent for Score Matching in Gaussian Mixtures via Reverse Fisher Divergence
papers.abstract_en: The score matching problem is a central training objective in modern generative modeling, diffusion models, fitting unnormalized statistical models, and inverse problems. A standard approach is to minimize the forward Fisher divergence, where the expectation is taken with respect to the teacher distribution. However, recent results show that even in simple Gaussian mixture model settings, this objective can lead to undesirable and initialization-dependent convergence behavior. In this paper, we study an alternative objective: the reverse Fisher divergence, where the expectation is taken with respect to the student distribution. We analyze gradient descent (GD) for fitting Gaussian mixture models and show that this change in the objective leads to significantly better optimization properties. First, when the teacher distribution is a single Gaussian and the student is a Gaussian mixture model with fixed weights and identity covariances, we prove the global convergence of GD from arbitrary initializations. Second, we extend the analysis to the case where the teacher is also a Gaussian mixture model and prove global convergence guarantees under a global random initialization scheme and a $\widetildeΩ(1)$-separation assumption on the target means. In particular, with high probability, each student component converges near its closest teacher component, and we provide conditions under which the student distribution converges in total variation distance. Our proofs rely on a new Lyapunov-based analysis of the gradient descent dynamics, showing that the reverse Fisher divergence has a much more favorable optimization landscape than the forward Fisher divergence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究评分匹配问题中的反向Fisher散度（reverse Fisher divergence）目标，分析其在高斯混合模型拟合中的优化性质。作者证明，当教师分布为单高斯、学生为固定权重和单位协方差的高斯混合时，梯度下降从任意初始化全局收敛。进一步，在教师也为高斯混合且目标均值满足分离假设时，随机初始化下每个学生分量收敛到最近教师分量，学生分布在全变差距离下收敛。证明基于新的Lyapunov分析，表明反向Fisher散度比前向Fisher散度具有更有利的优化景观。
Motivation: 标准前向Fisher散度在简单高斯混合模型中会导致依赖初始化的不良收敛行为，亟需更优的目标函数。
Method: 采用反向Fisher散度作为目标，其中期望对student分布取，而非teacher分布；并利用Lyapunov分析法证明梯度下降的全局收敛性。
Result: 当教师为单高斯时，梯度下降从任意初始化全局收敛；当教师为高斯混合时，在随机初始化且目标均值满足~Ω(1)分离假设下，学生分量以高概率收敛到最近教师分量，学生分布在全变差距离下收敛。
Conclusion: 反向Fisher散度相比前向Fisher散度具有更优的优化景观，为评分匹配提供新的理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MMD-SLAM: Structure-Enhanced Multi-Meta Gaussian Distribution-Guided Visual SLAM
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has significantly boosted novel view synthesis and high-fidelity scene reconstruction, expanding the potential of 3DGS-based Visual Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) methods. However, most existing systems fail to fully exploit the underlying structural information, which limits rendering quality and often leads to inconsistent maps. To address these limitations, we propose MMD-SLAM, a structure-enhanced Visual SLAM framework that leverages the Atlanta World (AW) assumption to guide a Multi-Meta Gaussian representation for photorealistic mapping. First, we introduce a point-line fusion strategy for pose optimization, where 3D line segments are incorporated to improve tracking robustness and provide additional constraints for mapping. Second, we design a Multi-Meta Gaussian representation with dominant directions, explicitly encoding structural priors from the AW hypothesis. Finally, we propose a Gaussian evolution strategy that adapts to scene geometry and incorporates structural cues into global optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that these innovations enable MMD-SLAM to achieve state-of-the-art performance in both tracking accuracy and mapping quality. e.g., our method achieves a 48.56% reduction in ATE RMSE on ScanNet and a 5.71% improvement in PSNR on Replica, compared with MonoGS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MMD-SLAM，一种基于结构增强的视觉SLAM框架，利用Atlanta World假设引导多元高斯表示进行逼真建图。通过点线融合策略优化位姿，设计带主导方向的多元高斯表示，并提出高斯演化策略适应场景几何。在ScanNet和Replica数据集上，追踪精度和建图质量均达到领先水平。
Motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的SLAM方法未能充分利用场景结构信息，导致渲染质量受限和地图不一致。
Method: 提出MMD-SLAM框架：1）点线融合策略用于位姿优化，引入3D线段增强追踪鲁棒性；2）基于Atlanta World假设的多元高斯表示，编码结构先验；3）高斯演化策略适应场景几何并融入全局优化。
Result: 在ScanNet数据集上，ATE RMSE降低48.56%；在Replica数据集上，PSNR提升5.71%，相比MonoGS达到SOTA。
Conclusion: 结构增强的多元高斯表示有效提升了视觉SLAM的追踪精度与建图质量，验证了Atlanta World假设在SLAM中的潜力。

papers.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Black-Box Uncertainty Estimation Methods for Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Although large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, their outputs often remain unreliable and may contain hallucinations, making uncertainty estimation (UE) essential for building trustworthy LLMs. In practice, many mainstream LLMs are only accessible through restricted APIs, where internal signals such as logits and hidden states are unavailable, making black-box UE especially important. However, existing work on black-box UE for LLMs remains fragmented in methodology and lacks a unified empirical comparison. To address this gap, we present a systematic review of black-box UE methods and organize them into five categories: verbalization-based, sampling-based, explanation-based, multi-agent, and hybrid methods. We further build a unified evaluation framework and benchmark 24 representative methods across 4 models and 4 dataset settings. Our results show that no single method consistently dominates across all settings. Nevertheless, methods that reason over and compare candidates in the answer space are generally effective, and hybrid methods that combine multiple uncertainty signals perform well under most conditions. By releasing the benchmark data and a unified evaluation framework, we aim to facilitate reproducible comparisons and support future research, while our empirical findings provide practical guidance for developing future black-box UE methods for LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了大型语言模型的黑盒不确定性估计方法，将其分为五类（基于言语化、基于采样、基于解释、多智能体和混合方法），并在4个模型和4个数据集设置下基准测试了24种代表性方法。结果表明没有单一方法在所有设置中一致占优，但基于答案空间推理和比较的方法通常有效，混合方法在大多数条件下表现良好。
Motivation: 黑盒不确定性估计对于仅通过受限API访问的LLM至关重要，但现有工作方法学上碎片化，缺乏统一的实证比较。
Method: 将黑盒UE方法分为五类，构建统一评估框架，在4个模型和4种数据集设置下基准测试24种方法。
Result: 没有单一方法在所有设置中一致占优；基于答案空间推理和比较的方法通常有效；混合方法在大多数条件下表现良好。
Conclusion: 通过发布基准数据和统一评估框架促进可重复比较，实证结果为未来黑盒UE方法提供实践指导。

papers.title: PSCT-Net: Geometry-Aware Pediatric Skull CT Reconstruction via Differentiable Back-Projection and Attention-Guided Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Computed Tomography (CT) is essential for diagnosing pediatric craniofacial abnormalities, yet poses radiation risks to developing anatomies. Reconstructing 3D CT from sparse bi-planar X-rays offers a low-dose alternative but is severely ill-posed. Existing methods employ geometry-agnostic feature lifting, naively projecting 2D features into 3D without explicit spatial modeling, causing depth ambiguity and degraded osseous boundaries. We present PSCT-Net, a geometry-aware framework with differentiable back-projection. Differentiable back-projection establishes a spatially faithful volumetric prior, alleviating depth ambiguity. An Attention-Guided Projection (AGP-3D) module then learns non-linear voxel-wise correspondences between 2D regions and 3D locations. A Bidirectional Mamba (BiM-3D) module captures long-range volumetric dependencies with linear complexity. We further curate a private institutional pediatric skull CT cohort, PedSkull-CT, comprising normal and pathological cases for internal evaluation, addressing the gap in adult-centric, trunk-focused datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PSCT-Net，一种几何感知的儿科颅骨CT重建框架，从稀疏双平面X光重建3D CT，通过可微分反投影建立空间先验，结合注意力引导投影（AGP-3D）和双向Mamba（BiM-3D）模块，解决深度模糊和骨骼边界退化问题。在自建儿科颅骨数据集PedSkull-CT上评估。
Motivation: 儿科CT扫描存在辐射风险，从稀疏X光重建3D CT是一种低剂量替代方案，但该问题严重病态。现有方法缺乏几何先验，导致深度模糊和骨骼边界质量差。
Method: 提出几何感知框架，包括可微分反投影构建空间先验、注意力引导投影（AGP-3D）学习2D-3D对应、双向Mamba（BiM-3D）捕获长程体素依赖。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅在自建儿科颅骨数据集上内部评估。

papers.title: Doeblin Curves
papers.abstract_en: Recent research on Doeblin coefficients has shed light on their usefulness as a multi-way generalization of the Dobrushin contraction coefficient for TV distance, in a separate vein from their classic role in the theory of Markov chain ergodicity. However, strong conditions, such as being bounded away from 0, are typically necessary for Doeblin coefficients to establish the existence of information contraction. Building on recently formulated concepts of nonlinear information contraction, we aim to propose a finer-grained Doeblin-based characterization of multi-way contraction behavior which yields non-vacuous contraction guarantees even for channels whose Doeblin coefficient is 0. To this end, we introduce the notion of a Doeblin curve -- a nonlinear function which quantifies the contraction behavior of a Markov kernel on collections of input distributions at specific levels of divergence and power. Through the course of our analysis, we develop a new variational characterization of Doeblin coefficients, present several properties of Doeblin curves, define several versions of power-constrained Doeblin curves, and derive upper and lower bounds using our aforementioned variational characterization. We then utilize these results in diverse areas, including generalization bounds for noisy iterative optimization, error bounds for reliable computation with noisy circuits, and differential privacy guarantees for online iterative algorithms. In particular, we extend results in these areas to broader domains or group settings, leveraging Doeblin curves to reveal finer-grained contraction phenomena than Doeblin coefficients.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Information Theory, vol. 72, no. 6, pp. 3556-3596, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Doeblin 曲线 (Doeblin curve) 概念，这是一种非线性函数，用于量化马尔可夫核在特定散度水平和功率下对输入分布集合的收缩行为。即使当 Doeblin 系数为零时，该曲线也能提供非平凡的收缩保证。作者开发了新的变分刻画，定义了功率约束版本，并推导了上下界。应用包括含噪迭代优化的泛化界、含噪电路的误差界以及在线迭代算法的差分隐私保证，将现有结果扩展到更广泛的领域。
Motivation: 经典 Doeblin 系数需要远离零才能建立信息收缩的存在性，但许多信道的 Doeblin 系数为零时缺乏收缩保证，需要一个更细粒度的刻画。
Method: 引入 Doeblin 曲线，一种基于非线性函数的多路收缩刻画；开发 Doeblin 系数的变分刻画；定义多种功率约束 Doeblin 曲线并利用变分推导边界。
Result: 摘要声称该方法在含噪迭代优化、含噪电路和差分隐私等领域的现有结果被扩展到更广泛的领域或群体设置，揭示了比 Doeblin 系数更细粒度的收缩现象。
Conclusion: 论文强调 Doeblin 曲线在信息论和机器学习中的理论价值，但未明确讨论局限。

papers.title: Large Language Models Do Not Always Need Readable Language
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are commonly prompted and interfaced with human-readable natural language, even when the intended reader is another model. This paper investigates whether semantic information can be encoded in compact, non-standard textual forms that sacrifice human readability while remaining recoverable by LLMs. We refer to this class of model-centric textual representations as BabelTele, approached here not as a fixed protocol but as an empirical probe into LLMs' capacity to generate and interpret such representations. Through readability diagnostics, model likelihood measures, human questionnaires, and downstream task evaluations, we find that BabelTele can substantially depart from ordinary natural language while preserving core semantics for instruction-tuned LLMs. As a task-agnostic representational paradigm, BabelTele demonstrates high information density, maintaining 99.5% semantic fidelity even when the text volume is condensed to 27.9% of its original length. We further evaluate its semantic robustness in cross-model transfer, agent memory, and multi-agent communication. Results suggest that BabelTele can reduce context overhead while generally maintaining reliable downstream performance, although its effectiveness depends on the compressor-reader pair and task setting. These findings indicate that human readability, natural-language typicality, and model-side semantic recoverability can be partially decoupled, opening a path toward model-native representations in future exploration of LLM systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨大语言模型是否必须使用人类可读的自然语言进行交互。作者提出BabelTele，一种紧凑的非标准文本表示，牺牲可读性但保留语义。实验表明，在压缩至原始长度27.9%时仍保持99.5%的语义保真度，并能减少上下文开销，但效果依赖于压缩器-读取器对和任务设置。
Motivation: 当前LLM通常使用人类可读的自然语言进行交互，即使读者是另一个模型。本文质疑这种必要性，探索能否用紧凑、非标准、不可读但可被LLM恢复的文本形式编码语义信息。
Method: 提出BabelTele概念，作为模型中心文本表示。通过可读性诊断、模型似然度、人类问卷和下游任务评估来探究LLM生成和解释此类表示的能力。
Result: BabelTele在压缩至原始长度27.9%时仍保持99.5%语义保真度；在跨模型迁移、智能体记忆和多智能体通信中减少上下文开销，保持可靠下游性能，但依赖于压缩器-读取器对和任务设置。
Conclusion: 人类可读性、自然语言典型性和模型侧语义可恢复性可以部分解耦，为LLM系统探索模型原生表示开辟道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Informed Neural Network with Squeeze-Excitation-like Attention
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SEA-PINN, a novel architecture that incorporates a Squeeze-Excitation-like attention mechanism into physics-informed neural networks to dynamically recalibrate the importance of neurons across layers. A key feature of SEA-PINN is its highly stable initialization. On 17 out of 20 benchmark problems, SEA-PINN exhibit nearly negligible variance and significantly reduced initial loss, establishing a quasi-deterministic and favorable starting point for optimization. Notably, without employing Fourier feature embeddings or periodic activation functions, SEA-PINN attained competitive accuracy (83\% vs. 90\% improvement relative to FNN-PINN on the high-frequency case 7) as compared with TSA-PINN-a model specifically engineered for high-frequency problems via learnable frequencies in sinusoidal activations. Furthermore, integrating SEA-PINN into TSA-PINN boosted performance by 42.49\%. These results underscore SEA-PINN as a lightweight plug-in module that enhances nonlinear representation power, promotes more robust and efficient convergence, and strengthens the overall reliability of physics-informed learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEA-PINN，一种将Squeeze-Excitation类注意力机制集成到物理信息神经网络（PINN）中的新架构，以动态重新校准各层神经元的重要性。关键特性是高度稳定的初始化：在20个基准问题中的17个上，SEA-PINN表现出几乎可忽略的方差并显著降低初始损失，为优化提供了准确定性的有利起点。在不使用傅里叶特征嵌入或周期激活函数的情况下，SEA-PINN在高频案例7上相比FNN-PINN获得83%的改进（竞争性精度），而专门针对高频问题的TSA-PINN改进为90%。此外，将SEA-PINN集成到TSA-PINN中可使性能提升42.49%。结果表明SEA-PINN是一种轻量级插件模块，可增强非线性表示能力，促进更稳健高效的收敛，并提升物理信息学习的整体可靠性。
Motivation: 现有PINN在处理高频或多尺度问题时收敛困难，且初始化敏感。需要一种能动态调整神经元重要性的轻量级机制，以提高训练稳定性和准确率。
Method: 设计SEA-PINN架构，在PINN的全连接层中插入Squeeze-Excitation模块，通过全局平均池化和两个全连接层生成逐神经元的缩放因子，从而动态校准激活值。该模块作为插件可嵌入现有PINN模型。
Result: 在20个基准问题中，SEA-PINN在17个上实现近乎零方差的初始化，初始损失显著降低。在高频案例7上，SEA-PINN精度提升83%，接近专门设计的TSA-PINN（90%）。将SEA-PINN集成到TSA-PINN中额外提升42.49%的性能。
Conclusion: SEA-PINN是一种简单有效的轻量级插件，能显著改善PINN的初始化稳定性、收敛性和精度，尤其适用于高频问题。其无需特殊激活函数或特征嵌入，可推广至多种PINN架构。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Prompt, Plan, Extract: Zero-Shot Agentic LLMs Workflows for Lung Pathology Extraction from Clinical Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Information extraction from pathology reports is essential for cancer staging, tumor registry population. Yet key data remains embedded in narrative reports, making manual extraction labor-intensive and error-prone. Traditional supervised Natural Language Processing pipelines address this through fully supervised Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction, but require expensive manual annotation and suffer cascading failures when upstream entities are missed. In this study, we developed a zero-shot, agentic workflow, and evaluated five open-source generative Large Language Models (LLMs) to populate 13 College of American Pathologists synoptic fields from lung resection pathology reports. We compared them against a state-of-the-art supervised GatorTron NER-RE baseline using a novel, registry-aligned evaluation framework. The baseline achieved Micro-F1of 0.960, while the best zero-shot model (GPT-OSS-20B) achieved Micro-F1 of 0.893 (recall: 0.949), accurately extracting complex relations like Pathologic Stage without task-specific training. These results suggest that open-source, zero-shot agentic LLMs are a low-cost solution for extracting lung pathology information.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本（zero-shot）代理工作流（agentic workflow），使用开源生成式大语言模型（LLMs）从肺切除病理报告中提取13个美国病理学家学会（CAP）结构字段。作者比较了多个开源模型（最佳为GPT-OSS-20B）与监督基线GatorTron NER-RE，零样本模型达到Micro-F1 0.893（召回率0.949），监督基线为0.960。结果表明零样本代理LLMs能以低成本提取肺部病理信息。
Motivation: 病理报告中的关键信息（如癌症分期）嵌入叙述文本中，手动提取费力且易错。监督NLP需要昂贵标注且存在级联失败。论文旨在开发无需标注的零样本方法。
Method: 设计零样本代理工作流（Prompt, Plan, Extract），利用开源LLM（如GPT-OSS-20B）进行多步推理，包括提示、规划、提取，以从病理报告中提取13个CAP结构字段。
Result: 最佳零样本模型GPT-OSS-20B在肺病理提取任务上达到Micro-F1 0.893（召回率0.949），接近监督基线0.960，无需任务特定训练即可准确提取复杂关系如病理分期。
Conclusion: 开源零样本代理LLMs是提取肺部病理信息的低成本解决方案，具有可观的性能，可替代昂贵的有监督方法。

papers.title: Neural Additive and Basis Models with Feature Selection and Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) exhibit attractive performance in various fields but often suffer from low interpretability. The neural additive model (NAM) and its variant called the neural basis model (NBM) use neural networks (NNs) as nonlinear shape functions in generalized additive models (GAMs). Both models are highly interpretable and exhibit good performance and flexibility for NN training. NAM and NBM can provide and visualize the contribution of each feature to the prediction owing to GAM-based architectures. However, when using two-input NNs to consider feature interactions or when applying them to high-dimensional datasets, training NAM and NBM becomes intractable due to the increase in the computational resources required. This paper proposes incorporating the feature selection mechanism into NAM and NBM to resolve computational bottlenecks. We introduce the feature selection layer in both models and update the selection weights during training. Our method is simple and can reduce computational costs and model sizes compared to vanilla NAM and NBM. In addition, it enables us to use two-input NNs even in high-dimensional datasets and capture feature interactions. We demonstrate that the proposed models are computationally efficient compared to vanilla NAM and NBM, and they exhibit better or comparable performance with state-of-the-art GAMs.
papers.comment: Accepted at PAKDD 2024. Code is available at https://github.com/shiralab/NAM-FS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经加性模型（NAM）和神经基模型（NBM）在高维数据中计算资源消耗大的问题，提出引入特征选择机制，通过添加特征选择层并在训练中更新选择权重，降低计算成本和模型大小，同时允许使用双输入神经网络捕获特征交互。实验表明，所提模型相比原始NAM和NBM计算更高效，且性能与最先进的广义加性模型（GAMs）相当或更优。
Motivation: NAM和NBM虽然可解释性好，但在高维数据集上或考虑特征交互时，因计算资源需求剧增而变得难以训练。
Method: 在NAM和NBM中引入特征选择层，通过训练自动选择重要特征，从而减少模型计算量和参数量，并使得双输入神经网络能够用于高维数据以捕获特征交互。
Result: 所提模型相比原始NAM和NBM计算效率更高，且在多个数据集上与最先进GAMs性能相当或更优。
Conclusion: 特征选择机制能有效缓解NAM和NBM在高维场景下的计算瓶颈，同时保持可解释性和良好性能。

summary_sections.result: 所提模型相比原始NAM和NBM计算效率更高，且在多个数据集上与最先进GAMs性能相当或更优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 特征选择机制能有效缓解NAM和NBM在高维场景下的计算瓶颈，同时保持可解释性和良好性能。

papers.title: ViCoStream: Streaming VideoLLMs Can Run Beyond 100 FPS with Stage-Wise Coordinated Inference
papers.abstract_en: Streaming VideoLLMs must continuously process incoming video while maintaining low query latency, making both video-ingestion throughput and query-time responsiveness critical for real-time deployment. Existing methods largely focus on accelerating individual modules, such as visual encoding, token pruning, or KV-cache compression, but provide limited insight into whether the resulting system can sustain real-time streaming performance. We formulate streaming VideoLLM inference as a coordinated pipeline spanning visual preprocessing, visual encoding, token dropping, and LLM prefilling/decoding. Building on this formulation, we propose ViCoStream (Video Coordinated Streaming), a stage-wise coordinated streaming framework that combines chunk-wise execution, CUDA-stream overlap, visual token control, bounded visual attention, and query-side retrieval to bound per-chunk computation and memory costs. We further provide a systematic study of bottleneck migration, revealing how chunk size, token retention, attention locality, and retrieval scope shape the throughput-accuracy trade-off. Experiments with Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct across multiple streaming benchmarks show that ViCoStream achieves 134 FPS video throughput and less than 50 ms TTFT on a single A100 GPU while maintaining accuracy close to full-history baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对流式视频大语言模型（VideoLLM）的实时部署需求，提出阶段协调流式推理框架ViCoStream。通过分块执行、CUDA流重叠、视觉token控制、有界视觉注意力和查询侧检索等策略，将视频摄入吞吐量和查询响应时间控制在实时范围内。实验表明，在单张A100 GPU上，ViCoStream可实现134 FPS的视频吞吐量和小于50 ms的首个token生成时间（TTFT），同时保持接近全历史基线的精度。
Motivation: 现有流式VideoLLM推理方法主要关注加速单个模块（如视觉编码、token剪枝或KV缓存压缩），缺乏对系统整体能否维持实时流式性能的洞察。
Method: 提出ViCoStream，将流式VideoLLM推理建模为协调流水线（视觉预处理、视觉编码、token丢弃、LLM预填充/解码），并采用分块执行、CUDA流重叠、视觉token控制、有界视觉注意力和查询侧检索来约束每块的计算和内存开销。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B-Instruct模型上，ViCoStream在多个流式基准测试中达到134 FPS视频吞吐量和小于50 ms的TTFT，精度接近全历史基线。
Conclusion: 论文系统研究了瓶颈迁移，揭示了块大小、token保留率、注意力局部性和检索范围对吞吐-精度权衡的影响。

papers.title: OTCHA: Optimal Transport-driven Confidence-aware Latent Hub Alignment for Multi-View Medical Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view imaging, such as mammography and chest radiography, is a standard component of clinical practice. However, medical images are often unregistered and contain view-specific artifacts or irrelevant background cues that can obscure diagnostically relevant findings. Many existing methods directly fuse per-view representations, allowing such irrelevant content to contaminate the fused embedding and reducing robustness under varying view configurations. We propose OTCHA, a confidence-aware latent hub token alignment module based on optimal transport (OT) that refines patch tokens before fusion for multi-view classification. OTCHA introduces a set of learnable latent hub tokens shared across views. For each view, we compute an OT plan between patch tokens and hub tokens that jointly considers feature similarity and geometry, and augment the OT formulation with token-conditional dustbins to enable partial matching and discard irrelevant tokens. The resulting transport plan provides token-wise matching confidence, which gates hub-mediated message passing and weights a novel optimal-transport-based representation alignment loss to stabilize refinement. Experiments on three multi-view medical image datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines across diverse anatomies and view configurations. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/OTCHA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OTCHA，一种基于最优传输的置信度感知潜在集线器对齐模块，用于多视图医学图像分类。它通过可学习的潜在集线器令牌和自适应丢弃无关令牌的OT规划，在融合前精炼补丁令牌。在三个多视图医学图像数据集上，该方法在不同解剖结构和视图配置下均优于基线。
Motivation: 多视图医学图像常未配准且包含视图特定伪影或无关背景，直接融合各视图表示会污染融合嵌入并降低鲁棒性。
Method: 提出OTCHA，引入跨视图共享的可学习潜在集线器令牌，计算补丁令牌与集线器令牌之间的最优传输（OT）规划，结合特征相似性和几何信息，并加入令牌条件尘箱实现部分匹配和丢弃无关令牌。传输规划提供令牌级匹配置信度，用于门控集线器介导的消息传递和加权一种基于OT的表示对齐损失。
Result: 在三个多视图医学图像数据集上，OTCHA在不同解剖结构和视图配置下一致优于竞争基线。
Conclusion: OTCHA通过置信度感知的潜在集线器对齐和最优传输，有效减少了无关内容对融合嵌入的污染，提升了多视图分类的鲁棒性。

papers.title: World Engine: Towards the Era of Post-Training for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous vehicles must operate safely in the real world, where errors can have severe consequences. Although modern end-to-end driving policies excel in routine scenarios, their reliability is limited by the scarcity of safety-critical ``long-tail'' events in real driving datasets. These rare interactions define the practical safety boundary of the learned policy, yet they are difficult to collect at scale in the real world. Here we show that this fundamental limitation can be addressed by post-training pre-trained driving models on synthesized high-stakes interactions. We introduce World Engine, a generative framework that reconstructs high-fidelity interactive environments from real-world logs and systematically extrapolates them into realistic safety-critical variations. This paradigm enables reinforcement-based post-training to align policies with safety constraints, circumventing the physical risks inherent in real-world exploration. On a public benchmark built on nuPlan, World Engine substantially reduces failures in rare safety-critical scenarios and yields significantly larger gains than scaling pre-training data alone. Furthermore, when deployed on a production-scale autonomous driving system, the resulting policy reduces simulated collisions and demonstrates measurable improvements in on-road testing, showing that post-training on synthesized, safety-critical interactions offers a scalable and effective pathway to safer autonomous driving. The full codebase suite, including training, is released to the public.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出World Engine框架，通过从真实日志重建高保真交互环境并外推安全关键变体，对预训练驾驶模型进行后训练。在nuPlan基准上显著减少罕见安全关键场景的失败，并在量产自动驾驶系统中降低模拟碰撞并提升路测表现。
Motivation: 自动驾驶模型在真实世界中因安全关键的长尾事件稀缺，导致可靠性受限。传统方法难以大规模收集此类数据，且物理实车探索风险高。
Method: 构建生成式框架World Engine，从真实驾驶日志重建交互环境，系统性地外推为现实的安全关键变体，并利用强化学习进行后训练以对齐安全约束。
Result: 在nuPlan基准上，后训练显著降低安全关键场景的失败率，增益大于单纯扩大预训练数据。量产系统中减少模拟碰撞，路测表现有可衡量的改进。
Conclusion: 在合成的安全关键交互上进行后训练是实现更安全自动驾驶的可扩展有效途径，代码库已开源。

papers.title: Neural Events: Discrete Asynchronous Autoencoders for Event-Based Vision
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras capture dynamic scenes with exceptional temporal fidelity by representing them as a continuous stream of microsecond resolution \textit{events}. Each individual event, however, only carries minimal semantic value, merely signaling a localized brightness change. To derive meaningful signals, downstream algorithms need to quickly integrate cues from a potentially massive torrent of low-information events. Current architectures, however, are easily overwhelmed, struggling to balance capturing fine-grained temporal dynamics and maintaining a manageable data throughput. This paper proposes a framework to re-tokenize event streams into a small set of highly informative \textit{neural events}, each representing a local spatio-temporal context window with a discrete learnable code. Every time this code flips, a neural event is triggered, yielding a highly compressed data stream. We demonstrate that, across object detection and classification, networks trained on neural events are on par or surpass the performance of state-of-the-art approaches while reducing the event rate by a factor of 2.0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出将事件相机产生的连续事件流重新分词为少量高信息量的"神经事件"（neural events），每个神经事件代表一个局部时空上下文窗口的离散可学习编码。在目标检测和分类任务上，基于神经事件的网络性能与最先进方法相当或更优，同时将事件率降低2倍。
Motivation: 事件相机产生的事件流数据量巨大但单个事件信息量低，现有架构难以平衡细粒度时间动态和可控的数据吞吐量。
Method: 提出将事件流重新分词为少量神经事件，每个神经事件对应一个局部时空上下文窗口的离散可学习编码，在编码翻转时触发神经事件，实现高度压缩的数据流。
Result: 在目标检测和分类任务上，基于神经事件的网络性能与最先进方法相当或更优，同时事件率降低2.0倍。
Conclusion: 该框架通过离散异步自编码器（discrete asynchronous autoencoders）实现事件流的高效压缩和信息保留。

papers.title: Leverage Is Not Reach: A Control-Window Law for Single-Neuron Steering in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Aligned language models gate behaviors such as refusal and language routing through sparse feed forward neurons, yet no theory predicts when a single neuron intervention controls a behavior coherently rather than collapsing the output. We develop a budget normalized control window framework for single neuron steering. A dose along one write direction reduces to one control coordinate: the alignment between the residual stream and the write, driven along a universal saturation curve in units of a coherence budget set by the residual norm divided by the write norm. Coherent control exists when a behavior trigger lies below the collapse ceiling. The same coordinate governs benign mode switches and refusal; the ceiling follows from weights and one generic forward pass, while triggers are measured at rollout. On fifteen held out neurons, the predicted ceiling has mean absolute error 0.14, about 0.07 in bulk layers, and the committed open or closed verdict holds on eleven against a ten of fifteen majority baseline. Closed cases expose three failure modes rather than violations: collapse before trigger, too little depth to propagate, or a normalization that caps how far one neuron can push. The law explains why local gradient attribution anti predicts control: true controllers write off the readout axis and carry a near zero first order gradient. A forward only contrastive screen made precise by the window recovers controllers that attribution misses. On refusal, the hardest case, intervention success is typed, not scalar: coherent bypass and strict actionable reach separate, so a neuron can flip refusal in fluent, on task text with no actionable content, and genuine actionable reach appears only for three of six audited Llama pivots and only at later rollout horizons. Single neuron steering is therefore a budgeted, typed audit of controllability rather than a fixed dose anecdote.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型中单神经元干预的连贯控制问题，提出了基于预算归一化的控制窗框架。该框架将干预效果量化为一个控制坐标（残余流与写入方向的对齐度），并推导出当行为触发点低于崩溃上限时才能实现连贯控制。在15个保留神经元上的实验表明，预测崩溃上限的平均绝对误差为0.14（批量层约0.07），且对11个神经元给出了正确的开/关判定。论文还分析了拒绝行为中的三种干预失败模式以及干预效果的分类。
Motivation: 现有单神经元干预缺乏理论预测，无法判断干预何时产生连贯控制而非导致输出崩溃。
Method: 提出预算归一化的控制窗框架：定义控制坐标为残余流与写入方向的协同度，通过残余范数除以写范数设定连贯预算，推导出行为触发点低于崩溃上限时方可实现连贯控制。
Result: 在15个保留神经元上，预测崩溃上限的平均绝对误差为0.14（批量层约0.07），对11个神经元给出了正确的开/关判定，优于10/15多数基准。揭示了三种失败模式：触发前崩溃、深度不足、归一化限制。
Conclusion: 单神经元干预是预算化、类型化的可控性审计，而非固定剂量的轶事；干预成功需考虑触发点与崩溃上限的关系，以及干预的类型（连贯绕过与可行行为分离）。

papers.title: 3D-PLOT-LLM: Part-Level Object Tokens for 3D Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: 3D multimodal large language models (3D MLLMs) describe a 3D object as a whole but cannot address, name, or reason about its parts. Prior part-aware attempts add segmentation decoders, heavier 3D encoders, or bounding-box grammars at substantial parameter cost. We take a fundamentally different path: we reorganize the input token stream so that parts become directly addressable through the LLM's own vocabulary. Our model, 3D-PLOT-LLM, partitions the frozen point encoder's patches into K locally coherent regions and inserts, before each region's patch tokens, a learnable per-region marker and a reserved vocabulary token <part_k>; a Marker-Space Refinement (MSR) module then conditions each marker on its region's spatial statistics and adjacency neighbors. The model thus cites parts in its output and follows prompts that refer to parts by token, a capability absent from prior object-level 3D MLLMs. To probe this interface, we construct PartVerse-QA, a vocabulary-level part-QA benchmark adapted from PartVerse mesh annotations (77K training pairs and 588 held-out queries on disjoint object splits), on which 3D-PLOT-LLM reaches caption-to-slots Jaccard 0.459 and Exact-match 13.78%, with a slot-to-caption GPT-4o judge of 44.68. On the 3DCoMPaT-GrIn part-aware grounded description benchmark, 3D-PLOT-LLM outperforms PointLLM, Kestrel, PARIS3D, and SegPoint on every text-output metric, and ShapeLLM on 3 of 4, with up to +3.03 GPT-4o judge over PointLLM. On Objaverse whole-object captioning, adding PartVerse-QA at Stage 2 yields +0.65 SBERT and +1.85 GPT-4o over PointLLM, and tops PointLLM-PiSA on 4 of 5 traditional metrics (SBERT, SimCSE, BLEU-1, METEOR) despite targeting a different (part-grounded) objective. All with under 1M new trainable parameters on a frozen point encoder, an order of magnitude below prior part-aware 3D MLLMs, and no segmentation decoder or bounding-box head.

Conclusion: 通过令牌级部件接口，模型能以极低参数代价实现部件级3D理解与生成，为3D MLLMs提供新的部件感知范式。

papers.title: When, Where, and How: Adaptive Binning for Tabular Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Medical tabular data are ubiquitous in clinical research, but deep learning for tables remains underexplored because reliable labels often require costly expert adjudication, even though structured clinical variables are routinely available in tabular form. Self-supervised learning can leverage these unlabeled tables, and recent binning-based pretexts offer a promising inductive bias, but existing objectives fix a single global quantile discretization and apply feature-agnostic supervision. We propose Adaptive Binning, a training-adaptive discretization pretext for tabular SSL that couples discretization to learning through a feature-wise coarse-to-fine curriculum. Motivated by the spectral bias of neural networks and the principles of curriculum learning, our method progressively refines discretization per feature upon plateau detection and selects representation-aware splits to jointly improve value-space concentration and representation-space coherence. A heterogeneity-aware objective unifies categorical reconstruction with ordinal supervision for numerical features, and experiments on public medical tabular datasets under unified evaluation protocols show consistent gains for linear probing and fine-tuning without dataset-specific discretization tuning. We further introduce a medical tabular SSL benchmark with standardized protocols to support reproducible progress in this underexplored domain. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/Adaptive-Binning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医疗表格数据的自监督学习，提出自适应分箱（Adaptive Binning）预处理任务，通过特征级粗到细课程和表示感知分割，在统一评估协议下的公开医疗表格数据集上实现线性探测和微调的一致提升，并引入标准化基准以促进可重复研究。
Motivation: 医疗表格数据普遍存在，但标签获取成本高；现有基于分箱的自监督方法固定全局分位数且特征无关，限制了表示质量。
Method: Adaptive Binning：将离散化与学习耦合，基于神经网络频谱偏置和课程学习，在训练平台期逐步细化每个特征的分箱，并选择表示感知的分割；异质性感知目标结合分类重建与数值特征的排序监督。
Result: 在多个公开医疗表格数据集上，线性探测和微调一致获得优于固定分箱方法的性能，无需数据集特定的离散化调参。
Conclusion: 自适应分箱是一种有效的表格自监督学习预处理方法，可避免手工离散化工程，并提升表示质量。

papers.title: Enhancing Graph Neural Networks Using Proximity Graphs for Dust Source Emission Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of dust source emissions is critical for mitigating the significant environmental and health hazards posed by dust storms. Traditional forecasting methods often struggle to capture the complex spatiotemporal dynamics of these phenomena. In this paper, we demonstrate that proximity graphs enable Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to effectively model the intricate spatial and temporal relationships between data points. Specifically, we use proximity graphs--such as Delaunay triangulation, Gabriel graph, k-Nearest Neighbor graph, and Yao graph--as the input for GNNs (including GraphSAGE, Graph Convolutional Networks, and Graph Attention Networks) to perform message passing. Our approach highlights the effectiveness of integrating proximity graphs with GNNs for robust and accurate dust source forecasting. To emphasize the importance of proximity graph representations, we compare our method against GNNs using random graphs for message passing. The results show that GNNs with proximity graphs significantly outperform those with random graphs and are also far superior to Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model in dust source emission forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用邻近图（Delaunay三角剖分、Gabriel图、k近邻图和Yao图）增强图神经网络（GraphSAGE、GCN、GAT）进行沙尘源排放预测。实验表明，基于邻近图的GNN显著优于随机图GNN和LSTM模型。
Motivation: 传统沙尘暴预报方法难以捕获复杂的时空动态，需要更有效的空间关系建模方法。
Method: 将多种邻近图（Delaunay、Gabriel、kNN、Yao图）作为GNN的输入图结构，通过消息传递机制建模数据点之间的空间和时间关系。
Result: GNN结合邻近图在沙尘源排放预测上显著优于随机图GNN和LSTM模型。
Conclusion: 邻近图结构能有效提升GNN在沙尘源预测中的表现，为环境预报提供新思路。

papers.title: CSWinUNETR: Segmentation of Thin Anatomical Structures in Medical Images
papers.abstract_en: Accurate segmentation of thin, tortuous anatomical structures, such as retinal vessels, cerebral vasculature, and facial wrinkles, remains challenging due to low contrast, frequent discontinuities, and severe class imbalance. Although recent convolutional and Transformer-based models have improved performance, they often yield fragmented predictions and fail to recover fine branches. We propose CSWinUNETR, a general-purpose backbone for 2D and 3D thin-structure segmentation. It employs cross-shaped stripe self-attention to model long-range principal-axis context and incorporates cyclic shifts to enhance information exchange across stripes. To better preserve fine-grained details, we further introduce a detail-enhanced multi-scale self-attention module that aggregates contextual features from multi-resolution representations. In addition, we propose sparse-control dynamic snake convolution, which reconstructs reliable dense curvilinear kernels from sparsely predicted control points to better follow tortuous geometry. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks across ophthalmology, neurovascular imaging, and dermatology demonstrate that CSWinUNETR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods without task-specific post-processing or topology-aware losses. The code is available at https://github.com/labhai/CSWinUNETR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CSWinUNETR，一种用于2D和3D薄解剖结构分割的通用骨干网络。它采用十字形条带自注意力捕捉长程主轴上下文，并通过循环移位增强条带间信息交换；引入细节增强的多尺度自注意力模块聚合多分辨率特征；提出稀疏控制动态蛇形卷积，从稀疏控制点重建致密曲线核以拟合曲折几何。在眼科、神经血管成像和皮肤科四个基准上，该方法无需任务特定后处理或拓扑损失，持续超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法在分割薄、曲折的解剖结构（如视网膜血管、脑血管、面部皱纹）时，因低对比度、频繁断裂和严重类别不平衡，常产生碎片化预测且难以恢复细分支。
Method: 提出CSWinUNETR，包含十字形条带自注意力（cross-shaped stripe self-attention）、循环移位、细节增强多尺度自注意力模块（detail-enhanced multi-scale self-attention）以及稀疏控制动态蛇形卷积（sparse-control dynamic snake convolution）。
Result: 在眼科、神经血管成像和皮肤科四个基准数据集上，CSWinUNETR一致优于现有方法，无需任务特定后处理或拓扑感知损失。
Conclusion: CSWinUNETR作为通用骨干，在薄解剖结构分割上有效，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Low-Burden Data Augmentation for Dysarthric ASR via Zero-Shot Voice Cloning
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition remains unreliable for dysarthric speech due to data scarcity and high inter-speaker variability. While synthetic data can address these gaps, traditional methods often require extensive speaker-specific data, reintroducing the collection bottleneck. We investigate zero-shot voice cloning as a low-burden augmentation strategy, using Higgs Audio V2 to clone speakers in the TORGO dataset. We fine-tune (FT) Whisper-medium on cloned, real, and hybrid data and evaluate on held-out real speech. Compared to the zero-shot (31.62%), Clone FT achieved a competitive 26.00% WER, nearly matching the 24.44% and 25.12% seen with Real and Hybrid FT, respectively. Notably, Clone and Hybrid FT outperform Real FT for moderate-severe speakers. Clone FT achieves the best results (11.45% relative) in cross-corpus evaluation on the SAP-1102. These results suggest that zero-shot cloning provides scalable training data that circumvents the costly data collection bottleneck.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用零样本语音克隆（zero-shot voice cloning）为构音障碍语音识别（dysarthric ASR）生成合成训练数据，以减轻数据采集负担。在TORGO数据集上使用Higgs Audio V2克隆说话人，微调Whisper-medium模型，克隆数据训练的模型达到26.00% WER，接近真实数据训练的24.44% WER。跨语料库评估中，克隆数据训练在SAP-1102上取得最佳相对提升11.45%。
Motivation: 构音障碍语音ASR因数据稀缺和高说话人间变异性而表现不佳，传统数据增强需大量说话人特定数据，未能解决采集瓶颈。
Method: 使用Higgs Audio V2进行零样本语音克隆，生成TORGO数据集中说话人的克隆语音，然后用克隆数据、真实数据以及混合数据微调Whisper-medium模型。
Result: 克隆数据微调（Clone FT）在TORGO测试集上WER为26.00%，接近真实数据（24.44%）和混合数据（25.12%）；对于中重度说话人，克隆和混合数据优于真实数据。跨语料库SAP-1102上，克隆数据取得11.45%的相对提升。
Conclusion: 零样本语音克隆可提供可扩展的训练数据，绕开昂贵的数据采集瓶颈，但方法可能依赖于特定的克隆模型和数据集。

papers.title: TelcoAgent: A Scalable 5G Multi-KPM Forecasting With 3GPP-Grounded Explainability
authors: V V N K Someswara Rao Koduri
papers.abstract_en: Key Performance Measurement (KPM) forecasting is essential for proactive network management of 5G and next-generation telecom networks. However, existing machine learning (ML) approaches face significant limitations in scalability and explainability, restricting their effectiveness in real-world deployments. We propose TelcoAgent, a foundation model-based framework that enables accurate, scalable, and explainable forecasting of multiple KPMs across diverse network cells without the need for site-specific training. Specifically, the framework comprises three key components: (i) an automated three-agent pipeline that constructs a 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) knowledge graph directly from specification documents, (ii) a scalable, time-series foundation model (TSFM)-based prediction pipeline to deliver accurate, zero-shot forecasting, and finally (iii) a reasoning and explanation pipeline that provides actionable, domain-grounded diagnostics. Evaluated using a 3-month, real-world, city-scale 5G KPM dataset from a U.S.-based network operator, TelcoAgent demonstrates high forecasting accuracy for all 7 considered KPMs per cell across 200 cells, while delivering explainable insights and actionable instructions to address network degradations.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to IEEE GLOBECOM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TelcoAgent，一个基于基础模型的框架，用于5G网络的关键性能测量（KPM）预测，具备可扩展性和基于3GPP标准的可解释性。框架包含自动构建3GPP知识图谱的三智能体管道、基于时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的零样本预测管道，以及提供可操作诊断的解释管道。在来自美国运营商的3个月真实城市规模5G KPM数据集上，对200个细胞的7个KPM实现了高精度预测，并提供了网络退化原因的可解释说明。
Motivation: 现有机器学习方法在5G KPM预测中面临可扩展性差和缺乏可解释性的问题，限制了其在真实网络管理中的应用效果。
Method: 提出三组件框架：(i) 自动从3GPP规范文档构建知识图谱的三智能体管道；(ii) 基于时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的可扩展零样本预测管道；(iii) 提供领域特化可解释诊断的推理与解释管道。
Result: 在包含200个细胞、长达3个月的真实城市规模5G KPM数据集上，对所有7种KPM均实现了高精度预测，并提供了可解释的网络退化诊断和可操作建议。
Conclusion: TelcoAgent实现了无需站点特定训练的可扩展、准确且可解释的多KPM预测，有助于5G网络的主动管理。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CREDENCE: Claim Reduction for Decomposition & Enhanced Credibility -- Semantic Metrics and Convergence Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Decomposing compound sentences into atomic, verifiable claims is a prerequisite for reliable automated fact-checking. Prior work has relied on token-overlap (Jaccard) metrics that systematically underestimate decomposition quality for paraphrastic claims, and has lacked formal termination analysis for the repair loop. We present Credence, a revised claim decomposition and evaluation framework addressing both shortcomings. Our contributions are: (1) Semantic-F1: we use BGE-large cosine similarity fidelity metric that resolves Jaccard's penalisation and improves downstream fact-checking accuracy; (2) Convergence theorems: we formally characterise four properties of the repair pipeline, establishing that rule-based repair is monotone and finitely terminating under an oracle parser assumption; LLM-based self-repair is provably non-monotone and requires an early-exit guard; (3) Three evaluation benchmarks spanning social-media, encyclopaedic, and news domains for cross-domain generalisation measurement; (4) Multi-model benchmarking across four decomposer models (3.8B-12B) and a closed API model. Experiments on SocialClaimSplit, WikiSplitBench, and ClaimDecompBench show that Semantic-F1 outperforms Jaccard-F1 by +15-32pp. EPR ranges from 0.94 to 1.00 on SocialClaimSplit and WikiSplitBench, while ClaimDecompBench includes lower base EPR cases (down to 0.824) due to harder news-domain constructions, and rule-repair reduces the Atomicity Violation Rate (AVR) by 47-100% relative to the base model without degrading fidelity.

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Reward Modeling for Stable RLHF
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) aligns large language models by training reward models on preference data and optimizing policies to maximize predicted rewards. However, this pipeline faces two fundamental challenges: (1) reward models cannot signal when their predictions are unreliable, since they usually act as deterministic point estimators; and (2) modern group-based policy optimization can amplify unreliable reward signals, as exemplified by GRPO's uniform treatment of rewards during advantage computation. As policies explore increasingly diverse responses, these two limitations create a critical vulnerability: unreliable reward estimates may be granted disproportionate influence, triggering severe reward hacking. We propose Uncertainty-Aware Reward Modeling (UARM), which equips reward models with calibrated uncertainty via quantile-based conformal prediction and reweights GRPO advantages through heteroscedastic variance decomposition. Experiments across HelpSteer, UltraFeedback, and PKU-SafeRLHF demonstrate that UARM significantly improves reward model calibration, reduces reward hacking, and enhances downstream alignment quality compared to standard GRPO and uncertainty-agnostic baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对RLHF中奖励模型的不确定性问题和基于组的策略优化放大不可靠奖励的问题，提出不确定性感知奖励建模（UARM），通过分位数共形预测为奖励模型提供校准的不确定性，并通过异方差方差分解重新加权GRPO优势。实验表明UARM改善了奖励模型校准，减少了奖励黑客攻击，提升了对齐质量。
Motivation: RLHF中奖励模型通常作为确定性点估计，无法指示预测是否可靠；同时现代基于组的策略优化（如GRPO）统一处理奖励，可能放大不可靠信号，导致奖励黑客攻击。
Method: 提出UARM，利用基于分位数的共形预测赋予奖励模型校准的不确定性，并通过异方差方差分解重新加权GRPO优势计算。
Result: 在HelpSteer、UltraFeedback和PKU-SafeRLHF上，UARM相比标准GRPO和忽略不确定性的基线显著改善了奖励模型校准、减少了奖励黑客攻击、提升了下游对齐质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了UARM通过不确定性感知机制稳定RLHF的有效性。

papers.title: Training-Free Metrics for Synthetic Object Detection Data: A Proxy for Detector Performance
papers.abstract_en: With the recent advent of image generative models, synthetic data are increasingly being used to supplement limited real datasets for training computer vision models. However, not all synthetic datasets improve performance equally, and their effectiveness can only be assessed by training a downstream model, which is computationally expensive and time-consuming. This problem is pronounced in the task of object detection, where the required annotations are much more dense due to bounding boxes. In this paper, we propose a pre-computable metric family, dubbed Conditional-Composition Domain Match (CCDM), which serves as a proxy for the relative utility of candidate synthetic training sets for downstream detection. Experiments on the VisDrone-DET dataset show that the CCDM metric families achieve a Spearman correlation of 1.0 with the downstream performance of YOLOv8, clearly outperforming existing metrics for synthetic image evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无需训练的指标体系CCDM（Conditional-Composition Domain Match），用于预测合成目标检测训练集的相对效用，以替代昂贵的下游检测器训练评估。在VisDrone-DET数据集上，CCDM与YOLOv8下游性能的Spearman相关系数达到1.0，显著优于现有合成图像评估指标。
Motivation: 训练目标检测模型时，合成数据的效用只能通过训练下游模型来评估，计算成本高且耗时；现有合成图像评估指标无法准确预测检测性能。
Method: 提出CCDM指标族，该指标基于条件-组合域匹配，无需训练，直接计算合成数据与真实数据的分布对齐程度，作为下游检测器性能的代理。
Result: 在VisDrone-DET数据集上，CCDM与YOLOv8检测性能的Spearman相关系数为1.0，优于现有指标。
Conclusion: CCDM可作为有效的无训练代理指标，用于评估合成目标检测训练集的效用，减少对下游模型训练的依赖。

papers.title: Human-on-the-Loop Orchestration for AI-Assisted Legal Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in electronic discovery (e-discovery), where compounding errors across multi-step reasoning chains can constitute legal malpractice. Unlike single-turn retrieval, agentic workflows operating over privileged document corpora exhibit a class of failure we term "trajectory collapse": an early misclassification silently propagates, rendering an entire privilege review invalid. This paper makes three contributions. First, we propose a structured taxonomy of agentic failures in legal information retrieval, organized by functional stage. Second, we introduce a four-layer verification architecture -- spanning planning, reasoning, execution, and uncertainty quantification -- designed to intercept these failures before they compound. Third, we present a preliminary simulation study on a synthetic e-discovery corpus that demonstrates how mandatory Human-on-the-Loop (HOTL) escalation thresholds reduce privilege-waiver risk relative to fully autonomous baselines. Our results suggest that calibrated uncertainty thresholds can reduce privilege-waiver risk by up to 61% versus fully autonomous deployment, while routing fewer than one quarter of documents to attorney review.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子取证中自主大语言模型（LLM）智能体的复合错误问题，提出一种带有人机回路（HOTL）增强的四层验证架构，通过规划、推理、执行和不确定性量化拦截早期错误传播。在合成语料库上的模拟实验表明，相对于完全自主基线，校准的不确定性阈值可将特权豁免风险降低高达61%，同时仅将不到四分之一的文档送交人工审查。
Motivation: 自主LLM智能体在多步推理中容易产生复合错误，导致“轨迹崩溃”（trajectory collapse）——早期错误无声传播使整个特权审查无效，这在法律电子取证中构成法律风险。
Method: 提出一个四层验证架构，涵盖规划、推理、执行和不确定性量化，并引入强制性人机回路（HOTL）升级阈值，在检测到高不确定性时介入人工审查。
Result: 在合成电子取证语料库的初步模拟中，校准的不确定性阈值使特权豁免风险相比完全自主部署降低61%，同时仅需将少于25%的文档路由至律师审查。
Conclusion: 论文认为，通过人机回路结合不确定性量化可以有效降低电子取证中自主LLM代理的法律风险，但该结论基于合成数据，需要进一步在实际场景中验证。

papers.title: Think Again or Think Longer? Selective Verification for Budget-Aware Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Test-time reasoning is increasingly used as a serving-time control knob, but extra reasoning is not uniformly valuable: it can repair failed attempts, waste compute on already-correct answers, or introduce harmful answer changes. We study this as a deployment allocation problem rather than a new-verifier problem. We introduce \sevra, Selective Verification for Reasoning Allocation, a serving-layer controller that decides whether to preserve a frozen solver's initial answer or invoke active verification. Using a frozen Qwen3-4B solver, we log intervention outcomes and train recoverability-aware gates from serving-visible attempt state. On \mathfive, selective verification reaches 76.3\% accuracy, compared with 75.5\% for always verifying, while reducing post-generation tokens by 26.8\% and harmful flips from 2.2\% to 1.0\%. However, an 8,192-token initial solve reaches 76.0\% accuracy with 28\% fewer total model tokens, showing that selective recovery is useful but not the best tested cost frontier. In frozen transfer to \gsm, the selective policy verifies only 3.0\% of examples, improves accuracy from 93.4\% to 94.5\%, and reduces verification tokens by 91.2\% relative to always verifying; again, a longer initial solve matches its accuracy with fewer realized tokens. On CommonsenseQA, always-on verification hurts, while Self-Consistency@5 improves accuracy at about five times the realized token cost. The resulting deployment rule is: tune the initial budget first, then use selective recovery when explicit checks, bounded retries, auditability, or regression-risk control matter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出选择性验证框架SEVRA，在部署层控制是否对冻结求解器的初始答案进行验证，以平衡计算成本与准确性。在Math-500上，选择性验证达到76.3%准确率（始终验证为75.5%），同时减少后生成token 26.8%并降低有害翻转。但更长的初始生成在更低成本下达到相似准确率，说明选择性恢复并非最优成本前沿。
Motivation: 测试时推理的额外计算并不总是有益：可能修复错误、浪费在已正确回答上或引入有害更改。本文将其视为部署分配问题而非新验证器问题。
Method: 提出SEVRA控制器，使用冻结的Qwen3-4B求解器，记录干预结果并训练基于可恢复性的门控，仅从部署可见的尝试状态进行决策。
Result: 在Math-500上，选择性验证准确率76.3%（始终验证75.5%），后生成token减少26.8%，有害翻转从2.2%降至1.0%。在GSM8K迁移中，仅验证3.0%样本，准确率从93.4%提升至94.5%，验证token减少91.2%。但更长的初始求解（8192 token）以更少总模型token达到76.0%准确率。
Conclusion: 部署规则是：先调整初始预算，再在需要显式检查、有限重试、可审计性或回归风险控制时使用选择性恢复。

papers.title: ParaScale: Scale-Calibrated Camera-Motion Transfer via a Gauge-Invariant Parallax Number
papers.abstract_en: Transferring the camera motion of a reference video to a freshly generated one lets creators reuse cinematic moves. Yet reference and target often live at incompatible scales -- a sweep across a galaxy versus a nudge across a desk -- and naively reusing the recovered trajectory yields either imperceptible or violently exaggerated motion. We trace this to a geometric fact: translation-induced image motion scales as ||T||/Z, so a monocular trajectory is meaningful only up to a depth-scale gauge. We distill this into the Parallax Number Pi = ||Delta T|| / Zbar, a dimensionless, gauge-invariant descriptor of how strongly a camera move is felt, and prove that it -- not the raw trajectory -- is the quantity that scale-faithful transfer must preserve. ParaScale is a plug-and-play module that reads Pi off any reference video and re-realizes it against the target scene's own depth, per frame, leaving rotation untouched. Sitting between pose extraction and pose injection, it requires no retraining and drops into any pose-conditioned generator. We further introduce the Parallax Consistency Error (PCE), a scale-symmetric metric that -- unlike the similarity-aligned TransErr -- exposes scene-scale mismatch. Across scale regimes spanning four orders of magnitude and multiple backbones, ParaScale keeps the realized parallax on the identity line and cuts PCE by more than 3x over uncalibrated transfer with no loss of visual fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ParaScale模块，通过无量纲的视差数（Parallax Number）实现参考视频与目标视频之间尺度校准的相机运动转移，保持视差一致性，无需重新训练。实验表明，在跨四个数量级的尺度范围内，Parallax Consistency Error (PCE) 降低3倍以上且不损失视觉保真度。
Motivation: 相机运动转移中，参考视频与目标视频的尺度不匹配导致运动过小或过大，根源在于单目轨迹仅定义到深度-尺度规范（depth-scale gauge）。
Method: 定义视差数 Pi = ||ΔT|| / Z̄，作为无量纲、规范不变的描述符，并设计ParaScale模块，从参考视频读取Pi，逐帧针对目标场景深度重新实现，保持旋转不变。
Result: 在跨四个数量级的尺度范围和多个骨干网络上，Parallax Consistency Error (PCE) 比未校准转移降低3倍以上，且视觉保真度无损失。
Conclusion: ParaScale是即插即用模块，无需重训练，可集成到任何位姿条件生成器中，有效解决尺度校准问题。

summary_sections.method: 定义视差数 Pi = ||ΔT|| / Z̄，作为无量纲、规范不变的描述符，并设计ParaScale模块，从参考视频读取Pi，逐帧针对目标场景深度重新实现，保持旋转不变。
summary_sections.result: 在跨四个数量级的尺度范围和多个骨干网络上，Parallax Consistency Error (PCE) 比未校准转移降低3倍以上，且视觉保真度无损失。
summary_sections.conclusion: ParaScale是即插即用模块，无需重训练，可集成到任何位姿条件生成器中，有效解决尺度校准问题。

papers.title: HypOProto: Hyperbolic Ordinal Prototypes for Left Ventricular Filling Pressure Classification
papers.abstract_en: Echocardiography (echo) is a widely used imaging modality for assessing cardiac function, with Left Ventricular Filling Pressure (LVFP) serving as a critical physiological marker for conditions such as heart failure. Standard LVFP classification into normal \emph{vs} elevated categories relies on the Doppler-derived $E/e'$ ratio, which is operator-dependent and often unavailable in resource-limited settings, motivating methods that infer LVFP directly from B-mode echo. Existing deep learning approaches achieve high performance but remain largely black-box, limiting clinical interpretability. We propose HypOProto, a hyperbolic, ordinal prototype-based framework for interpretable LVFP classification using a frozen, explainable foundation model backbone. HypOProto arranges prototypes along the physiological $E/e'$ scale, placing borderline cases near the hyperboloid root where small angular differences separate similar cases, while normal and elevated cases occupy outward positions reflecting increasing diagnostic certainty. This hyperbolic geometry encodes clinically meaningful ordinal relationships and improves interpretability. We also introduce a novel Hyperbolic Prototype Angular Separation (HyperPAS) loss, enforcing inter-class prototype separation in hyperbolic space. HypOProto achieves SOTA performance while maintaining transparency, and highlights clinically relevant regions in visualizations. This work represents the first prototype-based framework for LVFP classification in echo. Our code can be found at https://github.com/DeepRCL/HypOProto.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HypOProto，一个基于双曲空间顺序原型（hyperbolic ordinal prototype）的可解释左心室充盈压分类框架。该方法利用冻结的可解释基础模型骨干，将原型沿生理 E/e' 尺度排列，在双曲空间中编码临床有意义的顺序关系，并引入 HyperPAS 损失增强类间原型分离。在超声心动图 LVFP 分类任务上达到 SOTA 性能，同时保持可解释性。
Motivation: 现有 LVFP 分类依赖多普勒衍生的 E/e' 比值，操作者依赖性强且资源受限场景不可用；深度学习方法虽性能高但缺乏临床可解释性。
Method: 采用双曲原型网络，将原型嵌入双曲空间并沿 E/e' 生理尺度排序，利用双曲几何区分边界案例；提出 HyperPAS 损失强制类间原型角度分离。
Result: 摘要报告在 LVFP 分类上达到 SOTA 性能，可视化突出临床相关区域。
Conclusion: 这是首个基于原型的超声心动图 LVFP 分类框架，提升了模型透明度和临床适用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Policy-aware Vector Search: A Vision for Fine Grained Access Control in Vector Databases
papers.abstract_en: Vector databases are increasingly used in security sensitive contexts with Retrieval Augmented Generation and organizational AI pipelines; however, their security capabilities remain limited. Specifically, Fine-grained Access Control (FGAC) which is required to ensure that data access adheres to user-specific policies is not fully supported in modern vector databases. Unlike relational databases, vector databases combine structured and unstructured attributes to provide semantic, approximate query results, which complicates FGAC implementation. This creates an inherent tension between enforcing FGAC policies correctly, achieving high ANN search recall and maintaining low query latency. In this paper, we present a vision for Policy-aware Vector Search by formalizing the FGAC policy model in vector databases as well as the enforcement problem. We compare various enforcement strategies, present preliminary findings, and identify key open challenges for future research in policy-aware vector search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Policy-aware Vector Search的愿景，旨在解决向量数据库中细粒度访问控制（FGAC）缺失的问题。作者形式化了FGAC策略模型和执行问题，比较了多种执行策略，并基于初步实验指出了关键开放挑战，为向量数据库的安全增强提供了方向。
Motivation: 向量数据库在RAG等安全敏感场景中应用广泛，但缺乏细粒度访问控制（FGAC），无法确保数据访问遵循用户特定策略。与关系数据库不同，向量数据库的语义近似查询特性使FGAC实现更加复杂。
Method: 形式化定义了向量数据库中的FGAC策略模型和执行问题，比较了多种策略执行方法（如过滤后搜索、搜索后过滤等），并进行了初步实验验证。
Result: 提供了初步实验结果，但摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅指出不同策略在正确性、召回率和延迟之间存在权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为策略感知向量搜索是向量数据库安全的关键方向，并指出了未来需要解决的开放挑战，如策略表达力与查询效率的平衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Flow Map Denoisers: Traversing the Distortion-Perception Plane for Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration faces a fundamental tradeoff: methods that minimize error produce blurry reconstructions, while those that maximize perceptual quality yield sharp but less faithful images. Existing approaches either commit to a single operating point on this distortion perception (DP) frontier or require paired-data supervision, auxiliary models, or hyperparameter tuning of the sampler to access different points. We show that flow map models, a recent extension of flow matching for few-step sampling that learns an average field, implicitly define a one-parameter family of denoisers that continuously spans the DP frontier. The lookahead parameter t acts as a control knob between the MMSE and perceptual regimes. For Gaussian targets, we prove that varying t exactly recovers the optimal DP frontier; for natural images, we observe similar behavior empirically. Within a Plug-and-Play solver, the same mechanism extends to general inverse problems, where it controls a tradeoff between perceptual alignment and data consistency. Despite the lack of exact optimality guarantees in this setting, a single trained flow map spans the DP tradeoff, matching or exceeding specialized baselines at both extremes. Extensive experiments on CelebA ($128\times 128$) and AFHQ ($256\times 256$) across several linear and nonlinear inverse tasks validate our findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用流映射模型（flow map models）作为去噪器，通过一个参数t在失真-感知（DP）前沿上连续遍历。理论证明在高斯目标下，变化t精确恢复最优DP前沿；在自然图像上，实验观察到类似行为。在逆问题中，该机制控制感知对齐与数据一致性之间的权衡。实验在CelebA和AFHQ数据集上验证了效果。
Motivation: 图像复原面临失真与感知质量的根本权衡：最小化误差的方法产生模糊重建，最大化感知质量的方法产生锐利但不逼真的图像。现有方法要么固定DP前沿上的单个操作点，要么需要配对数据监督、辅助模型或超参数调优。
Method: 利用流映射模型（flow map models）——一种流匹配（flow matching）的扩展，用于少步采样并学习一个平均场——隐式定义一个连续跨越DP前沿的单参数族去噪器。参数t作为MMSE和感知机制之间的控制旋钮。在Plug-and-Play求解器中，相同机制扩展到一般逆问题。
Result: 实验在CelebA (128×128)和AFHQ (256×256)上，针对多个线性和非线性逆任务，单个训练好的流映射跨越DP权衡，在两个极端匹配或超越专门的基线方法。
Conclusion: 尽管在逆问题设置中缺乏精确最优性保证，但单个流映射可覆盖DP权衡空间，为图像复原提供灵活的控制。

papers.title: The Hidden Environmental Cost of Poor Coding Practices in TensorFlow and Keras Applications: A Study on Resource Leaks and Carbon Emissions
papers.abstract_en: Efficiency and sustainability are critical considerations in the development and deployment of machine learning (ML) applications. Among the factors influencing sustainability, resource leaks in ML code can introduce hidden inefficiencies that elevate energy consumption and CO2 emissions. Despite this, empirical evidence quantifying their environmental impact remains limited. This emerging results paper presents an initial empirical investigation of two common resource-leak smells, namely Improper Model Reuse (IMR) and Unreleased Tensor References (UTR), and their impact on energy consumption and CO2 emissions in TensorFlow and Keras workloads. Controlled experiments were conducted for each smell by executing identical training tasks while comparing against a smell-free baseline. Our preliminary results show that both smells consistently increase estimated electricity usage and carbon emissions. IMR and UTR increased electricity consumption by approximately 32% and 46%, respectively, with proportional increases in CO2 emissions. Paired statistical tests indicate that these differences are systematic and statistically significant, providing initial empirical evidence that resource-leak smells may degrade ML energy efficiency and environmental sustainability. These findings suggest that resource-leak smells pose measurable risks to both software quality and sustainability, emphasizing the importance of integrating resource-lifecycle management and energy-efficiency considerations into ML development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验，初步实证研究了 TensorFlow/Keras 应用中两种常见资源泄漏反模式（Improper Model Reuse 和 Unreleased Tensor References）对能源消耗和二氧化碳排放的影响。实验表明，两种反模式分别使电力消耗增加约 32% 和 46%，并导致碳排放成比例上升，统计检验证实这些差异显著。
Motivation: 尽管资源泄漏可能隐藏低效率并增加能耗和碳排放，但缺乏量化其环境影响的实证证据，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 对每种反模式执行受控实验，通过运行相同训练任务并与无反模式基线对比，测量电力消耗和碳排放量。
Result: Improper Model Reuse 和 Unreleased Tensor References 分别使电力消耗增加约 32% 和 46%，碳排放相应增加，配对统计检验表明差异系统显著。
Conclusion: 资源泄漏反模式对软件质量和可持续性构成可测量风险，强调在 ML 开发中集成资源生命周期管理和能效考虑的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving End-to-End Speech Recognition for Dysarthric Speech through In-Domain Data Augmentation
papers.abstract_en: Dysarthric speech recognition is crucial for facilitating effective communication among individuals with dysarthria. However, accurately recognizing dysarthric speech poses significant challenges due to varying severity levels and limited data availability. In this paper, we explore data augmentation techniques for dysarthric automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems by fine-tuning the End-to-End pre-trained Wav2Vec2 model, with a specific focus on severity levels. To address the challenges of data scarcity and the need for extensive data in fine-tuning pre-trained ASR systems for dysarthric speech, we investigate four prominent data augmentation methods: Speaking-Rate Modification (SRM), Pitch Modification (PM), Formant Modification (FM), and vocal tract Length Perturbation (VTLP), tailored to different aspects of dysarthria. The study uses individually fine-tuned Wav2Vec2 models for each severity class as baseline systems. Additionally, we conducted severity-specific fine-tuning of the ASR model using augmented data. Results demonstrate distinct efficacy patterns for each augmentation technique across severity levels. The best WERs were achieved with SRM ($s$=0.8) for \textit{low} (9.02\%) and \textit{medium} (38.11\%) severities, and with PM ($τ$=0.8) for \textit{high} severity (55.15\%), reflecting relative improvements of 30.02\%, 16.64\%, and 15.47\%, respectively. These results confirm the effectiveness of the augmentation methods in improving dysarthric ASR performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对构音障碍语音识别中数据稀缺和各严重程度性能差异大的问题，探索了四种数据增强方法（语速修改、音调修改、共振峰修改、声道长度扰动）在微调Wav2Vec2模型时的效果。实验表明，低严重度下语速修改最佳（WER 9.02%），中严重度下语速修改最佳（38.11%），高严重度下音调修改最佳（55.15%），相对改进分别为30.02%、16.64%和15.47%。
Motivation: 构音障碍语音识别因数据有限且严重程度不同而极具挑战，现有预训练ASR模型微调需大量数据，需要针对不同严重程度的数据增强策略。
Method: 采用四种数据增强技术（SRM、PM、FM、VTLP）对构音障碍语音进行域内增强，按低、中、高严重程度分别微调Wav2Vec2模型。
Result: 语速修改(SRM)在低和中严重度上取得最佳WER（9.02%和38.11%），音调修改(PM)在高严重度上最佳（55.15%），相对改进分别达30.02%、16.64%和15.47%。
Conclusion: 数据增强方法能有效提升构音障碍ASR性能，且不同严重程度适用于不同的增强技术。
