papers.title: Beyond Static Leaderboards: Predictive Validity for the Evaluation of LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent benchmarks are growing fast, but no single benchmark touches more than four or five of the dimensions that deployment exposes. This paper aggregates the largest coordinated deep-dive of one MCP-based industrial-agent benchmark to date: fourteen parallel implementation studies covering new asset classes (including a multi-modal visual extension), alternative orchestrations, retrieval strategies, reasoning modes, infrastructure optimizations, and evaluation-methodology probes. Consolidating those studies with seven prior agent benchmarks, we argue that aggregate-score leaderboards systematically underspecify deployed-agent evaluation. Rankings derived from aggregate scores do not transfer to out-of-distribution settings; recent public-to-hidden competition retrospectives provide direct empirical evidence of this rank instability. We propose ranking configurations by predictive validity, the correlation between in-sample and out-of-sample rank, rather than in-sample mean, and report a twelve-tier measurement apparatus that exposes the deployment-relevant dimensions HELM and its agent-era successors collapse. The position is operationalized through three falsifiable out-of-distribution criteria with explicit thresholds; existing evidence partly supports it but is too thin to confirm. We close with a pre-registered pilot design and a field-level vision for what the next generation of agentic benchmarks should report.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过整合14项针对MCP工业代理基准的并行研究，以及7个现有代理基准，论证了基于聚合分数的排行榜在评估部署代理时的系统性缺陷。作者提出用预测有效性（即样本内与样本外排名的相关性）替代聚合分数作为排名依据，并设计了一个12层测量框架来暴露HELM及其后续基准所忽略的部署相关维度。尽管现有证据部分支持该观点，但尚不足以确认，论文最后给出了预注册实验设计和下一代代理基准的愿景。
Motivation: 现有代理基准虽快速增长，但单个基准最多覆盖部署暴露的维度中的四五个，导致聚合分数排行榜无法准确反映代理在分布外（OOD）场景下的表现。近期公开-隐藏竞赛回顾提供了排名不稳定的直接经验证据。
Method: 聚合14项MCP工业代理基准的并行研究（涵盖新资产类别、多模态视觉扩展、替代编排、检索策略、推理模式、基础设施优化和评估方法论探测）与7个现有基准，提出用预测有效性（样本内与样本外排名的相关性）排序配置，并设计12层测量框架来暴露被HELM等基准忽略的部署相关维度，同时提出三个可证伪的OOD标准及显式阈值。
Result: 论文通过经验证据表明聚合分数排行榜会导致排名不稳定，且不适用于分布外场景。但现有证据“太薄弱”无法完全证实所提出的OOD标准。
Conclusion: 本文主张下一代代理基准应报告预测有效性而非聚合分数，并提供了预注册的试点设计和领域级愿景。其观点部分得到支持，但需要更多实证验证。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文通过整合14项针对MCP工业代理基准的并行研究，以及7个现有代理基准，论证了基于聚合分数的排行榜在评估部署代理时的系统性缺陷。作者提出用预测有效性（即样本内与样本外排名的相关性）替代聚合分数作为排名依据，并设计了一个12层测量框架来暴露HELM及其后续基准所忽略的部署相关维度。尽管现有证据部分支持该观点，但尚不足以确认，论文最后给出了预注册实验设计和下一代代理基准的愿景。

papers.title: Comparative Study on Agility, Efficiency, and Impact Absorption of Bipedal Robots with Active Toes
papers.abstract_en: Human legs exhibit high efficiency, agility, and impact absorption, with toes playing a crucial role in these capabilities. While many attempts have been made to implement human-like toes in robots, they have not fully replicated human characteristics nor rigorously validated their benefits. We propose a 14-DOF biped robot emulating human toes' lightweight, high-torque, robust nature. To quantitatively analyze the effectiveness of the active toes in terms of agility, efficiency, and impact absorption, we developed a high-fidelity simulation training environment that reflects actual actuators with coupled transmissions and accurate power consumption. To ensure a fair comparison between configurations with and without active toes, we designed a minimal RL reward function and applied an identical training procedure to both. The simulation results indicate that, at 1.33 m/s walking, the toe-equipped robot reduced CoT by 17.5% and heel-strike GRF by 5.0% compared with the toe-ablation configuration. On the agility test, average and maximum path deviation decreased by 25.0% and 34.0%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定量研究主动脚趾对双足机器人敏捷性、效率和冲击吸收的影响。提出一个14自由度双足机器人模拟人类脚趾的轻量、高扭矩、鲁棒特性，并构建高保真仿真训练环境。在无主动脚趾配置对比中，有脚趾的机器人在1.33 m/s行走时，CoT降低17.5%，着地冲击力降低5.0%，路径偏差平均降低25.0%，最大降低34.0%。

Method: 设计14自由度双足机器人模拟人类脚趾，构建高保真仿真环境，使用最小RL奖励函数训练有无脚趾两种配置进行公平对比。

papers.title: Efficiently Representing Algorithms With Chain-of-Thought Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The increasing popularity of \emph{reasoning} models -- language models that output a series of reasoning or thought tokens before producing an answer -- is justified, in part, by theoretical results showing that chain-of-thought (CoT) transformers can simulate Turing machines, and thus perform arbitrary computation. However, the Turing machine, while suitable for complexity-theoretic analysis, is not convenient, intuitive, or efficient for discussing algorithms. Algorithms are typically designed and analyzed at a higher level of abstraction, captured by the \emph{Word RAM} model with random-access memory and unit-cost operations on $\bigO(\log n)$-bit words. As a result, Word RAM algorithms can be substantially more efficient than their Turing machine counterparts, raising the question: \emph{Can CoT transformers efficiently simulate Word RAM algorithms?} For instance, can they sort $n$ items in $\bigO(n \log n)$ steps or run Dijkstra's algorithm in $\bigO(E + V \log V)$ steps? We answer affirmatively, up to poly-logarithmic overhead. We first establish this for finite-precision transformers with poly-logarithmic width and rightmost unique hard attention, then strengthen the result to two more practical settings with finite width and log-precision: \emph{continuous} CoT, where reasoning takes the form of vectors rather than tokens, and a \emph{hybrid} architecture in which transformer layers sit atop a recurrent (linear RNN) layer. In all three cases, we find that CoT \emph{can} efficiently simulate any Word RAM algorithm with only a poly-logarithmic overhead in $n$. This overhead reduces to log-square when the Word RAM has a ``flat'' instruction set, and only logarithmic for multiplication-free flat instructions -- in stark contrast to known CoT simulations of Turing machines, which require quadratic overhead over Word RAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明，Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Transformer 能够高效模拟 Word RAM 算法，仅需 poly-logarithmic 开销。作者在三种设置下给出证明：有限精度 transformer 带 poly-logarithmic 宽度和右most唯一硬注意力；连续 CoT（推理向量而非 token）；以及混合架构（transformer 层在循环线性 RNN 层之上）。与已知的模拟图灵机相比，模拟 Word RAM 的开销更小（log-square 甚至 logarithmic），而模拟图灵机需要二次开销。
Motivation: 虽然 CoT Transformer 已被证明可以模拟图灵机，从而执行任意计算，但图灵机模型对于讨论算法效率不够便捷或直观。算法通常使用 Word RAM 模型（随机存取、单位成本对 O(log n) 位字操作）进行设计和分析，其效率可能远高于图灵机。因此需要研究 CoT Transformer 能否高效模拟 Word RAM 算法。
Method: 作者在三种设置下证明 CoT Transformer 可以高效模拟 Word RAM 算法：(1) 有限精度 transformer，具有 poly-logarithmic 宽度和右most唯一硬注意力；(2) 连续 CoT，推理表示为向量而非 token；(3) 混合架构，transformer 层位于循环线性 RNN 层之上。每种设置都保证了 poly-logarithmic 开销。
Result: 论文证明 CoT Transformer 能以 poly-logarithmic 开销模拟任意 Word RAM 算法。当 Word RAM 具有“平坦”指令集时，开销降至 log-square；对于无乘法平坦指令，开销仅为 logarithmic。这与已知的 CoT 模拟图灵机需要二次开销形成鲜明对比。
Conclusion: 本文表明，CoT Transformer 不仅能够进行任意计算（如模拟图灵机），而且能够以高效（poly-logarithmic 开销）的方式模拟更实际的 Word RAM 算法，从而为推理模型的理论优势提供了更强的基础。

papers.title: Multi-Granular Attention-Driven Reinforcement Learning Framework for Web Intelligent Enhancement Systems
papers.abstract_en: From the past few years, web intelligent enhancement systems increasingly rely on heterogeneous and dynamic web data to deliver personalized, context-aware services. However, traditional machine learning, deep learning, and reinforcement learning models often struggle with semantic understanding, adaptability, and scalability in continuously evolving web environments. In this research, a Multi-Granular Attention-based Reinforcement Web Intelligent Enhancement System (MGAR-WIES) is proposed to address the challenges by integrating semantic graph modeling, attention mechanisms, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Initially, heterogeneous web data comprising structured, semi-structured and unstructured sources are collected and preprocessed for generating unified feature representations. These representations are transformed into a dynamic semantic graph, where entities and their relationships are modeled by using graph embeddings enhanced by attention mechanisms for capturing both local relevance and global contextual dependencies. Subsequently, an adaptive multi-agent reinforcement learning strategy leverages the attention-aware semantic states to optimize personalized web actions like content recommendation, navigation optimization, and service adaptation. Finally, the continuous online feedback is further integrated to update graph representations and learning policies in real time by ensuring sustained adaptability and performance. The proposed MGAR-WIES acheived better results in terms of accuracy (80%) when compared with existing approaches.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多粒度注意力驱动的强化学习框架（MGAR-WIES），用于Web智能增强系统。该框架通过语义图建模、注意力机制和自适应多智能体强化学习，处理异构、动态的Web数据，以优化个性化Web服务（如内容推荐、导航优化、服务适配）。在实验中，该方法在准确率上达到80%，优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统机器学习、深度学习和强化学习模型在持续演化的Web环境中难以处理语义理解、自适应性和可扩展性问题，限制了个性化、上下文感知服务的质量。
Method: 首先收集并预处理结构化、半结构化和非结构化Web数据，生成统一特征表示；然后构建动态语义图，利用图嵌入和注意力机制捕捉局部相关性和全局上下文依赖；最后采用自适应多智能体强化学习策略，利用注意力感知语义状态优化个性化Web动作，并通过在线反馈实时更新图表示和学习策略。
Result: 摘要报告所提MGAR-WIES在准确率上达到80%，优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 通过语义图建模、注意力机制和自适应强化学习的结合，能够有效提升Web智能增强系统在动态环境中的自适应性和性能。

papers.title: Exploring Multi-Modal Large Language Models and Two-Stage Fine-Tuning for Fashion Image Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Composed image retrieval retrieves a target image using a composed query of a reference image and a modified text description. In the fashion domain, this task requires understanding subtle attribute variations such as color, pattern, and texture. However, existing approaches face limitations due to scarce annotated data and simplistic negative sampling. We propose a novel framework that integrates a multi-modal large language model (LLaVA) to generate attribute-aware triplets and introduces a two-stage fine-tuning strategy to enhance contrastive learning. We leverage pretrained vision-language models, such as CLIP-ViT/B32, to generate and concatenate sentence-level prompts with the relative caption and to scale the number of negatives using static representations. Experimental results demonstrate enhanced compositional reasoning and improved fine-grained retrieval behavior, underscoring the feasibility and potential of the proposed framework for fashion retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对时尚领域组合图像检索任务，提出一个融合多模态大语言模型（LLaVA）和两阶段微调策略的框架。该方法利用LLaVA生成属性感知三元组，并通过两阶段微调增强对比学习，使用CLIP-ViT/B32生成句子级提示并利用静态表示扩展负样本数量。实验表明该方法提升了组合推理能力和细粒度检索性能。
Motivation: 现有方法在时尚图像检索中面临标注数据稀缺和负采样简单的问题，导致对颜色、图案、纹理等细微属性变化的理解不足。
Method: 提出集成LLaVA生成属性感知三元组的框架，并采用两阶段微调策略：第一阶段使用CLIP-ViT/B32生成句子级提示与相对描述串联，第二阶段利用静态表示扩展负样本数量以增强对比学习。

Conclusion: 该框架通过多模态大模型和两阶段微调有效缓解了数据稀缺和负采样局限，为时尚图像检索提供了可行的解决方案。

papers.title: Exit-and-Join Dynamics for Decentralized Coalition Formation
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies coalition formation as a decentralized dynamical process driven by unilateral exit-and-join decisions. Agents evaluate local moves using the Aumann-Dreze value, so payoffs are computed within the agent's current coalition rather than through a globally negotiated coalition structure. The resulting model links cooperative payoff allocation with noncooperative best-response behavior: a terminal partition is precisely a coalition structure with no admissible, individually profitable exit-and-join deviation. We establish equilibrium characterizations, identify conditions under which the dynamics admit scalar Lyapunov or exact-potential representations, and analyze how switching and acceptance costs shape local stability. Numerical experiments test finite-time stabilization, cost sensitivity, and a special convex-game benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究去中心化联盟形成中的退出-加入动力学，利用Aumann-Dreze值进行局部收益分配，将非合作最优反应行为与合作收益分配结合。建立了均衡特征，分析了稳定性条件，并通过数值实验验证了有限时间稳定性和成本敏感性。
Motivation: 现有联盟形成模型常依赖全局协商，缺乏对去中心化动态过程的严格分析。
Method: 提出基于单边退出-加入决策的动力学模型，使用Aumann-Dreze值计算局部收益，将终止划分定义为无可盈利偏差的联盟结构。
Result: 证明了均衡等价于无可行、个体盈利的退出-加入偏差；给出了标量Lyapunov或精确势函数存在的条件；数值实验展示了有限时间稳定性和成本影响。
Conclusion: 本文为去中心化联盟形成的均衡和稳定性提供了理论框架，但未涉及实际应用，与气象预报等领域无直接关联。

papers.title: Vortex: Multi-Modal Fusion System for Intelligent Video Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Vortex, the multimodal video retrieval system developed by our team, FocusOnFun, for the Ho Chi Minh City AI Challenge 2025, designed to advance intelligent multimedia search and temporal reasoning. The system integrates adaptive keyframe extraction, multimodal metadata generation from vision-language and speech models, and a hybrid retrieval strategy that fuses CLIP and SigLIP2 embeddings through Reciprocal Rank Fusion to balance global and fine-grained semantics. To enhance interactivity, Vortex incorporates Rocchio-based relevance feedback and a multi-stage temporal search mechanism for sequential event alignment. Built on Milvus and Elasticsearch, the architecture enables scalable indexing and efficient retrieval. Evaluated in the official competition, our FocusOnFun team's system achieved a score of 79.6/88 (90.5\%) in the Preliminary Round and was further evaluated in the Final Round, achieving an `Excellent' overall performance with `Outstanding' results in the question-answering (QA) task. This demonstrating the complementary strengths of CLIP and SigLIP2 and confirming the effectiveness of the hybrid retrieval approach. The system establishes a robust foundation for future research in intelligent, context-aware, and interactive video retrieval.

papers.title: LOKI: Memory-Free Null-Space Constrained Lifelong Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong knowledge editing aims to efficiently and sequentially update language models over time, as new knowledge becomes available or when the model makes mistakes, while preserving acceptable performance on past knowledge. One unresolved challenge is that existing methods modify a fixed set of layers for all new knowledge samples, reducing flexibility and increasing catastrophic forgetting. Another is requiring access to previous knowledge and extensive pre-processing to obtain data statistics. To address these challenges, we introduce LOKI, a novel approach that uses dynamic layer selection based on the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion and projects gradient updates onto the null-space of the model weights, bypassing the requirement for previous knowledge access. We show that LOKI achieves superior performance to existing approaches across a wide variety of experiments, achieving up to a 14\% improvement in average accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LOKI，一种基于希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则的动态层选择方法，结合零空间约束梯度更新，实现无需访问旧知识的终身知识编辑。在多个实验中，LOKI相比现有方法平均准确率提升高达14%。
Motivation: 现有终身知识编辑方法固定修改层集，缺乏灵活性且导致灾难性遗忘；同时需要访问旧知识或大量预处理来获取数据统计信息。
Method: LOKI利用希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则动态选择要编辑的层，并将梯度更新投影到模型权重的零空间上，从而避免访问旧知识。
Result: 在多项实验中，LOKI平均准确率比现有方法提升高达14%。
Conclusion: LOKI通过动态层选择和零空间约束，有效解决了终身知识编辑中的灵活性和灾难性遗忘问题。

papers.title: TeleMorpher: Toward Robust Simultaneous Motion-Location Editing
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in image and video generation and editing. While recent studies have extended these efforts toward motion editing, simultaneously transforming both motion and location-despite its practical importance-remains largely unexplored. To better understand robust motion-location editing, we first analyze the fundamental factors that degrade its quality. Based on this analysis, we propose TeleMorpher, one of the first one-shot frameworks to the best of our knowledge, for simultaneous motion-location editing. Our approach leverages motion priors, a target motion-centric video generated from an off-the-shelf model as motion-editing guidance, and the ground truth motion to enable more controllable and precise motion-location editing. Via this, our framework works as follows: (1) we first disentangle the protagonist and the background via pre-trained segmentation and inpainting models. (2) Then, we introduce a training-free pose warping that edits the protagonist's motion with the motion prior as the guidance. (3) The result of warped motion video is directly injected into a baseline motion editor during inference, mitigating the difference between source and target motions while preserving the appearance of the source video. (4) To enhance the reliability of quantitative evaluations, we propose two new LPIPS-based metrics that measure the background consistency before and after the motion editing and the fidelity of motion editing performance via measuring the difference between the extracted protagonist's skeletons from source and target videos. Experiments with in-the-wild videos and the TaiChi dataset demonstrate that TeleMorpher achieves superior performance across both quantitative and qualitative measurements (real-human evaluation), underscoring its effectiveness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对同时编辑视频中运动与位置这一未充分探索的问题，提出 TeleMorpher，一种基于扩散模型的一次性框架。该方法利用运动先验（由预训练模型生成）和真实运动，通过解耦前景与背景、无训练姿态变形、以及将变形结果注入基线运动编辑器，实现鲁棒的运动-位置联合编辑。在真实视频和 TaiChi 数据集上的定性与定量（包括真实人类评估）实验显示优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在图像/视频生成与编辑上取得了成功，但运动编辑研究多局限于单一运动变换，同时改变运动与位置这一实际需求尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出四步框架：(1) 利用预训练分割与修复模型分离主角与背景；(2) 引入无需训练的姿态变形，以运动先验为指导编辑主角运动；(3) 将变形后的视频直接注入基线运动编辑器的推理过程，减少源与目标运动差异同时保留外观；(4) 提出两个基于 LPIPS 的新指标，分别衡量编辑前后背景一致性与运动编辑保真度。
Result: 在真实视频和 TaiChi 数据集上的实验表明，TeleMorpher 在定量和定性（真实人类评估）指标上均优于现有方法，证明了其有效性。
Conclusion: TeleMorpher 是首个用于同时运动-位置编辑的一次性框架，通过运动先验引导和背景解耦提升了编辑的鲁棒性。新的 LPIPS 指标为运动编辑评估提供了更可靠的量化手段。

papers.title: Learning When to Denoise: Optimizing Asynchronous Schedules for Latent Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Multi-representation diffusion models can improve visual synthesis by denoising complementary views of an image, but their performance depends critically on the asynchronous schedule that determines when each representation is denoised. We propose to learn this schedule. Our method formulates asynchronous flow matching over multiple representation spaces and uses a schedule-corrected objective that keeps each representation's local noising-time weights fixed as the schedule changes. We instantiate the schedule with a flexible parametric class that is convex and monotone by construction, and learn it using a fast joint probe with less than 1% additional training compute. On ImageNet 256x256, the learned schedule substantially improves both convergence speed and final quality under a matched 675M-parameter XL backbone. With AutoGuidance, our 200-epoch model reaches FID 1.05, matching the 800-epoch SFD-XL baseline with 4x less training. Training to 600 epochs further improves to FID 1.02, outperforming the 1B-parameter SFD-XXL result of FID 1.04 while using a smaller model. In the unguided setting, our 200-epoch model reaches FID 2.37, already below the best 800-epoch SFD-XL result (2.54) at 4x less training, and improves to FID 2.14 at 600 epochs. Code is available at https://github.com/bsq532087/LWD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习异步调度（asynchronous schedule）的方法，用于多表征扩散模型（multi-representation diffusion models），以优化不同表征的去噪顺序。方法通过调度校正目标（schedule-corrected objective）和参数化凸单调调度类，在ImageNet 256x256上显著提升收敛速度和最终质量，使用675M参数XL骨干，200轮训练达到FID 1.05（带自动引导），匹配800轮基线，且训练至600轮FID 1.02，优于1B参数模型。
Motivation: 多表征扩散模型的性能严重依赖于异步调度（即何时去噪每个表征），但现有调度是手工设计的，缺乏学习机制。
Method: 提出学习异步调度的方法，将异步流匹配（asynchronous flow matching）形式化到多个表征空间，使用调度校正目标固定局部噪声时间权重，并通过凸单调参数化调度类进行快速联合探测（少于1%额外训练计算）。
Result: 在ImageNet 256x256上，带自动引导的200轮模型达到FID 1.05，匹配800轮SFD-XL基线，训练量减少4倍；600轮模型FID 1.02，超过1B参数SFD-XXL的FID 1.04。无引导设置下，200轮模型FID 2.37，低于800轮基线2.54，600轮进一步降至2.14。
Conclusion: 学习得到的异步调度能大幅加快收敛并提升图像生成质量，且计算开销很小。

papers.title: Qwen-RobotNav Technical Report: A Scalable Navigation Model Designed for an Agentic Navigation System
papers.abstract_en: Agentic navigation systems require a base navigation model whose observation strategy can be externally reconfigured at inference time, because instruction following, object search, target tracking, and autonomous driving share the same perception-planning backbone yet demand fundamentally different strategies for consuming the visual stream. We present Qwen-RobotNav, a scalable navigation model built on Qwen-RobotNav that addresses it through a parameterised interface with two complementary dimensions: multiple task modes that select the navigation behaviour, and controllable observation parameters (e.g., token budget, per-camera weights) that govern how visual history is encoded. With training-time randomization over all parameters, Qwen-RobotNav is robust to any inference-time configuration requiring zero architectural modification to the Qwen-RobotNav backbone. We train Qwen-RobotNav on 15.6M samples; co-training with vision-language data prevents the collapse into reactive action-sequence mappers observed in trajectory-only training. The parameterised interface also makes Qwen-RobotNav a natural building block for agentic systems: for long-horizon scenarios, an upper-level planner decomposes goals into sub-tasks and dynamically switches Qwen-RobotNav's task mode and context strategy mid-episode, composing complex behaviours from repeated calls to the same model. Extensive experiments show that Qwen-RobotNav sets new state-of-the-art results across major navigation benchmarks. The model exhibits favourable scaling from 2B to 8B parameters, with joint multi-task training developing a shared spatial-planning substrate that transfers across task families, and demonstrates strong zero-shot generalisation to real-world robots across diverse environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Qwen-RobotNav，一个基于参数化接口的可扩展导航模型。该模型通过任务模式和可控观测参数（如 token budget、每相机权重）实现推理时外部重配置，在 15.6M 样本上训练，联合视觉-语言数据防止纯轨迹训练导致的崩溃。实验表明，Qwen-RobotNav 在多个导航基准上达到新 SOTA，从 2B 扩展到 8B 参数性能持续提升，并展现出对真实世界机器人的强零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 agentic 导航系统需要基础导航模型在推理时可重新配置观测策略，因为不同任务（指令跟随、物体搜索、目标跟踪、自动驾驶）共享感知-规划主干但要求不同的视觉流消耗策略，而传统模型难以灵活适应。
Method: 提出参数化接口，包含两个互补维度：多种任务模式选择导航行为，以及可控观测参数（如 token 预算、每相机权重）控制视觉历史编码。训练时对所有参数进行随机化，使模型对任意推理配置鲁棒，无需修改 Qwen-RobotNav 主干。上层规划器可在长时域场景中动态切换任务模式和上下文策略。
Result: 在多个导航基准上取得新 SOTA，模型从 2B 扩展到 8B 参数表现持续提升，联合多任务训练形成共享空间规划基板并跨任务族迁移，对真实世界机器人展示出强零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: 参数化接口使 Qwen-RobotNav 成为 agentic 系统的自然构建块，支持长时域目标分解和子任务动态切换，无需修改主干，为构建复杂导航系统提供可扩展方案。

papers.title: STAR: SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward Allocation for Text-to-Image RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Existing RL post-training methods for text-to-image generation usually convert the final-image reward into a single scalar advantage and apply it with the same strength to the entire generative trajectory. However, text-to-image generation naturally has temporal and spatial structure: different denoising steps are responsible for different generation stages, and the content that truly determines text alignment often appears only in part of the image. This granularity mismatch makes it difficult for policy updates to focus on the generative components that actually affect the reward. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{SpatioTemporal Adaptive Reward (STAR) Allocation} for RL post-training of text-to-image diffusion and flow models. STAR uses text-image attention inside the generative model and starts from the core content that the user truly cares about in the prompt. It constructs spatial allocation maps that dynamically vary across denoising steps and rollouts, and allocates the same group-relative advantage to more relevant latent regions with almost no additional computational overhead. STAR then applies stronger policy updates to these regions through a spatially resolved policy objective. We use Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium as the base model and evaluate on three tasks: GenEval, OCR text rendering, and PickScore. Experimental results show that STAR improves compositional semantic alignment, text rendering, and preference optimization without changing the external reward source, achieving $\mathbf{0.9759}$, $\mathbf{0.9757}$, and $\mathbf{23.60}$ on GenEval, OCR, and PickScore, respectively.

papers.title: Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: A Theoretical and Empirical Study of Monotonicity as an Inductive Bias
papers.abstract_en: Monotonicity has been a long-running architectural inductive bias for neural networks, motivated by tabular, scientific, and economic settings where outputs are known to respond monotonically to certain inputs. Existing approaches are MLP- or flow-based and lack per-edge functional transparency; the only Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN) variant with monotonicity, MonoKAN, enforces the constraint only on a restricted parameter subset and requires a projection-style training procedure. We close this gap with \textbf{MKAN}, a KAN with hard monotonicity guaranteed for \emph{all} parameter values via exponential reparameterization of B-spline coefficients, positive edge weights, and a monotone base activation. Training reduces to standard unconstrained gradient descent. Our headline theoretical contribution is a \emph{representation-cost} theorem: any $C^K, K >0$ feature extractor inducing a ball-shaped semantic-neighborhood partition admits a monotone realization of the equivalent neighborhood structure at $N' = N^* + k \le 2N^*$, where $k$ is the number of non-monotone coordinates of the original. The bound is architecture-agnostic and gives a principled sizing rule for monotone encoders. Empirically, MKAN is competitive with state-of-the-art monotone NNs on the SMM/ICML-2024 benchmark while being the only method that combines hard unconstrained monotonicity with KAN's per-edge functional transparency; the $2N^*$ prediction is validated in a self-supervised feature-size sweep on four real datasets, and on a controlled monotone-generative dataset MKAN recovers ground-truth factors with substantially higher Spearman alignment than KAN, MLP, and linear baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MKAN，一种通过指数重参数化 B 样条系数、正边缘权重和单调基激活函数实现硬单调性的 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络。理论贡献包括一个表示代价定理，表明任何诱导球状语义邻域分割的 C^K 特征提取器都可以用单调实现等价的邻域结构，且尺寸上界为 N' = N* + k ≤ 2N*。实验表明 MKAN 在 SMM/ICML-2024 基准上与最先进单调神经网络竞争，并在单调生成数据集上恢复 ground-truth 因子的 Spearman 相关性高于基线。
Motivation: 现有单调神经网络方法多为 MLP 或流模型，缺乏每边功能透明性；唯一的 KAN 变体 MonoKAN 仅在受限参数子集上施加约束，需要投影式训练。本文旨在填补这一空白，实现对所有参数值保证硬单调性且保持 KAN 透明性的方法。
Method: 通过指数重参数化 B 样条系数、使用正边缘权重和单调基激活函数，使得网络在任意参数下均为单调的，训练简化为标准无约束梯度下降。并给出一个表示代价定理，为单调编码器提供原则性的尺寸规则。
Result: 在 SMM/ICML-2024 基准上，MKAN 与最先进单调神经网络竞争力相当，且是唯一结合硬无约束单调性与每边功能透明性的方法。在自监督特征尺寸扫描实验中验证了 2N* 预测，在单调生成数据集上 MKAN 的 Spearman 对齐度显著高于 KAN、MLP 和线性基线。
Conclusion: MKAN 提供了同时满足硬单调性、无约束训练和功能透明性的 KAN 架构，理论定理给出了单调编码器的尺寸界限，实验验证了其有效性和性能。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: From Drift to Coherence: Stabilizing Beliefs in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are often hypothesized to perform implicit Bayesian inference, yet a key coherence condition, the martingale property of predictive beliefs, has been shown to fail in controlled synthetic in-context learning settings. We revisit this question in a more typical usage regime: generic multiple-choice question answering. Exploiting the discrete answer space, we compute exact predictive distributions and study belief dynamics induced by autoregressive answer resampling. We introduce prompted predictive resampling (PPR), where an LLM generates a sequence of answers to the same question. Empirically, PPR reveals early-stage belief drift, indicating martingale violations. However, after sufficient resampling steps, the belief process self-stabilizes and converges to a coherent predictive distribution. Based on this observation, we further propose (i) a seed-answer prompting strategy to accelerate stabilization, and (ii) a self-consistency loss that amortizes early-stage drift into the model via fine-tuning. Experiments on multiple-choice QA benchmarks show that our methods substantially reduce belief drift and improve predictive coherence without sacrificing accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）在多项选择问答中的信念动态，发现初始阶段存在信念漂移（违反鞅性质），但经过多次自回归重采样后信念过程自稳定并收敛到一致预测分布。基于此，提出种子答案提示策略加速稳定，以及自一致性损失通过微调将早期漂移摊销到模型中。实验表明方法在提高预测一致性的同时不牺牲准确性。
Motivation: 现有研究在可控合成上下文学习设置中发现LLM的预测信念不满足鞅性质（一致性条件），但现实使用场景中这一问题尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出提示式预测重采样（PPR），让LLM对同一问题生成多次答案以观察信念动态；进而提出种子答案提示策略和自一致性损失（微调）。
Result: 在多项选择问答基准上，PPR显示早期信念漂移，但多次重采样后信念自稳定；所提方法显著减少信念漂移并提高预测一致性，且不降低准确率。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了LLM在通用问答中信念从漂移到稳定的演化过程，并提供了实用方法提升一致性。

papers.title: Statistical Foundations of LLM-based A/B Testing: A Surrogacy Framework for Human Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Organizations and researchers show increasing interest in using large language models (LLMs) in place of human participants in A/B tests, in the hope of experimenting faster and at lower cost. We study when a treatment effect estimated on LLM outcomes can recover the effect that would have been measured on the human population of interest. Distributional equivalence between LLM and human outcomes would make any standard estimator valid but is unrealistic. We therefore develop a statistical framework that adapts surrogate endpoint theory to LLMs, showing that calibrating LLM outcomes to human outcomes identifies the average treatment effect under surrogacy and comparability conditions that are jointly weaker than distributional equivalence. We present a falsification test for surrogacy and a bound on the worst-case bias from limited overlap between the LLM and human samples. We further show that the stochasticity inherent to LLMs can weaken surrogacy for identification while also introducing bias and variance during estimation, but that using an average over multiple LLM draws per unit as the surrogate mitigates these issues. Simulations validate the results, and an empirical application to A/B tests on Upworthy headlines shows that raw LLM predictions recover only 39\% of the human treatment effect while nonparametric calibration closes the gap. A central takeaway is that A/B testing on LLMs yields correct results only by assumption, whereas A/B testing on humans is correct by design, and that the required assumptions are hardest to justify precisely where A/B testing on LLMs promises the greatest benefit. We discuss the role of LLM choice, prompting, and temperature as design variables, the compounded challenge posed by long-term outcomes, and how to size human pilot studies for validation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用大语言模型（LLM）替代人类参与者进行A/B测试时，如何从LLM结果中恢复人类上的处理效应。作者发展了一个基于替代终点理论的统计框架，提出在可比性和替代性条件下，通过校准LLM输出可以识别平均处理效应，并给出了可证伪的检验和最坏情况偏差界限。模拟和Upworthy标题的实证表明，非参数校准能缩小LLM与人类效应之间的差距，但核心结论是LLM上的A/B测试只有通过假设才能正确，而人类上的A/B测试天生正确。
Motivation: 组织和研究者希望用LLM替代人类进行A/B测试以降低成本和提高速度，但LLM与人类结果分布等价不现实，因此需要统计框架来保证从LLM估计的处理效应能反映人类效应。
Method: 将替代终点理论适配到LLM场景，提出替代性（surrogacy）和可比性（comparability）条件，在这些条件下通过校准LLM输出识别平均处理效应；并设计了一个针对替代性的可证伪检验和基于重叠偏差的边界。
Result: 模拟验证了理论结果，Upworthy头条A/B测试实证显示原始LLM预测仅恢复人类处理效应的39%，而非参数校准后差距消失。
Conclusion: LLM上的A/B测试只有通过假设才能正确，而人类上的A/B测试天生正确；所需假设在LLM承诺最大收益的地方最难成立。

papers.title: Multimodal Evaluator Preference Collapse: Cross-Modal Contagion in Self-Evolving Agents
papers.abstract_en: When AI agents use language models to evaluate their own outputs in a feedback loop, systematic biases emerge. We show that Evaluator Preference Collapse (EPC) is dramatically amplified in multimodal settings. Using GPT-4o to evaluate DeepSeek-chat across text and visual tasks, we find that a single strategy (step_by_step) absorbs 48.4% of all weight -- 3.2x the collapse observed in text-only self-evaluation -- while three visual-domain strategies receive only 9.1% combined weight. We then demonstrate a novel phenomenon we term cross-modal contagion: evaluator preferences acquired on one modality transfer to and corrupt strategy selection on another. Through a four-phase isolation training paradigm, we measure contagion coefficients and document strategy inversion -- the optimal strategy for a modality reverses after cross-modal exposure. A Phase 3 statistical validation across five evaluator configurations (N=80 total independent repetitions, ~35,000 API calls) with both text-proxy and real-image visual tasks finds: cross-model evaluation produces strong contagion (JSD~0.19-0.34), real-image inputs yield the most directionally consistent signal (mean gamma_{T->V}=1.145, gamma_{V->T}=0.937, 70% T->V, Cohen's d=0.56), and self-evaluation provides near-complete immunity -- 97% of runs (N=30) yield zero contagion (JSD=0.003, d=0.07). Three methodological ablations and multi-executor validation confirm the effect is not a structural artifact. We introduce the contagion matrix indexed by evaluator identity, release the MM-EPC framework, and identify cross-model evaluator architecture as the primary risk factor for preference drift. Code and data: https://github.com/aidless/mm-epc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多模态评估者偏好崩溃（EPC）现象，发现AI代理在使用语言模型自我评估时，偏好会急剧收敛到单一策略（step_by_step）上，权重占比48.4%，且这种崩溃在跨模态场景下显著加剧。作者进一步发现跨模态传染现象：在一个模态上习得的评估者偏好会转移并扭曲另一模态的策略选择。通过四阶段隔离训练范式，测量了传染系数并记录了策略反转。实验表明，跨模型评估产生强传染（JSD~0.19-0.34），而自我评估几乎完全免疫（97%零传染）。
Motivation: 现有研究关注AI自我评估中的偏好崩溃，但多模态场景下的动态尚不明确，且偏好如何在模态间传播未被探索。
Method: 使用GPT-4o评估DeepSeek-chat，在文本和视觉任务上比较策略权重分布；提出四阶段隔离训练范式测量传染系数；通过多种评估者配置和消融实验验证效应稳健性。
Result: 单一策略（step_by_step）吸收48.4%权重，是纯文本场景的3.2倍；视觉领域三策略合计仅9.1%；跨模型评估产生强传染（JSD~0.19-0.34），自我评估的97%运行无传染（JSD=0.003）。
Conclusion: 自进化多模态AI代理存在严重的偏好崩溃和跨模态传染风险，跨模型评估者架构是主要风险因素，而自我评估可提供免疫。

summary_sections.result: 单一策略（step_by_step）吸收48.4%权重，是纯文本场景的3.2倍；视觉领域三策略合计仅9.1%；跨模型评估产生强传染（JSD~0.19-0.34），自我评估的97%运行无传染（JSD=0.003）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 自进化多模态AI代理存在严重的偏好崩溃和跨模态传染风险，跨模型评估者架构是主要风险因素，而自我评估可提供免疫。

papers.title: SUP-MCRL: Subject-aware Unified Pseudo-feature Coded Multimodal Contrastive Representation Learning for EEG Visual Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Non-invasive brain-computer interfaces exhibit significant performance degradation when moving from controlled laboratory stimuli to real-world natural images. This degradation occurs because conventional multimodal contrastive representation learning models focus exclusively on optimizing geometric distance alignment, thereby failing to account for semantic consistency and inter-subject variability in neural representation and selective attention. As a result, these models are prone to producing spurious zero-shot matches. To address these limitations, we propose SUP-MCRL, a unified framework integrating three collaborative mechanisms: (1) a Semantic-entity Aware Visual Encoder (SAVE) that learns spatial attention to extract semantic content without relying on pre-trained saliency models; (2) a Unified EEG Enhancer (UEE) that employs multi-scale atrous convolutions and inter-band attention for adaptive cross-subject robustness; and (3) a Prototype-based Progressive Augmenter (PPA) that maintains an EMA-updated pseudo-feature pool to prevent representation collapse. Zero-shot experiments on the THINGS-EEG achieve 66.0%/91.9% (Top-1/Top-5) intra-subject and 24.0%/52.9% LOSO accuracy, significantly surpassing state-of-the-art methods and demonstrating that structured alignment supervision is key to overcoming the limitations of cross-modal decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/NZWANG/SUP-MCRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SUP-MCRL，一个面向EEG视觉解码的统一框架，通过三个协作机制（语义感知视觉编码器SAVE、统一EEG增强器UEE、原型渐进增强器PPA）解决传统多模态对比表示学习中忽略语义一致性和跨被试变异性的问题。在THINGS-EEG数据集上的零样本实验表明，该方法在脑电视觉解码任务上显著超越现有方法，证明了结构化对齐监督的重要性。
Motivation: 传统多模态对比表示学习仅优化几何距离对齐，忽略语义一致性和跨被试变异性，导致从实验室刺激迁移到真实自然图像时性能严重下降。
Method: 提出SUP-MCRL框架，包含三个模块：SAVE学习空间注意力提取语义内容；UEE使用多尺度空洞卷积和频带间注意力实现自适应跨被试鲁棒性；PPA维护EMA更新的伪特征池防止表示崩溃。
Result: 在THINGS-EEG上零样本实验达到66.0%/91.9%（Top-1/Top-5）被试内准确率和24.0%/52.9% LOSO准确率，显著超越现有最好方法。
Conclusion: 结构化对齐监督是克服跨模态解码局限性的关键。

papers.title: RepNN: Tackling spectral bias in deep neural networks via parameter reparameterization
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in scientific computing, yet they often suffer from spectral bias in capturing oscillatory and multiscale behaviors. In this study, we investigate this limitation by examining the failure of shallow ReLU neural networks in fitting high-frequency functions. This observation identifies two important factors in resolving rapid oscillations: the initial slope scale and the distribution of partition points induced by the networks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose RepNN, a reparameterized neural network model with activation ReLU or tanh designed for high-frequency and multiscale problems. The key idea is to reparameterize the weights and biases in the first hidden layer, which enables effective control of the initial slope scale and provides an appropriate distribution of the initial partition points. Furthermore, treating the reparameterized weights and biases as trainable parameters allows the DNN to achieve adaptive frequency scaling during training. In addition, we derive quantitative estimates for the output and slope magnitudes of the reparameterized DNN to guide the initialization of the proposed method. Numerical experiments, including multiscale one- and four-dimensional function approximations, forward and inverse PDE problems in combination with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), and operator learning for an earthquake problem using real data, demonstrate that RepNN improves the predicted accuracy of vanilla DNNs in capturing highly oscillatory features with slightly additional computational cost. These results indicate that RepNN provides an effective and flexible approach for overcoming spectral bias and applying DNNs to multiscale problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络在捕捉高频和多尺度行为时存在的频谱偏差问题，提出RepNN模型，通过重参数化第一隐藏层的权重和偏置，有效控制初始斜率尺度和初始分割点分布，并实现训练中的自适应频率缩放。数值实验表明，RepNN在多种多尺度函数逼近、PINNs求解以及地震算子学习任务中，以少量额外计算成本显著提高了对高频特征的预测精度。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在科学计算中虽取得成功，但在捕捉振荡和多尺度行为时受频谱偏差限制。浅层ReLU网络拟合高频函数失败的现象揭示了两个关键因素：初始斜率尺度和网络诱导的分割点分布。
Method: 提出RepNN，对第一隐藏层的权重和偏置进行重参数化，以控制初始斜率尺度和初始分割点分布；将重参数化后的参数作为可训练参数，实现自适应频率缩放；并推导了输出和斜率幅度的定量估计以指导初始化。
Result: 在多尺度一维和四维函数逼近、PINNs的正向和逆向问题、以及基于真实数据的地震算子学习等实验中，RepNN以略增加的计算代价提升了原始DNN对高频振荡特征的预测精度。
Conclusion: RepNN为克服频谱偏差并应用DNN于多尺度问题提供了一种有效且灵活的方法。

papers.title: Gaming-Resistant Insurance Contracts for Autonomous AI Agents: Strategy-Proof Toll Mechanism Design
papers.abstract_en: Paper A defines a time-consistent actuarial runtime that prices each side-effect-bearing action against a contractually fixed safe default and gates execution against a reserve budget. It treats the operator as passive. This paper makes the operator strategic. We characterise a five-attack space for autonomous AI-agent insurance contracts and prove when the actuarial runtime is gaming-resistant. Two attack surfaces -- post-toll safe-default selection and within-boundary action splitting -- are closed by Paper A's minimal-authority and no-splitting clauses. The remaining three require new contract clauses. First, common-control aggregation prevents cross-boundary re-routing from reducing toll below the boundary potential applied to total exposure. Second, interface failures such as invalid JSON are contract-relevant events, not safety wins: treating them as zero-toll safe defaults can reward unreliable models, while escalation fees reverse the incentive. We validate this interface-compliance theorem on committed cross-model traces from the companion empirical paper. Third, a model-identity menu with a componentwise-minimum penalty schedule makes truthful reporting of the deployed model weakly dominant. We then compose these clauses with Paper A's runtime guarantees to obtain joint incentive compatibility over the five-attack space. Finally, a two-parameter premium family discharges operator individual rationality and weak budget balance at the truthful equilibrium. The result is an incentive-compatibility layer for actuarial control of autonomous-agent side effects.
papers.comment: 29 pages. Companion to arXiv:2605.26508 (Paper A, foundations) and arXiv:2605.25632 (Paper B, empirical)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在Paper A定义的精算运行时（actuarial runtime）基础上，将操作者视为策略性主体，刻画了自主AI代理保险合约的五类攻击空间，并证明了在何种条件下该精算运行时具有抗博弈性。通过引入新合约条款（共同控制聚合、接口失败处理、模型身份菜单），与Paper A的运行时保证组合，实现了五类攻击空间上的激励相容性。最后，一个双参数保费族在真实均衡下满足个体理性和弱预算平衡。
Motivation: 现有自主AI代理精算控制框架假设操作者是被动的，未考虑其策略性行为可能导致合约漏洞，需要设计抗博弈的保险合约机制。
Method: 分析五类攻击空间，对其中两类利用Paper A已有条款封闭，对剩余三类提出新合约条款：共同控制聚合防止跨边界重路由、接口失败处理（征收升级费）消除激励、模型身份菜单使真实报告成为弱占优策略，并与Paper A的运行时保证组合。
Result: 形式化刻画了五类攻击空间，证明了所提条款组合下的激励相容性，以及双参数保费族满足个体理性和弱预算平衡。
Conclusion: 本文在精算控制基础上添加了激励相容层，为自主AI代理副作用管理提供了可验证的合约设计框架。

papers.title: VEPHand: View-Efficient Photometric Hand Performance Capture at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Robust, high-fidelity 3D hand capture, while fundamental to digital human creation, remains challenging with practical multi-view systems that balance rich photometry with the geometric ambiguities of reconstruction arising from limited viewpoint density. This paper presents an end-to-end pipeline for dynamic hand performance capture and registration, specifically designed for view-efficient setups ($\sim$20 views). We address key challenges with two primary innovations. First, to overcome reconstruction difficulties like limited view overlap and background clutter, our mask-free neural method robustly extracts detailed hand geometry and appearance from unmasked images using scene parameterization and scenario-specific density regularization. Second, addressing registration challenges such as accurately capturing non-linear skin deformations and ensuring plausible results during severe self-contact, we propose a physics-inspired framework. It aligns reconstructions to a personalized hand model by optimizing intrinsic volumetric offsets within its canonical tetrahedral mesh, alongside pose parameters. This approach, supported by robust losses and optimization, captures fine surface deformations, ensures plausible results under severe articulation and self-contact, and demonstrates strong tolerance to input noise. We demonstrate the scalability and robustness of our automated pipeline on an extensive dataset of over 12,000 sequences, from which we also derive a large-scale, high-quality synthetic 2D/3D hand dataset for training downstream tasks. This showcases its effectiveness for single hands, intricate two-hand interactions, and natural hand-object manipulations. Our method achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction fidelity in view-efficient, unmasked scenarios and highly accurate registration. Our project page are available at https://vephand.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种端到端的手部动态性能捕捉与注册管线，专为约20个视角的稀疏多视图系统设计。通过无掩码的神经重建方法和物理启发的注册框架，实现了高保真3D手部几何与外观重建，并在超过12,000个序列的数据集上验证了可扩展性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有的多视图手部捕捉系统在有限视角密度下存在重建几何模糊和注册不准确的问题，尤其是处理自接触和非线性皮肤变形时。
Method: 提出两类创新：1）无掩码神经重建，利用场景参数化和稀疏正则化从无掩码图像中提取手部几何与外观；2）物理启发式注册，将重建与个性化手部模型对齐，通过优化规范四面体网格内的体积偏移和姿态参数来捕捉精细表面变形。
Result: 在12,000+序列的数据集上实现了稀疏视角、无掩码场景下的最先进重建保真度和高精度注册，并衍生出大规模合成2D/3D手部数据集。
Conclusion: 该管线在单双手交互和手物操作场景中均有效，对输入噪声具有强容忍性，适用于实用多视角设置。

papers.title: High-Fidelity 4D Hand-Object Capture via Multi-View Spatiotemporal Tracking and Physics-Aware Gaussians
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for high-fidelity 4D hand-object interaction (HOI) data in embodied AI and spatial computing is currently bottlenecked by the reliance on pre-scanned object templates and physical markers. While recent methods have demonstrated promising results in reconstructing 4D hand-object interaction from videos, they are highly sensitive to initial estimates of hand and object poses. Yet, estimating these poses from images is challenging, in particular under severe occlusion which is inherent in hand-object interaction scenarios. We propose a novel system for the robust and accurate reconstruction of hands and objects from synchronized and calibrated multi-view videos without requiring any templates or markers. Our system consists of two main components with key innovations: (1) a multi-view feed-forward transformer model that aggregates cross-view geometry and temporal cues to provide a reliable, metric-consistent initialization for both poses and dense object geometry, and (2) a hand-object physics-aware Gaussian-based optimization framework to refine the initial estimates, integrating tetrahedral constraints, collision refinement, and appearance decomposition to produce physically plausible and visually accurate reconstruction. Validated on public benchmarks and an extensive internal dataset, our pipeline achieves highly robust, artifact-free reconstruction, providing an efficient foundation for automated 4D asset generation. Our project page are available at https://zyshen021.github.io/HOSTPG/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个从多视角视频中高清重建4D手-物体交互的系统，无需预扫描模板或标记。系统由多视角前馈Transformer模型（提供可靠的初始姿态和密集几何）和基于物理感知的Gaussian优化框架（整合四面体约束、碰撞精化、外观分解）组成。在公开基准和内部数据集上验证了鲁棒、无伪影的重建。
Motivation: 现有4D手-物体交互数据采集依赖预扫描模板和物理标记，且对初始姿态估计敏感，尤其在严重遮挡下难以准确估计。
Method: 提出一个两阶段系统：(1) 多视角前馈Transformer模型，聚合跨视角几何和时间线索，给出度量一致的初始化；(2) 基于物理感知的Gaussian优化框架，整合四面体约束、碰撞精化和外观分解，产生物理合理且视觉准确的重建。
Result: 在公开基准和内部数据集上，实现了高度鲁棒、无伪影的重建，为自动化4D资产生成提供了高效基础。
Conclusion: 该系统无需模板或标记，通过创新的初始化与物理感知优化，实现了鲁棒准确的4D手-物体重建，可服务于自动化4D资产生成。

papers.title: RetailBench: Benchmarking long horizon reasoning and coherent decision making of LLM agents in realistic retail environments
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have made rapid progress on short-horizon, well-scoped tasks, yet their ability to sustain coherent decisions in dynamic long-horizon environments remains uncertain. We introduce RetailBench, a data-grounded simulation benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents in single-store supermarket operation. RetailBench models retail management as a partially observable decision process and is designed to support thousand-day-scale simulations. In this environment, agents must manage pricing, replenishment, supplier selection, shelf assortment, inventory aging, customer feedback, external events, and cash-flow constraints. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs under representative agent frameworks over a 180-day evaluation horizon and compare them with a privileged oracle policy. Results show substantial variation across models: only a small subset survives the full evaluation horizon, and even the strongest LLM runs remain substantially behind the oracle policy in final net worth and sales outcomes. Behavioral analysis attributes these gaps to incomplete evidence acquisition, surface-level decision making, and the lack of a consistent long-horizon policy. RetailBench provides a controlled testbed for studying reliable autonomy in economically grounded long-horizon decision-making.

papers.title: SILAGE: Memory-Efficient, Full-Gradient-Free Nonconvex Optimization for Nested Finite Sums
papers.abstract_en: Empirical risk minimization on massive datasets naturally exhibits a nested double finite-sum structure, where $N=nm$ total samples are logically or physically partitioned into $n$ blocks of size $m$ (e.g., in pooled data silos, out-of-core learning, or deliberate stratification). While variance-reduced methods achieve optimal oracle complexities for nonconvex objectives, they suffer from severe scaling bottlenecks in this centralized regime. Recursive estimators, such as PAGE, require periodic global full-gradient refreshes over all $nm$ samples, which are computationally expensive. Conversely, single-loop methods, such as SILVER, avoid such refreshes but require an impractical $\mathcal{O}(nm)$ memory footprint to store a control variate for every sample. In this paper, we propose SILAGE, a variance-reduced algorithm that addresses this trade-off. By actively exploiting the double-sum structure, SILAGE eliminates periodic global full-gradient refreshes over all $nm$ components (evaluating at most one local group gradient per iteration) while requiring only $\mathcal{O}(n)$ memory. Furthermore, we provide a tight convergence analysis that avoids pessimistic worst-case Lipschitz constants. Instead, SILAGE's complexity natively adapts to the underlying data geometry via nested functional similarities: across-group ($δ_1$) and within-group ($δ_2$) heterogeneity. Our results improve existing state-of-the-art bounds in several practically relevant regimes.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SILAGE算法，用于求解嵌套双重有限和形式的非凸优化问题。该算法无需周期性的全局全梯度刷新，且内存开销仅为O(n)，同时通过利用组间和组内异质性实现了自适应复杂度分析。
Motivation: 现有方差缩减方法（如PAGE）需要昂贵的全局全梯度刷新，而单循环方法（如SILVER）内存开销过大。论文旨在解决这一权衡问题，在保持高效率的同时降低内存需求。
Method: SILAGE通过主动利用双重求和结构，每次迭代至多计算一个局部组梯度，无需全局全梯度刷新，仅需O(n)内存存储控制变量。收敛分析采用嵌套函数相似性（组间δ1和组内δ2）代替最坏情况Lipschitz常数。
Result: 在非凸目标下，SILAGE的复杂度自适应于数据几何结构，改进了多个实际相关场景下的现有最优界。
Conclusion: SILAGE在内存效率和计算效率之间取得了新的平衡，适用于数据分块、外存学习等场景。

papers.title: StarOR: Synergizing Tree Search and Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Optimization Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Optimization modeling is inherently hierarchical, requiring a precise sequence of symbolic commitments. Traditional learning-based automated optimization modeling methods improve modeling policies through large-scale annotated or curated training data, but are costly to adapt to new problem distributions. Meanwhile, one-shot generation remains brittle in hierarchical modeling, where early symbolic errors can propagate into invalid formulations. Test-time scaling offers a promising alternative by enabling structural exploration with additional instance-level computation; however, existing search-based methods typically rely on a fixed policy, causing repeated rollouts to inherit similar modeling biases and providing limited credit assignment for intermediate decisions. To address these limitations, we propose StarOR, a synergistic search-and-adaptation framework that couples MCTS with Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for optimization modeling. StarOR decomposes the modeling process into four stages and updates a transient LoRA adapter via GRPO at each non-terminal node. By using MCTS-generated siblings as local comparison sets, StarOR transforms search-time exploration into instance-specific policy refinement. Moreover, an unsupervised multi-faceted reward system provides fine-grained feedback for intermediate formulation decisions without ground-truth labels. Experiments across five optimization benchmarks show that StarOR achieves state-of-the-art performance even with a 4B backbone, outperforming existing methods and the frontier LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StarOR 将蒙特卡洛树搜索 (MCTS) 与测试时强化学习 (Test-Time RL) 结合，用于分层优化建模。该方法将建模拆解为四个阶段，在每个非终端节点通过 GRPO 更新临时 LoRA 适配器，利用 MCTS 生成的兄弟节点作为局部比较集，实现实例特定的策略优化。无监督的多面奖励系统为中间决策提供细粒度反馈。在五个优化基准上，StarOR 使用 4B 骨干模型即达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有学习型自动化优化建模方法依赖大规模标注或整理数据，难以适应新问题分布；单次生成在分层建模中脆弱，早期符号错误会传播。搜索型方法则使用固定策略，导致重复 rollout 继承相似偏差且缺乏中间决策的信用分配。
Method: 提出 StarOR，将分层建模分为四个阶段，结合 MCTS 与测试时 RL：在每个非终端节点，使用 GRPO 更新 LoRA 适配器；MCTS 生成的兄弟节点作为局部比较集，将搜索探索转化为实例特定策略细化；无监督多面奖励系统提供无标注的中间决策反馈。
Result: 在五个优化基准上，StarOR 以 4B 骨干模型达到最先进性能，超越现有方法和前沿大语言模型。
Conclusion: StarOR 通过协同搜索与适应，展示了测试时计算扩展在分层优化建模中的潜力，无需额外标注数据即可进行实例级策略调整。

papers.title: NEXUS: Neural Energy Fields for Physically Consistent Contact-Rich 3D Object Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Physics-grounded video generation requires controllable 3D object dynamics that remain physically consistent under contact, deformation, and external forcing. Existing trajectory-based methods often model isolated physical effects, making it difficult to compose conservative and non-conservative dynamics in contact-rich 3D scenes. We present NEXUS, a neural energy-field framework for contact-rich 3D object dynamics. NEXUS represents each object as a structural graph and constructs dynamic object-object and object-environment contact graphs. Inspired by Hamiltonian Neural Networks, NEXUS formulates motion through scalar energy and dissipation terms rather than directly predicting states or accelerations. Conservative effects, including gravity and elastic deformation, are composed as additive energy terms, while non-conservative effects such as damping and impact-induced energy loss are modeled with learned Rayleigh-style dissipation. Forces are derived by differentiating the energy and dissipation functions and rolled out with a multi-substep semi-implicit integrator. Across controlled trajectory benchmarks, NEXUS improves long-horizon accuracy over representative learned and physics-structured dynamics baselines under varying mechanical properties and physical-effect compositions. We further show that NEXUS trajectories provide effective guidance for contact-rich video generation, improving physical plausibility while maintaining competitive visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NEXUS，一种基于神经能量场（neural energy field）的框架，用于物理一致的接触丰富3D物体动力学建模。该方法将物体表示为结构图，构建动态接触图，并通过哈密顿神经网络思想，由标量能量和耗散项导出运动，而非直接预测状态或加速度。保守效应（重力、弹性变形）作为可加能量项，非保守效应（阻尼、碰撞能量损失）用学习到的瑞利型耗散建模，最后通过多子步半隐式积分器推演轨迹。在受控轨迹基准上，NEXUS在不同机械属性和物理效应组合下提升了长期轨迹精度，并用于接触丰富视频生成以增强物理合理性。
Motivation: 现有基于轨迹的方法常建模孤立的物理效应，难以在接触丰富的3D场景中组合保守与非保守动力学，导致物理一致性不足。
Method: 将物体表示为结构图，构建物体-物体和物体-环境接触图；采用哈密顿神经网络形式，通过标量能量和耗散项推导力；保守效应作为可加能量项，非保守效应用学习到的瑞利型耗散建模；使用多子步半隐式积分器进行轨迹推演。
Result: 在受控轨迹基准上，相比有代表性的学习型和物理结构动力学基线，NEXUS在不同机械属性和物理效应组合下提升了长期轨迹精度；NEXUS生成的轨迹能有效指导接触丰富视频生成，提高物理合理性同时保持竞争性视觉质量。
Conclusion: NEXUS框架通过能量和耗散项的显式组合，实现了物理一致的接触丰富3D物体动力学，并能提升视频生成的物理合理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Sparse Latent Predictive Foundation Model for Multimodal Neuroimaging
papers.abstract_en: Brain MRIs are routinely acquired as multiple complementary sequences with unique contrast weighting, including T1-weighed imaging (T1w) anatomic and fluid-sensitive T2-weighted (T2w) contrasts. However, methods for learning unified representations across the multitude of MRI contrast mechanisms at health-system scale are lacking. In this study, we introduce Neuro-JEPA, a sparse multimodal neuroimaging foundation model that combines a latent predictive objective with a Mixture-of-Experts architecture to encode brain MRI across core T1w, T2w, and fluid-suppressed FLAIR imaging (FLAIR). We further provide a systematic methodological study of architectural, masking, objective, and sparsity design choices beneficial for robust neuroimaging multimodal representation learning. Neuro-JEPA was pretrained on 1,551,862 scans from 428,647 studies after modality-specific preprocessing with data curation across three core structural brain MRI sequences. We evaluated the learned representations across clinical and research settings, including 25 tasks from three health systems: NYU Langone, NYU Long Island, and Massachusetts General Hospital, and 22 tasks from 12 public datasets, covering unimodal, multimodal and cross-domain evaluation configurations. Across these benchmarks, existing neuroimaging foundation models showed inconsistent gains over a simple convolutional neural network (CNN) baseline, whereas Neuro-JEPA achieved stronger and more consistent performance across all evaluated settings. These results establish a scalable methodological framework for multimodal neuroimaging representation learning and highlight the need for foundation model evaluation protocols that include simple baselines, clinically heterogeneous cohorts and controlled multimodal comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neuro-JEPA，一种稀疏多模态神经影像基础模型，结合潜在预测目标（latent predictive objective）与混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）架构，用于编码脑 MRI 的 T1w、T2w 和 FLAIR 序列。模型在 155 万余次扫描上预训练，并在来自三个医疗系统和 12 个公开数据集的 47 项任务上评估，相比现有神经影像基础模型和简单 CNN 基线，Neuro-JEPA 性能更强且更一致。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏在健康系统规模下统一学习多种 MRI 对比机制表征的能力，且已有神经影像基础模型在跨设置评估中表现不一致。
Method: 采用稀疏多模态架构，将潜在预测目标与混合专家网络结合，通过系统的架构、掩码、目标和稀疏性设计选择研究来优化多模态表征学习。
Result: 在 47 项任务上，现有基础模型相比简单 CNN 基线改进不稳定，而 Neuro-JEPA 在所有评估设置中均取得更强且一致的表现。
Conclusion: 该方法为多模态神经影像表征学习提供了可扩展的方法框架，并强调基础模型评估协议需包含简单基线、临床异质性队列和受控多模态比较。

papers.title: Applicability Condition Extraction for Therapeutic Drug-Disease Relations
papers.abstract_en: Identifying conditions that a certain drug takes therapeutic effect on a target disease is crucial for clinical decision-making support. However, most existing biomedical information extraction methods have focused on identifying only relations between drugs and diseases, while largely overlooking the context-specific conditions where such relations can apply. To address this problem, we introduce the task of applicability condition extraction for therapeutic drug-disease relations from biomedical research literature. We create the first dataset that has manually annotated triples of drugs, diseases, and applicability conditions on biomedical paper abstracts with 1,119 drug-disease pairs. Using this dataset, we systematically evaluate the performance of a range of existing methods. In addition, we propose a new method that enhances LoRA to consider relations between drugs and diseases. Our method consistently outperforms strong baselines across different evaluation settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出药物-疾病治疗关系适用条件提取任务，并构建了包含1,119个药物-疾病对的第一个手工标注数据集。方法上增强LoRA以显式建模药物与疾病间的关联，在多种评估设置下持续优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有生物医学信息抽取方法大多只识别药物与疾病间的二元关系，忽略了这些关系生效的上下文条件（如适用人群、疗程等），不利于临床决策。
Method: 定义三元组（药物、疾病、适用条件）的抽取任务；基于论文摘要人工标注数据集；提出改进的LoRA方法，通过引入药物-疾病关系嵌入增强条件抽取。
Result: 在自建的1,119对数据集上，所提方法在精确率、召回率和F1上均超过多个现有基线模型，且在不同条件类型上表现稳定。

papers.title: An integrated interpretable control effectiveness learning and nonlinear control allocation methodology for overactuated aircrafts
papers.abstract_en: Nonlinear dynamics and the strong couplings that arise between multiple effectors undermine the assumptions behind conventional, linear control allocation techniques. When flight enters regimes where nonlinear effects dominate, linear allocators exhibit reduced accuracy due to increased model mismatch, which subsequently degrades performance and robustness of the flight control system. High fidelity onboard models and black box data driven approaches can recover accuracy across the flight envelope, but respectively impose computational burdens prohibitive for real time allocation and sacrifice the interpretability required for verification and fault diagnosis. This paper addresses these limitations by learning an explicit, physics constrained analytical model of the control effectiveness mapping from representative flight data using Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics. The resulting mapping is compact, interpretable, and admits analytical derivatives, enabling efficient computation within nonlinear solvers that additionally incorporate actuator dynamics, without requiring an onboard model. An online adaptation mechanism monitors prediction residuals and refreshes the model when significant plant changes are detected, providing graceful reconfiguration under actuator failures and varying operating conditions. The methodology is evaluated on a high fidelity nonlinear benchmark aircraft across a range of aggressive maneuvers, achieving accuracy comparable to a full nonlinear onboard model while substantially reducing computational cost relative to established baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对过驱动飞行器在非线性动力学和强耦合下传统线性控制分配精度下降的问题，提出一种集成可解释控制效能学习与非线性控制分配的方法。通过稀疏辨识从飞行数据中学习显式的物理约束解析模型，该模型紧凑、可解释且具有解析导数，能够在非线性求解器中高效计算并纳入执行器动力学。在线自适应机制监控预测残差并在检测到显著变化时刷新模型，实现执行器故障和变工况下的优雅重构。在高保真基准飞行器的激进机动中评估，该方法达到了与全非线性机载模型相当的精度，同时显著降低了计算成本。
Motivation: 传统线性控制分配在非线性效应主导的飞行区域精度下降，而高保真机载模型计算负担大，黑箱数据驱动方法缺乏可解释性，不利于验证和故障诊断。
Method: 利用稀疏辨识（SINDy）从代表性飞行数据中学习控制效能映射的显式物理约束解析模型，该模型可解释且提供解析导数，用于非线性控制分配求解器，并结合在线自适应机制监控残差进行模型刷新。
Result: 在高保真非线性基准飞行器上的激进机动测试中，该方法达到与全非线性机载模型相当的精度，且计算成本显著低于现有基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法在保持可解释性的同时实现了高精度和低计算成本，并具备在线重配置能力，适用于过驱动飞行器的实际控制。

papers.title: LLM-Based Synthetic Ground Truth Generation for Audio-Based Emotion Classification via In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Understanding human states and interaction dynamics is a core goal of human-computer interaction (HCI). As interaction paradigms become more immersive, virtual reality (VR) has emerged as a powerful platform for studying collaborative work. In such settings, evaluating team collaboration states, including team performance and team resilience, requires continuous and reliable inference of latent team-level cognitive and affective states from multi-modal sensor data, such as speech signals. However, generating ground truth labels for these latent states remains challenging due to sensor-induced noise, contextual variability, and sparse expert annotations. Traditional self-reporting approaches provide only static and delayed measurements and are therefore insufficient for capturing dynamic team processes reflected in continuous speech data. In this work, we propose a large language model (LLM)-driven, agentic inference workflow for automated emotion-related synthetic ground truth generation from streaming speech data in multi-user VR environments. Leveraging the generalization capabilities of LLMs, we use In-Context Learning (ICL) with few-shot demonstrations of paired audio-based samples and their corresponding transcriptions. ICL tends to achieve task adaptation comparable to model fine-tuning while circumventing the computational overhead of parameter updates. To construct informative and robust in-context prompts, we adopt a retrieval-based selection strategy that dynamically identifies relevant audio demonstrations based on similarity in the acoustic feature space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多用户虚拟现实（VR）环境中从连续语音数据自动生成情感相关合成真实标签（synthetic ground truth）的难题，提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能推理流程。该方法利用上下文学习（ICL）与少量示例，通过检索音频特征空间中的相似样本来构建提示，无需参数更新即可实现任务适配。
Motivation: 传统自我报告方法只能提供静态、滞后的测量，无法捕捉连续语音数据中动态的团队协作状态。从语音等传感器数据中推断团队认知和情感状态需要可靠的标签，但传感器噪声、上下文变化和专家标注稀疏使真实标签的生成极具挑战。
Method: 提出LLM驱动的智能推理流程，利用上下文学习（ICL）与少量配对音频-文本示例进行任务适配。采用基于检索的选择策略，在声学特征空间中动态选择与当前音频最相似的演示，构造信息丰富的上下文提示。
Result: 摘要未明确报告量化结果，但声称该方法能超越静态自我报告，有效生成连续语音数据的情感相关合成真实标签，并在多用户VR环境中验证了可行性。
Conclusion: LLM驱动的ICL方法可规避参数更新的计算开销，为多模态传感器数据中的潜在状态标注提供自动化方案，适用于动态团队协作分析。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Based Lunar Crater Terrain Relative Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate position estimation is crucial for the successful implementation of future lunar landings using autonomous vehicles, especially in dangerous environments with sparse terrain features. In this paper, we propose a terrain relative navigation (TRN) algorithm combining our deep-learning crater detector, which was designed specifically for the NASA Crater Detection Challenge problem, and an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). Our detector analyzes crater features from the monocular images acquired from orbit, and their matches with craters from a global database are identified via a Hungarian assignment approach followed by the consensus-based outliers removal method. The estimated measurements are then used to refine an EKF, where spacecraft pose estimation in the Lunar-Centered Lunar-Fixed (LCLF) frame of reference, augmented with altitude aiding information, constrains radial drift. The simulation results indicate that even if the spacecraft is off from its actual location up to 5 km, TRN could recover from this situation, achieving navigation error reduction to a few hundred meters. It should be noted that in order to maintain crater feature correspondences, it is important to match the image resolution and the scales within the scene to the detector training set distribution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对未来月球自主着陆中的位置估计问题，提出一种结合深度学习陨石坑检测器与扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的地形相对导航（TRN）算法。检测器分析轨道单目图像中的陨石坑特征，通过匈牙利分配和一致性异常剔除与全球数据库匹配，估计值用于EKF中航天器的月心月固系（LCLF）位姿估计，并加入高度信息约束径向漂移。仿真表明，即使初始位置偏差达5公里，TRN也能将导航误差降低到几百米。
Motivation: 月球着陆自主车辆在稀疏地形特征的危险环境中需要精确位置估计，现有方法依赖稀疏地形特征导致定位困难。
Method: 设计针对NASA陨石坑检测挑战的深度学习检测器，提取轨道单目图像中的陨石坑，通过匈牙利分配和一致性异常剔除与全局数据库匹配，将测量值输入带高度辅助的扩展卡尔曼滤波进行位姿估计。
Result: 仿真中，即使航天器初始位置偏差达5公里，TRN也能从该情况恢复，将导航误差降低到几百米。
Conclusion: 闭环仿真验证了TRN的有效性，并强调保持陨石坑特征对应需要匹配图像分辨率与场景尺度到训练集分布。

papers.title: Improving Crash Frequency Prediction from Simulated Traffic Conflicts Using Machine Learning Based Microsimulation
papers.abstract_en: Traffic microsimulation combined with surrogate safety measures has increasingly been used as a proactive alternative to historical crash data for predicting crash frequency for current or planned road infrastructure designs. However, existing microsimulation-based safety studies have adopted simplified rule-based behaviour models, which reproduce traffic flow reasonably well but often fail to generate realistic conflict dynamics, limiting crash prediction accuracy. Recent advances in machine learning (ML)-based behaviour models offer a promising opportunity to potentially improve microsimulation realism and crash frequency predictions by learning human driving behaviour directly from large-scale trajectory datasets. To investigate this possibility, traffic microsimulation was conducted for five real-world signalised intersections in Leeds, UK, using both a standard rule-based model and a state-of-the-art ML model. Simulated vehicle trajectories were analysed using a two-dimensional Time-to-Collision metric to identify simulated conflicts, which were then modelled using Extreme Value Theory to predict crash frequency. Results show that conflicts from the ML model yielded crash predictions in line with the real-world crash data, whereas the rule-based model did not permit meaningful predictions, presumably due to a lack of model calibration to the specific simulated intersections. Directly using ML-generated simulated crashes to predict real-world crash frequency also yielded poor results, suggesting that while current ML models can realistically reproduce conflicts, they are not yet able to generate realistic crashes. Overall, the findings demonstrate that ML-based behaviour models are promising for improving crash prediction from simulated conflicts, without a need for location-specific model calibration, and suggest clear future directions for ML-based traffic microsimulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用基于机器学习的微观交通模拟行为模型来改进从模拟交通冲突预测碰撞频率的方法。在真实信号交叉口测试中，ML模型生成的冲突数据经极值理论建模后，碰撞预测与实际数据吻合，而规则模型因未校准无法产生有意义预测；但直接使用ML生成的模拟碰撞预测效果差。结果表明ML行为模型有潜力提高预测精度且无需位置特定校准。
Motivation: 现有微观模拟安全研究多采用简化规则模型，虽能重现交通流但难以生成真实冲突动态，导致碰撞预测精度有限。ML行为模型可从大规模轨迹数据学习人类驾驶行为，有望提升模拟真实性和碰撞预测。
Method: 对英国利兹五个真实信号交叉口，分别使用标准规则模型和最新ML行为模型进行交通微观模拟。利用二维碰撞时间指标识别模拟冲突，再通过极值理论建模预测碰撞频率，并与真实碰撞数据对比。
Result: ML模型冲突生成的碰撞预测与真实数据一致，而规则模型无法给出有意义预测；直接使用ML生成的模拟碰撞预测效果差。
Conclusion: ML行为模型在无位置特定校准下即可改善基于模拟冲突的碰撞预测，但当前ML模型尚不能生成真实碰撞，需进一步改进。

papers.title: Higher-Order Token Interactions via Quantum Attention
papers.abstract_en: Standard dot-product self-attention computes, in a single layer, only pairwise (order-2) interactions between tokens; representing a generic order-$k$ interaction is known to require either super-quadratic resources in one layer or composition across depth. We introduce \textbf{Quantum Higher-Order Attention (QHA)}, a shallow, hardware-realizable quantum attention head that, via data re-uploading and an all-to-all non-Clifford entangler, synthesizes order-$k$ token interactions inside the circuit and exposes them through a local single-qubit read-out. We prove (i) an expressivity separation: any single standard self-attention layer with embedding dimension $m$, $H$ heads and $p$-bit precision satisfying $mHp=o(N/\log\log N)$ cannot represent the order-$k$ correlation family that one QHA head represents with circuit depth $O(\log k)$ ($O(k)$ two-qubit gates); and (ii) a trainability guarantee for its local-design instantiation: with a local read-out and $O(\log n)$ depth the gradient variance is $Ω(1/\mathrm{poly}(n))$ (no barren plateau), which we confirm empirically -- while being explicit that the more expressive all-to-all instantiation we benchmark is trained empirically and shows exponentially decaying gradients. Empirically, at a $6.5\times$ smaller parameter budget, QHA generalizes hidden-subset parity of every order $k\le6$ from disjoint inputs, whereas the larger classical attention head collapses past order~2; consistent with theory, the size of the advantage tracks the target's Fourier degree - largest for parity and shrinking when low-order structure is present. As an application, QHA serves as a compact high-order interaction detector across three domains - genetic epistasis, learning-parity-with-noise, and graph triangle detection - reaching the noise ceiling at the smallest parameter budget where field-standard linear methods fail.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子高阶注意力 (QHA)，一种浅层、硬件可实现的量子注意力机制，通过数据重上传和全对全非克利福德纠缠器在电路中合成order-k token交互，并通过局部单量子比特读出暴露它们。理论上证明了与经典自注意力的表达性分离：标准自注意力层在参数受限时无法表示QHA一层表示的order-k相关族，而QHA深度为O(log k)或O(k)两比特门；同时证明了局部设计实例的可训练性保证（梯度方差Ω(1/poly(n))，无贫瘠高原），而全连接实例有指数衰减梯度。实验表明，QHA以6.5倍更少的参数泛化隐藏子集奇偶性至k≤6，而经典注意力在order2后失败；在遗传上位性、带噪声学习奇偶性和图三角检测任务中，QHA以最小参数预算达到噪声天花板。
Motivation: 标准点积自注意力每层仅计算pairwise（order-2）交互，而表示通用order-k交互在单层需要超二次资源或跨深度组合，限制了模型捕获高阶依赖的能力。
Method: 引入量子高阶注意力 (QHA)，利用数据重上传结构和非克利福德全对全纠缠器，在量子电路中生成所有order-k交互，并通过单量子比特局部读出提取信息；同时设计了两种实例化：局部设计（可训练性保证）和全连接（更高表达性）。

papers.title: Indexed Bellman Information Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We develop indexed Bellman information complexity, a representation-level theory of interactive decision making centered on information indices and reference histories. The representation strips away problem-specific syntax and retains only the ingredients needed for dynamic programming and information accounting, thereby unifying the earlier framework of indexed algorithmic information ratios (AIR). On the upper-bound side, regret is controlled by Bellman supersolutions or potential identities whose gradient bracket is paid for by indexed information. Upper-confidence-bound (UCB), estimation-to-decision/decision-estimation-coefficient (E2D/DEC), and adaptive-minimax-sampling or exploration-by-optimization (AMS/EBO) methods appear as three relaxations of this same identity. On the lower-bound side, the posterior-reference trajectory supplies both the information telescope and the ghost quantile of small-regret trajectories. The resulting critical radius in the lower bound is an effective-dimension-scale quantity, as in Fano and local-prior-mass lower bounds, rather than the constant radius of a two-point Le Cam argument. The examples show that DEC is best viewed as a one-step relaxation of indexed Bellman information complexity, not as a universally tight conversion mechanism. We illustrate the framework through several applications, with particular emphasis on kernel bandits. In this setting, the active action marginal provides a concrete basis for comparing UCB, E2D, and AMS/EBO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了索引贝尔曼信息复杂度，一种基于信息索引和参考历史的交互式决策表示级理论。该表示剥离了问题特定的语法，保留了动态规划和信息核算所需的要素，统一了先前的索引算法信息比（AIR）框架。上界方面，遗憾由贝尔曼超解或势恒等式控制，其梯度括号由索引信息支付；下界方面，后验参考轨迹提供了信息望远镜和小遗憾轨迹的幽灵分位数。示例表明DEC最好被视为索引贝尔曼信息复杂度的一步松弛，而非普遍紧的转换机制。
Motivation: 现有交互决策理论框架（如AIR）存在局限性，需要一种更统一的表示层理论，能够剥离问题特定语法并统一上界和下界分析方法。
Method: 提出索引贝尔曼信息复杂度，基于信息索引和参考历史，通过贝尔曼超解/势恒等式统一上界分析，通过后验参考轨迹建立下界。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称该方法统一了UCB、E2D/DEC、AMS/EBO等方法，下界临界半径是有效维数尺度量而非常数半径。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了统一的交互决策分析视角，DEC应视为一步松弛而非紧转换机制，并通过核bandit等应用展示了框架的效用。

papers.title: An adaptive framework for the axisymmetric pulsar magnetosphere using physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
papers.abstract_en: The pulsar magnetosphere has only recently been addressed using Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), by deploying a domain-decomposition approach and treating the separatrix and equatorial current sheet as infinitesimally thin discontinuities. However, this baseline requires extensive manual hyperparameter tuning, achieves limited final accuracy and demands several hours of training. We refine this framework by introducing domain-specific neural architectures based on Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, an automated adaptive training pipeline and a physics-based convergence criterion that eliminate the need for manual calibration. The proposed methodology delivers self-consistent axisymmetric magnetosphere solutions with mean squared errors of the PDE residuals at O(1e-6) in double precision - an improvement of two orders of magnitude over the baseline - while achieving convergence in under 20 minutes in single precision. Importantly, the method reliably resolves stellar radii reduced by up to 80% compared to the baseline, overcoming the severe spatial scale disparities that also challenge traditional solvers. Furthermore, by varying the flux that opens to infinity, we provide a correction to the equation that connects it to the equatorial T-point's position. The complete framework is released as the open-source library PulsarX.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）的自适应框架，用于求解轴对称脉冲星磁层。与传统的物理信息神经网络（PINN）相比，该方法通过自动化训练流程和物理收敛准则，避免了手动调参，将PDE残差均方误差降低至O(1e-6)（提升两个数量级），并在20分钟内收敛。此外，该方法能解析比基线小80%的恒星半径，并通过改变开放磁通对赤道T点位置方程进行了修正。
Motivation: 现有PINN方法求解脉冲星磁层需要大量手动超参数调优、精度有限且训练耗时。
Method: 引入基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的领域特定架构、自动化自适应训练管道和物理收敛准则，无需手动校准。
Result: 双精度下PDE残差均方误差达O(1e-6)，比基线提升两个数量级；单精度下20分钟内收敛；可解析半径减小80%的恒星尺度。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了自洽的轴对称磁层解，并开源为PulsarX库。

papers.title: Learning What to Remember: Observability-Safe Memory Retention via Constrained Optimization for Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents accumulate observations, reasoning traces, and retrieved facts exceeding context windows, making memory retention a fundamental resource-allocation problem. Existing systems treat retention as local and do not model long-term consequences under observability constraints. To fill this gap, we formulate memory retention as a constrained stochastic optimization with budget feasibility, evidence utility, and delayed costs including miss, reacquisition, and stale penalties. We show this multi-step problem is NP-hard, making exact solution intractable. Moreover, deployment decisions must be made under partial observability. To address these challenges, we propose OSL-MR (Observability-Safe Learning for Memory Retention), a learning-augmented framework that enforces a strict separation between online-observable features and offline-available supervision. OSL-MR combines an evidence learner trained from realized evidence with a Mixed-Score heuristic that serves as a deployable online-safe baseline and an inductive prior. The policy learns query-conditioned evidence from interaction data and remains deployable under the same constraints. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show OSL-MR outperforms recency-based, Generative Agents-style, and other heuristic baselines, especially under tight budgets. The Mixed-Score prior improves precision and recall, and sensitivity analysis shows robustness across cost settings. On small solvable instances, single-step optimization is insufficient to anticipate future demand shifts, while OSL-MR stays significantly closer to the dynamic-programming optimum, confirming the necessity of the sequential formulation and reinforcing our learning-guided approximation. These results establish constrained stochastic optimization and optimization-guided learning as a principled foundation for memory management in long-horizon agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长时域语言代理在观测约束下的记忆保留问题，将其形式化为带预算、证据效用和延迟代价的约束随机优化，证明为NP难，并提出OSL-MR框架，利用在线可观测特征与离线监督分离的学习方法，结合证据学习器和混合评分启发式策略。实验表明OSL-MR在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上优于多种基线，尤其在紧预算下表现突出。
Motivation: 现有系统将记忆保留视为局部问题，未考虑观测约束下的长期后果，导致长序列任务中信息过载或丢失。
Method: 提出OSL-MR框架，包含证据学习器（从交互数据中学习查询条件化的证据）和混合评分启发式（作为可部署的在线安全基线和归纳先验），强制分离在线可观测特征与离线监督，实现可部署的在线策略。
Result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval上，OSL-MR优于基于时效性、生成式智能体风格等基线，尤其在紧预算下；混合评分先验提高了精确率和召回率；敏感性分析表明成本设置鲁棒；在小规模可解实例上接近动态规划最优解。
Conclusion: 约束随机优化与优化引导学习为长时域代理的记忆管理提供了原则性基础，验证了序列建模的必要性。

papers.title: iSAGE: A Human-in-the-Loop Framework for Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation via Sparse Point Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation in remote sensing requires costly pixel-level annotations, and nearly every problem demands a new dataset since models rarely transfer across sensors, platforms, or geographies. Existing human-in-the-loop frameworks expand sparse clicks into dense supervision via auxiliary machinery (pseudo-labels, propagation, CRFs, foundation-model prompts, auxiliary heads), all operating on the model's predictive distribution. A confidently wrong pixel is indistinguishable from a confidently correct one in that distribution by construction, so no rule reading it can separate the two; the distinguishing signal is external to the model. This paper hypothesizes that expert clicks targeting confident model errors, not arbitrary pixels, suffice to match dense supervision, with no expansion machinery. iSAGE (Iterative Sparse Annotation Guided by Expert) realizes this hypothesis on an integrated open-source platform, where an error-weighted loss amplifies the gradient at each click and the annotation record itself is the dataset, extensible, correctable, and auditable. Experiments use a minimum-effort regime: at most one labeled pixel per class per frame. On BsB Aerial, iSAGE recovers 97.2% of dense supervision (74.79% mIoU on 0.040% of pixels) with contrasting class dynamics: amorphous classes (permeable areas) saturate from the seed, while small classes (cars) require late-iteration effort. On ISPRS Vaihingen (external benchmark), iSAGE reaches 76.78% mIoU with 0.011% of pixels, matching the dense baseline (76.65%) and exceeding all published methods. Under the same pipeline, four output-reading mechanisms (oracle entropy across budgets 1--100x, pseudo-labels across thresholds 0.90--0.99, CRF-based propagation, uniform random) plateau 7.4 to 14.5 pp below iSAGE. Across 31 surveyed methods, iSAGE is the only iterative human-in-the-loop framework operating without auxiliary machinery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 iSAGE 框架，通过专家点击模型错误区域而非任意像素，实现稀疏点监督下的遥感语义分割，无需辅助机制（如伪标签、CRF），在 BsB Aerial 和 ISPRS Vaihingen 数据集上接近全监督性能。
Motivation: 遥感语义分割需要大量像素级标注，现有人类在环框架依赖辅助机制扩展稀疏点击，但无法区分模型自信的错误与正确预测。
Method: iSAGE 采用迭代稀疏标注，专家仅标注模型高置信度错误的像素，使用错误加权损失放大梯度，并以标注记录作为数据集。
Result: 在 BsB Aerial 上以 0.040% 像素达到 74.79% mIoU（全监督的 97.2%）；在 ISPRS Vaihingen 上以 0.011% 像素达到 76.78% mIoU，超越全监督基线（76.65%）及所有已发表方法。
Conclusion: 专家点击自信错误像素可替代全监督，无需任何辅助扩展机制；iSAGE 是唯一不含辅助机制的迭代人类在环框架。

papers.title: Learning Geometric Representations from Videos for Spatial Intelligent Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at 2D semantic understanding but lack intrinsic 3D awareness, resulting in representations that fail to maintain geometric and spatial consistency across video frames. Given the scarcity of large-scale 3D data, we present GeoVR, a novel framework that learns geometric representations using purely 2D video sequences. This approach effectively restructures the semantic latent space within MLLMs to unlock spatial intelligence. Rather than employing superficial feature mixing, GeoVR reshapes the internal representations of the MLLM by distilling geometry knowledge from pre-trained 3D foundation models. This is accomplished through a multi-objective learning strategy driven by four complementary geometric targets: (1) estimating inter-frame camera poses to embed varying viewpoint dynamics, (2) regressing dense depth maps to anchor physical distances, (3) predicting a metric scale factor for real-world calibration, and (4) distilling multi-scale 3D features to align the intermediate feature space. Guided by these explicit physical and geometric constraints, the model's internal representations naturally develop strong 3D awareness. Extensive experiments on spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that GeoVR achieves state-of-the-art performance, establishing a new paradigm for endowing foundation models with spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GeoVR框架，通过纯2D视频序列学习几何表示，以赋予多模态大语言模型(MLLM)3D空间智能。方法利用四项几何目标（帧间相机姿态估计、密集深度回归、度量比例因子预测、多尺度3D特征蒸馏）从预训练3D基础模型中蒸馏知识，重塑MLLM内部表示。在空间推理基准上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有MLLM擅长2D语义理解但缺乏3D空间一致性，而大规模3D数据稀缺。
Method: GeoVR通过多目标学习策略，从2D视频中蒸馏预训练3D基础模型的几何知识，包括相机姿态、深度图、度量尺度和多尺度3D特征。
Result: 在空间推理基准上取得最先进性能，证明该方法能有效赋予基础模型空间智能。
Conclusion: GeoVR为赋予基础模型3D空间智能提供了新范式，且仅需2D视频输入。
