papers.title: Global Ease of Living Index: a machine learning framework for longitudinal analysis of major economies
papers.abstract_en: The drastic changes in the global economy, geopolitical conditions, and disruptions such as the COVID-19 pandemic have impacted the cost of living and quality of life. It is essential to comprehend the long-term implications of the cost of living and quality of life in major economies. A transparent and comprehensive living index must include multiple dimensions of living conditions. In this study, we present an approach to quantifying the quality of life through the Global Ease of Living Index that combines various socio-economic and infrastructural factors into a single composite score. Our index utilises economic indicators that define living standards, which could help in targeted interventions to improve specific areas. We present a machine learning framework to address missing data for certain economic indicators in specific countries. We then curate and update the data and use a dimensionality reduction approach (Principal Component Analysis and Factor Analysis) to create the Ease of Living Index for major economies since 1970. Our work significantly adds to the literature by offering a practical tool for policymakers to identify areas needing improvement, such as healthcare systems, employment opportunities, and public safety. Our approach with open data and code can be easily reproduced and applied to various contexts, providing transparency and accessibility for ongoing research and policy development in quality-of-life assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个机器学习框架，通过主成分分析和因子分析等降维方法，整合多种社会经济和基础设施指标，构建全球生活便利指数（Global Ease of Living Index），用于衡量主要经济体自1970年以来的生活质量，并处理缺失数据问题。
Motivation: 全球经济、地缘政治和疫情等变化严重影响生活成本与质量，需要一个透明、综合的指数来量化生活质量，帮助政策制定者识别需要改进的领域。
Method: 采用机器学习框架处理缺失数据，运用主成分分析和因子分析降维，将社会经济和基础设施指标融合为单一综合得分，构建生活便利指数。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但指出该方法为政策制定者提供了实用工具，可识别医疗、就业、公共安全等领域的改进需求，并强调其可复现性和透明性。
Conclusion: 该框架通过开放数据和代码，为生活质量评估的持续研究和政策发展提供了可推广、透明的工具。

papers.title: Adversarial Dependence Minimization
papers.abstract_en: Minimally redundant representations are typically learned by minimizing feature covariance. However, covariance-based methods fail to eliminate all dependencies/redundancies, as linearly uncorrelated variables can still exhibit nonlinear relationships. To address this, we introduce ADM, a differentiable algorithm that minimizes statistical dependence between feature dimensions through an adversarial game: auxiliary networks identify dependencies, while the encoder removes them. We prove that mutual independence is achieved at the global optimum, empirically verify convergence, and study three potential applications: extending PCA to nonlinear decorrelation, improving generalization in image classification, and preventing dimensional collapse in self-supervised learning. By promoting statistically independent representations, ADM paves the way for learning more robust, compressed, and generalizable representations across diverse applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ADM，一种通过对抗性游戏最小化特征维度间统计依赖性的可微分算法。理论上证明全局最优时达到相互独立，实验验证收敛性，并应用于非线性去相关PCA、图像分类泛化改进和自监督学习中防止维度坍缩。
Motivation: 现有基于协方差的最小冗余表示方法无法消除非线性依赖，因为线性无关变量仍可能存在非线性关系。需要一种能消除所有冗余的表示学习方法。
Method: 提出ADM（Adversarial Dependence Minimization），通过辅助网络识别依赖关系，编码器移除依赖，形成对抗性游戏。算法可微分，理论证明全局最优可实现相互独立。
Result: 经验上验证了收敛性；在三个应用中展示效果：扩展PCA到非线性去相关、提高图像分类泛化、防止自监督学习中的维度坍缩。
Conclusion: ADM通过学习统计独立的表示，为学习更鲁棒、压缩和可泛化的表示铺平了道路，适用于多种应用。

papers.title: UniMM: A Unified Mixture Model Framework for Multi-Agent Simulation
papers.abstract_en: Simulation plays a crucial role in assessing autonomous driving systems, where the generation of realistic multi-agent behaviors is a key aspect. In multi-agent simulation, the primary challenges include behavioral multimodality and closed-loop distributional shifts. In this study, we formulate a unified mixture model (UniMM) framework for generating multimodal agent behaviors, which can cover the mainstream methods including regression-based mixture models and discrete NTP models. Furthermore, we introduce a closed-loop sample generation approach tailored for mixture models to mitigate distributional shifts. Within the UniMM framework, we recognize critical configurations from both the model and data perspectives. We conduct a systematic examination of various model configurations, and comprehensively characterize their effects. Moreover, our investigation into the data configuration highlights the pivotal role of closed-loop samples in achieving realistic simulations. To extend the benefits of closed-loop samples across a broader range of mixture models, we further introduce a temporal disentanglement-and-alignment mechanism to address the shortcut learning and off-policy learning issues. Leveraging insights from our exploration, the distinct variants proposed within the UniMM framework, including discrete, anchor-free, and anchor-based models, all achieve state-of-the-art performance on the WOSAC benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted author manuscript. The version of record has been published in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence, Early Access, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniMM统一混合模型框架，用于生成多模态智能体行为，解决自动驾驶仿真中的行为多模态和闭环分布偏移问题。通过系统研究模型与数据配置，引入闭环样本生成和时序解耦对齐机制，提出的离散、无锚点和有锚点变体均在WOSAC基准上达到最优性能。
Motivation: 多智能体仿真面临行为多模态和闭环分布偏移两大挑战，现有方法难以同时处理。
Method: 构建统一混合模型框架UniMM，涵盖回归混合模型和离散NTP模型；提出针对混合模型的闭环样本生成方法，并引入时序解耦对齐机制解决捷径学习和离策略学习问题。
Result: 在WOSAC基准上，UniMM框架下的多个变体（离散、无锚点、有锚点）均达到最优性能。
Conclusion: 模型配置和数据配置的系统研究表明闭环样本对逼真仿真至关重要，时序解耦对齐机制可推广闭环样本收益至更多混合模型。

papers.title: Hierarchical mutual distillation for multi-view fusion: Learning from all possible view combinations
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view learning often struggles to effectively leverage images captured from diverse angles and locations. Learning methods for unstructured multi-view images remain largely underexplored. We propose a novel Hierarchical Mutual Distillation for Multi-View Fusion (HMDMV) method, which can handle both structured and unstructured multi-view scenarios. It makes predictions utilizing all possible view combinations: single view, partial multi-view, and full multi-view. The method generates predictions for each view combination and then applies hierarchical mutual distillation to enhance inter-view consistency. An uncertainty-based weighting mechanism further refines the fusion process by adjusting the influence of each view combination according to its prediction confidence, reducing the impact of low-confidence views. Extensive experiments on large-scale structured and unstructured datasets demonstrate that HMDMV consistently achieves state-of-the-art classification accuracy. Another unique advantage of HMDMV is that it provides improved flexibility in inference, allowing for more or fewer view counts in inference than those used in training without additional processing. We also provide a light version with reduced training cost by designing an efficient strategy that randomly samples subsets of view combinations during each training iteration. These results highlight HMDMV's robustness in real-world settings where view availability is variable or incomplete. The code is available at https://github.com/labhai/HMDMV.

TL;DR: 本文提出层次互蒸馏多视角融合方法，能够处理结构化和非结构化多视角图像，利用所有可能的视角组合（单视角、部分多视角、全多视角）进行预测，并通过层次互蒸馏增强视角间一致性，不确定性加权机制减少低置信度视角的影响。在大型结构化和非结构化数据集上达到最优分类精度，且推理时支持比训练时更多或更少的视角数，无需额外处理。
Motivation: 多视角学习通常依赖固定结构的多视角数据，对非结构化多视角图像（如来自不同角度和位置的无序图像）的学习方法探索不足，缺乏灵活处理可变视角数目的融合框架。
Method: 提出HMDMV方法：1) 对所有可能的视角组合（单视角、部分多视角、全多视角）分别生成预测；2) 通过层次互蒸馏在视角组合间传递知识，增强一致性；3) 基于预测置信度的不确定性加权机制调整各组合的融合权重；4) 提供轻量版本，通过随机采样视角子集降低训练成本。
Result: 在大型结构化和非结构化数据集上，HMDMV consistently 达到最先进分类准确率。推理时支持可变视角数，无需额外训练或调整。
Conclusion: HMDMV在处理视角数量可变或不完整的真实场景中表现出鲁棒性，并为多视角融合提供了灵活高效的框架。

papers.title: 3D Vessel Reconstruction from Sparse-View Dynamic DSA Images via Vessel Probability Guided Attenuation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Digital Subtraction Angiography (DSA) is one of the gold standards for vascular disease diagnosis. With the help of a contrast agent, time-resolved 2D DSA images deliver comprehensive blood flow information and can be utilized to reconstruct 3D vessel structures for medical assessment. Current commercial DSA systems typically require hundreds of scanning views to perform reconstruction, resulting in substantial radiation exposure. In this study, we propose a neural rendering-based optimization framework tailored for high-quality sparse-view DSA reconstruction to reduce radiation dosage. Our approach, termed vessel probability guided attenuation learning, represents DSA imaging as a complementary weighted combination of static and dynamic attenuation fields, with the weights derived from the time-independent vessel probability field. Functioning as a foreground mask, vessel probability provides proper gradients for both static and dynamic fields adaptive to different scene types. This mechanism enables self-supervised decomposition between static backgrounds and dynamic contrast agent flow, and significantly improves reconstruction quality. Our model is trained by minimizing the discrepancy between synthesized projections and real captured DSA images. We further employ two training strategies to improve reconstruction quality: (1) coarse-to-fine progressive training for better geometry and (2) temporal perturbed rendering loss for temporal consistency. Experimental results have demonstrated high-quality 3D vessel reconstruction and 2D DSA image synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经渲染的稀疏视图DSA重建框架，通过血管概率引导衰减学习实现高质量3D血管重建。该方法将DSA成像表示为静态与动态衰减场的加权组合，权重由时间无关的血管概率场导出，实现自监督分解。实验证明该方法能有效降低辐射剂量并保持重建质量。
Motivation: 现有商用DSA系统需数百个扫描视角进行重建，导致患者辐射暴露过大。本文旨在通过稀疏视图重建减少辐射剂量。
Method: 提出血管概率引导衰减学习框架，将DSA成像建模为静态和动态衰减场的互补加权组合，权重由时间无关的血管概率场提供。采用粗到细渐进训练和时域扰动渲染损失提升几何一致性与时间连续性。
Result: 实验结果表明该方法能够实现高质量的3D血管重建和2D DSA图像合成，验证了稀疏视图下的重建可行性。
Conclusion: 本文方法可在显著减少扫描视角条件下保持重建质量，有望降低DSA检查中的辐射剂量。

papers.title: Benign overfitting beyond prediction: The ordinary least squares interpolator
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in deep learning have highlighted the phenomenon of benign overfitting in overparameterized statistical models, sparking significant interest in understanding its foundations. Owing to its simplicity and practical relevance, the ordinary least squares (OLS) interpolator has become a key object of study for gaining theoretical insight into this phenomenon. While the properties of OLS are well understood in classical underparameterized settings, its behavior in the overparameterized regime -- unlike that of ridge regression or the lasso -- remains comparatively less explored. We contribute to this growing literature by deriving new algebraic and statistical results for the minimum $\ell_2$-norm OLS interpolator. In contrast to much of the existing work, which focuses on prediction risk, we center our analysis on parameter estimation and inference, which are fundamental for many statistics and causal inference applications. Specifically, we establish overparameterized analogues of (i) the leave-$k$-out formulas, (ii) the omitted variable bias formula, and (iii) the Frisch-Waugh-Lovell theorem. Under the Gauss-Markov model, we further extend the Gauss-Markov theorem and analyze variance estimation under homoskedasticity in the overparameterized setting. Collectively, these results provide a systematic framework for studying parameter estimation and inference in overparameterized linear models, offering a novel perspective on benign overfitting beyond its implications for prediction.
papers.comment: This work is accepted for publication in Biometrika
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究过参数化线性模型中最小二乘（OLS）插值器的代数与统计性质，推导了留k法、遗漏变量偏误公式和Frisch-Waugh-Lovell定理的过参数化版本，并扩展了高斯-马尔可夫定理。该工作从参数估计与推断视角理解良性过拟合，补充了现有主要关注预测风险的研究。
Motivation: 现有良性过拟合研究多集中于预测风险，而参数估计与推断在统计和因果推断应用中同样重要，但过参数化OLS在此方面的性质尚未被充分探索。
Method: 针对最小ℓ₂范数OLS插值器，推导其留k法、遗漏变量偏误公式和Frisch-Waugh-Lovell定理的过参数化版本，并在高斯-马尔可夫模型下分析方差估计。
Result: 建立了过参数化线性模型中参数估计与推断的系统性框架，为良性过拟合提供了超越预测风险的新视角。
Conclusion: 这些结果有助于理解过参数化OLS的统计推断性质，但仅适用于线性模型，且需同方差假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: IdealGPT: Iteratively Decomposing Vision and Language Reasoning via Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The field of vision-and-language (VL) understanding has made unprecedented progress with end-to-end large pre-trained VL models (VLMs). However, they still fall short in zero-shot reasoning tasks that require multi-step inferencing. To achieve this goal, previous works resort to a divide-and-conquer pipeline. In this paper, we argue that previous efforts have several inherent shortcomings: 1) They rely on domain-specific sub-question decomposing models. 2) They force models to predict the final answer even if the sub-questions or sub-answers provide insufficient information. We address these limitations via IdealGPT, a framework that iteratively decomposes VL reasoning using large language models (LLMs). Specifically, IdealGPT utilizes an LLM to generate sub-questions, a VLM to provide corresponding sub-answers, and another LLM to reason to achieve the final answer. These three modules perform the divide-and-conquer procedure iteratively until the model is confident about the final answer to the main question. We evaluate IdealGPT on multiple challenging VL reasoning tasks under a zero-shot setting. In particular, our IdealGPT outperforms the best existing GPT-4-like models by an absolute 10% on VCR and 15% on SNLI-VE. Code is available at https://github.com/Hxyou/IdealGPT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IdealGPT框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）迭代地将视觉-语言推理问题分解为子问题，由视觉-语言模型（VLM）回答子问题，再由LLM综合推理得出最终答案。在零样本设置下，IdealGPT在VCR和SNLI-VE基准上分别比现有GPT-4类模型绝对提升10%和15%。
Motivation: 现有端到端视觉-语言模型在多步推理的零样本任务中表现不足，而之前的分治方法依赖领域特定的子问题分解模型，且可能因子问题或子答案信息不足而强制预测最终答案。
Method: IdealGPT采用迭代的分治流程：一个LLM生成子问题，一个VLM提供子答案，另一个LLM推理并决定是否继续分解或给出最终答案，直至模型对主问题答案有信心。
Result: 在VCR和SNLI-VE零样本推理任务上，IdealGPT分别比最佳GPT-4类模型绝对提升10%和15%。
Conclusion: 通过LLM驱动的迭代分解，IdealGPT克服了先前分治方法中的两个关键缺陷，显著提升了零样本视觉-语言推理性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Group-Sparse Matrix Factorization for Transfer Learning of Word Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Unstructured text provides decision-makers with a rich data source in many domains, ranging from product reviews in retail to nursing notes in healthcare. To leverage this information, words are typically translated into word embeddings -- vectors that encode the semantic relationships between words -- through unsupervised learning algorithms such as matrix factorization. However, learning word embeddings from new domains with limited training data can be challenging, because the meaning/usage may be different in the new domain, e.g., the word ``positive'' typically has positive sentiment, but often has negative sentiment in medical notes since it may imply that a patient tested positive for a disease. In practice, we expect that only a small number of domain-specific words may have new meanings. We propose an intuitive two-stage estimator that exploits this structure via a group-sparse penalty to efficiently transfer learn domain-specific word embeddings by combining large-scale text corpora (such as Wikipedia) with limited domain-specific text data. We bound the generalization error of our transfer learning estimator, proving that it can achieve high accuracy with substantially less domain-specific data when only a small number of embeddings are altered between domains. Furthermore, we prove that all local minima identified by our nonconvex objective function are statistically indistinguishable from the global minimum under standard regularization conditions, implying that our estimator can be computed efficiently. Our results provide the first bounds on group-sparse matrix factorization, which may be of independent interest. We empirically evaluate our approach compared to state-of-the-art fine-tuning heuristics from natural language processing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于组稀疏惩罚的两阶段估计器，用于迁移学习领域特定的词嵌入，通过结合大规模通用语料（如维基百科）和有限的领域特定文本数据，高效学习新领域的词嵌入。理论上证明了泛化误差界和非凸目标函数的局部最优解与全局最优解在正则化条件下的统计等价性。实验在NLP任务上与现有微调方法进行了对比。
Motivation: 从新领域有限训练数据学习词嵌入具有挑战性，因为词汇在新领域中的含义可能发生变化（如“positive”在医疗记录中常含负面含义）。现有方法需要大量领域数据，而实际中仅有少数领域特定词汇含义改变。
Method: 提出两阶段估计器：第一阶段利用大规模通用语料学习基础词嵌入；第二阶段通过组稀疏惩罚（group-sparse penalty）对基础嵌入进行稀疏更新，仅允许少数词汇的嵌入发生显著变化，从而高效迁移学习。
Result: 理论分析表明，当只有少量嵌入在域间变化时，该方法能以显著更少的领域数据达到高精度；且非凸目标的所有局部最优解与全局最优解统计不可区分。实验对比了NLP中的最优微调方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 该方法为词嵌入的迁移学习提供了理论保证，并且组稀疏矩阵分解的界可能具有独立研究价值。适用于仅有少量领域特定词汇偏离通用语义的场景。

papers.title: Cinematic Compositing Using Character-Environment-Harmonized Video Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: Cinematic compositing aims to integrate green-screen characters into novel environments while maintaining physical and photometric realism. Previous methods often fail to capture the complex bidirectional interactions between characters and their surroundings, which we characterize as Character-to-Environment (C2E) physical interaction and Environment-to-Character (E2C) lighting harmonization. To address this, we propose an end-to-end video diffusion framework that jointly models C2E and E2C interactions, specifically handling the challenges of interactive props. Our approach introduces a tri-mask-guided architecture with RGB-D joint denoising to ensure physically consistent interactions among the character, props, and environment. We further develop an efficient prior-driven data curation pipeline to construct high-quality relighting pairs without expensive rendering. Finally, a reference-conditioned mechanism enables controllable environment synthesis and precise prop replacement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms existing methods in cinematic-quality dynamic video compositing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端的视频扩散框架，用于电影级合成，将绿幕角色与新颖环境融合，同时处理角色到环境（C2E）的物理交互和环境到角色（E2C）的光照和谐化。方法采用三掩膜引导架构和RGB-D联合去噪，以及先验驱动的数据整理流程和参考条件机制。实验表明在动态视频合成中显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法未能捕获角色与环境之间的复杂双向交互（C2E物理交互和E2C光照和谐化），导致合成缺乏物理和光度真实性。
Method: 提出一个端到端视频扩散框架，包含三掩膜引导架构和RGB-D联合去噪，用于保证角色、道具和环境的物理一致交互。还开发了先验驱动的数据整理管道以生成高质量重光照对，以及参考条件机制用于可控环境合成和精确道具替换。
Result: 摘要称该方法在电影级动态视频合成中显著优于现有方法（未给出具体数值）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能有效处理交互道具等挑战，实现电影质量的合成。

papers.title: Denoising Implicit Feedback for Cold-start Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Implicit feedback is widely used in recommender systems due to its accessibility and generality, yet it usually presents noisy samples (e.g., clickbait, position bias). Meanwhile, recommenders inevitably face the item cold-start problem due to the continuous influx of new items. We identify that cold items are more prone to noisy samples due to the aforementioned factors, and researchers often overlook the significance of denoising implicit feedback for cold items. Previous denoising studies usually identify noisy samples based on heuristic patterns, such as higher loss values, and mitigate noise through sample selection or re-weighting. However, these methods have limited adaptability and are ineffective in cold-start scenarios. To achieve denoising implicit feedback for cold-start recommendation, we propose a model-agnostic denoising method called DIF. First, user preferences for content remain stable, which allows us to infer pseudo-labels indicating whether a user is interested in a cold item through content-similar warm items. Furthermore, to improve pseudo-label accuracy, we model the confidence of pseudo-labels based on the content similarity between the cold item and warm items, and then aggregate multiple pseudo-labels for each sample. Finally, we explicitly estimate the uncertainty of the noisy sample label by considering its relative entropy and the cold-start status of the item, which adaptively guides the role of pseudo-labels to correct the noisy labels at the sample level. DIF's superiority is supported by both theoretical justification and extensive experiments on real-world datasets. The method has been deployed on a billion-user scale short video application Kuaishou and has significantly improved various commercial metrics within cold-start scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冷启动推荐中隐式反馈存在的噪声问题（如点击诱饵、位置偏差），提出一种模型无关的去噪方法DIF。该方法利用用户对内容偏好的稳定性，通过内容相似的warm item为冷物品生成伪标签，并基于内容相似度建模伪标签置信度，再通过相对熵和冷启动状态估计样本级不确定性来自适应修正噪声标签。理论分析和实验证明其有效性，已在快手亿级用户规模上部署并提升冷启动场景的商业指标。
Motivation: 冷物品由于数据稀疏更容易受隐式反馈噪声影响，而现有去噪方法基于启发式模式（如高损失值）识别噪声，在冷启动场景下适应性差且效果不佳。
Method: 提出DIF方法：首先利用用户稳定偏好，通过内容相似的warm物品为冷物品推断伪标签；然后基于内容相似度建模伪标签置信度并聚合多个伪标签；最后通过相对熵和物品冷启动状态显式估计样本标签的不确定性，自适应地利用伪标签修正噪声标签。
Result: 在真实数据集和快手亿级用户规模短视频应用中，DIF在冷启动场景下显著提升了多项商业指标。
Conclusion: DIF是一种有效的模型无关去噪方法，尤其适用于冷启动推荐，具有理论保证和实际工业价值。

papers.title: DF-ExpEnse: Diffusion Filtered Exploration for Sample Efficient Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: A natural recipe for intelligent robotic decision-making is initializing from pretrained generative control policies, which have summarized offline experience, and adapting them to self-collected online experience. We present DF-ExpEnse, an exploration technique that improves the quality of online experience collection, thus increasing finetuning sample-efficiency. DF-ExpEnse leverages the multimodal modeling capabilities of the generative control policy to create an expressive and tractably evaluatable candidate set. It then utilizes an ensemble of critics to identify the action that best balances quality with high exploration interest. In fleet settings, DF-ExpEnse further enables cross-agent communication to facilitate collaborative exploration as a group. DF-ExpEnse can be seamlessly integrated with existing strategies that finetune pretrained generative control policies via reinforcement learning. We experimentally validate consistent sample-efficiency benefits through DF-ExpEnse across a variety of manipulation and locomotion tasks, compared to default finetuning and alternative action selection schemes. Project can be found at https://df-expense.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DF-ExpEnse，一种用于微调预训练生成控制策略的探索技术，通过扩散模型生成候选动作并使用评论家集成选择高探索兴趣的动作，在多种操作和 locomotion 任务上提升了样本效率。
Motivation: 利用预训练生成控制策略进行在线微调时，收集高质量在线经验是样本效率的关键，现有方法在探索多样性和效率方面有局限。
Method: DF-ExpEnse 利用生成控制策略的多模态建模能力生成可评估的候选动作集，然后使用评论家集成选择平衡质量与探索兴趣的动作，并在多智能体场景中实现跨 agent 通信协作探索。
Result: 在多种操作和 locomotion 任务上，与默认微调和其他动作选择方案相比，DF-ExpEnse 一致提升了样本效率。
Conclusion: DF-ExpEnse 可无缝集成现有策略微调方法，提高样本效率，并在多机器人场景中支持协作探索。

papers.title: Convex training of Lipschitz-regularized shallow neural networks
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we introduce a training procedure for shallow neural networks that promotes robustness against adversarial attacks. We solve a non-convex Lipschitz-regularized training program by introducing a convex restriction that can be efficiently solved to global optimality. Our approach can be employed as a post-processing step by taking a pre-trained network as an initial solution to then solving the convex program whose optimal network is guaranteed to be no worse than the initial one. We illustrate the improvements of our training procedure with experiments using real world datasets for regression tasks under an adversarial setting. We show numerically that solving our proposed convex program yields networks with lower objective values on the Lipschitz-regularized program compared to existing methods. Additionally, we show that on certain datasets, networks obtained using our convex training program are both more accurate and robust with respect to adversarial attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对浅层神经网络的对抗鲁棒性，提出一种通过引入凸限制（convex restriction）来求解非凸Lipschitz正则化训练程序的方法，可得到全局最优解并作为后处理步骤提升预训练网络。在真实数据集上的回归实验表明，该方法相比现有方法在Lipschitz正则化目标上取得更低值，并在某些数据集上同时提高准确性和鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有神经网络在对抗攻击下缺乏鲁棒性，而训练Lipschitz正则化网络虽能提升鲁棒性，但非凸优化难以保证全局最优。
Method: 将非凸的Lipschitz正则化训练程序通过引入凸限制转化为可高效求解全局最优的凸程序，并允许以预训练网络作为初始解进行后处理。
Result: 在真实数据集上的回归任务中，凸训练程序得到的网络在Lipschitz正则化目标上数值更低，且在某些数据集上同时提升准确性和对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 提出的凸训练方法能为浅层神经网络提供更优的Lipschitz正则化解，兼顾准确性与鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BrainG3N: A Dual-Purpose Tokenizer for Controllable 3D Brain MRI Generation
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional (3D) brain MRI is central to clinical neurology and neuro-oncology, where generative models could augment under-represented cohorts, simulate disease trajectories, and support privacy-preserving data sharing. Latent diffusion has been the go-to solution for modeling imaging data, but it places two competing demands on the tokenizer: encoder embeddings must retain the clinical information that downstream tasks act on, and the decoder must reconstruct anatomically faithful volumes. Existing reconstruction-driven tokenizers achieve the second at the expense of the first. To address this, we introduce a fully volumetric masked-autoencoder (MAE) based tokenizer for 3D brain MRI latent diffusion, decoupling encoder and decoder: a frozen 3D MAE encoder produces clinically informative embeddings, while a dedicated CNN decoder reconstructs voxels from a linear projection of those embeddings. We pretrain the encoder on 35,309 volumes from 18 public cohorts spanning four modalities, ten disease categories, and 200+ acquisition sites, and demonstrate its dual utility in two settings. First, on a 23-task linear-probing benchmark, the encoder outperforms or matches SOTA models (i.e., BrainIAC, BrainSegFounder, and MedicalNet) on 21 of 23 tasks. Second, a conditional diffusion transformer (DiT) trained on these clinically informative embeddings supports both conditional generation across six variables and patient-specific longitudinal forecasting. Together these results establish a single 3D brain-MRI embedding space capable of both downstream clinical tasks and controllable generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于可控3D脑MRI生成的联合分词器BrainG3N，基于掩码自编码器（MAE）将编码器与解码器解耦：冻结的3D MAE编码器产生临床信息丰富的嵌入，专用CNN解码器重建体素。在18个公共队列、35,309个体积上预训练，编码器在23项线性探测任务中21项优于或匹配SOTA，且条件扩散Transformer（DiT）支持跨六变量的条件生成和患者特定纵向预测。
Motivation: 现有潜在扩散模型对分词器的要求互相矛盾：编码器需保留临床信息，解码器需高保真重建，而基于重建的分词器往往牺牲前者。本文旨在解决这一权衡。
Method: 提出全容积掩码自编码器（MAE）分词器，解耦编码器和解码器：冻结的3D MAE编码器生成临床嵌入，CNN解码器从嵌入的线性投影重建体素。条件扩散Transformer（DiT）基于该嵌入进行可控生成。
Result: 在23项线性探测基准上，编码器在21项任务中优于或匹配BrainIAC、BrainSegFounder和MedicalNet等SOTA模型。条件DiT支持跨六个变量的生成和患者特定纵向预测。
Conclusion: 单一的3D脑MRI嵌入空间可同时支持下游临床任务和可控生成，展示了双用途分词器的有效性。

papers.title: SAFE-Cascade: Cost-Adaptive Vision-Language Routing for Chart Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are powerful for chart question answering, but invoking a VLM for every query can be unnecessarily expensive when many questions are answerable from OCR text and lightweight language reasoning. We demonstrate SAFE-Cascade, an interactive system for cost-adaptive chart question answering. Given a chart image and a natural-language question, SAFE-Cascade first extracts chart text with OCR, obtains a provisional answer from a text-only language model, and then uses a learned router to decide whether to accept the text answer or escalate to a VLM. The demo exposes this decision process to users: OCR evidence, text-only answer, routing probability, escalation decision, final answer, estimated cost, and estimated latency are shown side by side. SAFE-Cascade is designed as a transparent interface for understanding when visual grounding is actually needed. Users can upload or select charts, ask questions, inspect the evidence used by each pathway, compare text-only and VLM answers, and adjust the escalation threshold to explore the accuracy-cost frontier. The system is implemented with Azure Document Intelligence for OCR, gpt-5-mini as the text-only model, gemini-2.5-flash-image as the VLM, and a Random Forest router trained on inference-time features. On a held-out ChartQA test split of 375 examples from a 2,500-example experiment, SAFE-Cascade achieves 69.1% unified accuracy with 73.1% VLM invocation, compared with 67.7% accuracy and 100% VLM invocation for the full-VLM baseline. The observed +1.4 percentage-point difference is statistically uncertain, so we interpret SAFE-Cascade as matching full-VLM performance while reducing VLM calls by 26.9% and estimated cost by 9.3%. The demonstration shows how selective modality routing can make multimodal knowledge systems more transparent, tunable, and cost-aware.
papers.comment: Demo paper submitted at CIKM 2026. 4 pages, 2 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SAFE-Cascade是一个成本自适应的视觉-语言路由系统，用于图表问答。它先通过OCR提取图表文本，用纯文本语言模型获得初步答案，再由学习路由器决定是否升级到VLM。在ChartQA测试集上，该系统以73.1%的VLM调用率达到69.1%的准确率，与全VLM基线（100%调用、67.7%准确率）性能相当，同时减少26.9%的VLM调用和9.3%的成本。
Motivation: 每次查询都调用VLM成本高昂，而许多图表问题仅通过OCR和文本推理即可回答，因此需要一种成本自适应的方法来区分哪些问题需要视觉理解。
Method: 系统流水线包括OCR提取文本、纯文本语言模型生成临时答案、基于随机森林的路由器（使用推理时特征）决定是否采纳文本答案或升级到VLM。用户可交互调整升级阈值以平衡准确率和成本。
Result: 在375个样本的ChartQA测试集上，SAFE-Cascade达到69.1%准确率（全VLM基线为67.7%），VLM调用率降低26.9%，估计成本降低9.3%。但准确率差异在统计上不显著，因此视为匹配全VLM性能。
Conclusion: 选择性模态路由可使多模态知识系统更透明、可调且成本感知，但需要进一步验证统计显著性和更大规模实验。

papers.title: Variational Consensus Monte Carlo for Bayesian Mixture
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the privacy, sensitivity and sharing limitations of health data, we present a comprehensive pipeline for inference of Bayesian mixture models within a federated learning setting, i.e. when data cannot be fully shared or pooled across compute nodes. We adopt a Consensus Monte Carlo (CMC) approach, in which an MCMC algorithm is run independently within each data silo to estimate local posterior distributions, which are then aggregated to approximate the posterior over the full data. The variational CMC approach of Rabinovich, Angelino and Jordan (2015) [1] frames the aggregation step as a variational inference problem, but their application to mixtures assumes the number of clusters and key mixture parameters to be known. Our main methodological contributions are: (i) an extension of variational CMC to over-fitted Bayesian mixture models that infer the number of clusters and all model parameters, without requiring conjugacy; (ii) novel cluster-matching algorithms suitable for cross-silo settings in which not every cluster appears in each local dataset; (iii) a number of inference strategies for the aggregation step, matched to different federated learning constraints; and (iv) guidelines for choosing among these in practice. A comprehensive simulation study validates the framework and allows us to compare to state-of-the-art federated learning alternatives. Notably, we show that when the composition of local datasets reflects the underlying clustering structure in the data, our approach can recover small clusters with greater accuracy than standard MCMC applied to the pooled data. We illustrate the framework on large-scale electronic health record data, identifying multi-morbidity patterns in a British geriatric population.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对联邦学习场景下贝叶斯混合模型推断的变分共识蒙特卡洛（Variational Consensus Monte Carlo）框架，允许各数据节点独立运行MCMC后聚合局部后验，并扩展至过拟合混合模型以自动推断簇数。通过仿真和英国老年电子健康记录数据验证了方法在保护隐私的同时恢复小簇的能力。
Motivation: 健康数据的隐私、敏感性和共享限制使得传统数据池化不可行，现有共识蒙特卡洛方法在混合模型应用中假设簇数和参数已知，无法处理实际中未知簇结构的情形。
Method: 扩展变分CMC至过拟合贝叶斯混合模型（无需共轭），提出适用于跨数据节点簇不匹配情况的新型簇匹配算法，并针对不同联邦学习约束设计多种聚合推断策略及选择指南。
Result: 仿真实验表明，当局部数据集组成反映底层聚类结构时，该方法比标准MCMC在全数据上更准确地恢复小簇。在英国老年电子健康记录数据上识别出多病共存模式。
Conclusion: 该方法为隐私保护的联邦贝叶斯混合模型推断提供了灵活且有效的解决方案，尤其适用于局部数据具有聚类结构的情形。

papers.title: Rigorous uncertainty quantification of probabilistic AI weather forecasts with conformal prediction
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic weather forecasting is undergoing rapid transformation with artificial intelligence (AI). In traditional numerical weather prediction, computing power can limit how well ensemble forecasts approximate the unknown statistical distribution of future states. AI models facilitate larger ensembles and are trained with probabilistic considerations, ideally leading to better uncertainty quantification. Forecasts from these state-of-the-art models are often considered well-calibrated. However, here we show that the statistical coverage of such models, the ultimate measure of calibration, can struggle, especially on extreme events. To address this shortcoming, we employ conformal prediction, a class of statistical methods that mathematically guarantees coverage under no distributional assumptions, unlike previous post-processing techniques. We apply online conformal prediction to temperature and precipitation forecasts (including extremes) of three leading global weather models, GenCast, NeuralGCM, and AIFS-ENS, ensuring calibrated uncertainty at no expense to other probabilistic metrics. This post-processing method can be applied to any forecasting model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明当前最先进的概率AI天气预报模型（如GenCast、NeuralGCM、AIFS-ENS）在极端事件上的统计覆盖率可能不足，并提出使用在线共形预测（conformal prediction）来数学保证覆盖率的后处理方法。该方法无需分布假设，能在不牺牲其他概率指标的前提下实现校准的不确定性量化，可应用于任何预报模型。
Motivation: 现有概率AI天气模型通常被认为校准良好，但作者发现其在极端事件上的统计覆盖率（calibration的终极度量）存在不足，亟需一种无需分布假设且保证覆盖率的后处理方法。
Method: 采用在线共形预测（online conformal prediction），这是一种统计方法，能在无分布假设下数学保证预测集的覆盖概率，并应用于三个全球天气模型（GenCast、NeuralGCM、AIFS-ENS）的温度和降水（包括极端）预报。
Result: 摘要未给出量化结果，但称该方法在保持其他概率指标不变的前提下，确保了校准后的不确定性量化。
Conclusion: 共形预测作为一种通用的后处理工具，可以弥补现有AI天气模型在极端事件覆盖率上的不足，且适用于任意预报模型。

papers.title: Scaling Self-Play for End-to-End Driving
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving models are typically trained on offline human-demonstration datasets that provide limited state coverage and often no closed-loop feedback, making them prone to compounding errors when deployed in closed-loop and brittle to long-tail agent interactions. To overcome these limitations, we propose an alternative strategy for training end-to-end driving models: large-scale self-play directly from pixels in simulation. While prior self-play approaches have shown promising transfer to real-world driving, they typically assume vectorized Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) observations that are incompatible with end-to-end policies operating directly on sensor observations. To this end, we introduce Gigapixel, a high-throughput batched driving simulator with perspective rendering, enabling scalable self-play directly from pixel observations. Rather than targeting compute-costly photorealistic sensor simulation, Gigapixel renders a simplified bounding-box world that preserves essential scene structure while achieving throughput at 50k agent steps per second. Since direct pixel-space self-play RL is prohibitively sample-inefficient at end-to-end model scale, we propose self-play DAgger training: we train pixel-based policies in self-play via on-policy distillation from a privileged RL teacher. To bridge the sim-to-real gap, we subsequently transfer the self-play trained policies to real-world sensor data through lightweight perception adaptation. Policies trained in Gigapixel and adapted to real-world sensor data achieve competitive performance on the HUGSIM and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks without human trajectory supervision. Moreover, scaling self-play training yields proportional gains in policy performance, establishing self-play as a practical and scalable strategy for training end-to-end models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Gigapixel，一个高吞吐量驾驶模拟器，支持从像素观测直接进行大规模自对抗学习（self-play）训练端到端驾驶模型。通过自对抗DAgger训练（从特权RL教师进行策略蒸馏）和轻量级感知适应，模型在HUGSIM和NAVSIM-v2基准上取得有竞争力的性能，且自对抗规模与性能呈正比例提升。
Motivation: 现有端到端驾驶模型在离线人类演示数据上训练，状态覆盖有限且缺乏闭环反馈，导致闭环部署时累积误差和对长尾交互的脆弱性。
Method: 提出Gigapixel模拟器，以简化边界框世界进行高效像素渲染（5万步/秒）；采用自对抗DAgger训练，通过在线策略蒸馏从特权RL教师学习像素策略；随后通过轻量级感知适应迁移到真实传感器数据。
Result: 在HUGSIM和NAVSIM-v2基准上取得与人类轨迹监督方法相当的竞争性性能，且增加自对抗训练规模带来性能的成比例提升。
Conclusion: 自对抗训练可作为训练端到端驾驶模型的实用且可扩展策略，无需人类轨迹监督。

papers.title: Creating Multilingual Mental Health Dialogue Datasets: Limits of Persona-Based Localization via Nationality and Language
papers.abstract_en: AI and large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising tools to address global mental health challenges. Despite the global nature of these challenges, there remains a critical shortage of high-quality datasets for training and evaluating such systems. To mitigate this gap, researchers increasingly generate synthetic clinical personas to simulate user data and test digital mental health support systems. However, most validated personas rely on English-centric contexts. This paper investigates whether similar persona-based methods can be used to generate multilingual mental health datasets. We modified nationality and language parameters in personas to generate clinical dialogues in Mandarin, Bengali, and Hindi. We then examined how different LLMs perform when evaluating the depression severity of these generated multilingual datasets against the baseline in English. Our findings indicate that just adding nationality and language parameters in personas might not be adequate, as it can introduce clinical inconsistency across languages. LLM judge models often exhibit inaccuracies in assessing depression severity in non-English texts, with performance varying across different models. This exposes the systemic limitations of applying English-centric personas to multilingual contexts. Ultimately, our work highlights the urgent need for culturally responsive data generation to ensure equitable mental health systems globally.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 2026 Workshop on Computational Linguistics and Clinical Psychology (CLPsych 2026), co-located with ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了通过修改人物角色中的国籍和语言参数来生成多语言心理健康对话数据集的有效性。实验发现，仅调整国籍和语言参数并不足以产生临床一致的数据，LLM在非英语文本中评估抑郁严重程度时存在不准确性，表明基于英语的人物角色方法在多语言环境中存在系统性局限。
Motivation: 全球心理健康挑战需要高质量的多语言数据集，但目前大多数已验证的人物角色基于英语背景，缺乏跨语言数据集的有效生成方法。
Method: 修改人物角色中的国籍和语言参数，生成普通话、孟加拉语和印地语的临床对话，然后使用不同LLM评估这些生成数据集的抑郁严重程度，并与英语基线比较。
Result: 仅添加国籍和语言参数会导致跨语言临床不一致，LLM评估模型在非英语文本中常出现不准确，且不同模型表现有差异。
Conclusion: 需要更具文化响应性的数据生成方法，以确保全球心理健康系统的公平性。

papers.title: Before the Labels: How Dataset Construction Shapes Suicidality Detection in Clinical Text
papers.abstract_en: Clinical NLP increasingly relies on electronic health record (EHR) data to detect suicidal behaviors, treating clinical documentation as more reliable ground truth than social media. We argue that this framing obscures how EHR-based suicidality datasets encode a particular operationalization of suicidality, shaped by who authors the data, how episodes are bounded, and how ambiguity is resolved. We ground this argument in a case study of the ScAN dataset, built over MIMIC-III clinical notes. We show how governance constraints, ICD-based cohort selection, single-annotator labeling, and hospital-stay-level aggregation produce labels that reflect clinician-documented judgments, treat suicidality as a bounded episode, and assume that intent can be reliably inferred from documentation. A linguistic analysis demonstrates that identical labels subsume heterogeneous clinical framings differing in temporality, negation, and uncertainty. We argue that clinical NLP should examine the assumptions embedded in suicidality datasets before interpreting their labels as ground truth.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 11th Workshop on Computational Linguistics and Clinical Psychology (CLPsych 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判性地审视了基于电子健康记录（EHR）的自杀检测数据集的构建方式，以ScAN数据集（基于MIMIC-III临床笔记）为案例，揭示了治理约束、ICD编码队列选择、单标注者标注和住院级别聚合如何编码特定自杀概念化。语言学分析表明相同标签包含不同临床框架。作者呼吁临床NLP在将标签视为真值前应检视数据集假设。
Motivation: 临床NLP将EHR数据视为比社交媒体更可靠的真值，但忽略了数据集中内嵌的操作化定义（由谁标注、如何界定事件、如何处理歧义），可能导致模型偏差。
Method: 通过ScAN数据集案例研究，分析治理约束、ICD-9代码队列选择、单标注者标注和住院级别聚合的影响，并进行语言学分析比较标签下的临床框架差异。
Result: 发现相同标签下存在不同的时间性、否定词和不确定性表述；标签反映临床医生判断而非客观真值，且自杀被视为有界事件。
Conclusion: 临床NLP应审视自杀检测数据集中的假设，而不是直接将标签作为真值；数据集构建方式直接影响模型有效性与公平性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hard or Just Unreached? Diagnosing the Sampling Blind Spot in Math-Reasoning Difficulty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Math and science reasoning benchmarks rely on pass@k, the fraction of sampled chains that reach gold, as the canonical per-example difficulty signal. The same signal drives RL with verifiable rewards, math data curation, synthetic curricula, and verifier training. We show this proxy has a persistent blind spot on its hardest stratum: on the eight free-form math cells we test (GSM8K and MATH across four open-weight models), 10.3-22.9% of the examples that no sampling seed solves in six tries are instead solved at matched compute by a six-chain deterministic regime. These are greedy decoding plus five cheap residual-stream perturbations applied via activation grafting, while greedy alone solves at most 6% on these math cells. Recovery scales with the additional budget, across perturbations whose mechanistic distinctness we verify across all twelve cells (cross-kind fix-set Jaccard <= 0.47 in every setup). Activation grafting is used as an intervention on internal representations, not a decoding method; we use it purely as a diagnostic and diversification tool, and our recovered items show that the pass@k= 0 % stratum is structurally identifiable in the residual stream rather than that the unmodified model reaches them under ordinary inference.
papers.comment: 9 pages of main paper, 4 figures and 5 tables in the main paper, with more in the appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现数学推理基准中的pass@k指标在 hardest stratum 存在盲点：在GSM8K和MATH数据集上，10.3-22.9%的pass@k=0的例子可以被六链确定性方法（贪心解码加5种残差流扰动）解决。该方法通过激活嫁接（activation grafting）实现，作为诊断工具揭示这些例子在残差流中具有结构性可识别性。
Motivation: 当前数学推理基准依赖pass@k作为难度信号，但该指标在 hardest stratum 存在盲点，误将实际可解决的例子标记为无法解决。
Method: 提出六链确定性方法：贪心解码加上5种通过激活嫁接生成的残差流扰动，不改变模型参数，作为诊断和多样化工具。
Result: 在GSM8K和MATH上使用四个开放权重模型，10.3-22.9%的pass@k=0例子被该方法解决，而贪心解码单独解决最多6%。
Conclusion: pass@k=0层在残差流中具有结构性可识别性，表明未被解决的例子并非真正难以解决；该诊断工具可用于改进难度估计。

papers.title: Token Factory: Efficiently Integrating Diverse Signals into Large Recommendation Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Recommendation Models (LRMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities in industry-scale recommendation tasks. However, holistically integrating traditional signals into these transformer-based architectures effectively and efficiently remains a major challenge. Conventional approaches that "textualize" these signals directly or create discrete item representations often lead to excessively long prompts, substantial memory footprints, and high computational overhead. To overcome these limitations, we propose "Token Factory", a framework designed to transform traditional signals into "soft tokens" that can be directly processed by LRMs. This approach enables efficient integration and compression of heterogeneous input features, preventing prompt length explosion while enhancing model performance. We detail the architecture of Token Factory and present experimental results validating its effectiveness in a production-scale recommendation environment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Token Factory框架，将传统推荐信号（如用户特征、物品特征）转换为软token（soft tokens），由大型推荐模型（LRM）直接处理。该方法避免直接文本化导致的提示长度爆炸和计算开销，实现异构输入的高效集成与压缩。实验在生产规模推荐环境中验证了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 工业级推荐模型中整合传统信号时，直接文本化或离散化会导致超长提示、大内存占用和高计算开销，亟需高效且可扩展的集成方案。
Method: Token Factory将异构输入特征通过一个小型网络映射为固定长度的软token序列，与LRM的输入嵌入拼接，从而在不显著增加序列长度的前提下融合多样信号。
Result: 在生产规模推荐环境中，Token Factory在保持或提升推荐精度的同时，显著降低了推理内存和计算成本。
Conclusion: Token Factory提供了一种高效整合多样信号到大型推荐模型的通用框架，平衡了模型表现与资源消耗。

papers.title: CTS-MoE: Implicit Terrain Adaptation via Mixture-of-Experts for Perceptive Locomotion
papers.abstract_en: Perceptive legged locomotion over discontinuous terrain (e.g., stairs, gaps, and obstacles) requires adaptive behavior, as a single conservative gait cannot produce the anticipatory maneuvers needed for abrupt topology changes. Cast as multi-task reinforcement learning, this problem introduces a tension between sharing and separation. Tasks use a common locomotion base but have conflicting rewards, so a policy must share behavior while avoiding value interference. Prior work addresses only one side, with monolithic policies sacrificing specialization and hierarchical sub-policies sacrificing generalization across transitions and unseen terrain. We propose CTS-MoE, which combines a dense mixture-of-experts actor with perception-based gating to compose shared behaviors and a multi-critic with task-specific value heads to prevent interference. The model is trained end-to-end in a single-stage concurrent teacher-student setup that handles partial observability and avoids sequential distillation, with task labels used only during training. At deployment, routing depends solely on perception, allowing terrain adaptation without a high-level selector or terrain classifier. Experiments on a Unitree Go1 in simulation and on hardware across seen and unseen terrains show task-aware specialization, with lower tracking error and higher success rates than monolithic baselines. Project Website: https://cts-moe.github.io/ .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CTS-MoE，一种基于混合专家模型（MoE）的感知腿式运动方法，用于在不连续地形（如楼梯、间隙）上实现自适应。该方法结合密集混合专家演员与基于感知的门控来组合共享行为，并采用多评论家与任务特定值头防止干扰。在仿真和真实Unitree Go1机器人上，CTS-MoE相比单体基线实现了更低跟踪误差和更高成功率，且部署时仅依赖感知进行路由。
Motivation: 感知腿式运动在不连续地形上需要自适应行为，但现有策略在共享与专门化之间存在矛盾：单体策略牺牲专门化，层级子策略牺牲泛化。
Method: 提出CTS-MoE，包含密集混合专家演员和基于感知的门控，以及多评论家架构。采用单阶段教师-学生训练处理部分可观测性，任务标签仅训练时使用，部署时路由完全依赖感知。
Result: 在仿真和真实Unitree Go1上，对已知和未知地形的实验显示，CTS-MoE实现了任务感知专门化，跟踪误差更低，成功率高于单体基线。
Conclusion: CTS-MoE通过感知门控实现隐式地形适应，无需高层选择器或地形分类器，有效解决了多任务共享与分离的矛盾。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Formal Verification of Learned Multi-Agent Communication Policies via Decision Tree Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) enables agents to develop coordination strategies through emergent communication, but neural policies lack the formal safety guarantees required for safety-critical robotic deployment in drone swarms and autonomous vehicle fleets. We present the first end-to-end framework for safety verification of learned multi-agent communication policies through policy abstraction: neural policies are distilled into interpretable decision trees, then formally verified, with empirical validation confirming that verified safety properties transfer to original networks. Our four-stage pipeline consists of domain-specific feature extraction from agent observations, decision tree distillation achieving 97.9% +/- 1.2% fidelity to neural policies, automated translation to PRISM probabilistic model checker specifications with complete feature-to-state-variable correspondence, and compositional verification of Probabilistic Computation Tree Logic (PCTL) properties via pairwise decomposition with union-bound aggregation and empirical neighbor modeling. Evaluating Vector-Quantized Variational Information Bottleneck (VQ-VIB) policies for multi-drone coordination with 5-7 agents, we verify 18 temporal logic properties across safety, liveness, and cooperation, achieving 88.9% property satisfaction with all five safety thresholds satisfied (0.3% collision probability vs. 1% threshold). Monte Carlo validation of original neural policies confirms that verified safety properties transfer with <=0.6 percentage-point deviation (95% CI). Discrete VQ-VIB messages provide +11.6 to +13.6 percentage-point fidelity advantages over continuous methods, enabling 3-4x faster verification. Our framework provides empirically validated safety verification for distilled policy abstractions, serving as a practical bridge between deep MARL and formal safety workflows for multi-robot deployment.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026), Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, USA, September 27-October 1, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个端到端框架，通过将神经网络策略蒸馏为可解释决策树，再形式化验证学习到的多智能体通信策略的安全性。实验使用VQ-VIB策略验证多无人机协调中的18个时序逻辑性质，包括安全性、活性和合作性，验证的安全性质以≤0.6个百分点的偏差转移到原始网络。离散VQ-VIB消息相比连续方法在保真度上提高11.6-13.6个百分点，验证速度加快3-4倍。
Motivation: 多智能体强化学习使智能体通过涌现通信发展协调策略，但神经策略缺乏形式化安全保证，限制了在无人机群和自动驾驶车队等安全关键场景的部署。
Method: 四阶段流水线：从智能体观测中提取领域特定特征；决策树蒸馏（对神经策略保真度97.9%±1.2%）；自动转换为PRISM概率模型检查器规范（特征到状态变量完全对应）；通过成对分解与联合边界聚合及经验邻居建模，组合验证概率计算树逻辑（PCTL）性质。
Result: 对5-7个智能体的多无人机协调VQ-VIB策略，验证18个时序逻辑性质，88.9%性质满足，所有5个安全阈值均满足（碰撞概率0.3%对阈值1%）。蒙特卡洛验证确认安全性质转移偏差≤0.6个百分点（95%CI）。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了经过实证验证的安全验证方法，作为深度MARL与安全关键多机器人部署中正式安全工作流之间的实用桥梁。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI4SE and SE4AI Exploration: A Decade Looking Back and Forward
papers.abstract_en: The March 2020 INCOSE INSIGHT special issue on AI and Systems Engineering (SE) became the most downloaded issue in the publication's history and launched a research community that now draws over 250 registrants to its annual workshop. In this article, we trace the progress in AI and SE across three phases (labeled here foundational, applied, and LLM inflection) based on the authors' reading of the field's core papers, and describe our opinions of where the community has converged and where critical gaps remain. Separately, a human-AI agreement literature review leveraging both human expertise and six AI models was performed to assess the relevance of 1,712 INCOSE INSIGHT articles and 889 SERC publications. The results identify five critical research gaps and offer guidance for practitioners navigating AI adoption, assurance, and workforce transformation in SE. We share the agreement data and the AI4SE/SE4AI Explorer web application so readers can compare their own relevance judgments with the human and AI raters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文回顾了过去十年人工智能与系统工程（AI4SE/SE4AI）交叉领域的发展，分为基础、应用和LLM转折三个阶段。通过人类专家与六种AI模型对INCOSE INSIGHT和SERC出版物进行相关性评估，识别出五个关键研究空白，并提供了AI4SE/SE4AI Explorer工具供研究者对比判断。
Motivation: AI与系统工程融合领域发展迅速，但缺乏系统性回顾和共识，特别是对关键研究空白的识别。
Method: 采用文献综述方法，结合人类专家和六种AI模型对1,712篇INCOSE INSIGHT文章和889篇SERC出版物进行相关性评估，并开发了交互式网络工具。
Result: 识别出五个关键研究空白，并提供了人类与AI评分数据，便于后续研究。
Conclusion: AI与SE的融合已取得进展，但在AI采纳、保证和劳动力转型方面仍存在显著空白，需要社区协作。

papers.title: RIVET: Robust Idempotent Voice Attribute Editing
papers.abstract_en: Voice attribute editing models modify characteristics such as age and gender while preserving speaker identity. In large-scale speech datasets, however, attribute annotations are often noisy or inconsistent, which can cause conditional generative models to produce unstable edits. In this work, we show that idempotency provides an effective mechanism for improving robustness to noisy labels. An idempotent operator is one for which repeated application does not change the result, i.e., f(f(x)) = f(x). Enforcing this property acts as an implicit regularizer that reduces sensitivity to mislabeled examples. We introduce RIVET, a training framework that incorporates an idempotency objective to improve robustness to label noise. We evaluate RIVET under controlled label noise and on the GLOBE dataset with naturally noisy annotations. RIVET improves editing success and better preserves speaker identity than standard training, showing that idempotency improves robustness in voice editing models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RIVET框架，通过强制模型满足幂等性（f(f(x))=f(x)）来提升语音属性编辑模型对标签噪声的鲁棒性。在可控噪声和自然噪声数据集上的实验表明，该方法能提高编辑成功率并更好地保留说话人身份。
Motivation: 大规模语音数据集中属性标注常含噪声或不一致，导致条件生成模型产生不稳定编辑，现有方法对此鲁棒性不足。
Method: 引入幂等性训练目标，作为隐式正则化项，强制模型对同一输入重复应用产生相同结果，从而减少对错误标注样本的敏感性。
Result: 在可控标签噪声实验和GLOBE自然噪声数据集上，RIVET提高了编辑成功率，同时更有效地保持了说话人身份。
Conclusion: 幂等性为语音属性编辑模型提供了一种有效的鲁棒性增强机制，能够改善在噪声标注下的编辑稳定性和身份保留。

papers.title: VCG: A Multimodal Retrieval Framework for E-Commerce Video Feeds under Extreme Cold-Start Conditions
papers.abstract_en: The digital commerce landscape is shifting from static, search-driven catalogs to dynamic, immersive video feeds. This transition introduces an ``extreme cold-start'' problem: unlike traditional items, new short-form videos lack the dense interaction history required for collaborative filtering. Furthermore, immersive feeds introduce strong position and duration biases that distort standard engagement signals. In this paper, we demonstrate the Video Candidate Generation (VCG) system, a scalable multimodal retrieval engine designed to solve these challenges in a large-scale e-commerce environment. By leveraging a domain-adapted vision-language model (based on CLIP), we map users and videos into a shared semantic space, enabling zero-shot retrieval based on visual content rather than behavioral history. We detail the system's architecture and present a rigorous evaluation comparing generative (LLM) vs. discriminative (CLIP) embeddings. Our results show that while generative models excel at attribute prediction, they suffer from embedding space collapse in retrieval tasks. Online A/B testing demonstrates that VCG effectively mitigates engagement biases, yielding a 50\% uplift in deep video completion. To showcase the system's capabilities, we present an interactive demonstration featuring three bi-directional retrieval scenarios: Product-to-Video, Video-to-Product, and Zero-Shot Semantic Search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VCG系统，一个可扩展的多模态检索框架，用于解决电商视频推送中的极端冷启动问题。通过领域适配的CLIP视觉-语言模型，将用户和视频映射到共享语义空间，实现基于视觉内容的零样本检索。在线A/B测试显示，VCG有效缓解了参与度偏差，使视频深度完成率提升50%。
Motivation: 电商平台从静态搜索转向动态视频推送，但新视频缺乏交互历史导致冷启动问题，且沉浸式推送引入位置和时间偏差，扭曲了标准参与度信号。
Method: 采用领域适配的CLIP模型构建多模态检索引擎，将用户和视频嵌入同一语义空间，支持产品到视频、视频到产品及零样本语义搜索三种双向检索场景。
Result: 在线实验表明，VCG将深度视频完成率提升50%，且生成式LLM在检索任务中会出现嵌入空间坍塌，而判别式CLIP更优。
Conclusion: VCG通过视觉内容而非行为历史实现零样本检索，有效解决了电商视频冷启动和偏差问题，为动态视频推送提供了可扩展的检索方案。

summary_sections.conclusion: VCG通过视觉内容而非行为历史实现零样本检索，有效解决了电商视频冷启动和偏差问题，为动态视频推送提供了可扩展的检索方案。

papers.title: Toten: Knowledge-Based Ontological Tokenization Of Physical Quantities And Technical Notation In Brazilian Portuguese
authors: Antonio de Sousa Leitão Filho; Allan Kardec Duailibe Barros Filho; Fabrício Saul Lima; Selby Mykael Lima dos Santos; Rejani Bandeira Vieira Sousa
papers.abstract_en: Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization is statistically efficient for vocabulary compression, but semantically blind to structured technical entities, fragmenting physical quantities, numbers, units, and symbolic expressions into lexically arbitrary subwords. We present TOTEN, a knowledge-based ontological tokenization framework that replaces statistical derivation with declarative classification grounded in a formal ontology of engineering entities (OEE). We formalize TOTEN as the triple <O, classify, {inst_tau}>: the ontology gathers types, structural principles, composition relations, and preservable invariants; the classification function maps raw text into typed regions; and the instantiator family yields a self-descriptive structured representation. Robustness derives from deterministic coupling with three external oracles: Pint (dimensional), Unicode Character Database (typographic), and RSLP (Portuguese morphology). Intrinsic evaluation covers four properties verifiable by construction -- ontological atomicity, dimensional equivalence, typographic robustness, and numerical reconstruction -- over an internal, physically validated benchmark (EngQuant, N=800) and four Brazilian Portuguese external corpora (N=1771 eligible cases). We also report detection recall, distinguishing coverage from conditional atomicity. Against eight state-of-the-art baselines, TOTEN achieves unit ontological atomicity in all contrasts and numerical reconstruction of 0.775-0.904 on external corpora, vs. 0.627-0.703 for the best baseline (Quantulum3); on EngQuant, 0.780 vs. 0.340. Differences are statistically significant (McNemar with Holm correction). Spearman correlation between internal and external rankings confirms concurrent validity of the control benchmark. Dimensional equivalence shows statistical parity with Pint, the oracle from which the system inherits dimensional authority.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TOTEN，一个基于本体论（工程实体本体 OEE）的标记化框架，用于巴西葡萄牙语中的物理量和技术符号。与 BPE 不同，TOTEN 使用声明式分类而非统计子词，并外部依赖 Pint（维度）、Unicode 字符数据库（排印）和 RSLP（葡萄牙语形态）。内在评估验证了本体原子性、维度等价性、排印鲁棒性和数值重建，在 EngQuant 基准和四个外部语料库上，TOTEN 在单元本体原子性上优于所有基线，数值重建得分显著更高。
Motivation: 现有 BPE 标记化对结构化技术实体缺乏语义理解，会随意分割物理量、数字、单位和符号表达式，需要一种能够保留这些实体语义完整性的标记化方法，特别是在巴西葡萄牙语中。
Method: 提出 TOTEN 框架，形式化为三元组 <O, classify, {inst_tau}>：O 是工程实体本体，classify 将原始文本映射到带类型的区域，inst_tau 生成自描述的、结构化的表示。系统与 Pint、Unicode 字符数据库和 RSLP 三个外部知识源确定性耦合以实现鲁棒性。
Result: 在内在评估中，TOTEN 在所有对比中实现了单元本体原子性和数值重建（外部语料库 0.775-0.904，对比最佳基线 Quantulum3 的 0.627-0.703；EngQuant 上 0.780 vs 0.340），差异统计显著（McNemar with Holm 校正）。维度等价性达到与 Pint 的统计持平。
Conclusion: TOTEN 通过基于本体的方法在物理量和技术符号标记化中优于统计方法，证明了知识驱动方法在技术文本处理中的优势，但可能受限于特定语言（巴西葡萄牙语）和领域本体。

papers.title: Where Does Social Reasoning Come From? Capability Provenance in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We use training-data attribution as an interpretable tool for capability discovery, mapping which regions of the pretraining corpus support social-reasoning versus STEM-reasoning in OLMo3-7B. Training-data attribution measures how strongly each training document influences a model's predictions on a benchmark, but document-level scores are too noisy to identify which corpus regions support which capabilities, and prior work has emphasized factual knowledge rather than reasoning. We compute gradient-based attribution (TrackStar via Bergson) over a working set drawn from the de-duplicated Dolma3 mix, aggregate influence across WebOrganizer's 24-format x 24-topic taxonomy (576 bins), and contrast benchmark pairs in a 2x2 design that varies domain (social vs. STEM) and capability type (reasoning vs. knowledge): SocialIQA and MMLU Social Sciences against ARC-Challenge and MMLU STEM. Social and STEM reasoning draw on qualitatively distinct corpus regions, and the contrast is sharper at the reasoning level than at the knowledge level. Targeted machine unlearning provides partial causal validation: forgetting high-attribution topic bins (e.g., Literature for SocialIQA) degrades the aligned benchmark more than within-bin random baselines, and we open-source all code, sampling manifests, the bin-level influence matrix, and unlearning checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用训练数据归因（training-data attribution）作为可解释性工具，研究OLMo3-7B模型的社会推理能力与STEM推理能力的来源。通过计算梯度归因，将训练语料按WebOrganizer的24x24格式-主题分类（576个分区）聚合影响力，对比SocialIQA、MMLU社会科学与ARC-Challenge、MMLU STEM等基准。发现社会推理与STEM推理所依赖的语料区域存在定性差异，且推理层面的对比比知识层面更显著。定向机器遗忘实验提供了部分因果验证：遗忘高归因主题分区（如文学）会显著降低对齐基准的性能。
Motivation: 现有工作主要关注事实知识而非推理能力的来源，且文档级归因噪声大，难以识别支持特定能力的语料区域。本文旨在填补这一空白，探索语言模型中社会推理能力的来源。
Method: 采用梯度归因方法（TrackStar via Bergson）在去重后的Dolma3语料子集上计算每个训练文档对模型预测的影响，然后通过WebOrganizer的24格式×24主题分类（共576个分区）聚合影响力，并采用2×2实验设计（领域：社会vs. STEM；能力类型：推理vs.知识）对比基准对。
Result: 社会推理与STEM推理依赖的语料区域定性不同，且推理层面的对比比知识层面更尖锐。定向机器遗忘实验表明，遗忘高归因主题分区（如文学）会导致SocialIQA性能下降超过随机基线。
Conclusion: 本文展示了训练数据归因可用于揭示语言模型不同推理能力的语料来源，并提供了部分因果验证。代码、采样清单、分区影响力矩阵和遗忘检查点均已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MassSpecGym in the Wild: Uncovering and Correcting Evaluation Pitfalls in AI-Driven Molecule Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Reliable benchmarking is critical for developing machine learning models for tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) based molecule discovery. Subtle issues in experimental design and model evaluation procedures can degrade the trustworthiness of such benchmarks and lead to erroneous conclusions. We conduct a thorough review of model evaluation issues in the recent MS/MS machine learning literature, using the standard MassSpecGym benchmark suite as a case study to illustrate the impact of these issues. We find evaluation issues in at least 17 of 26 papers reporting MassSpecGym benchmark results in the first year of its adoption. We isolate three classes of failures: (i) data leakage, (ii) shortcut learning, and (iii) implementation bugs and metric divergence. Through extensive experimentation and code replication, we quantify the impact of these issues and show how they corrupt the evaluation standards MassSpecGym was designed to enforce. We distill our findings into recommendations generalizable to MS/MS challenges, benchmarks, and custom evaluation setups. We also release MassSpecGym v1.5, an implementation of our recommendations in the MassSpecGym benchmarking suite which addresses the failure modes identified in this audit. MassSpecGym v1.5 is publicly available at https://github.com/pluskal-lab/MassSpecGym.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了基于串联质谱（MS/MS）的分子发现中机器学习模型评测的常见问题，以标准基准MassSpecGym为例，发现26篇论文中至少17篇存在评测缺陷。作者将缺陷归纳为三类：数据泄露、捷径学习以及实现错误与度量偏差，并通过实验量化其影响。最终发布MassSpecGym v1.5修正了这些问题并给出通用建议。
Motivation: 可靠的基准测试对基于MS/MS的分子发现至关重要，但近期文献中广泛存在评测设计缺陷，导致结论不可靠。需要系统审查并量化这些缺陷的影响。
Method: 对26篇使用MassSpecGym基准的论文进行系统性审查，通过代码复现和实验量化三类失败模式（数据泄露、捷径学习、实现错误与度量偏差）的影响，并发布修正后的MassSpecGym v1.5。
Result: 在26篇论文中发现至少17篇存在评测问题；数据泄露和捷径学习导致指标虚高，实现错误和度量差异进一步污染结果。
Conclusion: 评测缺陷在MS/MS分子发现领域广泛存在，MassSpecGym v1.5提供了修复方案，其发现和建议可推广至其他质谱挑战和基准。

papers.title: SEAGAN: domain-Specific and Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network for Dynamic Plant Processes
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) provide a flexible framework for learning from scientific data linked through physical, biological, or functional relationships. One promising domain is plant physiology, where measured responses often arise from multiple interacting processes whose exact separation remains difficult even with manual intervention. In plant physiology, a key example is the A-Ci curve, which relates net CO2 assimilation rate (Anet) to leaf intercellular CO2 concentration (Ci) and is used to estimate photosynthetic parameters in leaf and crop-canopy models. However, reliable estimation requires identifying the active biochemical limitation state at each curve point, which remains a major source of uncertainty. Here, we formulate limitation-state identification along A-Ci curves as a graph-based node classification problem, with curve points as nodes. Domain-specific graph representations are created using distance-based k-nearest-neighbor (kNN) and auxiliary-signal-guided (ASG) connectivity, with edge attributes encoding pairwise relations. The framework was evaluated against conventional learning baselines, graph-based architectures, and an automated fitting-based benchmark. Results on a large synthetic dataset with known ground-truth limitation states show that graph-based models improve classification, particularly near biochemical transition regions. The best-performing configuration, SEAGAN (domain-Specific and Edge-Aware Graph Attention Network for Dynamic Plant Processes), integrates process-aware node features, edge attributes, kNN connectivity, and graph attention with weighted cross-entropy loss, achieving an F1-score of 0.857 and an accuracy of 0.882. The results show that representing A-Ci curves as graphs improves biochemical limitation-state analysis, with edge-aware attention over local kNN neighborhoods providing the most effective strategy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEAGAN，一种面向植物生理学A-Ci曲线中生化限制状态识别的图注意力网络。该方法将曲线点视为图节点，利用距离kNN和辅助信号引导构建领域特定的图结构，并通过边缘感知注意力机制提升分类效果。在合成数据集上，SEAGAN取得F1分数0.857和准确率0.882，优于传统基线和自动拟合方法。
Motivation: 植物生理学中A-Ci曲线的关键挑战在于准确识别每个数据点对应的生化限制状态（如Rubisco限制或RuBP再生限制），传统方法依赖手动干预且难以分离多过程交互，导致参数估计不确定性高。
Method: 将A-Ci曲线建模为图节点分类问题：节点为曲线点，边通过距离kNN和辅助信号引导（ASG）构建，边缘属性编码成对关系。模型采用图注意力网络（GAT），并引入过程感知节点特征、边缘属性加权和加权交叉熵损失，形成SEAGAN架构。
Result: 在已知真实限制状态的大规模合成数据集上，SEAGAN的F1分数为0.857，准确率为0.882；在生化转变区域附近，图模型相比传统机器学习和自动拟合方法有显著改进。
Conclusion: 结果表明，将A-Ci曲线表示为图并利用边缘感知注意力在局部kNN邻域上处理，为生化限制状态分析提供了最有效的策略，减少了不确定性。

papers.title: GB-LSR: A Fast Local Spectral Image Representation with a Single Global Bandwidth for Continuous Reconstruction and Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: We present GB-LSR (Global-Bandwidth Local Spectral Representation), a fixed-grid local spectral representation for continuous image reconstruction. The image domain is partitioned into non-overlapping square patches, each carrying coefficients for a truncated Fourier basis predicted from shared convolutional-encoder features. A single trainable scalar bandwidth is shared globally across all patches and images, and reconstruction at any continuous coordinate is a fixed-size basis contraction whose cost is independent of image size. We study three bandwidth-handling variants: a trainable global scalar (main), a fixed global scalar, and a per-patch bandwidth field. On a standardized native-reconstruction benchmark across Kodak, Set14, and Urban100, the main variant outperforms matched-budget amortized LIIF / LTE / WIRE re-implementations by 2.8-3.6 dB PSNR and 0.11-0.15 LPIPS, while running at roughly one-quarter of the slowest baseline's inference cost. The single global scalar suffices empirically: per-patch adaptive-bandwidth alternatives do not improve over it on either a closed-form locality diagnostic or an end-to-end ablation. In a separate arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASR) extension, GB-LSR achieves competitive PSNR-Y under a canonical-style SR protocol and runs 1.44x faster than LIIF-RDN and 3.25x faster than LTE-SwinIR at x4; within the same extension, a variant trained and evaluated without 4-corner local-ensemble averaging gives a 1.77x speedup with 35% lower peak memory and negligible PSNR change, while additionally widening the RDN encoder from 64 to 96 channels gives a small positive PSNR shift with a 1.58x speedup and 31% lower peak memory. Native-reconstruction claims are scoped to the matched-budget amortized protocol, and ASR claims are scoped to a separate canonical-style SR protocol.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出GB-LSR，一种基于固定网格的局部频谱表示方法，用于连续图像重建。图像域被划分为非重叠方形块，每个块携带截断傅里叶基系数，这些系数由共享卷积编码器预测。全局带宽共享，重建成本与图像尺寸无关。在Kodak、Set14和Urban100基准上，主要变体在匹配预算的amortized LIIF/LTE/WIRE重实现上取得了2.8-3.6 dB PSNR和0.11-0.15 LPIPS的提升，推理成本约为最慢基线的四分之一。在任意尺度超分辨率扩展中，GB-LSR在标准SR协议下达到竞争性PSNR-Y，并比LIIF-RDN快1.44倍，比LTE-SwinIR快3.25倍。
Motivation: 现有连续图像表示方法在局部适应性和计算效率之间存在权衡，且全局带宽是否足够尚未得到充分验证。
Method: 将图像域划分为非重叠方形块，每个块使用截断傅里叶基，系数由共享卷积编码器预测，并引入一个可训练的全局标量带宽。研究了三种带宽变体：可训练全局标量、固定全局标量和逐块自适应带宽。
Result: 主要变体在原生重建基准上比LIIF、LTE、WIRE等基线提升2.8-3.6 dB PSNR和0.11-0.15 LPIPS，推理成本仅为最慢基线的四分之一。在任意尺度超分辨率扩展中，GB-LSR在标准SR协议下达到竞争性PSNR-Y，且运行速度比LIIF-RDN快1.44倍，比LTE-SwinIR快3.25倍。
Conclusion: 单个全局标量带宽在经验上足以实现高性能，逐块自适应带宽并未带来改进。原生重建结果限于匹配预算的amortized协议，ASR结果限于标准SR协议。

papers.title: Before the Pull Request: Mining Multi-Agent Coordination
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous coding agents now open millions of pull requests, yet large-scale studies find their PRs are produced faster but accepted less often - a coordination and trust gap that pull-request-level telemetry cannot explain. We argue the missing signal lives before the PR, in how concurrent agents claim, divide, and collide over shared work. We study this process through grite, our open-source coordination substrate that needs no central server and stores its records inside git itself, so its append-only, signed event log captures the coordination process directly. We show that (i) this shared substrate reduces duplicate and conflicting work at bounded overhead - the share of work that merely re-does a teammate's task falls from 78% to 0% while useful throughput more than triples; (ii) every agent's copy of the log converges to the same state with no write silently dropped, where a file-based tracker loses concurrent writes; and (iii) the log is a mineable artefact from which concrete failure modes - conflicting edits, lock starvation, redundant rediscovery, race-to-close - are automatically recoverable with provenance, several invisible in pull-request history. We release the dataset, harness, and mining toolkit.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 2 tables. LNCS format. Code, dataset, and mining toolkit: https://github.com/neul-labs/grite
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出gríte，一种无需中央服务器、将协调日志嵌入git的开放工具，用于研究多智能体编程协作中的冲突与浪费。实验表明，该共享日志将重复工作从78%降至0%，有效吞吐量提升三倍以上，且日志可自动挖掘出多种PR级别不可见的失败模式。
Motivation: 现有研究仅关注PR级别的产出，无法解释自主编码智能体产生大量PR但接受率低下的协调与信任鸿沟，缺乏对PR前期并发任务声明、分工与冲突过程的细粒度分析。
Method: 构建gríte协调基础设施，通过git内部的只增事件日志记录智能体间的协调过程，支持无需中央服务器的并发写入与状态收敛，并提供自动挖掘失败模式的工具。
Result: 共享日志将重复工作从78%降至0%，有效吞吐量提高三倍以上；所有智能体的日志状态一致收敛，无写入丢失；可自动恢复冲突编辑、锁饥饿、冗余发现、抢跑关闭等失败模式，部分模式在PR历史中不可见。
Conclusion: PR前的协调过程是理解多智能体编程协作效率的关键，gríte提供了可审计、可挖掘的协调记录，未来可基于该日志改进智能体协作策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: StaminaBench: Stress-Testing Coding Agents over 100 Interaction Turns
papers.abstract_en: We introduce StaminaBench, a benchmark that measures the stamina of coding agents: how many consecutive interaction turns (change requests) they can handle before failing. Unlike the prevailing fraction-of-tasks-solved metric, this matches real vibe-coding where sessions run dozens or hundreds of turns. In StaminaBench, agents implement a REST API server and modify it across a tunable number of procedurally generated follow-up change requests - 100 in our experiments, resulting in codebases of up to 6,000 lines. Tests are generated fully programmatically without LLM involvement, ensuring reproducibility and reliability; change sequences are drawn from either a hardcoded or LLM-driven sampler, both constrained to a structured action space to ensure changes are valid. The agent and the server run in an isolated environment and communicate with the benchmark through HTTP, making testing fully black-box and language-agnostic. We evaluate six agent harnesses paired with seven open-source LLMs across 20 scenarios of 100 turns each and find that: (1) all the tested models fail within 5-6 turns, confirming that vibe-coding-style programming without thorough testing produces bugs; (2) passing test feedback back to the agent and allowing it to retry improves passed turn count by up to 12x; and (3) a good harness is required for strong performance: stronger models exhibit up to a 6x gap between their best and worst harness, while weaker models fail with any harness. We release the benchmark and the generated tasks to enable further research into multi-turn coding agent behavior. Benchmark code and data: github.com/amazon-science/StaminaBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StaminaBench，一个用于评估编码智能体在多轮交互中持续修改代码能力的基准。与传统的单次任务解决率不同，该基准模拟真实的“vibe-coding”场景，包含多达100轮的连续变更请求。实验发现，所有测试模型在5-6轮内即失败，而提供测试反馈和重试机会可提升通过轮数达12倍。
Motivation: 现有基准多关注单次任务解决率，无法反映编码智能体在长时间多轮交互中的实际耐力，而实际编码会话往往包含数十甚至上百轮变更请求。
Method: 设计 StaminaBench，要求智能体实现一个REST API服务器并应对程序化生成的100轮连续变更请求，变更序列由硬编码或LLM驱动的采样器生成，限制在结构化动作空间内以保证有效性。测试在隔离环境中通过HTTP进行，完全黑盒且语言无关。
Result: 评估了6种智能体框架与7种开源LLM在20个场景中各100轮的表现，发现：(1) 所有模型在5-6轮内失败；(2) 向智能体返回测试反馈并允许重试可将通过轮数提升最多12倍；(3) 好的框架对性能至关重要：强模型在最佳和最差框架间性能差距达6倍，弱模型在任何框架下都失败。
Conclusion: StaminaBench揭示了当前编码智能体在多轮交互中缺乏耐力的问题，并提供了可复现的基准以推动相关研究。

papers.title: Latent Confounded Causal Discovery via Lie Bracket Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Recent work on Kan-Do-Calculus (KDC) has established that the boundary between passive observation and active intervention in causal inference is a category-theoretic bi-adjunction, with interventions modeled by left Kan extensions and conditioning by right Kan extensions. This paper introduces two causal discovery algorithms under latent confounding, building on the information-geometric and categorical consequences of KDC. In smooth statistical settings, Radon-Nikodym derivatives between observational and interventional measures induce local causal vector fields; failures of these fields to close under Lie brackets become computable Frobenius residuals, which we interpret as witnesses of failed visible integrability and possible latent or unmodeled structure. Our first algorithm, BRIDGE (Bracket Residuals for Interventional Discovery and Geometric Estimation), combines an interventional density or Radon-Nikodym-ratio engine with a geometric screen that proposes a high-recall family of admissible arrows, identifies non-closing visible pairs as latent-obstruction candidates, and passes the reduced family to downstream score-based or differentiable discovery routines. The second algorithmic contribution, Spectral Kan-Do Flow Matching (SKFM), learns amortized intervention fields and factors latent curvature spectrally, exposing the direct Lie-space endpoint toward which BRIDGE points. A detailed set of experiments show that both algorithms are capable of discovering causal models with latent confounders while collapsing the super-exponential space of possible DAGs by many orders of magnitude. This paper introduces a new paradigm in causal discovery, where latent structure is inferred directly from the geometry of intervention-induced flows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文基于范畴论和信息几何的Kan-Do微积分框架，提出两种在潜在混杂因素下的因果发现算法：BRIDGE（利用Lie括号残差检测不可积矢量场）和SKFM（通过谱分解学习干预场）。实验表明两种算法能显著缩小可能DAG空间，发现含潜在混杂的因果模型。
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法在处理潜在混杂因素时计算复杂度高，且难以区分观测与干预的边界。论文希望利用干预诱导流形的几何结构直接推断潜在混杂。
Method: 提出BRIDGE算法：结合干预密度或Radon-Nikodym比率引擎与几何筛选，通过Lie括号残差识别不可积的可见对作为潜在混杂候选；再提出SKFM算法：谱学习累积干预场并因子化潜在曲率，逼近BRIDGE指向的李空间终点。
Result: 实验表明两种算法能在含潜在混杂的因果模型中发现因果关系，并将可能DAG空间缩小多个数量级。
Conclusion: 该工作引入新范式：从干预诱导流的几何直接推断潜在结构，突破传统因果发现中枚举DAG空间的限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Which Pairs to Compare for LLM Post-Training?
papers.abstract_en: Preference-based post-training has become a central paradigm for aligning language models. A common data-collection strategy is to generate a small set of completions for each prompt and label the resulting comparison pairs. However, human preference labels are often much more expensive than generating additional completions, suggesting a different use of the same labeling budget: generate a larger pool of completions, but label only the most informative comparison pairs. This paper studies which pairs should be compared in preference-based post-training. We formulate comparison curation as a sampling-design problem and evaluate designs by the quality of the final policy under the preference-based post-training objective. We instantiate this framework for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), analyzing how the choice of labeled pairs propagates through DPO training to downstream policy performance. Our main results provide matching upper and lower bounds on the post-training optimality gap of the DPO-trained policy. The bounds show that comparison selection affects downstream performance through a single design-dependent information matrix, which links label allocation to parameter estimation error and policy suboptimality. This yields an explicit optimization criterion for budgeted comparison curation and motivates practical sampling designs for selecting informative pairs from large generated completion pools. Experiments on synthetic settings and language-model post-training benchmarks show that the proposed designs consistently improve sample efficiency over common comparison-selection heuristics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在基于偏好的后训练中如何选择最有效的比较对，通过将比较选择建模为抽样设计问题，分析了在直接偏好优化（DPO）下标签选择如何影响下游策略性能，并给出了最优性间隙的上下界，提出了实用的采样设计。
Motivation: 人类偏好标签成本高昂，而生成更多补全相对便宜；因此需要决定在生成的大量补全池中标记哪些比较对，以最大化样本效率。
Method: 将比较选择问题形式化为抽样设计问题，以DPO为例推导了设计相关的信息矩阵，该矩阵将标签分配与参数估计误差和策略次优性联系起来，并基于此提出显式的优化准则和实用采样设计。
Result: 给出了DPO训练策略的最优性间隙的匹配上下界，表明比较选择通过单一设计相关信息矩阵影响下游性能；实验证明所提设计在合成设置和语言模型后训练基准上优于常见启发式方法。
Conclusion: 通过理论分析和实验验证，提出了一个框架用于指导预算有限的比较选择，可提升偏好后训练的数据效率。

papers.title: FAPO: Fully Autonomous Prompt Optimization of Multi-Step LLM Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Multi-step LLM pipelines fail through interactions among retrieval, reasoning, and formatting steps, so prompt-only optimization can miss bottlenecks in the chain. We present FAPO (Fully Autonomous Prompt Optimization), a framework that lets Claude Code optimize an LLM pipeline inside a standardized codebase. FAPO evaluates a pipeline, inspects intermediate steps, diagnoses failures, proposes scoped changes, and validates variants repeatedly to optimize against a score function. It first tries prompt edits and, only when prompt optimization appears insufficient, changes chain structure within the permitted scope when attribution identifies a structural bottleneck. Across six benchmarks and three task models, FAPO beats the baseline GEPA in 15 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. In 11 model-benchmark comparisons, FAPO wins with non-overlapping mean $\pm$ trial-standard-deviation ranges, and the mean FAPO-GEPA gain is +14.1 pp. In the six HoVer and IFBench comparisons where prompt-first search escalated to structural changes, FAPO wins all six with a mean gain of +33.8 pp. FAPO also improves performance on security tasks: on CTIBench-RCM, a security CVE-to-CWE task, prompt-only FAPO lifts test accuracy by +4.0 pp on GPT-5, +7.1 pp on Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct, and +2.0 pp on Foundation-Sec-8B-Reasoning. These results position FAPO as a state-of-the-art pipeline optimization technique for both general-purpose and security-focused tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAPO（全自动提示优化）框架，用于优化多步骤 LLM 管道。该框架通过评估管道、检查中间步骤、诊断失败、提出局部修改并迭代验证变体来优化评分函数，先尝试提示编辑，仅在必要时改变链结构。在六个基准和三个任务模型上，FAPO 在 18 次模型-基准比较中 15 次优于基线 GEPA，平均增益 +14.1 个百分点；在需要结构升级的任务中平均增益 +33.8 个百分点；在安全任务上也取得显著提升。
Motivation: 多步骤 LLM 管道因检索、推理和格式化步骤之间的交互而失败，仅优化提示可能遗漏链中的瓶颈。
Method: FAPO 让 Claude Code 在标准化代码库内优化 LLM 管道：先评估管道并检查中间步骤，诊断失败原因，提出局部修改，然后重复验证变体以优化评分函数。如果提示编辑不足以提升，当属性分析识别出结构瓶颈时，允许在允许范围内改变链结构。
Result: 在六个基准（包括 HoVer、IFBench 等）和三个任务模型上，FAPO 在 18 个模型-基准比较中 15 次击败 GEPA，其中 11 次具有非重叠的均值±试验标准差范围，平均增益 +14.1 个百分点。在提示优先搜索升级为结构改变的六次比较中，FAPO 全部获胜，平均增益 +33.8 个百分点。在安全任务 CTIBench-RCM 上，仅提示编辑就使 GPT-5 的测试准确率提升 +4.0 个百分点，Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct 提升 +7.1 个百分点，Foundation-Sec-8B-Reasoning 提升 +2.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要将 FAPO 定位为通用和安全任务的最先进管道优化技术。

papers.title: Comparing Linear Probes with Mahalanobis Cosine Similarity
papers.abstract_en: Linear probes are widely used in interpretability research and often compared by cosine similarity. The Mahalanobis cosine similarity (MCS) between two directions, which reweights the inner product by test data covariance, is a natural task-aware refinement. Ying et al. (2026) report that a probe's MCS to a reference probe trained on the out-of-distribution (OOD) data near-perfectly linearly predicts the probe's OOD AUROC (R^2 = 0.98). Here, we extend this empirical finding across models, layers, and concept domains, and prove this general phenomenon in closed form: For balanced classes whose projections are Gaussian, OOD AUROC and MCS to the reference probe are linear because both are sigmoid-shaped functions of the probe's signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) on the test data. The theory also predicts when this linearity fails, which we verify empirically. MCS offers a theoretically grounded and empirically effective alternative to Euclidean cosine similarity for comparing linear probes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线性探针的比较方法，证明马氏余弦相似度（MCS）与探针的OOD AUROC之间存在线性关系（R²=0.98），并从理论和实验上验证了该关系在多种模型、层和概念域中的普适性。
Motivation: 现有可解释性研究中广泛使用余弦相似度比较线性探针，但缺乏理论依据。本文旨在提出并证明马氏余弦相似度作为更有效的替代度量。
Method: 通过理论推导，证明在平衡类且投影为高斯分布时，OOD AUROC与MCS均为探针信噪比（SNR）的S形函数，从而导出两者线性关系。并用跨模型、跨层实验验证理论预测及失效条件。
Result: MCS与OOD AUROC的线性关系R²高达0.98，且理论预测了线性成立与失效的条件，实验验证一致。
Conclusion: 马氏余弦相似度是一种有理论依据且经验有效的线性探针比较方法，优于欧几里得余弦相似度。

papers.title: Configurable Clinical Information Extraction with Agentic RAG: What Works, What Breaks, and Why
papers.abstract_en: Patient contexts span hundreds of heterogeneous documents and thousands of structured data points, yet the document-level metadata that AI systems need for retrieval and triage is absent or incomplete. Standard retrieval-augmented generation fails on this data, mishandling temporal reasoning, cross-document dependencies, and missing metadata. We deploy ACIE (Agentic Clinical Information Extraction) at University Medicine Essen: an on-premise agentic RAG pipeline that reasons over complete patient contexts and grounds every answer in source passages for clinician verification. We quantify the metadata gap, trace the architectural decisions it shaped, and evaluate extraction alongside an independent retrospective lymphoma registry study, in which nuclear-medicine physicians verify every extracted value against its cited sources. Across 7,326 judgments, clinicians accepted 96.5\% of extractions, with per-type acceptance ranging from 80\% to 99\%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨在临床信息提取中使用代理RAG（Agentic RAG）的配置问题，提出ACIE系统，并在大学医学中心部署，通过独立回顾性研究验证，医生接受率96.5%。
Motivation: 患者病历包含大量异构文档和结构化数据，但AI系统所需的元数据缺失或不完整，标准RAG无法处理时间推理、跨文档依赖和缺失元数据。
Method: 提出ACIE（Agentic Clinical Information Extraction），一个本地部署的代理RAG管道，推理完整的患者病历，并将每个答案基于源段落以供医生验证。
Result: 在7,326次判断中，临床医生接受了96.5%的抽取结果，各类型的接受率在80%到99%之间。
Conclusion: 论文量化了元数据差距，追踪了由此产生的架构决策，并通过独立的回顾性淋巴瘤注册研究评估了抽取效果。
Relevance: 0
