papers.title: PrefSQA: Pairwise Preference Prediction for Speech Quality Assessment and the Critical Role of High Quality Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Mean opinion scores (MOS) are widely used for speech quality assessment, yet scalar labels are sensitive to rater variability and listening test differences. This introduces labeling noise, which limits the reliability of MOS prediction. Preference prediction reduces this variability as listeners compare signals directly, producing cleaner labels. We study MOS-free preference prediction and propose PrefSQA, which incorporates uncertainty-aware logits, an impairment attention head, and a module based on non-matching-reference comparisons. We use and refine five datasets, including MOS-derived and low-noise simulated sets with matching and non-matching content, experiment with human preference sets, and test on unseen data. Experiments show small improvements on MOS-derived data, while other sets reveal clear improvement over the baselines, highlighting the value of high-quality preference data and demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音质量评估中MOS评分对标注噪声敏感的问题，提出PrefSQA方法，包含不确定性感知logits、损伤注意力头和基于非匹配参考比较的模块，并改进五个数据集。实验表明，在MOS派生数据上性能小幅提升，而在其他低噪声偏好数据集上显著优于基线，验证了高质量偏好数据的价值。
Motivation: MOS标量分数受评分者变异性和听力测试差异影响，引入标签噪声，限制了预测可靠性。偏好预测通过直接比较信号减少变异性，获得更干净的标签。
Method: 提出PrefSQA，一种无MOS的偏好预测方法，结合不确定性感知logits、损伤注意力头，以及基于非匹配参考比较的模块；使用并细化了五个涵盖MOS派生与低噪声模拟数据集，包含匹配与非匹配内容。
Result: 在MOS派生数据上实现小幅改进，而在其他偏好数据集上相比基线有明显提升。
Conclusion: 高质量偏好数据对提升语音质量评估至关重要，所提方法在利用此类数据时表现有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IHBench: Evaluating Post-Interruption Recovery in Voice Agents with Structured Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Voice agents deployed in structured workflows (customer service, healthcare scheduling, account management) must handle frequent user interruptions while maintaining progress through multi-step procedures. Existing benchmarks for speech-capable models focus on the timing of interruptions: barge-in detection, endpointing, and turn-taking dynamics. They leave unmeasured what happens after the interruption: does the agent resume the workflow at the correct step? Does it address the user's interjection? Does it avoid re-delivering content the user already heard? We introduce IHBench (Interruption Handling Benchmark), a benchmark that evaluates post-interruption recovery in voice agents executing state-machine-driven workflows across 10 enterprise domains. Six interruption types are injected at controlled points mid-utterance, with per-interruption evaluation rubrics generated alongside the data. Each interruption is scored on two axes: task fulfillment and recovery quality. We evaluate 27 audio-language model configurations from OpenAI, Google, and the open-weight community. Models vary widely, and recovery quality depends strongly on the interruption type. Across our experiments, closed-weight models are consistently more robust to interruptions than open-weight ones: they win far more often on task fulfillment, degrade roughly 3.3x more slowly as conversations grow longer, and show no audio-versus-text modality gap, whereas the open-weight models lose ground on all three. A human study validates the LLM judge against human annotators, and a cross-benchmark analysis against AudioMultiChallenge indicates that recovery quality is a largely distinct capability axis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出IHBench，一个评估语音代理在结构化工作流中中断后恢复能力的基准。该基准涵盖10个企业领域，六种中断类型，从任务完成和恢复质量两个维度评分。实验评估了27个音频语言模型配置，发现闭源模型在中断鲁棒性上显著优于开源模型，且恢复质量与现有基准测试的能力正交。
Motivation: 现有语音模型基准主要关注中断时机（如插话检测、端点检测），而忽略了中断后代理能否正确恢复工作流程、回应用户插话、避免重复已传达内容等关键能力。
Method: 构建IHBench基准，在状态机驱动的语音代理工作流中注入六种中断类型，并生成对应的评估细则。采用LLM评判员对每个中断从任务完成和恢复质量两个维度评分，并通过人工研究验证评判员的可靠性。
Result: 评估27个模型配置，闭源模型在任务完成上胜率更高，随着对话变长性能下降速度比开源模型慢约3.3倍，且没有音频vs文本模态差距。跨基准分析显示恢复质量与现有基准（如AudioMultiChallenge）是几乎独立的能力维度。
Conclusion: 中断后恢复是语音代理的关键能力维度，现有模型差异显著，闭源模型更鲁棒，且该能力未被已有基准充分覆盖。

papers.title: Unsupervised Causal Abstractions Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Causal abstractions formalize when a high-level structural causal model (SCM) captures the interventional behavior of a lower-level SCM. Existing applications of this notion largely follow a hypothesis-testing paradigm: an expert proposes a candidate high-level model and then evaluates if the low-level system implements it. We study the complementary problem of learning a high-level model directly from low-level measurements. Our contributions leverage hypotheses from low-rank causal discovery, and can be summarized as follows: (1) we show that observations generated by a low-rank graph induce latents that form a causal abstraction, (2) we provide identifiability results about these latents, and (3) we propose a practical objective to learn this high-level SCM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从低层测量数据中直接学习高层结构因果模型（SCM），而无需专家预先指定候选模型。作者利用低秩因果发现假设，证明低秩图生成的观测可以诱导出构成因果抽象的潜在变量，给出可识别性结果，并提出一个实用目标函数来学习高层SCM。
Motivation: 现有因果抽象主要依赖专家提出候选高层模型并通过假设检验验证，缺乏自动发现高层模型的方法。
Method: 基于低秩因果发现假设，证明低秩图观测数据可诱导出形成因果抽象的潜在变量，提供可识别性理论，并设计一个实用目标函数来学习高层SCM。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 该方法能够从低层测量中直接学习高层SCM，拓展了因果抽象的应用范式。

papers.title: A BART-based approach with hierarchical strategy for Vietnamese abstractive multi-document summarization
papers.abstract_en: In this technical report, we focus on solving the challenge of Vietnamese multi-document abstractive summarization, introduced in the International Workshop on Vietnamese Language and Speech Processing (VLSP) 2022. We choose to follow the popular hierarchical approach, i.e. condensing each document followed by aggregation and summarization. We propose a novel yet simple strategy to shorten documents that is driven by the golden summary, thus ensuring high correlation between stages of the hierarchical approach. Our method achieves a ROUGE2-F1 score of 0.2468 on the VLSP's public test set, and can produce fluent and concise summaries. Additionally, we utilize external sources for extra data, which greatly enhances the quantity of data for Vietnamese multi-document summarization. The additional data is made available for the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对越南语多文档抽象摘要（multi-document abstractive summarization）任务，采用层次化方法（先压缩各文档再聚合摘要），提出一种由参考摘要驱动的文档缩短策略。该方法在VLSP 2022公开测试集上取得ROUGE2-F1为0.2468，生成的摘要流畅简洁。此外，作者利用外部数据扩充训练集，并将额外数据公开。
Motivation: 越南语多文档摘要面临数据稀缺和文档间冗余的挑战，现有层次化方法中各阶段相关性不足。
Method: 遵循先压缩文档再聚合摘要的层次化框架，核心创新是利用golden summary指导文档压缩，使压缩阶段与后续摘要阶段高度相关。
Result: 在VLSP 2022测试集上达到ROUGE2-F1 0.2468，生成摘要流畅简洁；通过引入外部数据显著增加了训练数据量。
Conclusion: 该策略简单有效，公开的额外数据可促进越南语多文档摘要研究。

papers.title: Analyzing the Narration Gap in LLM-Solver Loops
papers.abstract_en: Formal tools such as SAT and SMT solvers are increasingly embedded in language model reasoning pipelines when a safety or security critical question can be formulated in logic. Unlike chain of thought whose steps are sampled from the model distribution without formal guarantee, a solver produces a sound and independently verifiable answer. However, the soundness guarantee can be lost in the interaction between the solver and the model. The hybrid pipeline has three components: formalizing the question, deciding it, and narrating the result. Prior work has studied the formalization and decision, but not narration, which is the step that turns a formal tool's output into the user answer. To fill the narration gap, we first model the LLM-solver loop as a verified decision procedure. We further evaluate five open-sourced models under prompt injection, and we find certificate gating makes the solver verdict sound, while an adversary can invert a verified conclusion across phrasings and channels. We study the mitigation through hardened prompt that reduces injection significantly but cannot eliminate it and still suffers under adaptive attack. Combining the formal analysis and empirical studies, we show in the LLM-solver loop, robustness does not reach to the answer that the user finally reads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）与形式化求解器（SAT/SMT）组成的混合推理流水线中的“叙述鸿沟”（narration gap），即求解器输出结果到最终用户答案的转化步骤。作者将LLM-求解器循环建模为可验证的决策过程，并通过实验发现，即使使用证书门控（certificate gating）确保求解器结论的可靠性，攻击者仍能通过提示注入（prompt injection）反转已验证的结论。研究还测试了强化提示（hardened prompt）的缓解效果，发现虽能显著减少注入，但无法完全消除，且在自适应攻击下依然脆弱。结合形式化分析与实证研究，论文指出在LLM-求解器循环中，鲁棒性并未延伸到用户最终读取的答案。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注LLM-求解器循环中的形式化（formalization）和决策（decision）步骤，但忽略了叙述（narration）步骤——即将形式化工具的输出转化为用户答案的过程。这一步骤可能破坏求解器的可靠性保证，形成“叙述鸿沟”。
Method: 首先将LLM-求解器循环建模为可验证的决策过程，然后通过提示注入攻击评估五种开源模型在叙述步骤中的鲁棒性，并试验证书门控和强化提示作为缓解措施。
Result: 证书门控可以保证求解器结论的可靠性，但对抗方仍能通过不同措辞和通道反转已验证的结论。强化提示能显著减少注入攻击，但不能完全消除，且在自适应攻击下仍然失效。
Conclusion: 在LLM-求解器循环中，鲁棒性未能延伸到最终用户读取的答案，叙述步骤是安全关键薄弱环节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Solver-Free Training Method for Predict-then-Optimize
papers.abstract_en: We propose a scalable method for training prediction (machine learning) models in the predict-then-optimize paradigm, where model outputs serve as coefficients for a subsequent linear optimization task. Directly minimizing the empirical decision regret is intractable for linear programming and combinatorial optimization since the decision mapping is piecewise constant, and the gradients are zero almost everywhere. While existing methods address this by smoothing the differentiation process, they suffer from scalability issues, since a computationally expensive solver call is required for every gradient evaluation. To address this, we propose a decision-focused learning pipeline based on a measure transformation principle, which yields a new surrogate loss that is completely optimization-solver-free during training. We establish theoretical guarantees, including Fisher consistency and excess risk bounds. Empirically, our method achieves decision quality competitive with state-of-the-art methods while reducing training time by orders of magnitude.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无求解器（solver-free）的预测-优化（predict-then-optimize）训练方法，通过测度变换原理构造替代损失函数，使得训练过程中无需调用昂贵的优化求解器。理论证明该方法满足Fisher一致性并给出过量风险界。实验表明该方法在决策质量上与现有方法持平，但训练时间降低数个数量级。
Motivation: 现有的预测-优化方法在训练时需要对每个梯度评估调用一次优化求解器，计算成本高昂，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 基于测度变换（measure transformation）原理设计新的替代损失函数，使得训练过程完全避免求解器调用，同时保持决策导向学习的有效性。
Result: 在多个基准上，决策质量与当前最优方法相当，但训练时间降低了数个数量级。
Conclusion: 该无求解器训练方法为预测-优化范式提供了一种高效且理论可保证的替代方案。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Language-Instructed Vision Embeddings for Controllable and Generalizable Perception
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models are typically trained as static feature extractors, placing the burden of task adaptation onto large downstream models. We propose an alternative paradigm: instead of solely feeding visual features into language models, we use language itself to dynamically guide the vision encoder. Our method, Language-Instructed Vision Embeddings (LIVE), leverages language as high-level guidance to produce task-centric embeddings at inference time, removing the need for task-specific retraining. This enables the encoder to focus on contextually relevant aspects of the input, yielding more controllable and generalizable representations. Empirically, LIVE reduces visual hallucinations (+34 points on MMVP), surpasses vision-language models with orders of magnitude more parameters on visual question answering, and generalizes to unseen instructions and tasks -- offering a direct path toward adaptive, instruction-driven visual intelligence.
papers.journal_ref: Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语言指导视觉嵌入（LIVE），利用语言动态引导视觉编码器生成任务中心嵌入，无需任务特定重训练。该方法在减少视觉幻觉（MMVP上+34分）和视觉问答上超越更大模型，并泛化到未见指令和任务。
Motivation: 现有视觉基础模型作为静态特征提取器，任务适应依赖大型下游模型，缺乏灵活性和可控性。
Method: 通过语言作为高层指导，在推理时动态调整视觉编码器输出，生成与任务相关的嵌入。
Result: 在MMVP基准上视觉幻觉降低34个百分点，视觉问答性能优于参数多数量级的模型，且泛化到未见指令。
Conclusion: 提供一种自适应、指令驱动的视觉智能路径，使编码器聚焦上下文相关特征，无需任务特定重训练。

papers.title: A Land-Sea Contrast Pattern in Surface Temperature and Atmospheric Circulation Trends in Recent Decades
papers.abstract_en: Spatial patterns in observed climate trends remain poorly understood. Here we argue that a warming of land relative to ocean has shaped observed surface temperature and atmospheric circulation trends, including the negative Inter-Decadal Pacific Oscillation (IPO)-like tendency across the Pacific basin. Observed and modeled trends display an overall decline in sea level pressure over the faster-warming land relative to ocean, with a spatial pattern that resembles the seasonal cycle and the response to land heating in idealized climate model experiments. Coupled climate model simulations with historical forcing underestimate the land-sea warming ratio. It is only in the early response of abrupt CO2 quadrupling climate model simulations that climate models are able to recreate the observed land-sea warming ratio, in which case a strengthening of oceanic surface highs and a negative IPO-like surface warming pattern over the Pacific comparable to observed trends are seen. We propose that discrepancies between modeled and observed trends in many climate variables may be explained by the underestimation of the land-sea warming ratio by climate models. Determining the cause of this discrepancy has the potential to constrain projections of future climate change as the underlying mechanism causing climate models to underestimate the land-sea warming ratio discrepancy will set the persistence of this problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析近几十年地表温度和大气环流趋势中陆地和海洋的对比模式，指出陆地相对于海洋的快速变暖塑造了观测到的趋势，包括太平洋负IPO-like型。气候模型在历史强迫下低估了海陆增温比率，只有在CO2骤增四倍的早期响应中才能再现观测到的比率。作者认为模型与观测的许多差异可能源于海陆增温比率低估。
Motivation: 观测到的气候趋势空间模式仍未被充分理解，尤其是陆地与海洋增温差异及其对环流的影响，而气候模型对此存在系统性偏差。
Method: 对比观测数据和气候模型模拟（历史强迫和CO2骤增四倍实验）的海陆增温比率及海平面气压趋势，结合理想化气候模型实验的季节循环和陆地加热响应进行分析。
Result: 观测和模式均显示陆地相对海洋的较快增温导致海平面气压下降，且空间模式类似季节循环；但历史强迫模拟低估了海陆增温比率，仅在CO2骤增四倍早期响应中才能再现观测比率，此时出现太平洋负IPO-like型。
Conclusion: 气候模型低估海陆增温比率可能是模型与观测在多个气候变量上差异的主要原因，解决这一偏差对约束未来气候变化预估至关重要。

papers.title: Machine Learning Integrated in Wavelet Shrinkage (MLShrink)
papers.abstract_en: Data encountered in practice are frequently contaminated by additive noise, and wavelet shrinkage remains a fundamental tool for recovering underlying signals in nonparametric estimation. Classical procedures such as hard and soft thresholding decide whether to retain a wavelet coefficient almost entirely from its magnitude. Although effective in many settings, these rules can be too rigid for coefficients whose magnitudes fall in an intermediate region where the distinction between signal and noise is uncertain. We propose MLShrink, a two-threshold wavelet denoising procedure that combines wavelet shrinkage with machine learning. Coefficients below a lower threshold are discarded, coefficients above an upper threshold are retained, and coefficients in the intermediate band are classified using local wavelet-domain features. In this way, MLShrink preserves the simplicity of classical thresholding away from the decision boundary while allowing data-adaptive decisions for ambiguous coefficients. The paper also develops a theoretical framework tailored to this architecture. We show that MLShrink is a nonexpansive support-selection rule, derive an oracle-based risk decomposition showing that excess denoising risk is determined by classification errors on the undecided band, and establish an oracle-consistency result under suitable assumptions on classifier performance. Simulation experiments on standard benchmark signals indicate that MLShrink is competitive with several established wavelet shrinkage methods and is especially effective for signals with irregular, edge-rich, or non-smooth structure. These findings suggest that learned decisions on the intermediate threshold band provide a useful and interpretable connection between classical wavelet denoising and modern statistical learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MLShrink，一种结合机器学习与小波收缩的两阈值去噪方法。通过设置低阈值和高阈值，中间带系数用局部小波域特征分类。理论表明MLShrink是非扩张的支持选择规则，并给出风险分解和一致性。实验上对不规则、边缘丰富的信号有效。
Motivation: 经典小波阈值去噪规则（硬阈值、软阈值）在系数幅度处于信号与噪声难以区分的中等区域时过于刚性，需要更灵活的数据自适应决策。
Method: MLShrink使用两个阈值：低于低阈值的系数丢弃，高于高阈值的保留，中间带系数利用局部小波域特征通过机器学习分类器决定保留或丢弃。同时提供理论分析。
Result: 在标准基准信号仿真实验中，MLShrink与多种经典小波收缩方法竞争，尤其对不规则、边缘丰富或非光滑结构的信号更有效。
Conclusion: 该工作为经典小波去噪与现代统计学习之间提供了有用且可解释的连接，但可能不适用于特定领域。

papers.title: FlowFake: Liquid Networks for Audio Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Audio deepfakes generated by neural text-to-speech and voice-cloning systems threaten speaker verification and public discourse at scale. The core challenge is cross-dataset generalization: detectors trained on one synthesis pipeline collapse on unseen forgeries. We argue that this failure is primarily because of structural synthetic speech artifacts which are multi-timescale trajectory anomalies. Though every existing detector aggregates a fixed-window frame statistics, this misaligns the architecture with the signal. We propose FlowFake, a Liquid Time-Constant (LTC) architecture whose hidden state evolves via a learned ODE, with per-neuron adaptive time constants simultaneously resolving spectral (10ms) and prosodic (2s) cues. At only 34K parameters FlowFake achieves formal BIBO stability and O(dt^4) integration error. On a four-dataset cross domain benchmark (ASVspoof2019-LA, FakeOrReal, InTheWild, MLAAD), FlowFake reaches 75.29% on ASVspoof2019 trained only on FakeOrReal and 79.97% trained only on MLAAD. It outperforms RawGAT-ST and Whisper-DF on every evaluated pair and matching SSL Wav2vec2 (300x larger) at 0.01% of its parameter count. The source code is available on : https://github.com/GhostRider2023/FlowFake

papers.title: FrequencyFormer: A Co-Designed Sensor-to-Processor Pipeline for Frequency-Domain Vision Transformer Inference
papers.abstract_en: Deploying vision transformers (ViTs) on sensor-edge systems is limited not only by on-device compute, but also by the energy and bandwidth required to transmit high-dimensional image data from the sensor to the processor. While in-sensor and near-sensor computing reduce this cost through early feature extraction, existing methods often provide only modest compression. We observe that the frequency domain provides a naturally compact representation of visual information and can be exploited at the sensor level to reduce sensor-to-processor data movement. Building on this insight, we present FrequencyFormer, a co-designed sensor-to-processor pipeline for efficient ViT inference. FrequencyFormer includes: (1) a multi-scale DCT tokenizer that compresses a 224x224 image into compact frequency-domain tokens, achieving up to 128x reduction in off-chip data volume with modest accuracy loss; (2) a LUT-based near-sensor hardware implementation that leverages fixed DCT coefficients for multiplier-free, energy- and area-efficient tokenization; and (3) a modified MIPI-based low-power communication architecture that further reduces transfer energy. FrequencyFormer serves as a drop-in replacement for standard ViT patch embedding and remains compatible with pretrained backbones across classification, detection, and segmentation tasks. The pipeline achieves 28.8 TOPS/W, reduces communication energy by 230x, and lowers total sensor-side energy by 2.22x, demonstrating frequency-domain tokenization as a scalable foundation for in-sensor ViT deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FrequencyFormer，一种协同设计的传感器到处理器流水线，用于高效视觉Transformer推理。通过多尺度DCT分词器将224x224图像压缩为频域token，实现最高128倍离片数据量压缩；基于查找表的近传感器硬件实现无乘法器token化；并采用修改的MIPI低功耗通信架构。在分类、检测、分割任务中保持与预训练骨干兼容，实现28.8 TOPS/W能效，通信能耗降低230倍，传感器侧总能耗降低2.22倍。
Motivation: 在传感器边缘系统部署视觉Transformer受限于设备计算能力以及传感器到处理器传输高维图像的能耗和带宽。现有近传感器计算方法压缩率有限。
Method: 提出包含三部分的流水线：(1) 多尺度DCT分词器，将224x224图像压缩为频域token，最高128倍压缩；(2) 基于查找表的近传感器硬件实现，利用固定DCT系数实现无乘子、高能效token化；(3) 修改的MIPI低功耗通信架构。
Result: 流水线实现28.8 TOPS/W能效，通信能耗降低230倍，传感器侧总能耗降低2.22倍；在分类、检测、分割任务中保持与预训练骨干兼容。
Conclusion: 频域token化可作为传感器内ViT部署的可扩展基础，有效降低数据移动能耗。

papers.title: On the QUEST for Uncertainty Quantification via Highest Density Regions
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for reliable decision-making in safety-critical applications in probabilistic machine learning. For regression problems, dominant scalar UQ approaches - notably, those based on proper scoring rules - measure uncertainty via pointwise predictive risk. This can lead to counterintuitive results when the target statistic is not the conditional expectation. We propose an alternative framework, in which uncertainty is characterised by the volume of the most probable subset of a distribution's support. QUEST (Quantifying Uncertainty via highest dEnSiTy regions) is a novel approach to UQ based on the concentration of Lebesgue measure at a distribution's peak(s), evaluated at one or more values of a robustness parameter $α$. We establish connections between our measures and classical statistics from information theory and economics. We show that, unlike popular alternatives based on proper scoring rules, QUEST measures of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty satisfy a set of axioms adapted from the UQ literature, including monotonicity under distributional spread and invariance to location shifts. Selective prediction benchmarks confirm that QUEST performs favourably against standard measures such as variance and differential entropy.
papers.comment: 27 pages, of which 10 are main text. Contains 7 figures, 4 tables, 1 algorithm in total
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对概率机器学习中不确定性量化（UQ）的局限性，提出基于最高密度区域（HDR）的量化方法QUEST。摘要证明其满足单调性、位置不变性等公理，并在选择性预测基准上优于方差和微分熵等标准度量。
Motivation: 现有基于适当评分规则的标量UQ方法在回归问题中可能因目标统计量不是条件期望而产生反直觉结果，需要更鲁棒的不确定性度量。
Method: 提出QUEST框架，通过分布支撑集上最可能子集的体积（基于Lebesgue测度集中于峰值的程度）来量化不确定性，并引入鲁棒性参数α来评估。
Result: 摘要表明QUEST满足从UQ文献中改编的一组公理（包括分布扩散下的单调性和位置平移不变性），并在选择性预测基准上优于方差和微分熵。
Conclusion: QUEST提供了一种基于最高密度区域的不确定性量化新途径，在理论上和实验中均表现出优于传统度量的性质。

papers.title: Exploring Feature Extraction Technique Parameters for Acoustic Gunshot Classification
papers.abstract_en: Acoustic gunshot detection is a problem with applications across civilian public safety, military operations, and wildlife conservation, yet the field lacks a rigorous exploration of feature extraction techniques with a focus on generalization to realistic data. The mixed effectiveness of commercial gunshot detection and classification systems indicates an open problem that is not adequately addressed by the current literature. In this paper, we present a systematic investigation of common feature extraction techniques using a dataset of 23,000 gunshot recordings across 85 firearms and 21 calibers. We benchmark three feature extraction techniques with 12 total unique parameter sets using ResNet-18. Our results demonstrate that using the correct feature extraction technique can improve top-1 accuracy by up to 20%, and utilizing the correct parameters for a given feature extraction technique can improve that value by up to 4.7%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了声学枪声分类中特征提取技术参数的影响，使用包含23,000条枪声录音的数据集，在ResNet-18上比较了三种特征提取技术及12种参数组合。结果表明，选择合适的特征提取技术可将top-1准确率提升最多20%，同一技术内优化参数可进一步提升最多4.7%。
Motivation: 现有商用枪声检测分类系统效果参差不齐，文献缺乏对特征提取技术及其参数对真实数据泛化性能的严格探索。
Method: 使用包含23,000条枪声录音（涵盖85种枪械和21种口径）的数据集，在ResNet-18上对三种特征提取技术及其12种参数组合进行系统基准测试。
Result: 使用正确的特征提取技术可将top-1准确率提升最多20%；同一技术内使用正确参数可进一步提升最多4.7%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调特征提取技术及其参数的选择对枪声分类性能有显著影响。

papers.title: GDGU: A Gradient Difference-based Graph Unlearning Method for Cyberattack Localization in Electric Vehicle Charging Networks
papers.abstract_en: Electric vehicle charging stations (EVCSs) can expose distribution feeders to cyberattacks. While machine learning methods, including graph neural networks, can localize which bus is compromised, significant challenges remain in data sharing and model training. For example, privacy regulations grant EVCS owners the right to delete their training data from a deployed model, yet retraining from scratch on every request is computationally prohibitive. To address this, we study graph unlearning (GU) for EVCS cyberattack localization, formulated as a feature-level unlearning problem on a graph-level multi-label classification task. Specifically, we propose gradient difference-based graph unlearning (GDGU), which removes the influence of the requested deletion data through a first-order parameter correction. The correction is computed from the gradient difference between the original training data and a modified dataset in which only the charging power features at the requested EVCS buses are unlearned. Then, a batch-normalization recalibration and a brief recovery fine-tuning step are applied to restore localization utility. We benchmark GDGU against two second-order GU baselines on the IEEE 34-bus, 123-bus, and 8500-node distribution networks across three graph neural network backbones and cumulative unlearning scenarios. GDGU matches the strongest baseline on localization utility and reaches forgetting fidelity close to full-retraining, while unlearning 10 to 12 times faster than retraining from scratch and using far less memory than the second-order GU baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究电动汽车充电网络中的网络攻击定位问题，提出基于梯度差异的图遗忘方法（GDGU），用于在用户请求删除训练数据时高效移除特定数据的影响。实验表明，GDGU在遗忘效果上与完整重训练相近，但速度快10-12倍，且内存消耗远低于二阶基线方法。
Motivation: 电动汽车充电站数据涉及隐私，用户有权要求删除其训练数据，但完整重训练成本过高。现有图神经网络攻击定位方法未考虑数据遗忘需求，缺乏高效的图遗忘解决方案。
Method: 提出GDGU方法，通过一阶参数修正移除请求删除数据的影响，修正量基于原始训练数据与修改后数据（仅遗忘请求充电站的充电功率特征）的梯度差异，并辅以批归一化重校准和短恢复微调。
Result: 在IEEE 34节点、123节点和8500节点配电网络上，使用三种图神经网络骨干网络和累积遗忘场景，GDGU在定位效用上匹配最强基线，遗忘保真度接近完整重训练，遗忘速度比重训练快10-12倍，内存使用远少于二阶基线。
Conclusion: GDGU为电动汽车充电网络攻击定位提供了一种高效、隐私合规的图遗忘方案，但方法泛化性及在更复杂攻击场景下的表现需进一步验证。

papers.title: Mix-QVLA: Task-Evidence-Aware Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose Mix-QVLA, a task-evidence-aware mixed-precision PTQ framework for VLA models. Mix-QVLA anchors each quantized variant to the full-precision action-token reference decision and evaluates whether quantization preserves task-relevant evidence across key VLA functional boundaries. It computes normalized gradient-weighted task-evidence maps from boundary activations and compares full-precision and quantized maps using evidence-mass and attribution-distribution distortion, capturing changes in both the strength and allocation of decision-supporting evidence. A soft-bottleneck objective aggregates boundary-level degradation into layer-wise sensitivity scores. Mix-QVLA further models sensitivity throughout task execution, capturing phase-dependent shifts in layer importance rather than assuming a fixed sensitivity profile. The resulting evidence- and time-aware scores guide mixed-precision bit allocation under model-size and BitOps budgets. Extensive evaluations on OpenVLA-style policies show that Mix-QVLA improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off of low-bit VLA deployment. On LIBERO, Mix-QVLA reduces OpenVLA-OFT memory from 15.4 GB to 4.1 GB, retains 96.3 average success compared with 97.1 for the BF16 model, and achieves a 1.52x inference speedup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Mix-QVLA 是一种面向视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的混合精度后训练量化（PTQ）框架，通过任务证据感知的位宽分配提升低比特部署的精度-效率权衡。该方法计算全精度与量化模型在关键边界上的梯度加权任务证据图，利用证据质量和分布失真度量层敏感度，并建模执行过程中的阶段依赖重要性变化。在 OpenVLA 策略上的实验表明，Mix-QVLA 将 LIBERO 任务中 OpenVLA-OFT 的内存从 15.4 GB 降至 4.1 GB，平均成功率保持 96.3%（BF16 为 97.1%），推理加速 1.52 倍。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 量化方法未充分考虑任务相关证据在量化过程中的保留，且忽略推理阶段中层重要性的动态变化，导致低比特部署下精度损失显著。
Method: 提出 Mix-QVLA，包含：1) 计算全精度与量化模型在边界激活上的归一化梯度加权任务证据图；2) 利用证据质量和分布失真度量层敏感度；3) 通过软瓶颈目标聚合边界级退化得到层敏感度分数；4) 在模型尺寸和 BitOps 预算下进行证据和时间感知的混合精度位宽分配。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，OpenVLA-OFT 量化至 4.1 GB（原 15.4 GB），平均成功率 96.3%（BF16 为 97.1%），推理速度提升 1.52 倍。
Conclusion: Mix-QVLA 通过任务证据感知和时间动态建模，有效改善了 VLA 模型低比特部署的精度-效率权衡，且无需额外训练。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有 VLA 量化方法未充分考虑任务相关证据在量化过程中的保留，且忽略推理阶段中层重要性的动态变化，导致低比特部署下精度损失显著。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Mix-QVLA，包含：1) 计算全精度与量化模型在边界激活上的归一化梯度加权任务证据图；2) 利用证据质量和分布失真度量层敏感度；3) 通过软瓶颈目标聚合边界级退化得到层敏感度分数；4) 在模型尺寸和 BitOps 预算下进行证据和时间感知的混合精度位宽分配。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，OpenVLA-OFT 量化至 4.1 GB（原 15.4 GB），平均成功率 96.3%（BF16 为 97.1%），推理速度提升 1.52 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: Mix-QVLA 通过任务证据感知和时间动态建模，有效改善了 VLA 模型低比特部署的精度-效率权衡，且无需额外训练。

papers.title: Advances in Scientific Machine Learning for Coupled Fluid Flow and Transport
papers.abstract_en: This chapter reviews recent advances in Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) for modeling coupled fluid flow and transport phenomena governed by the incompressible Navier-Stokes and scalar transport equations. Such systems, found in applications like turbidity currents and thermal convection, feature strong nonlinear coupling and multiscale behavior that make high-fidelity simulations computationally expensive. To address this, the chapter surveys state-of-the-art SciML methods for building efficient surrogate models, including linear reduced-order techniques based on Singular Value Decomposition (such as Dynamic Mode Decomposition) and nonlinear neural network approaches like Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) and $β$-Variational Autoencoders ($β$-VAEs). It first covers the authors' work combining these models with High Performance Computing strategies, including Adaptive Mesh Refinement/Coarsening (AMR/C) and scientific floating-point data compression. It then presents two new contributions: surrogate modeling of turbidity currents via PINNs, and the extraction of disentangled nonlinear modes from thermal flows using $β$-VAEs. Governing equations and representative benchmarks, including lock-exchange flows and Rayleigh-Bénard convection, illustrate these methodologies. The chapter is intentionally long, covering both the mathematical and physical foundations of coupled fluid flow and the computational aspects of state-of-the-art modeling. Overall, it demonstrates how SciML enables fast, accurate approximations of complex coupled systems within the specific data regimes and modeling assumptions considered, while substantially reducing computational cost relative to full-order simulations. Broader capabilities such as real-time prediction and uncertainty quantification remain active research directions whose feasibility depends strongly on the problem at hand.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了科学机器学习（SciML）在耦合流体流动与输运现象建模中的最新进展，重点介绍了基于奇异值分解的线性降阶技术和基于物理信息的神经网络（PINNs）与β-变分自编码器（β-VAEs）等非线性方法。文章展示了作者在高性能计算、自适应网格加密/粗化（AMR/C）和数据压缩方面的工作，并提出了两个新贡献：利用PINNs构建浊流代理模型，以及使用β-VAEs从热对流中提取解缠非线性模态。通过锁交换流和瑞利-贝纳德对流的基准测试验证了方法的有效性，表明SciML能在特定数据场景下大幅降低计算成本。
Motivation: 耦合流体流动与输运现象（如浊流和热对流）具有强非线性和多尺度特征，高保真仿真计算代价高昂，亟需高效的代理模型来降低计算成本。
Method: 综述了多种SciML方法，包括基于SVD的动态模态分解（线性降阶）以及PINNs和β-VAEs（非线性神经网络），并结合自适应网格加密/粗化和科学浮点数据压缩等高性能计算策略。
Result: 在锁交换流和瑞利-贝纳德对流等基准测试中，代理模型能快速提供准确近似，显著降低计算成本。
Conclusion: SciML能在特定数据条件下实现快速准确的近似，但实时预测和不确定性量化等更广泛能力仍取决于具体问题，是未来的研究方向。

papers.title: Understanding Key Features of Time Series Foundation Models from Epidemic Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Seasonal influenza infects millions of people and causes substantial morbidity and mortality in the United States each year, making accurate short-term forecasting a core public-health need. Reliable forecasts of epidemic time series can inform vaccination timing, hospital staffing, and resource allocation, yet the comparative behavior of modern forecasting architectures on infectious-disease surveillance data remains insufficiently characterized. We address this gap through a systematic evaluation of regional influenza forecasting using influenza-like illness surveillance and influenza-associated hospitalization time series under both temporal and spatial generalization settings for 1-4-week-ahead prediction. We compare classical neural network architectures, numerical transformer-based models, pretrained time series foundation models, and LLM-based forecasting approaches. Across tasks, we demonstrate that a mixture-of-experts model that fuses multiple pretrained forecasters achieves the strongest overall performance, indicating that heterogeneous pretrained representations provide complementary predictive information. Our results further show that numerical transformer-based models produce reliable forecasts, while pretraining provides the largest gains at longer horizons, particularly when the pretraining domain is mechanistically aligned with influenza dynamics. In contrast, LLM-based time series methods underperform relative to numerical forecasters in this setting. Finally, we examine hospitalization information as both an auxiliary covariate and a pretraining source. Hospitalization signals provide complementary improvements in selected settings and clarify when additional surveillance streams enhance the robustness of multi-horizon forecasting. These findings provide actionable guidance on model selection, pretraining strategy, and auxiliary-signal use for influenza preparedness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了多种深度学习架构（经典神经网络、数值Transformer、预训练时间序列基础模型、基于LLM的方法）在区域流感预测中的表现。使用流感样病例监测和流感相关住院时间序列，在1-4周前瞻预测的时间与空间泛化设置下进行比较。结果显示，融合多个预训练预测器的混合专家模型（mixture-of-experts）综合性能最优，预训练在较长预测周期带来最大收益，而LLM方法表现不佳。研究为流感防控中的模型选择、预训练策略和辅助信号使用提供了指导。
Motivation: 季节性流感每年导致严重发病和死亡，准确的短期预测是核心公共卫生需求。然而现代预测架构在传染病监测数据上的比较行为尚未得到充分刻画。
Method: 系统评估了经典神经网络、数值Transformer、预训练时间序列基础模型和基于LLM的预测方法，在时空泛化设定下进行1-4周前瞻的流感预测。特别提出了一种融合多个预训练预测器的混合专家模型。
Result: 混合专家模型整体表现最强；数值Transformer产生可靠预测；预训练在较长预测周期收益最大，尤其当预训练域与流感动力学机制对齐时；LLM方法表现不及数值预测器；住院信号作为辅助协变量在特定场景下提供互补改进。
Conclusion: 研究为流感防控提供了模型选择、预训练策略和辅助信号使用的可操作指导，但实验仅基于美国区域流感数据，泛化性可能有限。

papers.title: Uncertainty Decomposition for Clarification Seeking in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent position papers argue that the classical aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty framework is insufficient for interactive large language model (LLM) agents and call for underspecification-aware, decomposed, and communicable uncertainty representations that can unlock new agent capabilities such as proactive clarification seeking and shared mental-model building. Practical deployment constraints -- black-box APIs, interactive latency budgets, and the absence of labeled trajectories -- rule out logprob-based, multi-sampling, and training-based methods, leaving prompt-based estimation as the most viable family for surfacing such signals at deployment time. We answer this call with a simple prompt-based decomposition that separates action confidence from request uncertainty (u), enabling the agent to ask for clarification when the task specification is ambiguous. To evaluate it, we introduce two clarification-augmented benchmarks (WebShop-Clarification and ALFWorld-Clarification) in which 50% of tasks are deliberately underspecified, and systematically compare the proposed decomposition against ReAct+UE and Uncertainty-Aware Memory (UAM) across five LLM backbones (GPT-5.1, DeepSeek-v3.2-exp, GLM-4.7, Qwen3.5-35B, GPT-OSS-120B) on these variants together with the standard WebShop, ALFWorld, and REAL benchmarks for fault detection. Averaged across the five backbones, the proposed decomposition improves clarification F1 on ALFWorld-Clarification by 73% over ReAct+UE and by 36% over UAM, and leads clarification F1 on every backbone on WebShop-Clarification and on four of five backbones on ALFWorld-Clarification, indicating that the gains generalize beyond a single LLM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对交互式LLM代理中主动寻求澄清的能力，提出基于prompt的不确定性分解方法，将行动置信度与请求不确定性（u）分离，使代理能在任务规格模糊时自动请求澄清。作者引入两个澄清增强基准（WebShop-Clarification和ALFWorld-Clarification），其中50%任务故意欠指定，并在五个LLM骨干上比较，验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有aleatoric/epistemic不确定性框架不足以支持交互式LLM代理的主动澄清和共享心智模型构建，且部署限制（黑盒API、延迟预算、无标签轨迹）排除了logprob、多采样和基于训练的方法，亟需一种可部署的prompt-based不确定性表示。
Method: 提出一种简单的基于prompt的不确定性分解，将行动置信度与请求不确定性（u）分开，使代理在任务规格模糊时能够主动请求澄清。同时引入WebShop-Clarification和ALFWorld-Clarification两个澄清增强基准，其中50%任务故意欠指定。
Result: 平均在五个LLM骨干上，该方法在ALFWorld-Clarification上的澄清F1比ReAct+UE提升73%，比UAM提升36%；在WebShop-Clarification上所有骨干均领先，在ALFWorld-Clarification上五个骨干中四个领先。
Conclusion: 结果表明所提出的分解方法在不同LLM骨干上泛化良好，显著提升澄清能力，且无需修改模型训练或访问内部log概率。

papers.title: Displacement Is Not Direction: Evaluating Fidelity Metrics for Quantized LLM Deployment
papers.abstract_en: Fidelity metrics, such as per-token KL divergence (KLD) against a high-precision reference, are often used in practice as low-cost proxies for benchmark quality. We test this practice on a 28-quant cohort of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and a 41-quant cohort of Devstral-Small-2-24B, evaluated across a suite of downstream benchmarks. We find that KLD is strongly correlated with benchmark score over the full cohort ($ρ=-0.72$ on Qwen and $ρ=-0.86$ on Devstral, both with $p<0.001$). However, this relationship collapses to non-significance in the near-baseline silent zone ($ρ=+0.00$ on Qwen and $ρ=-0.24$, $p=0.36$, on Devstral). This collapse persists across 14 measurement variants, including different KLD aggregations, perplexity formulations, top-1 agreement, calibration corpora, and context lengths. At the per-prompt level, KLD has only weak failure-prediction power on code, with failed-vs-passed geometric-mean ratios in $[1.08,1.22]$ across five models on LiveCodeBench, and fails as a cross-model router, achieving only $42.3\%-49.4\%$ accuracy on disagreement prompts. We trace the collapse to a structural decomposition: KLD primarily measures the volume of disagreement with the reference, with silent-zone composite $ρ=+0.94$ ($p<0.001$) on Qwen and $+0.55$ ($p=0.03$) on Devstral, while its relationship to the direction of those disagreements is weak and task-conditional.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文测试了量化LLM部署中保真度指标（如每token KL散度）作为下游基准质量代理的有效性。在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（28个量化点）和Devstral-Small-2-24B（41个量化点）上发现，KL散度在整个量化群组中与基准分数强相关，但在接近基线的“静默区”中相关性消失。进一步分析表明，KL散度主要衡量与参考的分歧量，而非分歧方向，这导致其在关键区域失效。
Motivation: 实践中常用保真度指标作为基准质量的低成本代理，但该做法在量化LLM部署中的有效性缺乏系统验证。
Method: 在两个大规模LLM的量化群组上，系统评估KL散度与下游基准分数的整体及局部相关性，并分解其结构成分（分歧量 vs. 分歧方向）。
Result: 整体相关性显著（ρ=-0.72和-0.86，p<0.001），但近基线静默区塌陷（ρ=+0.00和-0.24，p=0.36）。该现象在14种测量变体中持续，且KL散度在代码任务上的失败预测能力弱（成功/失败几何平均比1.08-1.22），作为跨模型路由器准确率仅42.3%-49.4%。
Conclusion: KL散度主要反映分歧量而非分歧方向，解释了其在静默区相关性失效的原因，应谨慎使用保真度指标作为代理。

papers.title: Predicting Mergeability of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning Updates
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) makes it cheap to train many domain- and task-specific language model adapters, but whether two adapters can be merged is usually discovered only after both have been fully trained and evaluated. This late feedback is costly: adapters that are strong in isolation can interfere destructively once their updates are combined. We ask whether this outcome can be anticipated. We formalize adapter mergeability as the degree to which an adapter preserves its single-task utility after merging, and show that it can be forecast from signals measured in the first few percent of training -- chiefly how the low-rank updates and their gradients align across tasks and how much they disturb shared representations. We package these signals into MergeProbe, a lightweight predictor that estimates pairwise and set-level retention and turns the estimate into a concrete decision: merge directly, reweight, prune, or route. On MERGE-PEFT, a five-domain benchmark spanning math, code, science, instruction following, and safety, MergeProbe attains the best average and worst-case retention among strong interference-aware merge baselines while adding far less deployment overhead than full task routing. This turns LoRA merging from a post-hoc engineering step into an anticipatory measurement problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MergeProbe，一种轻量级预测器，用于预测低秩适应（LoRA）适配器的可合并性（mergeability）。通过分析早期训练中的低秩更新和梯度对齐以及共享表示扰动，MergeProbe能够估计合并后的性能保持，并推荐合并、重加权、剪枝或路由等决策。在包含数学、代码、科学、指令遵循和安全五个领域的MERGE-PEFT基准上，MergeProbe在平均和最差情况下的性能保持方面优于强干扰感知合并基线，且部署开销远低于全任务路由。
Motivation: 现有LoRA适配器合并通常需要完全训练和评估后才能确定是否有效，这种滞后反馈成本高昂。本文旨在从早期训练信号中提前预测适配器的可合并性，避免不必要的训练开销。
Method: 形式化适配器可合并性为合并后保持单任务效用的程度，并设计MergeProbe预测器，利用早期训练中低秩更新和梯度的跨任务对齐以及共享表示扰动等信号，估计成对和集合级别的性能保持，进而做出合并、重加权、剪枝或路由的决策。
Result: 在MERGE-PEFT基准上，MergeProbe在平均和最差情况下的性能保持方面优于强干扰感知合并基线，且部署开销远低于全任务路由。
Conclusion: 本文表明LoRA适配器的合并可以从早期训练信号中预测，将合并从后验工程步骤转变为可预期的测量问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tracking Representation Dynamics in Large Language Models with Persistent Homology
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are commonly aligned through supervised fine-tuning, yet little is known about how their internal representations evolve during this process. We study alignment dynamics using persistent homology by tracking the topology of activation spaces throughout fine-tuning. Across four transformer language models ranging from 1B to 7B parameters and three alignment objectives corresponding to helpful, harmless, and mixed training data, we find that the majority of topological reorganization occurs during the earliest stages of training. A dense checkpoint analysis reveals a transient peak in topological activity followed by rapid stabilization. We further show that different alignment objectives induce distinguishable topological trajectories, while instruction-tuned and pretrained models exhibit qualitatively different patterns of evolution. Our results suggest that persistent homology provides a complementary perspective on alignment, revealing representation-level changes that are not apparent from behavioral metrics alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用持久同调（persistent homology）追踪大型语言模型在监督微调过程中激活空间的拓扑演化。在1B到7B参数的四个Transformer模型上，针对helpful、harmless和混合三种对齐目标，发现大部分拓扑重组发生在训练初期，出现短暂的拓扑活动峰值后迅速稳定。不同对齐目标导致可区分的拓扑轨迹，且指令微调与预训练模型表现出不同的演化模式。
Motivation: 大型语言模型通常通过对齐训练来调整行为，但其内部表示在微调过程中如何演化尚不清楚。
Method: 使用持久同调分析激活空间的拓扑结构，通过密集的检查点分析追踪微调过程中的表示动力学。
Result: 拓扑重组主要发生在训练早期；出现短暂的拓扑活动峰值后迅速稳定；不同对齐目标产生不同的拓扑轨迹；指令微调与预训练模型演化模式不同。
Conclusion: 持久同调提供了对齐的互补视角，揭示了行为指标无法直接观察到的表示层面的变化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Overfitted high-dimensional matrix factorizations via adaptive spectral shrinkage
papers.abstract_en: Factor models are popular approaches for analyzing high-dimensional data to extract low-rank signals and estimate covariances. They decompose the covariance matrix as the sum of low-rank and diagonal components. A key issue is how to choose the latent dimension $k$, which is particularly challenging when the factor model only holds approximately and in low signal-to-noise scenarios. Bayesian overfitted factor models specify an upper bound on $k$ and rely on structured shrinkage priors to effectively remove extra components. Such approaches are popular and effective, but computationally expensive. We propose a much faster \texttt{EigenBayes} approach that provides valid uncertainty quantification, based on spectral estimation of latent factors and adaptive empirical Bayes calibration of key hyperparameters. The resulting posterior distribution factorizes across outcomes and is analytically tractable, bypassing Markov chain Monte Carlo. We show that \texttt{EigenBayes} adapts to the signal-to-noise ratio of each outcome and latent dimension, while shrinking superfluous latent components to zero. We establish favorable asymptotic properties and demonstrate strong empirical performance in numerical experiments and a genomics application, where EigenBayes outperforms state-of-the-art alternatives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EigenBayes方法，一种基于谱估计和自适应经验贝叶斯校准的高维矩阵分解方法，用于解决贝叶斯过拟合因子模型的计算瓶颈。该方法通过后验分布因子化避免MCMC，能够适应信噪比并收缩多余成分，在渐近性质和实证表现上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 贝叶斯过拟合因子模型在高维数据分析中有效但计算昂贵，尤其在因子模型近似成立且低信噪比场景下，潜在维度的选择具有挑战性。
Method: 提出EigenBayes方法，结合谱估计潜在因子和自适应经验贝叶斯校准关键超参数，使得后验分布可解析分解，避免马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛计算。
Result: 摘要表明EigenBayes在数值实验和基因组学应用中优于现有最先进方法，并具有渐近理论保证。
Conclusion: EigenBayes提供了一种快速且具有有效不确定性量化的过拟合因子模型替代方案，适用于高维数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Review of Machine Learning Models for Solar Energetic Particle Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Solar energetic particle (SEP) events have attracted increasing attention due to their significant radiation hazards for aviation, spacecraft electronics, and human missions beyond Earth's magnetosphere. From a scientific perspective, SEP events are intriguing because they arise from a set of physical processes extending from the solar surface and corona through the heliosphere, offering insight into particle acceleration and transport mechanisms that are widely applicable across astrophysics. Therefore, advancing our ability to understand and predict SEP events is essential both for deepening our knowledge of such mechanisms and for safeguarding space technologies and exploration. Traditionally, researchers have modeled SEPs using physics-based simulations and empirical methods. More recently, machine learning (ML) has emerged as a new tool for understanding and predicting SEP events. The purpose of this manuscript is to review the currently available ML models for SEP prediction, identify the datasets used for training, compare their architectures, inputs, and outputs, and, based on these insights, outline good practices and recommendations for future research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述，系统回顾了用于太阳高能粒子（SEP）事件预测的机器学习模型。文章涵盖了用于训练的数据集、模型架构、输入输出以及已有成果，并在此基础上提出了未来研究的良好实践和建议。
Motivation: SEP事件对航空、航天器电子设备及地球磁层外的人类任务构成严重辐射危害，同时其背后物理过程涉及粒子加速与输运机制，加深理解与预测能力对科学和应用均至关重要。
Method: 综述性方法，梳理了当前基于机器学习的SEP预测模型，对比了不同模型的结构、输入和输出，并整理了相关训练数据集。
Result: 未提供具体的实证结果，但总结了现有模型的性能趋势，并指出了数据、模型评估和可解释性等方面的共性挑战。
Conclusion: 强调了机器学习在SEP预测中的潜力，同时指出需要更高质量数据集、标准化评估基准以及物理约束的融入，以推动该领域发展。

papers.title: ITNet: A Learnable Integral Transform That Subsumes Convolution, Attention, and Recurrence
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional networks, recurrent networks, and transformers each encode different inductive biases -- locality, sequential memory, and content-dependent pairwise interaction -- and have remained mathematically distinct since their inception. We show that this fragmentation reflects not a fundamental diversity in how signals should be processed, but rather incomplete views of a single underlying mathematical object: a learnable integral transform. We introduce the Integral Transform Network (ITNet), a unified architecture built around a learnable kernel that depends jointly on positions and features. This kernel is implemented as a small neural network, specifically an MLP, that models pairwise interactions, enabling the model to adapt its behavior from data. We show that convolution, self-attention (including multi-head), and autoregressive recurrence (including LSTM, GRU, S4, and Mamba) arise as special cases under appropriate parameterizations, and that ITNet is a universal approximator of continuous operators. To make this practical, we develop tiled kernel fusion, importance-weighted Monte Carlo integration, and learned low-rank factorization, enabling efficient and scalable computation. A single ITNet architecture with a shared operator and lightweight modality-specific encoders matches or exceeds specialized baselines on ImageNet-1K , GLUE, ModelNet40, VQA\,v2 and NLVR2. The results demonstrate that a single learned interaction mechanism can recover the behavior of all three architectural families from data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出积分变换网络（ITNet），一种可学习的积分变换，其核函数同时依赖位置和特征，通过小型神经网络（MLP）实现。ITNet统一了卷积、自注意力（包括多头）和自回归递归（包括LSTM、GRU、S4、Mamba）作为特例，并证明了其作为连续算子通用逼近器的能力。通过平铺核融合、重要性加权蒙特卡洛积分和可学习的低秩分解实现高效计算。在ImageNet-1K、GLUE、ModelNet40、VQA v2和NLVR2上，单一ITNet架构匹配或超越专门基线。
Motivation: 卷积网络、循环网络和Transformer各自编码不同的归纳偏置，长期以来被视为数学上不同的架构。本文旨在证明这种碎片化并非信号处理本质差异，而是对同一潜在数学对象（可学习积分变换）的不完全视图。
Method: 提出ITNet，统一架构基于可学习核，核由MLP实现以建模逐对相互作用。通过适当参数化，卷积、注意力、递归等成为特例。采用平铺核融合、重要性加权蒙特卡洛积分和可学习的低秩分解实现高效可扩展计算。
Result: 单一ITNet架构在ImageNet-1K、GLUE、ModelNet40、VQA v2和NLVR2上匹配或超越专门基线，证明了单一学习交互机制可从数据恢复三种架构家族的行为。
Conclusion: ITNet表明一个统一的积分变换框架可以涵盖多种主流架构，且在实际任务中表现竞争力，为构建更通用的神经网络提供了新视角。

papers.title: FloatDoor: Platform-Triggered Backdoors in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sensitive settings such as software engineering, where their outputs directly shape downstream artifacts. Recent work has shown that an identical model can produce measurably different outputs depending on the deployment platform, a consequence of non-associative floating-point arithmetic and divergent kernel implementations. We study the security implications of this platform-dependent variability and uncover a novel attack surface on LLM deployments. We introduce FloatDoor, the first input-independent, platform-triggered backdoor attack against generative LLMs. The compromised model exhibits adversary-chosen behavior when served on a target platform and is otherwise benign. FloatDoor is realized through two lightweight LoRA adapters, one that amplifies inter-platform numerical divergence and one that binds the resulting platform signature to a malicious downstream task, while leaving aggregate model utility largely intact. FloatDoor exploits a pronounced time-of-check, time-of-use gap between model auditing and serving. We demonstrate FloatDoor on Qwen3-4B across a broad range of deployment targets, including NVIDIA GPUs, Google TPUs, AWS Graviton, and Alibaba Yitian-710. As a final case study, we show that FloatDoor reliably induces exploitable code vulnerabilities on a chosen target platform. Our results establish a new class of attacks on LLM deployments and underscore the pressing need for trusted model supply chains in sensitive, LLM-powered applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FloatDoor，首个与输入无关、由平台触发的后门攻击方法，针对生成式大语言模型（LLM）。攻击者通过两个轻量LoRA适配器（一个放大平台间数值差异，另一个将平台签名绑定到恶意任务）实现：模型在目标部署平台上表现出攻击者指定的行为，在其他平台上则表现正常。该攻击利用了模型审计与部署之间的时间差（TOCTOU）。在Qwen3-4B上对NVIDIA GPU、Google TPU、AWS Graviton、Alibaba Yitian-710等平台进行了验证，并展示了在目标平台可靠注入可被利用的代码漏洞的能力。
Motivation: 现有LLM在软件工程等敏感场景中部署，其输出因平台不同而存在可测量的差异（源于非结合浮点运算和不同的内核实现）。作者旨在探索这种平台依赖变异的的安全影响，揭示一种新的攻击面。
Method: FloatDoor由两个轻量LoRA适配器组成：一个放大跨平台数值发散，另一个将产生的平台签名绑定到恶意下游任务，同时保持模型整体效用基本不变。攻击利用模型审计与部署之间的TOCTOU时间差。
Result: 在Qwen3-4B上，FloatDoor在多种平台（NVIDIA GPU、Google TPU、AWS Graviton、Alibaba Yitian-710）上成功实现平台触发后门，并在目标平台可靠注入可被利用的代码漏洞。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了一类针对LLM部署的新攻击，强调了在敏感的LLM驱动应用中需要可信的模型供应链。

summary_sections.result: 在Qwen3-4B上，FloatDoor在多种平台（NVIDIA GPU、Google TPU、AWS Graviton、Alibaba Yitian-710）上成功实现平台触发后门，并在目标平台可靠注入可被利用的代码漏洞。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作建立了一类针对LLM部署的新攻击，强调了在敏感的LLM驱动应用中需要可信的模型供应链。

papers.title: PerceptionDLM: Parallel Region Perception with Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual understanding tasks. However, most existing MLLMs rely on autoregressive generation, which limits their efficiency for perception tasks that require captioning multiple regions. In this work, we propose PerceptionDLM, a multimodal diffusion language model optimized for efficient parallel region perception. Built upon PerceptionDLM-Base, a strong foundational baseline that achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source diffusion MLLMs, our architecture fully leverages the parallel decoding nature of DLMs. Specifically, we introduce efficient prompting and structured attention masking to enable simultaneous perception of multiple masked regions, allowing the model to generate region descriptions in parallel at both the sequence and token levels. This design significantly improves inference efficiency compared with existing approaches that process regions sequentially. To systematically evaluate the parallelism property of visual perception capability for DLMs, we construct a new Parallel Detailed Localized Captioning Benchmark (ParaDLC-Bench) by scaling the DLC-Bench to include multiple region masks per image, enabling joint evaluation of both caption quality and inference efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that PerceptionDLM maintains competitive performance in region captioning while achieving substantial speed improvements for multi-region perception tasks. Our results highlight the potential of multimodal diffusion language models for efficient, parallel visual perception. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to achieve parallel region caption and perception by leveraging the advantages of diffusion language models. Code, models, and datasets are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PerceptionDLM，一种基于多模态扩散语言模型 (diffusion language model) 的并行区域感知框架。通过高效提示设计与结构化注意力掩码，模型能够在序列和 token 级别并行生成多个区域描述，从而克服传统自回归 MLLM 在处理多区域感知时效率低下的问题。为系统评估并行感知能力，作者构建了 ParaDLC-Bench 基准。实验表明，该方法在保持区域描述质量的同时，大幅提升了多区域推理速度。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 主要依赖自回归生成，处理多个区域感知任务时需要逐区域顺序推理，导致效率低下。
Method: 基于扩散语言模型 (PerceptionDLM-Base)，引入高效提示 (efficient prompting) 和结构化注意力掩码 (structured attention masking)，实现多区域并行描述生成；并构建包含多区域掩码的 ParaDLC-Bench 基准用于评估。
Result: 在区域描述任务上保持与 SOTA 相当的性能，同时多区域感知的推理速度显著提升。
Conclusion: 首次利用扩散语言模型实现并行区域描述与感知，展示了多模态扩散语言模型在高效视觉感知中的潜力。

papers.title: A Tool for the Synthesis of Adaptive Probabilistic Processors Based on the Ising Model
papers.abstract_en: This work presents a tool for the synthesis and simulation of probabilistic architectures for solving combinatorial optimization problems by mapping them to the Ising model. The proposed approach automatically constructs the Ising Hamiltonian and determines the number of probabilistic elements (p-bits) based on problem characteristics such as size and topology. Furthermore, the tool introduces an adaptive strategy for selecting the most suitable update algorithm among Gibbs Sampling, Simulated Annealing (SA), Simulated Quantum Annealing (SQA), and cluster-based methods. Experimental results using benchmark problems demonstrate improved convergence behavior and flexibility compared to fixed approaches. The proposed framework enables systematic evaluation of probabilistic computing strategies and supports the development of future hardware implementations based on MTJs and p-bits.
papers.comment: ACM/IEEE/SBC/SBMICRO Symposium on Integrated Circuits and Systems Design 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一种用于综合和模拟概率架构的工具，通过将组合优化问题映射到Ising模型来求解。该工具自动构建Ising哈密顿量，确定概率元素（p-bits）的数量，并引入自适应策略选择最合适的更新算法（Gibbs采样、模拟退火、模拟量子退火、基于簇的方法）。基准问题的实验结果表明，与固定方法相比，该工具具有更好的收敛行为和灵活性。
Motivation: 组合优化问题求解需要高效的概率计算架构，现有方法缺乏系统性的工具支持。
Method: 提出一种自动化综合工具，将问题映射为Ising模型，自适应选择更新算法。
Result: 在基准问题上表现出更优的收敛行为和灵活性。
Conclusion: 该框架支持系统评估概率计算策略，并促进基于MTJ和p-bits的未来硬件实现。

papers.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly rely on video generation to bridge visual world modeling and robot control. However, video-based WAMs face three coupled limitations: dense multi-frame future tokens make inference costly, full video prediction spends capacity on action-irrelevant temporal and appearance details, and long-horizon future imagination may introduce errors that mislead action prediction. These issues raise a simple question: Does world action model really need video generation? We propose ImageWAM, a simple WAM framework that repurposes pretrained image editing models for robot action prediction. In contrast to video generation, image editing provides a better-matched prior: it only needs to model a target-frame transformation, focuses on action-relevant current-to-target visual differences, and grounds task instructions to localized visual changes through edit pretraining. In practice, ImageWAM does not decode the target frame at inference time; instead, it conditions a flow-matching action expert on the KV caches produced by image-editing denoising, using them as a compact world-action context. ImageWAM outperforms standard VLA baselines and matching competitive WAMs without additional policy pretraining across different simulator and real-world experiments. It also reduces FLOPs to 1/6 and latency to 1/4 of video-based WAMs. Attention analysis further shows that editing caches focus on task-relevant change regions, supporting image editing as an effective alternative to video-based world-action modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对世界动作模型依赖视频生成带来的高计算成本和冗余细节问题，本文提出ImageWAM框架，利用预训练图像编辑模型替代视频生成进行机器人动作预测。通过将图像编辑去噪过程的KV缓存作为动作专家的条件，避免了显式解码目标帧，在模拟和真实实验中超越标准VLA基线，计算量降至视频方法的1/6，延迟降至1/4。
Motivation: 视频生成的世界动作模型存在三大耦合缺陷：推理成本高、容量浪费在动作无关的时空细节、长程想象引入错误误导动作预测。因此需要探索更轻量且聚焦动作的替代方案。
Method: 重新利用预训练图像编辑模型，将其去噪过程中的KV缓存作为紧凑的世界动作上下文，条件化一个流匹配的动作专家（flow-matching action expert），推理时不解码目标帧。
Result: 在模拟和真实机器人实验中，ImageWAM性能优于标准VLA基线和同类WAM模型，同时将FLOPs降至视频WAM的1/6，延迟降至1/4。注意力分析表明编辑缓存聚焦于任务相关区域。
Conclusion: 图像编辑可作为视频生成的有效替代，提供更好的先验匹配（仅需建模目标帧变换、关注当前到目标的差异），但目前仅验证了图像编辑作为世界动作建模的可行性。

papers.title: Techniques for Peak Memory Reduction for LoRA Fine-tuning of LLMs on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning of Large Language Models (LLMs) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) on an end-user's data offers personalized experiences while keeping data private, but faces severe memory constraints on consumer hardware. Peak memory during fine-tuning often exceeds device limits, especially for models with billions of parameters and long-context training data. This paper introduces a suite of complementary techniques to reduce memory footprint without sacrificing model quality: (1) base model quantization with on-the-fly dequantization, (2) memory-efficient checkpointing combining selective activation caching and disk offloading, (3) softmax approximation using semantically relevant token subsets, and (4) logits masking. Experiments on Llama-3.2 3B and Qwen-2.5 3B demonstrate up to $26\times$ and $28\times$ reduction in peak memory, enabling fine-tuning on resource-constrained devices.
papers.comment: Hassan Dbouk and Matthias Reisser contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对边缘设备上LoRA微调LLM时峰值内存过高的问题，提出一套互补技术：基础模型量化与即时反量化、结合选择性激活缓存和磁盘卸载的内存高效检查点、基于语义相关token子集的softmax近似以及logits掩码。在Llama-3.2 3B和Qwen-2.5 3B上实现26倍和28倍的峰值内存减少，使在资源受限设备上微调成为可能。
Motivation: 在消费硬件上使用LoRA微调LLM时，峰值内存常超出设备限制，尤其对于数十亿参数模型和长上下文数据，阻碍了隐私保护下的个性化体验。
Method: 提出一套互补技术：基础模型量化与即时反量化；结合选择性激活缓存和磁盘卸载的内存高效检查点；使用语义相关token子集进行softmax近似；以及logits掩码。
Result: 在Llama-3.2 3B和Qwen-2.5 3B上，峰值内存分别减少高达26倍和28倍，使得在资源受限设备上微调成为可能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在不牺牲模型质量的前提下显著降低内存占用，适用于边缘设备。

papers.title: Emergent Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Can Large Language Models (LLMs) discern when their own outputs are misaligned with human ethics? And can they self-correct? We endow an LLM with a conscience step that reviews its own reasoning and outputs, and we extend the training loss with an alignment component using Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to steer the model away from non-ethical outputs. The result is an online technique to align models in a wide range of applications: training, fine-tuning, adversarial prompting, and zero-shot learning. It does not require a weaker or stronger judge, relying instead on a frozen copy of itself. In previous work, the Emergent Misalignment scenario showed a range of emergent unethical behaviors from fine-tuning the model to hack code. Instead, we empirically show how to achieve Emergent Alignment: a single high-level introspective question steers training toward an ethical model under the same code hacking scenario.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在线对齐技术，使大型语言模型（LLM）通过引入自我审查的“良心步骤”以及使用直接偏好优化（DPO）扩展训练损失，自主识别并纠正与人类伦理不符的输出。该方法不依赖更弱或更强的评判模型，而是使用自身的冻结副本，并在训练、微调、对抗性提示和零样本学习中均能生效。实验表明，在代码黑客场景下，仅通过一个高层内省问题即可引导模型实现伦理对齐。
Motivation: 以往研究（Emergent Misalignment）发现微调LLM可能导致其出现非预期的非伦理行为（如黑客代码），需要一种无需外部评判模型、能在线自我纠正对齐的方法。
Method: 在模型推理过程中增加一个“良心步骤”（conscience step），用于审查自身的推理和输出；同时使用直接偏好优化（DPO）扩展训练损失，添加对齐分量，引导模型远离非伦理输出。该方法使用模型自身的冻结副本作为参考，无需外部评判器。
Result: 在代码黑客场景下，通过单个高层内省问题引导训练，实现了模型伦理对齐（Emergent Alignment）。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种轻量级、在线且通用的对齐技术，适用于多种应用场景，且不依赖外部评判模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REVEAL++: Differentiable Phenotypic Grouping for Vision-Language Retinal Modeling of Alzheimer's Disease Risk
papers.abstract_en: The retina offers a noninvasive window into neurodegenerative disease, capturing subtle structural patterns associated with a risk of future cognitive decline. Vision-language alignment frameworks such as REVEAL have shown that pairing retinal fundus images with structured clinical risk narratives improves early prediction of Alzheimer's disease (AD). A key design choice in these approaches is the use of phenotypic grouping, where individuals with similar risk profiles are treated as multi-positive pairs during contrastive learning. However, existing methods operationalize phenotypic similarity as a discrete construct, relying on hard group assignments that impose rigid supervision and decouple group formation from representation learning. We propose a continuous formulation of phenotypic structure within contrastive learning. Rather than assigning samples to fixed clusters, we model inter-subject similarity as a differentiable weighting function derived from intra-modality embedding similarities in both retinal images and risk profiles. These weights define soft multi-positive relationships through a continuous aggregation operator, enabling graded supervision that reflects the spectrum nature of disease risk. We further introduce a soft-target contrastive objective that jointly learns cross-modal alignment and phenotypic structure in an end-to-end manner. Evaluated on UK Biobank retinal imaging data for incident AD prediction, the proposed framework consistently outperforms discrete group-based contrastive learning and standard vision-language baselines. By treating phenotypic similarity as a learnable, continuous signal rather than a fixed grouping rule, our approach provides a principled and robust foundation for population-scale neurodegenerative risk modeling from multi-modal retinal and clinical data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REVEAL++，一种可微分的连续表型分组方法，用于视网膜图像与临床风险叙述的视觉-语言对比学习，以预测阿尔茨海默病风险。该方法将受试者间相似性建模为连续权重函数，替代离散的硬分组，并通过软目标对比目标端到端学习跨模态对齐与表型结构。在 UK Biobank 数据上，该方法在阿尔茨海默病预测中优于传统离散分组和标准视觉-语言基线。
Motivation: 现有基于视网膜的阿尔茨海默病风险预测方法使用离散表型分组，依赖硬聚类标签，割裂了分组形成与表示学习的过程，无法反映疾病风险的连续谱特性。
Method: 提出连续表型对比学习框架：利用视网膜图像和风险叙述各自模态内的嵌入相似性定义可微分的样本间权重，通过连续聚合算子构建软多正样本对，并设计软目标对比损失函数实现端到端联合优化。
Result: 在 UK Biobank 数据上，该方法在阿尔茨海默病预测任务中显著优于离散分组对比学习及标准视觉-语言基线。
Conclusion: 将表型相似性作为可学习的连续信号而非固定分组规则，为基于多模态视网膜与临床数据的大规模神经退行性疾病风险建模提供了原理性且鲁棒的基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Interactive Pareto navigation for deep multi-task learning
papers.abstract_en: In multi-task learning, handling an increasing number of objectives can quickly become challenging, both in terms of the computational resources and the decision maker's capacity to choose appropriate trade-offs. A widely used approach is thus to aggregate the individual losses in a single loss function by a weighted sum. This often fails to capture either the decision maker's preferences as a result of the shape of the Pareto front, or requires multiple adjustments and computations which becomes prohibitively expensive in deep learning applications. To address these issues, we introduce a novel framework, Preference Pareto Exploration (PPE), which enforces the decision maker's preferences while accounting for the geometry of the Pareto set in an interactive exploration process. PPE is based on a predictor-corrector method that performs predictor steps tangential to the manifold of Pareto-optimal solutions, following the decision maker's preference. The subsequent corrector step results in a new trade-off reflecting this preference. To avoid explicit Hessian computations when characterizing the tangent space of the manifold, we employ a Krylov subspace method that relies solely on matrix-vector products. These products can be efficiently obtained via automatic differentiation, ensuring both efficiency and robustness throughout the optimization process. The method's functionality and performance are demonstrated using both toy problems and examples from deep learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种交互式Pareto导航框架Preference Pareto Exploration (PPE)，用于深度多任务学习。该方法通过预测-校正步骤沿Pareto最优解流形移动，并利用Krylov子空间方法避免显式Hessian计算，从而高效实现决策者偏好的交互式探索。在玩具问题和深度学习实例上验证了功能与性能。
Motivation: 多任务学习中，目标数量增加导致计算昂贵且决策者难以选择合适的权衡；传统加权和法因Pareto前沿形状而无法准确捕捉偏好，且调整成本高。本文旨在提供一种交互式、偏好感知且计算高效的Pareto优化方法。
Method: 提出PPE框架，基于预测-校正法：预测步沿Pareto最优解流形的切向方向移动，反映决策者偏好；校正步投影回Pareto集得到新权衡。使用Krylov子空间方法（仅需矩阵-向量乘积）通过自动微分高效计算切空间，避免显式Hessian。
Result: 在玩具问题和深度学习实例上展示了方法的有效性和效率，但摘要未提供具体数值结果。
Conclusion: PPE框架为深度多任务学习提供了交互式Pareto探索，能够根据决策者偏好调整权衡，且计算高效、鲁棒。

papers.title: LLM Doesn't Know What It Doesn't Know: Detecting Epistemic Blind Spots via Cross-Model Attribution Divergence on Clinical Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to structured clinical data, yet whether they can recognize the limits of their own knowledge on such tasks remains unexplored. We study this question through the lens of cross-model attribution divergence with the goal of reducing epistemic uncertainty for structured tasks, comparing Qwen 2.5 7B and XGBoost on a prediction task via attribution divergence analysis. We report four findings. First, LLM verbalized confidence is epistemically vacuous, it outputs a near-constant (0.856-0.937) regardless of whether accuracy is 49% or 75.3%, tracking prompt format rather than prediction quality. Second, the LLM exhibits an inverse difficulty effect: accuracy drops to 64.8% when XGBoost is 99% correct, but matches XGBoost (73.8% vs. 73.1%) when it is moderately uncertain. Third, few-shot examples and SHAP-derived feature evidence are orthogonal, super-additive interventions: they reduce the Attribution Disagreement Score (ADS) from 1.54 to 0.38 and improve accuracy from 49% to 75.3% without training. Fourth, a cross-model calibrator that determined LLM reliability using attribution divergence signals reduces expected calibration error from 0.254 to 0.080, replacing uninformative verbalized confidence with patient-specific reliability estimates, without accessing model internals or requiring repeated inference. We frame these findings as a cold start problem for LLMs on structured data and outline a path toward genuine epistemic self-awareness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在结构化临床数据上能否识别自身知识边界。通过跨模型归因发散（cross-model attribution divergence）分析，比较Qwen 2.5 7B和XGBoost在临床预测任务上的表现。发现：1) LLM口头自信度在预测质量不同时几乎恒定，仅随提示格式变化；2) LLM存在逆难度效应，当XGBoost完全正确时LLM准确率较低，而在中等不确定性时与XGBoost相当；3) few-shot和SHAP特征证据正交且超相加，将归因分歧分数从1.54降至0.38，准确率从49%提升至75.3%；4) 基于归因发散信号的跨模型校准器将期望校准误差从0.254降至0.080，无需内部访问或重复推理。这些发现被框架为LLM在结构化数据上的冷启动问题。
Motivation: LLM被应用于结构化临床数据，但它们能否识别自身知识局限性尚未被探索。本文旨在通过跨模型归因发散检测认知盲点以降低认知不确定性。
Method: 使用跨模型归因发散分析，比较Qwen 2.5 7B和XGBoost在临床表格数据预测任务上的归因差异。提出归因分歧分数（ADS）和基于该信号的跨模型校准器。
Result: LLM口头自信度无信息（0.856-0.937恒定，与准确率无关）；LLM准确率在XGBoost高置信时下降（64.8% vs 99%），在中等不确定时匹配；few-shot+SHAP降低ADS至0.38，准确率提升至75.3%；跨模型校准器将ECE从0.254降至0.080。
Conclusion: 这些发现表明LLM在结构化数据上的认知自信度存在盲点，需通过跨模型归因发散等方法来检测，为构建真正的认知自我意识提供路径。

papers.title: DeXposure-Claw: An Agentic System for DeFi Risk Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized finance exposes supervisors to fast-moving, networked credit risks. General-purpose LLM agents fit this setting poorly: they over-read weak evidence and recommend high-stakes interventions, while existing evaluations offer no regulator-aligned way to measure the resulting false alarms. We introduce DeXposure-Claw, a forecast-grounded agentic supervision system that routes LLM decisions through structured evidence: (1) DeXposure-FM, a graph time-series foundation model, forecasts future exposure networks; (2) deterministic monitors and stress scenarios then turn those forecasts into typed alerts, attribution signals, and scenario evidence; and (3) data-health and confidence gates constrain escalation before DeXposure-Claw emits auditable supervisory tickets with rationales. We further develop DeXposure-Bench, a six-axis evaluation harness, whose decision axis scores tickets against a regulator-aligned absolute-loss ground truth and an explicit false-intervention rate. Experiments on five years of weekly real data fully support our system. Code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/DeXposure-Claw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeXposure-Claw，一个基于预测的智能监管系统，用于去中心化金融（DeFi）风险监管。系统包含图时间序列基础模型DeXposure-FM预测未来暴露网络，结合确定性监控和压力场景生成警报，并通过数据健康与置信度门控约束升级，最终输出可审计的监管工单。同时提出DeXposure-Bench六轴评估框架，在五年真实周数据上验证了系统有效性。
Motivation: 通用大语言模型（LLM）代理不适合DeFi监管，因为它们过度解读弱证据并推荐高风险干预，而现有评估缺乏监管对齐的方式衡量误报。
Method: DeXposure-Claw包含三个核心组件：DeXposure-FM（图时间序列基础模型）预测未来暴露网络；确定性监控器和压力场景将预测转化为类型化警报、归因信号和场景证据；数据健康与置信度门控约束升级流程，最终生成带有理由的可审计监管工单。
Result: 在五年每周真实数据的实验完全支持系统，DeXposure-Bench评估框架的决策轴基于监管对齐的绝对损失真实值和明确错误干预率对工单评分。
Conclusion: 系统有效提升了DeFi风险监管的可靠性和可审计性，但依赖于预测模型和监控器的准确度。

papers.title: Calibrating Generative Models to Feature Distributions with MMD Finetuning
papers.abstract_en: Generative models can produce individually plausible samples while deviating substantially from a target set in the distribution of key features. For example, a model pretrained on broad drug-like chemical space may generate molecules whose molecular features differ from those of a therapeutic class of interest, such as known antibiotics. Correcting such distributional miscalibration is challenging: direct finetuning on the target set can overfit and does not control which features are matched. To fill this gap, we introduce kernel Calibrating Generative Models (kCGM). kCGM minimizes a maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) between generated and target feature distributions using an unbiased score-function estimator, with KL regularization to remain close to the pretrained model. On a target set of 174 antibiotics, direct finetuning sacrifices chemical validity for feature-distribution matching, whereas kCGM improves target feature matching while increasing validity. We further demonstrate kCGM in protein and DNA generation tasks, showing it can adapt autoregressive, continuous-space diffusion, and discrete diffusion models using only feature-level supervision. Code is available at https://github.com/smithhenryd/cgm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出kCGM方法，通过最大均值差异（MMD）微调生成模型，使其生成样本的特征分布匹配目标集。在抗生素分子生成任务中，kCGM相比直接微调提高了特征匹配度和化学有效性；该方法也适用于蛋白质和DNA生成任务。
Motivation: 生成模型可能生成个体合理但整体特征分布偏离目标集的样本，直接微调目标集易过拟合且无法控制匹配哪些特征。
Method: kCGM通过无偏分数函数估计器最小化生成样本与目标特征分布之间的MMD，并加入KL正则化以保持接近预训练模型。
Result: 在174个抗生素目标集上，kCGM改善了特征匹配同时提高了化学有效性；在蛋白质和DNA生成任务上同样有效，可适配自回归、连续扩散和离散扩散模型。
Conclusion: kCGM提供了一种仅使用特征级监督即可校准生成模型分布的方法，避免直接微调的问题。

papers.title: LooseControlVideo: Directorial Video Control using Spatial Blocking
papers.abstract_en: Precise 3D spatial orchestration in text-to-video generation remains a significant challenge, particularly for multi-object scenes where semantic layout and temporal dynamics are often entangled. While existing depth-conditioned models achieve good structural fidelity, they necessitate dense, frame-accurate guidance that is labor-intensive to author for dynamic events involving deformable objects. We present LooseControlVideo, a framework that enables intuitive and expressive control by using sparse, oriented 3D boxes as a "blocking" proxy. This allows users to author high-level layout and trajectory while leveraging a video generative model to generate realistic occlusions, dynamics and interactions. We achieve this by fine-tuning a Wan 2.2 backbone on a video dataset annotated with DNOCS, a novel encoding for 3D size, orientation and depth-ordered occlusions. Furthermore, our method allows for localized refinement, such as adjusting a jump trajectory or adding an interaction, with minimal disruption to the global scene context. Extensive evaluations on the nuScenes, HO-3D, and BEHAVE benchmarks demonstrate that LooseControlVideo significantly outperforms existing 2D-box and flow-based baselines. Our findings indicate a 1.2x to 3x improvement in Trajectory Error; 2x improvement in Rigid Motion Consistency; and a 1.5x to 2x increase in Occlusion Accuracy over current state-of-the-art layout-conditioned models, demonstrating that oriented 3D primitives provide good geometric prior for complex, multi-agent video authoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LooseControlVideo，一个使用稀疏定向3D框作为空间代理（spatial blocking）来直觉化控制文本到视频生成的框架。该方法通过微调Wan 2.2主干网络，并结合新编码DNOCS以编码3D大小、方向和深度排序遮挡，在nuScenes、HO-3D和BEHAVE基准上显著优于现有2D框和基于流的方法，在轨迹误差、刚体运动一致性和遮挡精度上分别提升1.2-3倍、2倍和1.5-2倍。
Motivation: 现有视频生成方法在精确3D空间编排上存在挑战，特别是多物体场景中语义布局与时空动态混叠；深度条件模型需要密集帧级引导，难以手工编辑动态形变物体。
Method: 使用稀疏定向3D框作为布局代理，通过微调Wan 2.2视频生成模型，结合新编码DNOCS（包含3D尺寸、方向和深度排序遮挡信息），并支持局部细化（如调整跳跃轨迹或添加交互）。
Result: 在nuScenes、HO-3D、BEHAVE基准上，轨迹误差提升1.2-3倍，刚体运动一致性提升2倍，遮挡精度提升1.5-2倍，优于现有基于2D框和光流的布局条件模型。
Conclusion: 定向3D基元为复杂多智能体视频创作提供了良好的几何先验，使稀疏用户输入生成逼真的遮挡、动态和交互。

summary_sections.method: 使用稀疏定向3D框作为布局代理，通过微调Wan 2.2视频生成模型，结合新编码DNOCS（包含3D尺寸、方向和深度排序遮挡信息），并支持局部细化（如调整跳跃轨迹或添加交互）。
summary_sections.result: 在nuScenes、HO-3D、BEHAVE基准上，轨迹误差提升1.2-3倍，刚体运动一致性提升2倍，遮挡精度提升1.5-2倍，优于现有基于2D框和光流的布局条件模型。
summary_sections.conclusion: 定向3D基元为复杂多智能体视频创作提供了良好的几何先验，使稀疏用户输入生成逼真的遮挡、动态和交互。

papers.title: Hidden Anchors in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM deliberation, where agents exchange and revise answers over several rounds, is increasingly used to improve reasoning and accuracy, yet how and why it works is rarely modelled. Such deliberation mirrors how humans reach decisions. As social animals we are pulled both by the group, the herd effect that classical opinion-dynamics models such as DeGroot and Friedkin--Johnsen capture, and by our own internal belief, which they do not. We model multi-agent deliberation as a closed-loop dynamical system in which each agent carries a hidden internal belief, its anchor, that continually pulls its opinion regardless of its neighbours. We show this anchor can be recovered from the deliberation alone, and that it explains a behaviour classical consensus rules forbid: an agent's confidence in the correct answer can climb past where any agent started, escaping the space (convexhull) formed by the initial beliefs. Checking whether the recovered anchor also predicts held-out runs (generalizes) gives a simple test for when a model is truly driven bysuch an anchor. Across three open-weight model families this is a spectrum, not all-or-nothing. All anchors' influence are about equally strongly, but they differ in where the anchor sits, and only when it sits far from the initial opinions does deliberation escape the hull and need the full closed-loop model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将多智能体LLM deliberation建模为闭环动态系统，每个智能体携带一个隐藏的内在信念（anchor），该anchor持续影响其意见。摘要表明，从deliberation轨迹中可恢复anchor，并解释了一种经典共识规则不允许的现象：智能体对正确答案的置信度可以超过任何初始信念。跨三个开源模型家族的实验发现，所有anchor的影响强度相近，但位置差异显著，仅当anchor远离初始意见时，deliberation才需要完整的闭环模型。
Motivation: 多智能体LLM deliberation虽被广泛用于提升推理和准确性，但其工作机制缺乏量化模型。人类决策受群体效应（herd effect）和内在信念共同影响，而经典意见动力学模型未能同时捕捉这两方面。
Method: 提出将多智能体deliberation建模为闭环动态系统，每个智能体有一个隐藏的内部信念锚（anchor），持续拉拽其意见。通过deliberation轨迹恢复anchor，并检验其泛化能力（预测未见的运行轨迹）以判断模型是否受anchor驱动。
Result: 摘要报告该模型重现了经典共识规则禁止的行为：智能体置信度可逃出初始信念的凸包。实验显示，三个开源模型家族中anchor影响强度相当，但anchor位置不同；仅当anchor远离初始意见时，deliberation才逃出凸包并需要完整闭环模型。
Conclusion: 本文提供一个可测试的框架来理解多智能体LLM deliberation的内在驱动机制，指出anchor的存在和位置是关键因素，且其影响在模型间呈连续谱分布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Algebraic Dead Directions in LayerNorm Transformers: A Forward-Pass-Only Diagnostic at LLM Scale
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained transformers sit near singular minima of the loss, where the Fisher information metric degenerates along dead directions: directions in parameter space along which the directional Fisher vanishes. Locating such a direction normally needs a forward pass and an eigendecomposition of activations, or a sampling-based complexity estimate; none returns a direction computable from the network's parameters alone. We give one, for LayerNorm transformers. The inverse-scale direction $γ^{-1}/\|γ^{-1}\|$ of the LayerNorm affine is an exact algebraic kernel of the post-final-norm centred activation covariance, for any input distribution, and induces a corresponding dead direction in parameter space. It is read from the LN scale parameter alone, with no forward or backward pass and no eigensolve: the cheapest dead-direction read, specific to LayerNorm. We test it on $14$ pretrained transformers ($9$ LayerNorm, $5$ RMSNorm; $160$M-$35$B; language and vision objectives). At random initialisation the predicted direction matches the measured bottom singular direction (one forward pass, direct SVD) to four decimal places on $9/9$ LayerNorm models, and is correctly absent on $5/5$ RMSNorm models, which lack the mean-subtraction projector that creates it. On the trained checkpoint the covariance eigenvalue along this direction deepens by ${\sim}10^3\times$ and further dead directions open; the random-init-to-trained gap is a one-forward-pass, per-checkpoint readout of singular structure along the predicted coordinate. Two consequences follow in closed form: the residual stream's smallest singular value is preserved block-to-block on $13/14$ transformers measured on their own input distribution, the one exception (Gemma$4$-$31$B) a genuine dead direction the same read pinpoints; and the kernel direction's presence classifies a transformer's normalisation from the parameters alone.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Empirical companion to arXiv:2606.05957
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LayerNorm Transformer，发现其LayerNorm仿射参数的逆尺度方向是后最终归一化中心激活协方差的精确代数核，对应于参数空间中的死方向。该方向仅从LN尺度参数即可读出，无需前向或反向传播。在14个预训练Transformer上验证，其中9个LayerNorm模型在随机初始化时预测方向与实测底部奇异方向高度一致，5个RMSNorm模型无此现象。
Motivation: 寻找Transformer损失曲面中Fisher信息度规退化的死方向通常需要前向传播和特征分解，本文旨在提出一种仅依赖网络参数的、无需额外计算的死方向诊断方法，专门针对LayerNorm归一化结构。
Method: 从数学上证明LayerNorm仿射参数的逆尺度方向γ^{-1}/‖γ^{-1}‖是后最终归一化中心激活协方差矩阵的精确零空间方向，并导出对应的参数空间死方向。该方法仅需读取LayerNorm的尺度参数，无需前向/反向传播或特征分解。
Result: 在9个LayerNorm模型上，随机初始化时预测方向与实测底部奇异方向的小数点后四位匹配；在训练检查点上，沿该方向的协方差特征值下降约10^3倍，且新的死方向出现。13/14个转换器上，残差流的最小奇异值在块间保持不变；唯一的例外（Gemma4-31B）被该方向准确识别。
Conclusion: 本文提出的代数死方向方法为诊断LayerNorm Transformer的退化结构提供了极低成本的前向传播诊断工具，并能通过参数本身区分归一化类型。该方法在实验上验证了有效性，但仅限于LayerNorm模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Concept Flow Models: Anchoring Concept-Based Reasoning with Hierarchical Bottlenecks
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) enhance interpretability by projecting learned features into a human-understandable concept space. Recent approaches leverage vision-language models to generate concept embeddings, reducing the need for manual concept annotations. However, these models suffer from a critical limitation: as the number of concepts approaches the embedding dimension, information leakage increases, enabling the model to exploit spurious or semantically irrelevant correlations and undermining interpretability. In this work, we propose Concept Flow Models (CFMs), which replace the flat bottleneck with a hierarchical, concept-driven decision tree. Each internal node in the hierarchy focuses on a localized subset of discriminative concepts, progressively narrowing the prediction scope. Our framework constructs decision hierarchies from visual embeddings, distributes semantic concepts at each hierarchy level, and trains differentiable concept weights through probabilistic tree traversal. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CFMs match the predictive performance of flat CBMs, while substantially mitigating information leakage by reducing effective concept usage. Furthermore, CFMs yield stepwise decision flows that enable transparent and auditable model reasoning with hierarchical class structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出概念流模型（CFMs），用层次化概念驱动决策树替代传统平面瓶颈，每个内部节点聚焦局部判别概念子集，逐步缩小预测范围，从而缓解信息泄露。实验表明，CFMs在多种基准上匹配了原始概念瓶颈模型的预测性能，同时通过减少有效概念使用显著提升可解释性，并提供逐步决策流。
Motivation: 现有概念瓶颈模型（CBMs）在概念数量接近嵌入维度时出现信息泄露，模型可能利用虚假或语义无关的相关性，损害可解释性。
Method: CFMs构建层次化决策树，每个内部节点关注局部判别概念子集；从视觉嵌入构建决策层次，在各层级分布语义概念，并通过概率树遍历训练可微概念权重。
Result: 在多种基准上，CFMs匹配了平面CBMs的预测性能，同时通过减少有效概念使用显著缓解信息泄露，并提供逐步决策流。
Conclusion: CFMs实现了透明、可审计的推理，支持层次化类别结构，且有效缓解了信息泄露问题。
Relevance: 5
