papers.title: DADP: Domain Adaptive Diffusion Policy
papers.abstract_en: Learning domain adaptive policies that can generalize to unseen transition dynamics, remains a fundamental challenge in learning-based control. Substantial progress has been made through domain representation learning to capture domain-specific information, thus enabling domain-aware decision making. We analyze the process of learning domain representations through dynamical prediction and find that selecting contexts adjacent to the current step causes the learned representations to entangle static domain information with varying dynamical properties. Such mixture can confuse the conditioned policy, thereby constraining zero-shot adaptation. To tackle the challenge, we propose DADP (Domain Adaptive Diffusion Policy), which achieves robust adaptation through unsupervised disentanglement and domain-aware diffusion injection. First, we introduce Lagged Context Dynamical Prediction, a strategy that conditions future state estimation on a historical offset context; by increasing this temporal gap, we unsupervisedly disentangle static domain representations by filtering out transient properties. Second, we integrate the learned domain representations directly into the generative process by biasing the prior distribution and reformulating the diffusion target. Extensive experiments on challenging benchmarks across locomotion and manipulation demonstrate the superior performance, and the generalizability of DADP over prior methods. More visualization results are available on the https://outsider86.github.io/DomainAdaptiveDiffusionPolicy/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对域自适应策略学习中的表示纠缠问题，提出 DADP 方法，通过滞后上下文动态预测和域感知扩散注入实现无监督解缠和鲁棒适应。实验在 locomotion 和 manipulation 基准上展示了优越性能。
Motivation: 学习域自适应策略时，现有方法通过动态预测学习域表示，但选择邻近上下文会导致表示纠缠静态域信息与动态特性，限制零样本适应。
Method: 提出 DADP，包括两个关键组件：1) 滞后上下文动态预测，通过增加时间间隔从历史偏移上下文预测未来状态，无监督地解缠静态域表示；2) 将域表示注入扩散过程，通过偏置先验分布和重新制定扩散目标。
Result: 在 locomotion 和 manipulation 基准上，DADP 优于先前方法，展示了优越性能和泛化性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 DADP 通过无监督解缠和域感知扩散注入实现了鲁棒的域适应。

papers.title: PCBSchemaGen: Reward-Guided LLM Code Synthesis for Printed Circuit Boards (PCB) Schematic Design with Structured Verification
papers.abstract_en: Most LLM code-synthesis benchmarks rely on unit tests as the reward oracle, but PCB schematic design has none: correctness is defined by structured physical constraints over real IC packages and pin-level assignments, per-task golden references are unavailable, and SPICE simulation does not validate schematic-level correctness. We introduce PCBSchemaGen, a training-free inference-time framework that turns a frozen LLM into a verifiable, repairable PCB schematic generator. The framework induces a domain schema from IC datasheets to ground LLM decoding, pairs it with a deterministic 5-layer continuous-reward verifier with pin-level error localization, and refines candidates through a Thompson Sampling arm-acquiring bandit. We evaluate on 2 PCB benchmarks covering 227 real-IC tasks across 22 unified circuit domains, including a public-schematic-derived suite that serves as a fully held-out generalization test (verifier, KG library, and prompts frozen before any evaluation). Under our framework, an open-weight 31B model (Gemma-4-31B) passes 81.3% of PCBBench tasks on average, and the same framework transfers across both benchmarks with zero verifier code changes; a Circuitron-style inference-time prompting baseline on the same Gemma-4-31B backbone collapses on hard system-level designs. This suggests inference-time refinement under a deterministic structural verifier is a general recipe for reference-free LLM code synthesis in domains without unit-test oracles. Our benchmarks and deterministic verifier are publicly available at https://github.com/HZou9/PCBSchemaGen_v2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PCBSchemaGen，一个无需训练的推理时框架，将冻结的LLM转化为可验证、可修复的PCB原理图生成器。该框架从IC数据表中提取领域模式以约束LLM解码，配以确定性的五层连续奖励验证器（支持引脚级错误定位），并通过Thompson Sampling bandit优化候选。在包含227个真实IC任务的2个PCB基准上，Gemma-4-31B模型平均通过81.3%的任务，且框架无需修改验证器代码即可跨基准迁移。
Motivation: PCB原理图设计缺乏单元测试作为奖励机制，正确性由物理约束定义，不存在每任务黄金参考，且SPICE仿真无法验证原理图级正确性。
Method: 提出一个推理时框架，包含：从IC数据表归纳领域模式以约束LLM解码；一个5层确定性连续奖励验证器，带引脚级错误定位；通过Thompson Sampling收集候选臂的bandit算法进行优化。
Result: 在PCBBench基准上，Gemma-4-31B模型平均通过81.3%的任务，而基于Circuitron风格的推理时提示基线在复杂系统级设计上彻底失败。框架无需修改验证器代码即可在两个基准间迁移。
Conclusion: 推理时优化配合确定性结构验证器，是在缺乏单元测试奖励的领域中实现无参考LLM代码合成的一般性方法。基准和验证器已开源。

papers.title: Shape of Thought: Progressive Object Assembly via Visual Chain-of-Thought
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal models for text-to-image generation have achieved strong visual fidelity, yet they remain brittle under compositional structural constraints, notably generative numeracy, attribute binding, and part-level relations. To address these challenges, we propose Shape-of-Thought (SoT), a visual CoT framework for process-supervised progressive shape assembly in the rendered 2D domain, without external engines at inference time. SoT trains a unified multimodal autoregressive model to generate interleaved textual plans and rendered intermediate states, helping the model capture shape-assembly logic without producing explicit geometric representations. Unlike text-only CoT, each decision is grounded in a rendered state, making counts, attachments, topology, and intermediate part-addition errors inspectable across the trajectory. To support this paradigm, we introduce SoT-26K, a large-scale dataset of grounded assembly traces derived from part-based CAD hierarchies, and T2S-CompBench, a benchmark for evaluating structural integrity and trace faithfulness. Fine-tuning on SoT-26K achieves 88.4% on component numeracy and 84.8% on structural topology, outperforming direct generation by +24.2 points on component numeracy and +19.3 points on structural topology. SoT establishes a transparent testbed for rendered-domain structure-aware generation. The code is available at https://github.com/yuhuo03/Shape-of-Thought.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Shape-of-Thought (SoT) 是一个视觉链式思维框架，用于过程监督的渐进式形状组装，解决多模态文本到图像生成中的组合结构约束问题。该方法训练统一的多模态自回归模型生成交错的文本计划和渲染的中间状态，在 SoT-26K 数据集上微调后，组件计数准确率达 88.4%，结构拓扑准确率达 84.8%，分别比直接生成提升 24.2 和 19.3 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像生成模型在组合结构约束下表现脆弱，尤其是在生成计数、属性绑定和部件级关系方面。
Method: 提出 SoT，一个视觉 CoT 框架，通过训练统一的多模态自回归模型生成交错的文本计划和渲染的中间状态，在渲染的 2D 域中实现过程监督的渐进式形状组装，推理时无需外部引擎。
Result: 在 SoT-26K 数据集上微调后，组件计数准确率达 88.4%，结构拓扑准确率达 84.8%，分别比直接生成提升 24.2 和 19.3 个百分点。
Conclusion: SoT 为渲染域的结构感知生成建立了一个透明的测试平台，源代码已公开。

papers.title: Policy-Embedded Graph Expansion: Networked HIV Testing with Diffusion-Driven Network Samples
papers.abstract_en: HIV is a retrovirus that attacks the human immune system and can lead to death without proper treatment. In collaboration with the WHO and the University of Witwatersrand, we study how to improve the efficiency of HIV testing with the goal of eventual deployment, directly supporting progress toward UN Sustainable Development Goal 3.3. While prior work has demonstrated the promise of intelligent algorithms for sequential, network-based HIV testing, existing approaches rely on assumptions that are impractical in our real-world implementations. Here, we study sequential testing on incrementally revealed disease networks and introduce Policy-Embedded Graph Expansion (PEGE), a novel framework that directly embeds a generative distribution over graph expansions into the decision-making policy rather than attempting explicit topological reconstruction. We further propose Dynamics-Driven Branching (DDB), a diffusion-based graph expansion model that supports decision making in PEGE and is designed for data-limited settings where forest structures arise naturally, as in our real-world referral process. Experiments on real HIV transmission networks show that the combined approach (PEGE + DDB) consistently outperforms baselines (e.g., 17.3% improvement in discounted reward and 15.4% more HIV detections with 25% of the population tested) and explore key tradeoffs that drive solution quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对实际HIV测试中的序列决策问题，提出政策嵌入图扩展（PEGE）框架，将图扩展的生成分布直接嵌入决策策略，避免显式拓扑重建。进一步提出基于扩散的动态分支（DDB）模型，适用于数据有限的森林结构。在真实HIV传播网络上，PEGE+DDB相比基线在折扣奖励和检测数量上分别提升17.3%和15.4%。
Motivation: 现有基于网络的HIV序列测试方法依赖不切实际的假设，无法在实际部署中应用。需要一种适应逐步揭示疾病网络且无需显式重建的决策框架。
Method: 提出PEGE框架，将图扩展的生成分布嵌入策略；提出DDB扩散模型，模拟森林结构的图扩展，适用于数据有限场景。
Result: 在真实HIV传播网络实验中，PEGE+DDB相比基线在折扣奖励提升17.3%，在25%人口测试时HIV检测数多15.4%。
Conclusion: 该联合方法改善了实际HIV测试效率，支持联合国可持续发展目标3.3。摘要强调了关键权衡对解决方案质量的影响。

papers.title: Modeling Day-Long ECG Signals to Predict Heart Failure Risk with Explainable AI
papers.abstract_en: Heart failure (HF) affects 11.8% of adults aged 65 and older, reducing quality of life and longevity. Preventing HF can reduce morbidity and mortality. We hypothesized that artificial intelligence (AI) applied to 24-hour single-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) data could predict the risk of HF within five years. To research this, the Technion-Leumit Holter ECG (TLHE) dataset, including 69,663 recordings from 47,729 patients, collected over 20 years was used. Our deep learning model, DeepHHF, trained on 24-hour ECG recordings, achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.80 that outperformed a model using 30-second segments and a clinical score. High-risk individuals identified by DeepHHF had a two-fold chance of hospitalization or death incidents. Explainability analysis showed DeepHHF focused on arrhythmias and heart abnormalities. This study highlights the feasibility of deep learning to model 24-hour continuous ECG data, capturing paroxysmal events essential for reliable risk prediction. Artificial intelligence applied to single-lead Holter ECG is non-invasive, inexpensive, and widely accessible, making it a promising tool for HF risk prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建DeepHHF模型，基于24小时单导联心电图（ECG）数据预测五年内心力衰竭（HF）风险。在TLHE数据集（69,663条记录）上，模型AUC达0.80，优于30秒片段模型和临床评分。高风险个体的住院或死亡风险翻倍。可解释性分析表明模型关注心律失常和心脏异常。
Motivation: 心力衰竭在老年人群中发病率高，早期风险预测可降低发病率和死亡率。现有研究多使用短时ECG片段，可能遗漏阵发性事件，而24小时连续ECG数据建模尚缺乏充分探索。
Method: 提出DeepHHF深度学习模型，输入为24小时单导联ECG记录，输出五年内HF风险概率。训练采用TLHE数据集，包含69,663条记录。通过可解释性分析（如注意力机制）识别关键心电特征。
Result: DeepHHF在HF风险预测上AUC为0.80，优于基于30秒ECG的模型和临床评分。高风险组住院或死亡事件发生率是低风险组的两倍。
Conclusion: 24小时单导联ECG结合深度学习可有效预测长期HF风险，且该方法非侵入、低成本、易于推广，具有临床转化潜力。

papers.title: Movement Primitives in Robotics: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.abstract_en: Biological systems exhibit a continuous stream of movements, consisting of sequential segments, that allow them to perform complex tasks in a creative and versatile fashion. This observation has led researchers towards identifying elementary building blocks of motion known as movement primitives, which are well-suited for generating motor commands in autonomous systems, such as robots. In this survey, we provide an encyclopedic overview of movement primitive approaches and applications in chronological order. Concretely, we present movement primitive frameworks as a way of representing robotic control trajectories acquired through human demonstrations. Within the area of robotics, movement primitives can encode basic motions at the trajectory level, such as how a robot would grasp a cup or the sequence of motions necessary to toss a ball. Furthermore, movement primitives have been developed with the desirable analytical properties of a spring-damper system, probabilistic coupling of multiple demonstrations, using neural networks in high-dimensional systems, and more, to address difficult challenges in robotics. Although movement primitives have widespread application to a variety of fields, the goal of this survey is to inform practitioners on the use of these frameworks in the context of robotics. Specifically, we aim to (i) present a systematic review of major movement primitive frameworks and examine their strengths and weaknesses; (ii) highlight applications that have successfully made use of movement primitives; and (iii) examine open questions and discuss practical challenges when applying movement primitives in robotics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于机器人学中运动基元 (movement primitives) 的全面综述，系统回顾了从人类示教中表示机器人控制轨迹的主要框架及其应用。摘要介绍了运动基元如何将基本运动编码为轨迹级表示（如抓取杯子或投掷球），并讨论了弹簧-阻尼系统、概率耦合、神经网络等分析特性。目标是为从业者提供使用这些框架的指导，包括现有框架的优劣、成功应用案例以及开放问题和实际挑战。
Motivation: 生物系统能够通过连续的移动序列执行复杂任务，这启发了研究人员寻找运动的基本构建块（运动基元），用于自主系统（如机器人）生成运动命令。该综述旨在填补对运动基元框架在机器人学中系统梳理的空白。
Method: 采用编年体方式对运动基元方法进行百科全书式概述，涵盖从人类示教中获取轨迹的多种表示框架，并分析其分析特性（如弹簧-阻尼系统、概率耦合、神经网络）。
Result: 综述总结了运动基元在机器人学中的主要框架及其优劣，并列举了成功应用案例，包括但不限于抓取、投掷等操作。
Conclusion: 该综述指出了在机器人学中应用运动基元的开放问题和实际挑战，旨在为从业者提供使用这些框架的指导。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 该综述指出了在机器人学中应用运动基元的开放问题和实际挑战，旨在为从业者提供使用这些框架的指导。

papers.title: Does Head Pose Correction Improve Biometric Facial Recognition?
papers.abstract_en: Biometric facial recognition models often demonstrate significant decreases in accuracy when processing real-world images, often characterized by poor quality, non-frontal subject poses, and subject occlusions. We investigate whether targeted, AI-driven, head-pose correction and image restoration can improve recognition accuracy. Using a model-agnostic, large-scale, forensic-evaluation pipeline, we assess the impact of three restoration approaches: 3D reconstruction (NextFace), 2D frontalization (CFR-GAN), and feature enhancement (CodeFormer). We find that naive application of these techniques substantially degrades facial recognition accuracy. However, we also find that selective application of CFR-GAN combined with CodeFormer yields meaningful improvements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 驱动的头部姿态校正和图像恢复技术是否能提升人脸识别的准确率。通过模型无关的大规模评估管道，测试了 3D 重建 (NextFace)、2D 正面化 (CFR-GAN) 和特征增强 (CodeFormer) 三种方法，发现直接应用会显著降低识别精度，但选择性组合 CFR-GAN 与 CodeFormer 能带来有意义的改进。
Motivation: 真实场景中人脸识别因非正脸、遮挡等因素准确率下降，本文探究是否可以通过有针对性的头位校正和图像恢复来改善识别性能。
Method: 构建模型无关的、大尺度取证评估管道，系统地测试三种恢复方法：3D 重建 (NextFace)、2D 正面化 (CFR-GAN) 和特征增强 (CodeFormer) 对识别精度的影响。
Result: 直接应用上述技术会大幅降低人脸识别准确率，但选择性组合 CFR-GAN 与 CodeFormer 能带来有意义的性能提升。
Conclusion: 头位校正和图像恢复并非总能提升识别精度，需要谨慎选择方法组合；选择性应用特定方法组合可带来改善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bid Farewell to Seesaw: Towards Accurate Long-tail Session-based Recommendation via Dual Constraints of Hybrid Intents
papers.abstract_en: Session-based recommendation (SBR) aims to predict anonymous users' next interaction based on their interaction sessions. In the practical recommendation scenario, low-exposure items constitute the majority of interactions, creating a long-tail distribution that severely compromises recommendation diversity. Existing approaches attempt to address this issue by promoting tail items but incur accuracy degradation, exhibiting a "see-saw" effect between long-tail and accuracy performance. We attribute such conflict to session-irrelevant noise within the tail items, which existing long-tail approaches fail to identify and constrain effectively. To resolve this fundamental conflict, we propose \textbf{HID} (\textbf{H}ybrid \textbf{I}ntent-based \textbf{D}ual Constraint Framework), a plug-and-play framework that transforms the conventional "see-saw" into "win-win" through introducing the hybrid intent-based dual constraints for both long-tail and accuracy. Two key innovations are incorporated in this framework: (i) \textit{Hybrid Intent Learning}, where we reformulate the intent extraction strategies by employing attribute-aware spectral clustering to reconstruct the item-to-intent mapping. Furthermore, discrimination of session-irrelevant noise is achieved through the assignment of the target and noise intents to each session. (ii) \textit{Intent Constraint Loss}, which incorporates two novel constraint paradigms regarding the \textit{diversity} and \textit{accuracy} to regulate the representation learning process of both items and sessions. These two objectives are unified into a single training loss through rigorous theoretical derivation. Extensive experiments across multiple SBR models and datasets demonstrate that HID can enhance both long-tail performance and recommendation accuracy, establishing new state-of-the-art performance in long-tail recommender systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对会话推荐中长尾分布导致推荐多样性下降且现有方法存在长尾与准确度跷跷板效应的问题，提出混合意图双约束框架（HID），通过属性感知谱聚类重构物品-意图映射，并设计意图约束损失统一优化多样性与准确度，实验证明HID能同时提升长尾性能和推荐准确性。
Motivation: 传统会话推荐方法在提升长尾物品时会导致准确度下降，存在跷跷板效应，根本原因是未能有效识别和约束尾物品中的会话无关噪声。
Method: 提出HID框架，包含混合意图学习（使用属性感知谱聚类重构物品-意图映射，并为每个会话分配目标意图和噪声意图）和意图约束损失（包含多样性和准确性两种约束范式，通过理论推导统一为单一损失）。
Result: 在多个SBR模型和数据集上，HID同时提升了长尾性能和推荐准确性，建立了长尾推荐系统的新最先进水平。
Conclusion: 通过混合意图的双约束，可以将跷跷板效应转化为双赢，有效解决长尾与准确度的冲突。

papers.title: Humanoid Everyday: A Comprehensive Robotic Dataset for Open-World Humanoid Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: From loco-motion to dextrous manipulation, humanoid robots have made remarkable strides in demonstrating complex full-body capabilities. However, the majority of current robot learning datasets and benchmarks mainly focus on stationary robot arms, and the few existing humanoid datasets are either confined to fixed environments or limited in task diversity, often lacking human-humanoid interaction and lower-body locomotion. Moreover, there are a few standardized evaluation platforms for benchmarking learning-based policies on humanoid data. In this work, we present Humanoid Everyday, a large-scale and diverse humanoid manipulation dataset characterized by extensive task variety involving dextrous object manipulation, human-humanoid interaction, locomotion-integrated actions, and more. Leveraging a highly efficient human-supervised teleoperation pipeline, Humanoid Everyday aggregates high-quality multimodal sensory data, including RGB, depth, LiDAR, and tactile inputs, together with natural language annotations, comprising 10.3k trajectories and over 3 million frames of data across 260 tasks across 7 broad categories. In addition, we conduct an analysis of representative policy learning methods on our dataset, providing insights into their strengths and limitations across different task categories. For standardized evaluation, we introduce a cloud-based evaluation platform that allows researchers to seamlessly deploy their policies in our controlled setting and receive performance feedback. By releasing Humanoid Everyday along with our policy learning analysis and a standardized cloud-based evaluation platform, we intend to advance research in general-purpose humanoid manipulation and lay the groundwork for more capable and embodied robotic agents in real-world scenarios. Our dataset, data collection code, and cloud evaluation website are made publicly available on our project website.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发布了Humanoid Everyday，一个大规模、多样化的人形机器人操作数据集，包含260个任务、10.3k条轨迹和超过300万帧多模态数据（RGB、深度、LiDAR、触觉），并提供自然语言标注和标准化云端评估平台。该数据集涵盖灵巧物体操作、人机交互、运动融合动作等类别，旨在推动通用人形操作研究。
Motivation: 现有机器人学习数据集主要集中在固定机械臂，人形数据集环境固定、任务多样性有限，缺乏人机交互和下肢运动，且缺乏标准化评估平台。
Method: 通过高效的人类监督遥操作管道收集高质量多模态数据，构建包含7大类260个任务的数据集，并引入云端评估平台支持策略部署与性能反馈。
Result: 数据集包含10.3k轨迹、超300万帧数据，覆盖260个任务；对代表性策略学习方法进行分析，揭示了不同任务类别的优劣势。
Conclusion: 该数据集和评估平台为通用人形操作研究奠定基础，促进更强大、具身的机器人在真实场景中的应用。

papers.title: Flow Matching for Efficient and Scalable Data Assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation (DA) estimates a dynamical system's state from noisy observations. Recent generative models like the ensemble score filter (EnSF) improve DA in high-dimensional nonlinear settings but are computationally expensive. We introduce the ensemble flow filter (EnFF), a training-free, flow matching (FM)-based framework that accelerates sampling and offers flexibility in flow design. EnFF uses Monte Carlo estimators for the marginal flow field, localized guidance for observation assimilation, and utilizes a novel flow path that exploits the Bayesian DA formulation. It generalizes classical filters such as the bootstrap particle filter and ensemble Kalman filter. Experiments on high-dimensional benchmarks demonstrate EnFF's improved cost-accuracy tradeoffs and scalability, highlighting FM's potential for efficient, scalable DA. Code is available at https://github.com/Utah-Math-Data-Science/Data-Assimilation-Flow-Matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出集成流滤波器 (EnFF)，一种基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的无训练数据同化框架。EnFF 利用蒙特卡罗估计边际流场，并结合局部化观测指导与贝叶斯流路径，通用化了粒子滤波与集合卡尔曼滤波。在高维基准上，EnFF 展示了更好的成本-精度权衡与可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有数据同化方法如集合分数滤波器 (EnSF) 计算昂贵，限制了高维非线性系统的可扩展性。
Method: EnFF 采用无训练的流匹配框架，通过蒙特卡罗估计边际流场，并引入局部化观测指导与贝叶斯流路径来加速采样并提升灵活性。
Result: 在多个高维基准上，EnFF 实现了改进的成本-精度权衡，并展示了良好的可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调流匹配在高效、可扩展数据同化中的潜力，EnFF 可作为通用滤波器框架。

papers.title: Assessment of Personality Dimensions Across Situations in Dyadic Role-Play Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Prior research indicates that users prefer assistive technologies whose personalities align with their own. This has sparked interest in automatic personality perception (APP), which aims to predict an individual's perceived personality traits. Previous studies in APP have treated personalities as static traits, independent of context. However, perceived personalities can vary by context and situation as shown in psychological research. In this study, we investigate the relationship between conversational speech and perceived personality for participants engaged in two work situations (a neutral interview and a stressful client interaction). Our key findings are: 1) perceived personalities differ significantly across interactions, 2) loudness, sound level, and spectral flux features are indicative of perceived extraversion, agreeableness, conscientiousness, and openness in neutral interactions, while neuroticism correlates with these features in stressful contexts, 3) handcrafted acoustic features and non-verbal features outperform speaker embeddings in inference of perceived personality, and 4) stressful interactions are more predictive of neuroticism, aligning with existing psychological research.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Affective Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究双人角色扮演场景中，不同工作情境（中性面试和压力客户互动）下对话语音与感知人格维度之间的关系。发现感知人格在不同交互中显著不同，声学特征与非言语特征在预测人格方面优于说话人嵌入，且压力情境更能预测神经质。
Motivation: 现有自动人格感知研究将人格视为静态特质，忽略情境变化。心理学表明人格感知随情境变化，本文旨在探索不同工作情境下语音特征与人格感知的关系。
Method: 分析参与者在两种工作情境（中性面试和压力客户互动）中的对话语音，提取响度、声级、谱通量等手工声学特征和非言语特征，并与说话人嵌入对比，预测大五人格维度。
Result: 感知人格在不同交互中差异显著；中性交互中，响度等特征与外向性、宜人性、尽责性、开放性相关，而压力情境中这些特征与神经质相关；手工声学特征和非言语特征优于说话人嵌入；压力交互更能预测神经质。
Conclusion: 研究验证了人格感知的情境依赖性，并表明手工声学特征在自动人格感知中具有优势，为个性化辅助技术提供依据。

papers.title: Critique of World Model
papers.abstract_en: World Model, the algorithmic simulator of the real-world environment which biological agents experience and act upon, has been an emerging topic in recent years due to the rising need to develop virtual agents with artificial (general) intelligence. There has been much discussion on what a world model really is, how to build it, how to use it, and how to evaluate it. In this essay, starting from the imagination in the famed Sci-Fi classic Dune, and drawing inspiration from the concept of ``hypothetical thinking'' in psychology literature, we argue the primary goal of a world model to be {\it simulating all actionable possibilities of the real world for purposeful reasoning and acting}. We examine the key design dimensions of world modeling: data, representation, architecture, learning objective, and usage, surveying existing approaches and analyzing their tradeoffs. Building on this examination, we propose a new Generative Latent Prediction (GLP) architecture for a general-purpose world model, based on stateful, hierarchical, multi-level, and mixed continuous/discrete representations, and a generative and self-supervised learning framework, with an outlook of a Physical, Agentic, and Nested (PAN) AGI system enabled by such a model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从《沙丘》中的想象和心理学「假设性思考」出发，论证世界模型的首要目标是模拟真实世界中所有可行的行动可能，以进行有目的的推理和行动。文章审视了世界模型的关键设计维度，并提出了一种新的生成式潜在预测（GLP）架构，基于有状态、分层、多级、混合连续/离散表示，以及生成式自监督学习框架，展望了由这种模型支持的物理、代理和嵌套（PAN）AGI系统。
Motivation: 世界模型是近期热点，但对于其定义、构建、使用和评估仍存在大量讨论。本文旨在澄清世界模型的核心目标，并系统分析现有方法的权衡。
Method: 提出生成式潜在预测（GLP）架构，该架构使用有状态、分层、多级、混合连续/离散表示，并采用生成式自监督学习框架。
Result: 本文是观点性论文，未报告定量实验结果，但通过概念论证和设计维度分析，提出GLP架构作为通用世界模型的潜在方向。
Conclusion: 世界模型的目标是模拟所有可行的行动可能性，GLP架构结合分层表示和自监督学习可望支撑未来的物理、代理和嵌套AGI系统。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 本文是观点性论文，未报告定量实验结果，但通过概念论证和设计维度分析，提出GLP架构作为通用世界模型的潜在方向。
summary_sections.conclusion: 世界模型的目标是模拟所有可行的行动可能性，GLP架构结合分层表示和自监督学习可望支撑未来的物理、代理和嵌套AGI系统。

papers.title: LaTtE-Flow: Layerwise Timestep-Expert Flow-based Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models unifying image understanding and generation have opened exciting avenues for tackling a wide range of vision-language tasks within a single framework. Despite progress, existing unified models typically require extensive pretraining and struggle to achieve the same level of performance compared to models dedicated to each task. Additionally, many of these models suffer from slow image generation speeds, limiting their practical deployment in real-time or resource-constrained settings. In this work, we propose Layerwise Timestep-Expert Flow-based Transformer (LaTtE-Flow), a novel and efficient architecture that unifies image understanding and generation within a single multimodal model. LaTtE-Flow builds upon powerful pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to inherit strong multimodal understanding capabilities, and extends them with a novel Layerwise Timestep Experts flow-based architecture for efficient image generation. LaTtE-Flow distributes the flow-matching process across specialized groups of Transformer layers, each responsible for a distinct subset of timesteps. This design significantly improves sampling efficiency by activating only a small subset of layers at each sampling timestep. To further enhance performance, we propose a Timestep-Conditioned Residual Attention mechanism for efficient information reuse across layers. Experiments demonstrate that LaTtE-Flow achieves strong performance on multimodal understanding tasks, while achieving competitive image generation quality with around 6x faster inference speed compared to recent unified multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LaTtE-Flow 是一种基于流匹配的统一多模态模型，通过层间时间步专家（Layerwise Timestep Experts）架构，将流匹配过程分布在 Transformer 层的专门化组中，每个组负责不同的时间步子集，从而在采样时仅激活少量层，显著提升推理速度。实验表明，该模型在多模态理解任务上表现强劲，图像生成质量与近期统一模型相当，但推理速度快约6倍。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型要么需要大量预训练，要么在各自任务上性能不如专用模型，且图像生成速度慢，限制了实际部署。
Method: 提出 Layerwise Timestep-Expert Flow-based Transformer，基于预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）构建，并引入层间时间步专家流架构，将流匹配过程分布到不同层组，每个组处理不同时间步；同时提出时间步条件残差注意力机制以实现跨层信息重用。
Result: 在多模态理解任务上表现强劲，图像生成质量与近期统一模型相当，但推理速度提升约6倍。
Conclusion: LaTtE-Flow 通过层间时间步专家设计有效平衡了统一多模态模型的性能与推理效率，适用于实时或资源受限场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bioacoustic Geolocation: Species Sounds as Geographic Signals
papers.abstract_en: Can we determine someone's geographic location solely from the sounds they hear? Are acoustic signals enough to localize within a country, state, or even city? In this work, we tackle the challenge of global-scale audio geolocation, with a particular focus on wildlife and natural sounds. We posit that bioacoustic signals contain informative geolocation cues because of well-defined geographic ranges of species. To test this hypothesis, we benchmark image geolocation and soundscape mapping methods, design oracles and species-centric baselines, and propose a hybrid approach that combines species range prediction with retrieval-based geolocation. We further ask whether geolocation improves with species-diverse recordings and spatiotemporal aggregation across neighboring samples. Finally, we extend our study to multimodal geolocation with case studies from movies that combine both audio and visual content. Our results highlight the potential of incorporating bioacoustic signals into geospatial tasks, motivating future work on species recognition and audio geolocation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了通过生物声学信号（如动物叫声）进行全球尺度地理定位的可能性。作者将音频地理定位视为一个基于物种地理分布的分类问题，并提出了结合物种范围预测与检索的混合方法，在自然声音数据集上评估了定位精度，同时扩展到了包含音频和视频的多模态场景。
Motivation: 现有地理定位研究多依赖图像或文本，而生物声学信号中蕴含的物种分布信息尚未被充分利用。本文旨在验证仅凭自然声音能否实现从国家到城市尺度的精确定位，并推动声学数据在空间任务中的应用。
Method: 设计了多个基线（图像地理定位、声音场景映射）和物种中心基准，并提出一种混合方法：先预测音频中的物种分布范围，再通过检索匹配实现位置估计。还研究了物种多样性和时空聚合对定位的影响。
Result: 实验表明生物声学信号包含有效的地理位置线索，混合方法在多个尺度上优于纯数据驱动基线，且结合多模态信息（音视频）能进一步提升定位精度。
Conclusion: 本文论证了生物声学用于地理定位的可行性，并指出物种识别和音频定位的未来研究方向。当前方法仍受限于物种数据库的覆盖范围和录音噪声。

papers.title: TerraMind: Large-Scale Generative Multimodality for Earth Observation
papers.abstract_en: We present TerraMind, the first any-to-any generative, multimodal foundation model for Earth observation (EO). Unlike other multimodal models, TerraMind is pretrained on dual-scale representations combining both token-level and pixel-level data across modalities. On a token level, TerraMind encodes high-level contextual information to learn cross-modal relationships, while on a pixel level, TerraMind leverages fine-grained representations to capture critical spatial nuances. We pretrained TerraMind on nine geospatial modalities of a global, large-scale dataset. In this paper, we demonstrate that (i) TerraMind's dual-scale early fusion approach unlocks a range of zero-shot and few-shot applications for Earth observation, (ii) TerraMind introduces "Thinking-in-Modalities" (TiM) -- the capability of generating additional artificial data during finetuning and inference to improve the model output -- and (iii) TerraMind achieves beyond state-of-the-art performance in community-standard benchmarks for EO like PANGAEA. The pretraining dataset, the model weights, and our code are open-sourced under a permissive license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TerraMind 是首个面向地球观测（EO）的任意到任意生成式多模态基础模型。该模型在双尺度表示（token 级和像素级）上进行预训练，以学习跨模态关系并捕捉空间细节。论文展示了 TerraMind 的双尺度早期融合方法支持零样本和少样本应用，并引入了“模态思考”（TiM）能力，即在微调和推理时生成额外人工数据以改善输出。TerraMind 在 PANGAEA 等社区标准 EO 基准上达到了超越现有技术的性能。
Motivation: 现有地球观测模型通常处理单一模态或有限模态，缺乏统一的多模态生成式预训练框架。TerraMind 旨在构建一个能够处理多种地理空间模态并支持任意到任意生成的基础模型。
Method: 采用双尺度表示预训练：token 级编码高层上下文以学习模态间关系，像素级编码细粒度特征以捕捉空间细节。基于九种地理空间模态的全球大规模数据集进行预训练，并提出“模态思考”（TiM）策略，在微调和推理时生成额外人工数据。
Result: 在 PANGAEA 等地球观测基准上取得超越现有技术的结果，并展示了零样本和少样本应用的能力。
Conclusion: TerraMind 作为首个任意到任意生成的多模态 EO 基础模型，验证了双尺度早期融合和 TiM 策略的有效性。模型权重和代码已开源。

papers.title: A Unified Perspective on the Dynamics of Deep Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Transformers, which are state-of-the-art in most machine learning tasks, represent the data as sequences of vectors called tokens. This representation is then exploited by the attention function, which learns dependencies between tokens and is key to the success of Transformers. However, the iterative application of attention across layers induces complex dynamics that remain to be fully understood. To analyze these dynamics, we identify each input sequence with a probability measure and model its evolution as a Vlasov equation called Transformer PDE, whose velocity field is non-linear in the probability measure. Our first set of contributions focuses on compactly supported initial data. We show the Transformer PDE is well-posed and is the mean-field limit of an interacting particle system, thus generalizing and extending previous analysis to several variants of self-attention: multi-head attention, L2 attention, Sinkhorn attention, Sigmoid attention, and masked attention--leveraging a conditional Wasserstein framework. In a second set of contributions, we are the first to study non-compactly supported initial conditions, by focusing on Gaussian initial data. Again for different types of attention, we show that the Transformer PDE preserves the space of Gaussian measures, which allows us to analyze the Gaussian case theoretically and numerically to identify typical behaviors. This Gaussian analysis captures the evolution of data anisotropy through a deep Transformer. In particular, we highlight a clustering phenomenon that parallels previous results in the non-normalized discrete case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从概率测度视角统一分析深度Transformer的动力学行为，将输入序列演化建模为Vlasov型偏微分方程（Transformer PDE），并证明其对于多种自注意力变体（多注意力、L2注意力、Sinkhorn注意力、Sigmoid注意力、掩码注意力）的适定性与均场极限。针对非紧支撑初始条件，首次分析高斯情形，证明Transformer PDE保持高斯测度空间，从而揭示数据各向异性演化及聚类现象。
Motivation: Transformer的逐层注意力迭代产生复杂动力学，缺乏统一理论理解；现有分析多限于紧支撑初始条件或特定注意力机制。
Method: 将每个输入序列视为概率测度，推导Transformer PDE（速度场为测度非线性的Vlasov方程）；分别针对紧支撑初始数据验证适定性与均场极限，并针对高斯初始数据利用高斯测度不变性进行理论与数值分析。
Result: 证明多种注意力变体的Transformer PDE适定且为粒子系统的均场极限；在非归一化离散情形下，高斯分析捕获数据各向异性演化，并复现聚类现象。
Conclusion: 该统一视角为理解Transformer深层动力学提供了理论框架，但分析限于特定初始分布（紧支撑或高斯），实际训练中的复杂分布仍需进一步研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluating deep learning models for fault diagnosis of a rotating machinery with epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty-aware deep learning (DL) models recently gained attention in fault diagnosis as a way to promote the reliable detection of faults when out-of-distribution (OOD) data arise from unseen faults (epistemic uncertainty) or the presence of noise (aleatoric uncertainty). In this paper, we present the first comprehensive comparative study of state-of-the-art uncertainty-aware DL architectures for fault diagnosis in rotating machinery, where different scenarios affected by epistemic uncertainty and different types of aleatoric uncertainty are investigated. The selected architectures include sampling by dropout, Bayesian neural networks, and deep ensembles. Moreover, to distinguish between in-distribution and OOD data in the different scenarios two uncertainty thresholds, one of which is introduced in this paper, are alternatively applied. Our empirical findings offer guidance to practitioners and researchers who have to deploy real-world uncertainty-aware fault diagnosis systems. In particular, they reveal that, in the presence of epistemic uncertainty, all DL models are capable of effectively detecting, on average, a substantial portion of OOD data across all the scenarios. However, deep ensemble models show superior performance, independently of the uncertainty threshold used for discrimination. In the presence of aleatoric uncertainty, the noise level plays an important role. Specifically, low noise levels hinder the models' ability to effectively detect OOD data. Even in this case, however, deep ensemble models exhibit a milder degradation in performance, dominating the others. These achievements, combined with their shorter inference time, make deep ensemble architectures the preferred choice.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对多种不确定性感知深度学习模型在旋转机械故障诊断中的性能进行了全面比较，包括dropout采样、贝叶斯神经网络和深度集成。研究考虑由未见故障引起的认知不确定性和由噪声引起的偶然不确定性，并应用两种不确定性阈值（其中一种为新提出）区分分布内与分布外数据。实验表明，深度集成模型在所有场景下均表现最佳，且推理时间更短。
Motivation: 现有不确定性感知深度学习模型在故障诊断中的应用缺乏系统性比较，尤其是在旋转机械领域面临不同类型不确定性时的表现尚不清楚。
Method: 选取采样dropout、贝叶斯神经网络和深度集成三种架构，在认知不确定性和偶然不确定性的多种场景下进行对比。采用两种不确定性阈值（包括新提出的阈值）进行分布外数据检测。
Result: 在认知不确定性下，所有模型均能有效检测大部分分布外数据；深度集成模型性能最优，且不受阈值选择影响。在偶然不确定性下，低噪声水平削弱检测能力，但深度集成模型性能下降更温和，且推理时间更短。
Conclusion: 深度集成架构因其优越性能和较短推理时间，成为不确定性感知故障诊断系统的首选方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representing Piecewise-Linear Functions by Functions with Minimal Arity
papers.abstract_en: Any continuous piecewise-linear function $F\colon \mathbb{R}^{n}\to \mathbb{R}$ can be represented as a linear combination of $\max$ functions of at most $n+1$ affine-linear functions. In our previous paper [``Representing piecewise linear functions by functions with small arity'', AAECC, 2023], we showed that this upper bound of $n+1$ arguments is tight. In the present paper, we extend this result by establishing a correspondence between the function $F$ and the minimal number of arguments that are needed in any such decomposition. We show that the tessellation of the input space $\mathbb{R}^{n}$ induced by the function $F$ has a direct connection to the number of arguments in the $\max$ functions.

papers.title: Wisdom of Committee: Diverse Distillation from Large Foundation Models and Domain Experts
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge distillation from foundation models to compact domain models is challenging due to substantial gaps in capacity, architecture, and modality. For example, in our experiments, distilling from a 76M-parameter language model to a 2M-parameter recommender closes less than 40% of the performance gap between the undistilled student and the teacher. We show that introducing domain-specific experts -- which share the student's architectural characteristics -- alongside the foundation model as a diverse teacher committee significantly improves transfer. However, standard multi-teacher methods fail to exploit this diversity: naively combining heterogeneous teachers can degrade performance below single-teacher distillation. To address this, we propose DiverseDistill, an interactive distillation framework that employs a learnable Question-Answer mechanism to generate teacher-conditioned queries and align heterogeneous teacher outputs into the student's representation space. Unlike methods requiring gradient-based co-optimization or architectural modification of teachers, DiverseDistill operates with frozen teachers using only forward-pass inference through their intermediate layers: no parameter updates, no co-training, and no architectural surgery. A dynamic teacher importance mechanism further reduces training cost by filtering low-relevance teachers per sample (e.g., ~30% fewer forward passes with no quality loss for recommendation tasks), while the entire Distillation Module is discarded after training, adding zero inference overhead. Evaluations on recommendation (38x compression) and vision (3.6x compression) tasks demonstrate that DiverseDistill recovers 73-114% of the teacher-student performance gap, consistently outperforming all single- and multi-teacher baselines.

TL;DR: 本文提出DiverseDistill框架，通过可学习的问答机制从多样化教师委员会（基础模型+领域专家）向紧凑学生模型进行知识蒸馏，在推荐任务（38倍压缩）和视觉任务（3.6倍压缩）上恢复了73-114%的师生性能差距，且无额外推理开销。
Motivation: 从基础模型蒸馏到紧凑领域模型面临容量、架构和模态的巨大差距，而标准多教师方法未能有效利用教师之间的多样性。
Method: DiverseDistill采用可学习的问答机制生成教师条件查询，将异构教师输出对齐到学生表示空间，并使用动态教师重要性机制过滤低相关教师以减少训练成本。
Result: 在推荐和视觉任务上，DiverseDistill恢复了73-114%的师生性能差距，优于所有单教师和多教师基线，同时通过动态教师过滤节省约30%前向传播。
Conclusion: 所提蒸馏框架有效利用了教师委员会的多样性，零推理开销，方法通用。

papers.title: Execution-bound advisory automation for agentic AI: a reproducible AIBOM-driven CSAF-VEX framework
papers.abstract_en: A protocol driven framework is presented that binds SBOM and AIBOM artefacts to deterministic environment capture and structured runtime telemetry. Exploitability is computed from declared artefacts, observed activation conditions, and enforced execution policies. CSAF VEX advisories are generated from combined static and runtime evidence, cryptographically signed, and validated through deterministic replay. Evaluation uses approximately 10000 component entries across synthetic Agentic AI workloads 50 to 5000 components, incorporating OSV, GitHub Advisory, KEV, and EPSS datasets.
papers.journal_ref: Execution-bound advisory automation for agentic AI: a reproducible AIBOM-driven CSAF-VEX framework. Front Artif Intell 9, (May 2026), 1826384
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一个协议驱动的框架，将SBOM和AIBOM工件与确定性环境捕获及结构化运行时遥测绑定，通过声明式工件、观察到的激活条件和执行策略计算可利用性，并生成CSAF VEX安全建议，经加密签名并通过确定性重放验证。评估使用约10000个组件条目，涵盖合成Agentic AI工作负载（50至5000个组件），结合OSV、GitHub Advisory、KEV和EPSS数据集。
Motivation: 现有安全咨询自动化缺乏将运行时证据与声明式工件绑定的标准化方法，难以生成可验证的漏洞可利用性评估。
Method: 提出结合SBOM/AIBOM、确定性环境捕获和运行时遥测的框架，基于静态和运行时证据生成CSAF VEX建议，并通过加密签名和确定性重放确保可重复验证。
Result: 在合成Agentic AI工作负载上评估，包含约10000个组件，利用OSV、GitHub Advisory、KEV和EPSS数据集验证了框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了从声明式工件和运行时证据到可验证安全建议的自动化流程，提高了漏洞管理的可追溯性和可信度。

papers.title: Interpretable and Verifiable Hardware Generation with LLM-Driven Stepwise Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in software development. However, they are susceptible to hallucinations, meaning that they can introduce subtle semantic and logical errors. Due to the high stakes in chip design and manufacturing, hardware engineers are still reluctant to rely on LLMs for register-transfer level (RTL) generation. In this paper, we propose a hardware generation framework that combines the creativity and broad knowledge of LLMs with the explainability and mathematical rigor of formal methods. Specifically, we devise a set of transformation rules that cover various design decisions and hardware features. By iteratively applying these rules, an LLM agent can convert a design specification into an RTL program with guaranteed correctness. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合大语言模型（LLM）与形式化方法的硬件生成框架，通过一组预定义的转换规则实现从设计规范到寄存器传输级（RTL）程序的逐步精化，并保证正确性。实验证明该框架有效且高效。
Motivation: LLM在生成RTL代码时容易产生幻觉（语义和逻辑错误），而硬件设计对可靠性要求极高，导致工程师不愿依赖LLM。需要一种结合LLM创造力与形式化方法可解释性和严谨性的方案。
Method: 设计一组覆盖设计决策和硬件特性的转换规则；LLM代理迭代应用这些规则，将高级规范逐步转换为正确性可保证的RTL程序。
Result: 实验结果表明该框架在生成RTL时有效且高效。
Conclusion: 通过将LLM的创造力与形式化方法的数学严谨性结合，可以实现可解释且可验证的硬件生成，有望提升工程师对AI辅助设计的信任。

papers.title: Bistable by Construction: Wall-Clock-Calibrated State Monitors Have No Moment-Detection Regime at Agent Cadence
papers.abstract_en: Runtime monitors for autonomous agents commonly threshold an accumulated internal state - a behavioural baseline, a drift statistic, or, in our prior work, a modelled affective state. We previously reported a State Saturation Trap: threshold-on-state triggers over a continuous affect engine become near-constant alarms on SWE-bench debugging agents (Modgil 2026). A post-release audit found the engine received dt=0 between actions, so its exponential decay never operated: the published trap is a pure-accumulator result. We correct the record (erratum, v2) and treat the flaw as an experiment. The key variable it exposes is whether a monitor's dynamics are calibrated in sample time (per observation, as in CUSUM) or wall-clock time (half-lives in seconds, as in affect models and EMA baselines). On fixed-rate streams these coincide; on agent streams, where inter-action time varies by orders of magnitude, they do not. A pre-registered sweep over uniform intervals (dt in {0..600}s) on 20 trajectories shows the wall-clock level trigger has two regimes: at dt<=1s a constant alarm (20/20; median 18 firings); at dt>=60s silent. Every critical dt lies in (1,30]s. Real agent runs measure latency at median 1.53s (p90 2.33s); real coding cadence sits inside the trap regime, vindicating the empirical finding under a corrected mechanism. The structure is a property of the calibration class, not the engine: a minimal wall-clock accumulator over the raw error stream reproduces the same cliff, while a sample-time CUSUM over the identical stream is exactly dt-invariant (20/20). A rising-edge trigger with hysteresis fires 0-3 times per trajectory in every condition. We conclude that wall-clock-calibrated leaky-integrator monitors admit no regime in which they act as moment detectors on agent streams; transition detection escapes the trap at every cadence, but does not recover human intervention timing.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文纠正了之前关于自主智能体运行时监视器中“状态饱和陷阱”的错误，发现原引擎因dt=0而从未执行指数衰减，实际是个纯累加器。实验表明，基于挂钟时间校准的泄漏积分器监视器在智能体流上只有恒定报警或静默两个状态，不存在瞬间检测模式，而基于样本时间的CUSUM则完美不受间隔影响。
Motivation: 先前工作报告的状态饱和陷阱被证实是由实现缺陷（dt=0）导致的纯累加器结果，需要纠正并揭示校准时间类型对监视器行为的根本影响。
Method: 通过预注册实验，在均匀间隔（dt=0至600秒）和真实智能体轨迹上比较挂钟时间校准（如情感模型、EMA基线）与样本时间校准（如CUSUM）的泄漏积分器行为。
Result: 挂钟时间触发器在dt≤1秒时恒报警（20/20），dt≥60秒时静默；真实智能体延迟中位数1.53秒（p90 2.33秒）落在陷阱区间内。样本时间CUSUM完全dt不变。上升沿滞回触发器每次发射0-3次。
Conclusion: 挂钟校准的泄漏积分器监视器在智能体流上不存在瞬间检测模式，过渡检测可避开陷阱但无法恢复人类干预时机。

papers.title: 3D Scene Graphs: Open Challenges and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: 3D Scene Graphs (3DSGs) have emerged as a powerful representation for spatial AI by combining geometric grounding with semantic and relational abstractions of the environment. Their expressiveness has made them relevant to a broad range of problems in robotics and computer vision, including manipulation, navigation, task planning, scene understanding, and many others. However, the field remains fragmented: different communities adopt distinct formulations, construction pipelines, and evaluation protocols, making it difficult to compare methods, identify common assumptions, and assess remaining challenges for robust real-world deployment. This survey provides a unified and critical review of 3DSGs, with particular emphasis on open challenges and future directions. We first formalize 3DSGs under a common definition and analyze the principal modeling choices that characterize existing formulations, including node and edge attributes, hierarchical structure, dynamic scene representations, and affordance-aware extensions. We then review how 3DSGs are built from raw sensory observations, discussing the most common terminologies, conventions, and techniques. Finally, we examine downstream applications and evaluation strategies, from intrinsic graph quality to task-level performance. To support the community, we also provide a dedicated website that organizes and extends the surveyed content, accessible at https://3dscenegraphs.com/.
papers.comment: Invited article for the Annual Review of Control, Robotics, and Autonomous Systems Volume 10
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于3D场景图（3D Scene Graphs）的综述性文章，旨在统一该领域的定义、建模选择、构建管道、下游应用和评估策略，并重点讨论开放挑战与未来方向。文章指出该领域当前存在社区碎片化、方法难以比较等问题，并提供了一个组织相关内容的网站。
Motivation: 3D场景图在空间AI中具有强大表达能力，但该领域存在社区碎片化、定义不统一、评估协议不兼容等问题，导致难以比较不同方法及识别真实部署中的挑战。
Method: 通过统一正式定义3D场景图，分析节点/边属性、层次结构、动态表示和可操作性扩展等建模选择；综述从原始传感器数据构建3D场景图的常用术语和技术；总结下游应用与内在质量、任务级性能评估策略。
Result: 无定量实验结果，本综述定性地梳理了现有工作并指出了开放问题。
Conclusion: 强调领域需要统一的定义和评估标准，并提供了公开网站（https://3dscenegraphs.com/）作为持续资源。

papers.title: Human Universal Grasping
papers.abstract_en: Humans can grasp objects effortlessly, whereas multi-fingered robots are far from this level of generality. We argue that the most natural source of robot grasping data is from humans, who pick up thousands of objects every day. We present HUG, a flow-matching model that generates diverse human grasps for any user-specified object in a single RGB-D image captured from a stereo camera. Using smart glasses, we first collect 1M-HUGs, an egocentric dataset of human grasps spanning 1M frames (27.8 hrs) and 6,707 object instances across 41 buildings. Next, to model the distribution of natural human grasps, our novel flow-matching model fuses RGB and depth observations to output a grasp parameterized by wrist translation, wrist rotation, and MANO hand pose. Predicted grasps can be retargeted to various robot hands, enabling zero-shot grasping in everyday scenes. To standardize evaluation, we build a new simulated benchmark, HUG-Bench, of 90 unseen objects from five geometric categories and various sizes, with metric-scale 3D meshes. We evaluate HUG in the real world on the 30-object test set of HUG-Bench across multiple stereo cameras, robot embodiments, and household environments. HUG outperforms the state-of-the-art grasping baselines by +23% and +34% on our challenging object set. Code, data, benchmark, checkpoints, and an interactive demo are released on our website: https://grasping.io/

papers.title: DynAMO:Dynamic Asset Management Orchestration via Topological Multi-Agent Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: While LLM-powered agents offer end-to-end automation for industrial asset lifecycles, real-world Industry 4.0 deployment is hindered by latency, concurrency instability, and safety risks. We present DynAMO (Dynamic Asset Management Orchestration), a deployment-ready engine using a Plan-then-Execute architecture to generate verifiable workflow graphs. DynAMO supports both SequentialWorkflow (topological execution) and ParallelWorkflow (dependency-aware concurrency). By dynamically identifying independent tasks, DynAMO preserves structural correctness and safety while significantly improving efficiency through controlled reasoning overlap. Across six controlled experiments on the AssetOpsBench industrial benchmark, DynAMO demonstrates substantial performance and robustness gains. Parallel execution reduces end-to-end latency by a median of 1.6x over sequential orchestration, rising to 1.8x on highly parallelizable workflows. After instrumenting external tool calls with realistic latencies, a latency decomposition shows that LLM reasoning and orchestration still account for more than 90% of execution time, identifying model inference as the primary system bottleneck. Structured context pruning reduces inference latency by approximately 30%, and DynAMO maintains correct functional behaviour (task completion, agent sequencing, and output quality) while exhibiting graceful degradation under controlled fault injection. Reproducibility analysis further confirms stable execution under repeated runs, with parallel scheduling reducing latency variance. These findings establish DynAMO as a practical blueprint for scalable, safe, and latency-aware agent deployment in Industry 4.0 automation pipelines. Code is available at: https://github.com/kushwaha001/DynAMO
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables, 4 algorithms. Evaluated on the AssetOpsBench industrial benchmark. Code: https://github.com/kushwaha001/DynAMO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DynAMO 是一个面向工业资产管理的动态编排引擎，采用 Plan-then-Execute 架构生成可验证的工作流图，支持顺序执行和依赖感知的并行执行。在 AssetOpsBench 工业基准测试中，并行执行将端到端延迟中位数降低 1.6 倍，结构化上下文剪枝减少约 30% 推理延迟，并在故障注入下保持正确行为。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的智能体在工业 4.0 部署中面临延迟高、并发不稳定和安全风险等问题，缺乏实用、安全的编排方案。
Method: 提出 DynAMO 引擎，包含 Plan-then-Execute 架构，生成拓扑工作流图，并动态识别独立任务以支持并行执行；同时引入结构化上下文剪枝和故障注入下的优雅降级机制。

papers.title: Improving Code-Switching ASR with Code-Mixing Guided Synthetic Speech
papers.abstract_en: Code-switch (CS) Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) remains challenging due to limited availability of high quality CS text-speech pairs for training. Although synthetic data augmentation via Text-to-speech (TTS) has been explored, existing CS TTS approaches primarily optimise reconstruction fidelity and do not explicitly enforce language-boundary consistency, thereby limiting their effectiveness for CS ASR augmentation. This paper proposes a code-mixing guided preference-learning framework that steers synthetic speech generation toward improved code-switching fidelity using the Code Mixing Index (CMI). Experiments on the SEAME Mandarin-English conversational corpus demonstrate that the proposed method enhances the utility of synthetic data for ASR fine-tuning. Specifically, when fine-tuning Whisper Large, the proposed approach reduces Mixed Error Rate (MER) from 12.1%/17.8% to 8.9%/14.2% on the DevMAN and DevSGE sets, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对代码切换（Code-Switching, CS）语音识别中高质量文本-语音对稀缺的问题，提出一种码混合引导的偏好学习框架，通过码混合指数（Code Mixing Index, CMI）优化合成语音的生成，使其更符合真实代码切换模式。在SEAME普通话-英语对话语料库上，该方法在Whisper Large微调中，DevMAN和DevSGE测试集上的混合错误率（MER）从12.1%/17.8%降至8.9%/14.2%。
Motivation: 现有代码切换ASR因缺乏高质量CS语音文本对而性能受限；而基于TTS的数据增强方法仅优化重建保真度，未显式约束语码边界一致性，导致对CS ASR的增强效果有限。
Method: 提出码混合引导的偏好学习框架，利用码混合指数（CMI）作为信号，引导合成语音生成朝向更高的代码切换保真度。
Result: 在SEAME语料库上，微调Whisper Large后，DevMAN集MER从12.1%降至8.9%，DevSGE集从17.8%降至14.2%。
Conclusion: 该方法能有效提升合成数据对CS ASR微调的效用，但局限性可能在于仅验证了单一语料库和模型，且依赖CMI指标的合理性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgentArmor: A Framework, Evaluation, \& Mitigation of Coding Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: Software engineering and deployment are increasingly being delegated to AI coding agents. The scale of their adoption is surfacing rare, but highly destructive, failure modes. In this paper, we study these failure modes as stemming from three distinct mechanisms: underspecification, where default model behavior is unsafe; capability errors, where the safe action is available but the model does not adhere to it due to bias or capability limitations; and agent harness errors, where the model fails to execute the safe action through the harness. We evaluate these across 8 different evaluations, each inspired by real-life deployment failures, totaling 20 coding environments and 59 synthetic transcript templates. Based on this evaluation, we propose AgentArmor, an agent harness modification, to mitigate these errors. By adding an extended system prompt, a separate command classifier, a ``3 strikes'' policy, deterministic guardrails, and tools for the agent to edit its own context, we show that AgentArmor is safer across a statistically significant number of samples. Thus, we suggest concrete mitigations for current coding agents and a design philosophy for future agent harness features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 编码代理在软件工程和部署中的失败模式，将其归因于三种机制：欠规格（underspecification）、能力错误（capability errors）和代理工具错误（agent harness errors）。作者提出 AgentArmor，一种代理工具修改方法，包括扩展系统提示、单独命令分类器、“三击”策略、确定性护栏和上下文编辑工具，并在 8 个评估、20 个编码环境和 59 个合成模板中验证其安全性改进。
Motivation: AI 编码代理的大规模采用暴露了罕见但破坏性的失败模式，现有研究缺乏对这些故障的系统分类和缓解方法。
Method: 提出 AgentArmor 框架，通过修改代理工具（harness）来缓解三类故障：添加扩展系统提示、单独命令分类器、“三击”策略、确定性护栏，以及允许代理编辑自身上下文的工具。
Result: 在 8 个不同评估（共 20 个编码环境和 59 个合成模板）上，AgentArmor 在统计显著样本上更安全。
Conclusion: 论文建议对当前编码代理实施具体缓解措施，并为未来代理工具功能提供设计理念。

papers.title: How Linear Is a Transformer Feed-Forward Block? Per-Block Linear Recoverability Is Learned, Not Architectural
papers.abstract_en: Transformer feed-forward networks (FFNs) are often treated as nonlinear stores of computation, yet how nonlinear a trained FFN block actually is has rarely been measured. We treat each FFN as a position-wise input-to-output map and split it into the exact least-squares linear approximation plus a residual. The held-out variance the closed-form linear map explains defines a block's linear recoverability (R^2_lin), an optimiser-free measure of its linearity. Across all twelve blocks of GPT-2, Pythia-160m, and llama-160m, R^2_lin is highly heterogeneous and non-monotone with depth, ranging from near-linear (>0.99) to strongly nonlinear (<0.3) between adjacent blocks, and is not set by the activation function: same-width GELU models GPT-2 and Pythia-160m have sharply different profiles, so recoverability is a learned property of individual trained blocks, not an architectural one. A low-rank bilinear probe of the residual recovers only a few points of R^2, with gain uncorrelated with residual nonlinearity: the unrecovered computation is not a single position-wise product but higher-order or distributed structure. The measurement also serves as a targeted compression signal: recoverable blocks admit large single-layer replacements (GPT-2's early FFN at 8x fewer parameters for +0.77 perplexity), while low-recoverability blocks flag where this is unsafe. It further exposes a methodological pitfall: trained linear baselines can badly under-converge on ill-conditioned transformer activations, so we report the exact closed-form least-squares ceiling throughout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文测量了Transformer中每个前馈网络（FFN）块的线性可恢复性（R²_lin），发现不同块之间的线性程度差异很大，且不是由架构（如激活函数）决定的，而是训练后的性质。还展示了线性可恢复性可用于模型压缩和揭示训练基线问题。
Motivation: Transformer FFN通常被视为非线性计算模块，但实际训练后的非线性程度未被测量。需要量化每个FFN块的线性程度及其影响因素。
Method: 将每个FFN视为位置级输入输出映射，分解为精确最小二乘线性近似加上残差，用保留方差解释率（R²_lin）衡量线性可恢复性。对GPT-2、Pythia-160m、llama-160m的12个块进行分析，并测试低秩双线性探针和单层替换压缩。
Result: R²_lin高度异质且非单调，范围从接近线性（>0.99）到强非线性（<0.3），激活函数不能决定线性程度。可恢复性高的块可用单层替换（8倍参数减少，困惑度增加+0.77），低可恢复性块则不安全。还发现训练线性基线在病态条件下可能欠收敛。
Conclusion: 线性可恢复性是训练后的属性，而非架构属性；可以作为压缩信号，并可揭示方法论陷阱。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Hybrid GNN-FEM Framework for Phase-Field Fracture Simulation. Physics-Preserving Hybridization for Generalizable Surrogate Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Scientific machine learning (SciML) has emerged as a promising approach for accelerating simulations of complex physical systems, yet achieving physically consistent and generalizable predictions for nonlinear, history-dependent problems remains a central challenge. In this study, we propose a hybrid GNN--FEM framework for efficient and generalizable phase-field fracture modeling. While phase-field approaches provide a robust variational framework for simulating complex crack evolution, their high computational cost limits practical applications because they require solving coupled, nonlinear, and history-dependent systems within an incremental finite element procedure. To address this challenge, a graph neural network surrogate is integrated into the conventional staggered scheme, replacing the phase-field update at each load increment while retaining the FEM-based displacement solver to enforce mechanical equilibrium and boundary conditions. By preserving the incremental solution structure, the framework remains consistent with history-dependent fracture evolution without requiring the surrogate to approximate the full solution trajectory. This selective surrogate strategy emphasizes the identification of a physically meaningful and incrementally structured learning target, rather than relying on brute-force data generation to learn the full fracture process. The proposed framework achieves strong generalization across varying geometries, loading conditions, material properties, and discretizations through dimensionless feature design, a graph-based formulation on mesh-based domains, and a physics-informed loss derived from the governing phase-field equation. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the hybrid approach reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy compared with conventional FEM, and exhibits robust predictive performance across diverse problem settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出混合GNN-FEM框架用于相场断裂模拟，将图神经网络代理集成到传统交错方案中，替代每个载荷增量下的相场更新，同时保留基于FEM的位移求解器以强制执行力学平衡和边界条件。通过保持增量解结构，框架与历史依赖的断裂演化保持一致，无需代理逼近完整解轨迹。数值实验表明，该方法在降低计算成本的同时保持精度，并在不同几何、载荷、材料属性和离散化下展现出强泛化能力。
Motivation: 相场断裂模拟由于需要求解耦合非线性历史依赖系统，计算成本高，限制了实际应用。现有代理模型通常需要大量数据学习完整断裂过程，且难以保证物理一致性。
Method: 提出混合GNN-FEM框架：保留FEM位移求解器，仅用图神经网络替代每个载荷增量下的相场更新；采用无量纲特征设计、基于网格的图表示和由相场控制方程导出的物理信息损失函数。
Result: 数值实验表明该混合方法在保持精度与常规FEM相当的同时降低了计算成本，并在不同几何、载荷、材料属性和离散化下展现出稳健的预测性能。
Conclusion: 该框架通过选择性代理策略和物理信息学习，实现了对历史依赖断裂演化的高效泛化建模，为非线性历史依赖问题的SciML提供了新思路。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出混合GNN-FEM框架用于相场断裂模拟，将图神经网络代理集成到传统交错方案中，替代每个载荷增量下的相场更新，同时保留基于FEM的位移求解器以强制执行力学平衡和边界条件。通过保持增量解结构，框架与历史依赖的断裂演化保持一致，无需代理逼近完整解轨迹。数值实验表明，该方法在降低计算成本的同时保持精度，并在不同几何、载荷、材料属性和离散化下展现出强泛化能力。

summary_sections.method: 提出混合GNN-FEM框架：保留FEM位移求解器，仅用图神经网络替代每个载荷增量下的相场更新；采用无量纲特征设计、基于网格的图表示和由相场控制方程导出的物理信息损失函数。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架通过选择性代理策略和物理信息学习，实现了对历史依赖断裂演化的高效泛化建模，为非线性历史依赖问题的SciML提供了新思路。

papers.title: Emyx: Fast and efficient all-atom protein generation
papers.abstract_en: Computational enzyme design requires generating proteins that scaffold catalytic residues and ligands, a task that demands both geometric accuracy and structural diversity from the underlying generative model. Current all-atom generators inherit expensive architectures from structure prediction, leading to high training costs and limited sample diversity. We argue that much of this complexity is unnecessary for generators, which condition on sparse geometric constraints rather than rich co-evolutionary signals. Emyx is a 140M-parameter conditional flow matching model that concentrates capacity within standard transformer blocks, replacing heavy embedding stacks with lightweight conditional representations and sparse connectivity. We additionally derive an exact reparametrisation of the flow matching interpolant into the EDM noise-level framework, bridging flow matching training efficiency with state-of-the-art sampling methods designed for diffusion models without retraining. Despite being the smallest model, Emyx outperforms both Proteína-Complexa and RFdiffusion3 against the AME enzyme design benchmark across success rate under strict evaluation requiring both global fold recovery and catalytic geometry accuracy, structural novelty, scaffold diversity, and geometric validity, while training in just $682$ GPU-hours, roughly $4\times$ less than RFdiffusion3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Emyx 是一个 140M 参数的 conditional flow matching 模型，用于全原子蛋白质生成。它通过标准 Transformer 块和轻量条件表示替代昂贵的嵌入堆叠，并推导出将 flow matching 插值重新参数化为 EDM 噪声级别的精确方法。在 AME 酶设计基准上，Emyx 在全局折叠恢复、催化几何精度、结构新颖性、支架多样性和几何有效性方面均优于 Proteína-Complexa 和 RFdiffusion3，且训练仅需 682 GPU 小时，约为 RFdiffusion3 的 1/4。
Motivation: 当前全原子蛋白质生成模型继承了结构预测的昂贵架构，导致高训练成本和有限的样本多样性。这些复杂性对于生成模型而言是不必要的，因为生成模型只需处理稀疏几何约束而非丰富的共进化信号。
Method: Emyx 采用 140M 参数的 conditional flow matching 模型，将容量集中在标准 Transformer 块中，用轻量条件表示和稀疏连接替代重嵌入堆叠。同时，推导了将 flow matching 插值精确重新参数化为 EDM 噪声级别的方法，无需重新训练即可利用针对扩散模型的最先进采样方法。
Result: 在 AME 酶设计基准的严格评估（要求全局折叠恢复和催化几何精度）下，Emyx 在成功率、结构新颖性、支架多样性和几何有效性方面均优于 Proteína-Complexa 和 RFdiffusion3，训练仅需 682 GPU 小时（约 RFdiffusion3 的 1/4）。
Conclusion: Emyx 证明了轻量级架构和条件 flow matching 在全原子蛋白质生成中的有效性，能以更低成本实现更强的性能和多样性。

papers.title: Cost-Optimal LLM Routing with Limited User Feedback under User Satisfaction Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Inference costs for large language model (LLM) applications are rapidly growing, driven by surging demand and rising infrastructure cost. Users expect high-quality responses, and in commercial settings this is formally codified in Service Level Agreements (SLAs), creating a fundamental tension between cost and quality. Recent progress on cost-aware LLM request routing has shown potential to resolve this tension, but existing approaches rely on complete feedback signals, offline training, extensive per-workload tuning, and most lack SLA guarantees or inference-time adaptivity. We introduce SLARouter, an online routing algorithm that learns a cost-optimal policy from the sparse, one-sided user feedback available in production systems. SLARouter provides theoretical guarantees for both cost optimality and strict SLA compliance. Experiments across a wide range of LLM benchmarks show that SLARouter satisfies SLA constraints without the need for per-benchmark tuning, reducing operating cost by up to 2.2x over existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）推理服务中成本与用户服务质量（SLA）之间的权衡，提出在线路由算法SLARouter。该算法仅利用生产系统中稀疏的单侧用户反馈学习成本最优策略，同时提供成本最优性和严格SLA满足的理论保证。实验表明SLARouter在多种LLM基准上无需每基准调参即满足SLA约束，并将运营成本降低至基准方法的2.2倍。
Motivation: 现有LLM路由方法依赖完整反馈信号、离线训练和大量每工作负载调参，且多数缺乏SLA保证或推理时自适应能力。实际生产环境中用户反馈稀疏且单侧，导致成本和质量的权衡难以解决。
Method: 提出SLARouter在线路由算法，从稀疏、单侧用户反馈中学习成本最优策略，并给出成本最优性和严格SLA合规的理论保证。
Result: 在多种LLM基准上，SLARouter无需每基准调参即可满足SLA约束，运营成本降低至现有基准方法的2.2倍。
Conclusion: SLARouter通过在线学习稀疏反馈，实现了成本最优性和SLA保证，无需额外调参，适用于生产环境。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Physics-Informed Discovery of Yield Functions in Plasticity via Convex Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Identifying anisotropic yield functions remains challenging since yielding is not directly observed in full-field mechanical measurements, directional calibration can require many loading directions, and selecting an appropriate analytical form is nontrivial. This study proposes a physics-informed framework for discovering yield functions from full-field displacement data and reaction force data, without stress observations, plastic strain measurements, direct yield surface data, or a prescribed parametric yield function. The framework identifies the yield function as a mechanically constrained constitutive component inside elastoplastic stress integration, rather than through direct stress-space supervision. The yield function is represented by a convex neural network that enforces convexity and positive homogeneity of degree one while imposing the assumed tension-compression symmetry, and this neural yield function is trained with a differentiable stress update and a physics-informed force equilibrium loss across multiple loading cases. The proposed framework is validated using finite element (FE) benchmark studies with von Mises, Hill 1948, and Yld2000-2d yield functions, assessing yield contour agreement, displacement-noise sensitivity, identifiability through plastically active stress states, epistemic uncertainty, and polynomial-surrogate deployment. This study provides a mechanics-constrained pathway for discovering anisotropic yield functions from displacement and force data while keeping the identified component within the structure of elastoplastic stress integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理信息框架，用于从全场位移和反作用力数据中发现各向异性屈服函数，无需应力观测、塑性应变测量或预设的解析屈服函数。屈服函数由凸神经网络表示，强制凸性和正齐次性，并在可微应力更新中通过力平衡损失训练。在有限元基准中针对von Mises、Hill 1948和Yld2000-2d验证，评估了屈服轮廓吻合度、噪声敏感性和不确定性。
Motivation: 各向异性屈服函数的识别困难，因为屈服无法直接观测，标定需要多个加载方向，且选择合适的解析形式具有挑战性。
Method: 提出一个物理信息框架，将屈服函数表示为凸神经网络（强制凸性和一次齐次性），作为弹塑性应力积分中的力学约束组件，通过可微应力更新和跨多个加载案例的物理信息力平衡损失进行训练。
Result: 在有限元基准研究中，针对von Mises、Hill 1948和Yld2000-2d屈服函数进行验证，评估了屈服轮廓吻合度、位移噪声敏感性、可识别性、认知不确定性及多项式代理部署。
Conclusion: 该研究提供了一条力学约束途径，可从位移和力数据中发现各向异性屈服函数，同时保持识别组件在弹塑性应力积分结构内。

papers.title: Protein Representation Learning with Secondary-Structure and Energy-Filtered Hydrogen-Bond Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph-based representations are widely used in protein modeling, yet many existing approaches rely primarily on sequence adjacency or geometric proximity, which only partially reflect the principles governing protein folding. Proteins instead adopt complex three-dimensional conformations organized around secondary structure elements, such as $α$-helices and $β$-sheets, which encode recurring local motifs and stabilizing hydrogen-bond interactions. In this work, we introduce a secondary-structure-aware graph neural network for protein representation learning. Residue-level node representations are augmented with secondary structure assignments, and graph edges are constructed from hydrogen-bond interactions filtered by their energetic strength. This design enables the model to capture both local structural context and long-range couplings that are central to protein stability and function. We evaluate the proposed approach on commonly used protein benchmarks and observe consistent improvements over existing graph-based methods. In addition, the resulting graph representations offer enhanced biological interpretability, as the learned connectivity aligns with established structural motifs. These findings suggest that incorporating secondary structure and energy-filtered hydrogen-bond topology provides an effective inductive bias for protein representation learning. The code is released at https://github.com/mohamedmohamed2021/SSProNet
papers.journal_ref: The 25th International Workshop on Data Mining in Bioinformatics (BIOKDD 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于二级结构和能量过滤氢键图的图神经网络用于蛋白质表示学习。节点表示融合二级结构标签，边由氢键强度过滤构建，旨在同时捕获局部结构上下文和长期耦合。在常用蛋白质基准上，该方法比现有图方法取得一致提升，且表示具有更好的生物可解释性。
Motivation: 现有基于图的蛋白质建模多依赖序列邻接或几何邻近，未能充分反映蛋白质折叠的结构原理，特别是二级结构元件（α-螺旋和β-折叠）及其稳定的氢键相互作用。
Method: 提出二级结构感知的图神经网络：残基节点表示增强二级结构指派；图边由能量过滤的氢键相互作用构建，仅保留强氢键连接。
Result: 在常用蛋白质基准上，该方法相比现有图方法获得一致改进，且学到的图连接与已知结构基序对齐，增强生物可解释性。
Conclusion: 融入二级结构和能量过滤氢键拓扑为蛋白质表示学习提供了有效归纳偏置。

papers.title: cAPM: Continual AI-Assisted Pace-Mapping with Active Learning
papers.abstract_en: Ventricular tachycardia is a life-threatening rhythm disorder and a major cause of sudden cardiac death. Pace-mapping is a clinical procedure for identifying the intervention target during catheter ablation of VT. It requires clinicians to pace different sites in the ventricles and rapidly interpret the resulting electrocardiograms to determine where to pace next or whether a target site has been identified. Active learning AI models have been proposed to guide clinicians to the next pacing site, showing promise in reducing the number of pacing sites and improving the efficiency of pace-mapping. Existing methods require retraining each target without the ability to transfer knowledge across multiple VTs within the same patient or across patients. We introduce cAPM for continuous AI-assisted pace-mapping to capture and transfer knowledge accumulated from past pace-mapping data to reduce the number of pace-mapping data needed for future target VTs. This is made possible by a task-agnostic surrogate neural network that learns the mapping from pacing sites to 12-lead ECG morphology, an active-learning strategy that refines this surrogate model by selecting the most informative pacing site for each target, and a continual learning strategy to do so sequentially while retaining knowledge from prior targets. Evaluated on an in-silico testbed consisting of sequentially-presented localization tasks across different physiological conditions and ventricular geometries, cAPM with and without replay of past data samples achieved an 81% probability of localizing within clinical tolerance (5 mm accuracy) using 4.5 pace-mapping sites, compared to the state-of-the-art active-learning method achieving 38% probability using 13.7 pacing sites. These results provide a strong basis for preparing cAPM towards in-vivo preclinical and clinical studies where it can be used to guide pace-mapping.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出cAPM，一种持续AI辅助起搏标测方法，通过任务无关的代理神经网络学习起搏点到12导联ECG形态的映射，结合主动学习和持续学习策略，在连续呈现的定位任务中迁移知识，减少所需起搏点数量。在计算机模拟测试中，cAPM使用4.5个起搏点达到81%的定位成功率（5mm精度），显著优于现有主动学习方法的38%成功率和13.7个起搏点。
Motivation: 现有主动学习AI方法在起搏标测中需要针对每个靶点重新训练，无法跨多个室性心动过速（VT）或跨患者迁移知识，导致数据效率低下。
Method: cAPM包含三个组件：任务无关的代理神经网络（学习起搏点到12导联ECG形态的映射）、主动学习策略（选择最具信息量的起搏点以改进代理模型）、持续学习策略（顺序学习多个靶点并保留先前知识）。
Result: 在包含不同生理条件和心室几何形状的连续定位任务计算机模拟中，cAPM（无重放重放旧数据）使用4.5个起搏点达到81%概率在临床容差（5mm精度）内定位，而现有主动学习方法使用13.7个起搏点仅有38%概率。
Conclusion: cAPM的结果为将其应用于体内临床前和临床研究以指导起搏标测提供了坚实基础。

summary_sections.result: 在包含不同生理条件和心室几何形状的连续定位任务计算机模拟中，cAPM（无重放重放旧数据）使用4.5个起搏点达到81%概率在临床容差（5mm精度）内定位，而现有主动学习方法使用13.7个起搏点仅有38%概率。
summary_sections.conclusion: cAPM的结果为将其应用于体内临床前和临床研究以指导起搏标测提供了坚实基础。

papers.title: Full-Self Diagnostics (FSD): Physics-Grounded Visual Biomarker Inference from Smartphone Video via Inverse Problems and Operator Learning
papers.abstract_en: We present Full-Self Diagnostics (FSD), a unified mathematical framework for recovering latent physiological states from unconstrained 9-second facial videos captured by consumer smartphones. The approach integrates five mutually reinforcing components: (1) a physics-based forward model derived from the radiative transfer equation and chromophore absorption that maps camera observables to biomarker concentrations; (2) an information-theoretic observability theory proving that multi-channel visual signals (spectral, pulse, respiratory, micro-expression, and oculomotor) contain strictly increasing mutual information with physiological state; (3) a stable, Tikhonov-regularized inverse problem with domain-uniform identifiability guarantees; (4) an operator-learning formulation that enables generalization across devices, resolutions, and populations; and (5) a supervised learning procedure, interpretable as stochastic variational inference, that continuously refines the model from paired biosensor ground truth with performance improving proportionally to one over the square root of the number of paired observations. Empirical validation on 38812 real-world paired scans across 59 subjects demonstrates practical performance. Self-collected data from the lead author (glucose range 35-550 mg/dL) yields MARD of 29.86 percent with 97.57 percent of predictions in Clarke Error Grid Zones A+B and only 0.27 percent in the dangerous Zone E. A well-managed diabetic participant achieves MARD of 17 percent in the narrower 70-180 mg/dL band. These results confirm that consumer-grade facial video encodes sufficient structured information for clinically relevant, non-invasive biomarker inference under fully unconstrained conditions, with performance scaling predictably as more paired data becomes available.
papers.comment: 38,812 paired scans, preliminary longitudinal validation of multichannel visual glucose inference (MARD 17 to 46 percent across cohorts); physics plus information theory plus operator learning framework

TL;DR: 本文提出Full-Self Diagnostics (FSD)框架，通过求解反问题从智能手机拍摄的9秒无约束面部视频中恢复潜在生理状态（如血糖）。该框架融合物理前向模型、信息论可观测性、Tikhonov正则化反问题、算子学习和可解释为随机变分推断的监督学习。在38812个真实配对扫描上验证，血糖预测MARD为29.86%，97.57%在Clarke Error Grid A+B区，仅0.27%在危险E区；管理良好的糖尿病参与者MARD为17%（70-180 mg/dL范围）。

Conclusion: 消费者级面部视频编码了足够结构化信息，可在完全无约束条件下进行临床相关的非侵入性生物标志物推断，且性能随更多配对数据可预测地提升。

papers.title: ProMUSE: Progressive Multi-modal Uncertainty-guided Staged Evidential Alzheimer Disease Classification
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a fatal disorder that destroys memory and cognitive skills in the elderly population. Most treatments for AD are effective in the early stage, leading to an increasing demand for early AD diagnosis. AD diagnosis increasingly relies on multimodal data such as clinical assessments, structural Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), and Positron Emission Tomography (PET) imaging. However, MRI and PET acquisition remain costly and not universally accessible, making full-modality inference impractical in real-world clinical workflows. We propose ProMUSE, a Progressive Multi-modal Uncertainty Guided Staged Evidential Network that adaptively determines when additional modalities are necessary, helping reduce the overall cost of data acquisition while maintaining accuracy. ProMUSE first performs evidential classification using low-cost clinical data and quantifies uncertainty via a Dirichlet-based subjective logic model. When uncertainty exceeds a learned threshold, ProMUSE progressively incorporates MRI or PET features, fusing modality-wise belief and uncertainty through Dempster-Shafer theory to obtain a calibrated multimodal prediction. This staged acquisition strategy enables accurate diagnosis while minimizing reliance on expensive imaging. Experiments on ADNI, AIBL, and OASIS across CN-AD, CN-MCI, and MCI-AD tasks demonstrate that ProMUSE achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to full-modality baselines while reducing MRI/PET usage by 50-90%, yielding substantial cost savings. These results highlight ProMUSE as a practical, uncertainty-aware, and resource-efficient solution for real-world AD screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProMUSE，一种渐进式多模态不确定性引导的分阶段证据网络，用于阿尔茨海默病分类。该方法首先利用低成本临床数据进行证据分类，通过狄利克雷主观逻辑模型量化不确定性；当不确定性超过学习阈值时，逐步引入MRI或PET特征，并使用Dempster-Shafer理论融合模态信念和不确定性。在ADNI、AIBL和OASIS数据集上的实验表明，ProMUSE在保持竞争性或更优准确率的同时，将MRI/PET使用量减少50-90%，大幅降低数据采集成本。
Motivation: AD诊断依赖多模态数据（临床评估、MRI、PET），但MRI和PET获取成本高且非普遍可及，导致全模态推断在临床实践中不实用。需要一种方法自适应决定何时需要额外模态，以降低数据获取成本同时保持诊断准确性。
Method: 提出ProMUSE，采用渐进式多模态不确定性引导的分阶段证据网络。首先仅使用低成本临床数据进行证据分类，通过Dirichlet主观逻辑模型量化不确定性；当不确定性超过可学习阈值时，逐步融合MRI或PET特征，利用Dempster-Shafer理论进行模态级信念和不确定性的融合，得到校准的多模态预测。
Result: 在ADNI、AIBL和OASIS数据集上，针对CN-AD、CN-MCI和MCI-AD分类任务，ProMUSE达到与全模态基线相当或更优的准确率，同时将MRI/PET使用量减少50-90%，显著节约成本。
Conclusion: ProMUSE是一种实用、不确定感知且资源高效的AD筛查方案，通过分阶段获取模态数据在保持准确性的同时降低临床成本。

papers.title: Human-like autonomy emerges from self-play and a pinch of human data
papers.abstract_en: Self-play reinforcement learning has recently emerged as a way to train driving policies without any human data. It uses cheap, large-scale simulations to substitute expensive, large-scale human driving demonstrations. A key limitation of this approach is that policies trained through pure self-play can learn effective but alien driving conventions incompatible with people. Previous works attempt to mitigate such behavioral misalignments through extensive reward engineering and domain randomization, which are brittle and labor-intensive. Instead of completely discarding human demonstrations, our method treats them as a regularization objective on top of a minimal safe goal-reaching reward. Like the spice in a good stew, we find that a little human data goes a long way: our method uses only 30 minutes of human demonstrations, 2500x fewer than comparable imitation learning approaches. Resulting policies coordinate with held-out human trajectories and complete training in 15 hours on a single consumer-grade GPU. Videos and full source code are available at https://spiced-self-play.com/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合自我对弈强化学习和少量人类演示数据的方法，用于训练自动驾驶策略。摘要称仅需30分钟人类数据（比模仿学习少2500倍）即可训练出与人类轨迹协调的策略，并在单张消费级GPU上15小时完成训练。代码和视频已开源。
Motivation: 纯自我对弈策略学习有效但会产生与人类驾驶习惯不兼容的行为，而精细的奖励工程和域随机化方法脆弱且劳动密集。提出将人类演示作为正则化目标以缓解对齐问题。
Method: 以最小安全目标导向奖励为基础，将人类演示数据作为正则化项加入自我对弈强化学习。仅使用30分钟演示数据。
Result: 训练出的策略与留出的人类轨迹协调，训练时间15小时/单GPU，数据需求量仅模仿学习的1/2500。
Conclusion: 少量人类数据结合自我对弈可有效生成人性化自动驾驶策略，避免了纯自我对弈的行为不兼容。

papers.title: Zero-Inflated Gaussian Distributions Enable Parameter-Space Sparsity in Estimation-of-Distribution Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Estimation-of-distribution algorithms (EDAs) are a powerful class of evolutionary methods for black-box optimization, especially when little is known about the structure of the objective. Whereas classical evolutionary algorithms rely on hand-designed mutation and crossover operators, hard to devise for unknown problem structures, and a source of bias, EDAs sidestep operator design entirely: they fit a probability distribution to the best individuals and sample the next generation from it. EDAs are well established on continuous parameter spaces, but they have not previously been generalized to sparse ones, in which most coefficients of a good solution are exactly zero. Existing sparse black-box optimizers therefore reintroduce exactly what EDAs were designed to avoid: hand-crafted sparsity operators, bi-level schemes alternating between support set and active values, zeroing thresholds, and other baked-in assumptions. We close this gap by proposing multivariate zero-inflated Gaussian (ZIG) distributions as EDA sampling laws. A latent Gaussian model with separate indicator and value dimensions represents sparsity patterns, correlations among active parameters, and the interactions between the two, so sparsity patterns and active values are optimized jointly, hierarchy-free. We show that the latent parameters of this model are identifiable from observed samples, unlike in the missing-data settings where related constructions originate, and introduce practical amortized inversion-based estimators for them. The estimators accurately recover latent correlation structures, and on the Lunar Lander benchmark the resulting ZIG-EDA converges faster and reaches higher final returns than a dense Gaussian EDA, a hand-crafted sparse evolutionary algorithm, and an ad-hoc sparse EDA, while finding controllers with only a small fraction of parameters active.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用多元零膨胀高斯（ZIG）分布作为估计分布算法（EDA）的采样分布，以处理参数空间稀疏性问题。通过潜在高斯模型同时优化稀疏模式和活跃参数值，避免手工设计的稀疏算子。实验表明，在Lunar Lander基准上，ZIG-EDA收敛更快、最终回报更高，且找到的控制器仅激活少量参数。
Motivation: 现有EDA无法处理稀疏参数空间，而现有稀疏黑盒优化器需要手工设计稀疏算子、双层方案或零阈值，违背EDA避免手工设计的初衷。
Method: 提出多元零膨胀高斯分布作为EDA的采样分布，采用潜在高斯模型联合建模稀疏模式、活跃参数间的相关性以及两者交互，并引入基于摊销逆的估计器。
Result: 在Lunar Lander基准上，ZIG-EDA比密集高斯EDA、手工稀疏进化算法和特设稀疏EDA收敛更快、最终回报更高，且控制器仅激活少量参数。
Conclusion: 零膨胀高斯分布有效实现了EDA的参数空间稀疏性，无需手工设计算子。
